  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font:
    600 11px ui-monospace,
    Consolas,
    monospace;
  color: rgba(230, 210, 195, 0.55);
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  z-index: 1;
}
@media (max-width: 820px) {
  .mn-tele {
    display: none;
  }
  #menuCol {
    margin-top: 40px;
  }
}
@media (max-height: 560px) {
  .mn-badge {
    display: none;
  }
}
@media (max-height: 620px) {
  #menuCol .sub {
    margin: 8px 0 14px;
  }
  .mn-ctrl {
    display: none;
  }
  .mbtn {
    padding: 8px 14px 8px 10px;
  }
  .mbtn .ic {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
  }
}

#introSkip {
  position: absolute;
  right: 2.4vw;
  bottom: 2.2vh;
  z-index: 80;
  pointer-events: auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  color: #e8f1ff;
  opacity: 0.72;
  transition: opacity 0.2s;
  font:
    600 12px "Segoe UI",
    system-ui,
    sans-serif;
}
#introSkip:hover {
  opacity: 1;
}
#introSkip button {
  position: relative;
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: none;
  background: rgba(10, 16, 36, 0.6);
  color: #fff;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  padding: 0;
}
#introSkip svg {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  transform: rotate(-90deg);
}
#introSkip circle {
  fill: none;
  stroke-width: 2.4;
}
#introSkip circle.bg {
  stroke: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
}
#introSkip #introSkipRing {
  stroke: #ff8c42;
  stroke-dasharray: 100;
  stroke-dashoffset: 100;
  stroke-linecap: round;
}
#introSkip span {
  position: relative;
  font-size: 14px;
}
#introSkip b {
  display: block;
  font-size: 13px;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
}
#introSkip small {
  color: #9aa6c8;
}
#introSkip kbd {
  font:
    700 10px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 0 4px;
}
/* ===== iletişim terminali ===== */
.cm-con {
  width: min(940px, 96vw) !important;
  height: min(660px, 84vh);
  max-height: 84vh;
}
#ui.con-open #commBadge {
  display: none;
}
#ui.comm-open #toast {
  top: calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px));
  bottom: auto;
  font-size: 16px;
}
.cm-tabs {
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 10px 16px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bd);
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
}
.cm-tabs button {
  font:
    700 12.5px "Segoe UI",
    system-ui,
    sans-serif;
  color: var(--m);
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-bottom: none;
  border-radius: 10px 10px 0 0;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}
.cm-tabs button:hover {
  color: var(--t);
}
.cm-tabs button.on {
  color: var(--t);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(90, 209, 255, 0.14), rgba(90, 209, 255, 0.02));
  border-color: var(--bd);
}
.cm-tabs em {
  font:
    800 10px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  font-style: normal;
  background: #ff8c42;
  color: #1d0c04;
  border-radius: 9px;
  padding: 1px 6px;
}
.cm-tabs em.g {
  background: #4ade80;
}
.cm-tabs em.b {
  background: #5ad1ff;
}
.cm-body {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: hidden !important;
}
.cm-link {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  font-size: 11px;
}
.cm-link i {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: currentColor;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px currentColor;
  animation: cmBlink 1.2s infinite;
}
.cm-link.ok {
  color: #4ade80;
  border-color: rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.4);
  background: rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.07);
}
.cm-link.warn {
  color: #d9f99d;
  border-color: rgba(163, 230, 53, 0.45);
  background: rgba(163, 230, 53, 0.07);
}
.cm-link.err {
  color: #ff7b7b;
  border-color: rgba(255, 90, 90, 0.45);
  background: rgba(255, 90, 90, 0.08);
}
@keyframes cmBlink {
  50% {
    opacity: 0.25;
  }
}
.cm-cols {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.25fr 1fr;
  gap: 16px;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 0;
}
.cm-col {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 9px;
  min-height: 0;
}
.cm-obs {
  flex: 1;
  overflow: auto;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 7px;
  padding-right: 4px;
  min-height: 0;
}
.cm-ob {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 18px 34px 1fr auto;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: start;
  padding: 9px 10px;
  border-radius: 11px;
  cursor: pointer;
  border: 1px solid rgba(141, 156, 192, 0.18);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  transition: 0.15s;
}
.cm-ob:hover {
  border-color: rgba(90, 209, 255, 0.35);
}
.cm-ob.off {
  opacity: 0.45;
}
.cm-ob input {
  accent-color: #ff8c42;
  margin-top: 9px;
  width: 15px;
  height: 15px;
}
.cm-ob .ic {
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  border-radius: 9px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  font-size: 18px;
  background: #111a38;
  border: 1px solid rgba(141, 156, 192, 0.22);
}
.cm-ob .tx b {
  font-size: 13.5px;
}
.cm-ob .tx em {
  font:
    600 10.5px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  color: var(--m);
  font-style: normal;
  margin-left: 4px;
}
.cm-ob .tx small {
  display: block;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #b7c3e0;
  line-height: 1.45;
  margin-top: 3px;
}
.cm-empty {
  margin: auto;
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--t);
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  padding: 30px;
}
.cm-empty small {
  color: var(--m);
  font-size: 12.5px;
}
#cmNote {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 110px;
  resize: vertical;
  border-radius: 11px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(141, 156, 192, 0.3);
  background: #0a1024;
  color: var(--t);
  font:
    500 13.5px/1.5 "Segoe UI",
    system-ui,
    sans-serif;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  outline: none;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
#cmNote:focus {
  border-color: var(--c);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(90, 209, 255, 0.12);
}
.cm-quick {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 5px;
}
.cm-quick .chip {
  font:
    600 11.5px "Segoe UI",
    system-ui,
    sans-serif;
  color: #cdd6f0;
  background: #111a38;
  border: 1px solid rgba(141, 156, 192, 0.3);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 4px 9px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.cm-quick .chip:hover {
  border-color: var(--c);
  color: var(--t);
}
.cm-prio {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 8px;
}
.cm-prio button {
  font:
    800 12.5px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  color: var(--m);
  background: #111a38;
  border: 1px solid rgba(141, 156, 192, 0.28);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.cm-prio button small {
  display: block;
  font:
    600 10.5px "Segoe UI",
    sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.cm-prio button.on {
  color: #5ad1ff;
  border-color: #5ad1ff;
  background: rgba(90, 209, 255, 0.1);
}
.cm-prio button.acil.on {
  color: #ff7b7b;
  border-color: #ff7b7b;
  background: rgba(255, 90, 90, 0.1);
}
.cm-sum {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 6px 14px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border-radius: 11px;
  border: 1px dashed rgba(141, 156, 192, 0.3);
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
  font:
    600 11.5px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
}
.cm-sum div {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
}
.cm-sum span {
  color: var(--m);
}
.cm-sum b {
  color: var(--t);
}
.cm-sum .mut {
  grid-column: 1/-1;
  color: var(--m);
}
.cm-inbox {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 270px 1fr;
  gap: 14px;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 0;
}
.cm-list {
  overflow: auto;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  padding-right: 4px;
  min-height: 0;
}
.cm-it {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 8px 1fr auto;
  gap: 9px;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 9px 10px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  cursor: pointer;
  border: 1px solid rgba(141, 156, 192, 0.16);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.025);
}
.cm-it:hover {
  border-color: rgba(90, 209, 255, 0.32);
}
.cm-it.sel {
  border-color: var(--c);
  background: rgba(90, 209, 255, 0.08);
}
.cm-it .dot {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
}
.cm-it.unread .dot {
  background: #ff8c42;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px #ff8c42;
}
.cm-it .tx {
  min-width: 0;
}
.cm-it .tx b {
  display: block;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}
.cm-it.unread .tx b {
  color: #fff;
}
.cm-it:not(.unread) .tx b {
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #b7c3e0;
}
.cm-it .tx small {
  display: block;
  font:
    600 10.5px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  color: var(--m);
  margin-top: 2px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}
.cm-it .tag {
  font:
    800 9px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  padding: 3px 6px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  color: #5ad1ff;
  border: 1px solid rgba(90, 209, 255, 0.35);
}
.cm-it .tag.st {
  color: #ffd2a8;
  border-color: rgba(255, 170, 90, 0.45);
}
.cm-it .tag.al {
  color: #ff7b7b;
  border-color: rgba(255, 90, 90, 0.45);
}
.cm-it .tag.br {
  color: #4ade80;
  border-color: rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.4);
}
.cm-it .tag.ai {
  color: #c4b5fd;
  border-color: rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.5);
}
.cm-read {
  overflow: auto;
  min-height: 0;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: #0a1024;
  padding: 14px;
}
/* resmî mektup */
.ltr {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fbf8f1, #f1ece0);
  color: #1d2333;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 22px 26px 16px;
  font:
    14px/1.62 Georgia,
    "Times New Roman",
    serif;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
  position: relative;
  animation: conIn 0.25s ease-out;
}
.ltr::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 8px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(29, 35, 51, 0.12);
  border-radius: 3px;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.ltr-hd {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  padding-bottom: 12px;
  border-bottom: 2.5px double #1d2b4f;
}
.ltr-seal {
  width: 52px;
  height: 52px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  flex: 0 0 52px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  align-content: center;
  color: #fbf8f1;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #c0392b, #7a1a12);
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 3px #fbf8f1,
    0 0 0 4.5px #7a1a12;
  font:
    800 11px "Segoe UI",
    sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  line-height: 1.1;
}
.ltr-seal span {
  font-size: 8px;
  opacity: 0.85;
}
.ltr-org {
  flex: 1;
}
.ltr-org b {
  display: block;
  font:
    800 14px "Segoe UI",
    system-ui,
    sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  color: #1d2b4f;
}
.ltr-org span {
  font:
    italic 12px Georgia,
    serif;
  color: #5b6178;
}
.ltr-cls {
  font:
    800 11px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  color: #1d2b4f;
  border: 1.5px solid #1d2b4f;
  padding: 5px 8px;
  text-align: center;
  transform: rotate(2deg);
}
.ltr-cls small {
  font-size: 8.5px;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
}
.ltr-cls.acil {
  color: #b91c1c;
  border-color: #b91c1c;
}
.ltr-meta {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  margin: 12px 0 6px;
  font:
    12px ui-monospace,
    Consolas,
    monospace;
}
.ltr-meta td {
  padding: 3px 6px;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted rgba(29, 35, 51, 0.25);
}
.ltr-meta td:nth-child(odd) {
  color: #6b7186;
  width: 72px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-size: 10.5px;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
}
.ltr-body p {
  margin: 9px 0;
}
.ltr-body h4 {
  font:
    800 13px "Segoe UI",
    system-ui,
    sans-serif;
  color: #1d2b4f;
  margin: 16px 0 4px;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  border-left: 3px solid #c0392b;
  padding-left: 8px;
}
.ltr-body h4 small {
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #6b7186;
}
.ltr-body blockquote {
  margin: 8px 0;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-left: 3px solid #8d94b2;
  background: rgba(29, 43, 79, 0.06);
  font-style: italic;
  color: #3a4256;
}
.ltr-dir {
  margin: 8px 0 4px;
  padding: 8px 12px 6px;
  background: rgba(29, 43, 79, 0.06);
  border: 1px solid rgba(29, 43, 79, 0.18);
  border-radius: 4px;
}
.ltr-dir > b {
  font:
    800 10.5px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  color: #c0392b;
}
.ltr-dir ol,
.ltr-body ol {
  margin: 4px 0 2px;
  padding-left: 22px;
}
.ltr-dir li {
  margin: 3px 0;
}
.ltr kbd {
  font:
    700 11px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  border: 1px solid #8d94b2;
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 0 4px;
  background: #fff;
}
.ltr-ul {
  margin: 4px 0;
  padding-left: 20px;
}
.ltr-ul li {
  margin: 3px 0;
}
.ltr .ok {
  color: #15803d;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.ltr .bad {
  color: #b91c1c;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.ltr-sci {
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  background: rgba(29, 43, 79, 0.12);
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 2px 0 8px;
}
.ltr-sci i {
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #1d4ed8, #22c55e);
}
.ltr-annex {
  margin: 14px 0 6px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(29, 43, 79, 0.25);
  border-radius: 4px;
  overflow: hidden;
  font:
    12px ui-monospace,
    Consolas,
    monospace;
}
.ltr-annex .ah {
  background: #1d2b4f;
  color: #fbf8f1;
  padding: 5px 10px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  font-size: 10.5px;
}
.ltr-annex table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}
.ltr-annex td {
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-top: 1px dotted rgba(29, 35, 51, 0.2);
}
.ltr-annex td:first-child {
  width: 62px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #1d2b4f;
}
.ltr-annex .an {
  padding: 4px 10px;
  color: #6b7186;
  font-size: 10.5px;
  border-top: 1px dotted rgba(29, 35, 51, 0.2);
}
.fx {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 1px 6px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  margin: 1px 4px 1px 0;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.fx.st {
  background: rgba(234, 88, 12, 0.13);
  color: #9a3412;
}
.fx.rd {
  background: rgba(101, 163, 13, 0.15);
  color: #3f6212;
}
.fx.ok {
  color: #15803d;
}
.ltr-sign {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px 34px;
  margin-top: 16px;
}
.ltr-sign div {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.ltr-autog {
  font:
    italic 22px "Brush Script MT",
    "Segoe Script",
    "Lucida Handwriting",
    cursive;
  color: #1d3a8a;
  transform: rotate(-4deg);
  margin-bottom: -2px;
}
.ltr-sign b {
  font:
    700 13px "Segoe UI",
    system-ui,
    sans-serif;
  border-top: 1px solid #1d2333;
  padding-top: 3px;
  min-width: 150px;
}
.ltr-sign span {
  font:
    12px Georgia,
    serif;
  color: #5b6178;
}
.ltr-cc {
  margin-top: 12px;
  font:
    11.5px Georgia,
    serif;
  color: #5b6178;
}
.ltr-ft {
  margin-top: 12px;
  padding-top: 7px;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(29, 35, 51, 0.15);
  font:
    10px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  color: #8d94b2;
  text-align: center;
}
/* gönderilenler */
.gs {
  height: 100%;
  overflow: auto;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
  padding-right: 4px;
}
.gs > * {
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.gs-hero {
  display: flex;
  gap: 14px;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bd);
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(11, 61, 145, 0.35), rgba(90, 209, 255, 0.06));
}
.gs-mk {
  flex: 0 0 58px;
  height: 58px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #2f6fd6, #0b3d91 70%);
  color: #fff;
  font:
    900 15px "Segoe UI",
    system-ui,
    sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15),
    0 6px 18px rgba(11, 61, 145, 0.5);
}
.gs-hero b {
  display: block;
  color: var(--t);
  font-size: 15px;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}
.gs-hero p {
  margin: 3px 0 0;
  color: var(--m);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.gs-sec {
  font:
    800 10.5px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  color: #7fd6ff;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin: 2px 0 -4px;
}
.gs-path {
  display: flex;
  align-items: stretch;
  overflow-x: auto;
  padding: 4px 0;
}
.gs-node {
  flex: 1 1 0;
  min-width: 112px;
  padding: 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bd);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035);
  text-align: center;
}
.gs-node i {
  font-style: normal;
  font-size: 22px;
  display: block;
}
.gs-node b {
  display: block;
  color: var(--t);
  font-size: 12px;
  margin-top: 3px;
}
.gs-node small {
  display: block;
  color: var(--m);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  margin-top: 2px;
  line-height: 1.35;
}
.gs-node.on {
  border-color: rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.55);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.25);
}
.gs-node.off {
  border-color: rgba(255, 107, 107, 0.5);
  opacity: 0.75;
}
.gs-ar {
  flex: 0 0 40px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  color: #5ad1ff;
  font-size: 16px;
  position: relative;
}
.gs-ar span {
  position: absolute;
  top: 8px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  font:
    700 8.5px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  color: var(--m);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.gs-ar.off {
  color: #ff6b6b;
}
.gs-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 10px;
}
.gs-card {
  padding: 12px 13px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bd);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  position: relative;
}
.gs-card h5 {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--t);
  font-size: 13.5px;
  padding-right: 4px;
}
.gs-card .loc {
  color: var(--m);
  font-size: 11px;
  margin: 3px 0 8px;
}
.gs-card ul {
  margin: 0;
  padding-left: 16px;
  color: var(--t);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.55;
}
.gs-card .st {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-bottom: 7px;
  font:
    800 9.5px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  padding: 3px 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  color: var(--m);
}
.gs-card .st.on {
  background: rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.16);
  color: #4ade80;
}
.gs-card .st.err {
  background: rgba(255, 107, 107, 0.16);
  color: #ff8a8a;
}
.gs-card.gs-on {
  border-color: rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.45);
}
.gs-card .role {
  display: inline-block;
  font:
    800 9.5px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  color: #ffd166;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.gs-ant {
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.gs-ant span {
  font:
    700 10.5px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  color: #bfe9ff;
  background: rgba(90, 209, 255, 0.08);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 2px 6px;
}
.gs-kv {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 10px;
}
.gs-kv div {
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bd);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
}
.gs-kv span {
  display: block;
  color: var(--m);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}
.gs-kv b {
  display: block;
  color: var(--t);
  font:
    800 16px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  margin-top: 3px;
}
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .gs-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .gs-kv {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr) !important;
  }
}
.gs-mk.sm {
  flex: 0 0 40px;
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  font-size: 10.5px;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}
.np-card {
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bd);
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: rgba(11, 61, 145, 0.12);
}
.np-hd {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.np-hd small {
  display: block;
  font:
    800 9.5px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  color: #7fd6ff;
}
.np-hd b {
  color: var(--t);
  font-size: 15px;
}
.np-kv {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: max-content 1fr;
  gap: 5px 14px;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12.5px;
}
.np-kv dt {
  color: var(--m);
}
.np-kv dd {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--t);
}
.np-note {
  margin-top: 8px;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--m);
  font-style: italic;
}
.np-crew {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0 0 12px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}
.np-crew b {
  display: block;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 13.5px;
}
.np-crew small {
  display: block;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
  font-size: 11px;
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.ar-kv {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 8px;
}
.ar-kv div {
  padding: 9px 11px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bd);
  border-radius: 11px;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
}
.ar-kv div.bad {
  border-color: rgba(255, 107, 107, 0.5);
}
.ar-kv span {
  display: block;
  color: var(--m);
  font-size: 11px;
}
.ar-kv b {
  display: block;
  color: var(--t);
  font:
    800 14px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  margin: 2px 0;
}
.ar-kv small {
  color: var(--m);
  font-size: 10.5px;
}
.ar-segs {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 10px;
}
.ar-seg {
  padding: 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bd);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
}
.ar-sh {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.ar-sh i {
  font-style: normal;
  font-size: 18px;
}
.ar-sh b {
  color: var(--t);
  font-size: 13px;
  flex: 1;
}
.ar-seg p {
  margin: 6px 0 8px;
  color: var(--m);
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.45;
}
.ar-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  padding: 3px 0;
  border-top: 1px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
}
.ar-row span {
  color: var(--m);
}
.ar-row b {
  color: var(--t);
  font-weight: 600;
  text-align: right;
}
.ar-pill {
  font:
    800 9px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  padding: 2px 7px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 209, 102, 0.15);
  color: #ffd166;
}
.ar-pill.ok {
  background: rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.15);
  color: #4ade80;
}
.ar-pill.bad {
  background: rgba(255, 107, 107, 0.16);
  color: #ff8a8a;
}
.ar-tls {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0;
  position: relative;
  padding: 6px 0;
}
.ar-tl {
  flex: 1;
  text-align: center;
  position: relative;
  padding-top: 20px;
}
.ar-tl::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 7px;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 2px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
}
.ar-tl.done::before {
  background: #5ad1ff;
}
.ar-tl i {
  position: absolute;
  top: 1px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #2a3348;
  border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
}
.ar-tl.done i {
  background: #5ad1ff;
  border-color: #5ad1ff;
}
.ar-tl.now i {
  background: #ff8c42;
  border-color: #ffd1b0;
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px #ff8c42;
}
.ar-tl b {
  display: block;
  color: var(--t);
  font-size: 12px;
}
.ar-tl small {
  display: block;
  color: var(--m);
  font-size: 10.5px;
}
.ar-cmls {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
  gap: 8px;
}
.ar-cml {
  padding: 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bd);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
}
.ar-cml em {
  display: block;
  font:
    800 10px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  letter-spacing: 1.5px;
  color: #5ad1ff;
  font-style: normal;
}
.ar-cml b {
  display: block;
  color: var(--t);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  margin: 3px 0;
}
.ar-cml small {
  color: var(--m);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  line-height: 1.4;
  display: block;
}
.ar-cml.done em::after {
  content: " ✓";
  color: #4ade80;
}
.ar-cml.now {
  border-color: rgba(255, 140, 66, 0.5);
  background: rgba(255, 140, 66, 0.07);
}
.ar-cml.now em {
  color: #ff8c42;
}
.ar-subs {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 8px;
}
.ar-sub {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 12px 170px 1fr;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 9px 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bd);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
}
.ar-sub .d {
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #ffd166;
}
.ar-sub .d.ok {
  background: #4ade80;
}
.ar-sub .d.bad {
  background: #ff6b6b;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px #ff6b6b;
}
.ar-sub b {
  color: var(--t);
  font-size: 12px;
}
.ar-sub small {
  color: var(--m);
  font-size: 11.5px;
}
.ar-src {
  font-size: 10.5px;
  color: var(--m);
  font-style: italic;
  line-height: 1.5;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
  padding-top: 8px;
}
@media (max-width: 860px) {
  .ar-segs {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }
  .ar-cmls {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }
  .ar-subs {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .ar-sub {
    grid-template-columns: 12px 130px 1fr;
  }
}
#mdScreen {
  z-index: 45;
  background:
    radial-gradient(1200px 700px at 70% 20%, rgba(30, 60, 120, 0.35), transparent),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #05070f, #0b0f1d);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}
#mdScreen .md-wrap {
  width: min(1240px, 97vw);
  height: min(820px, 95vh);
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: rgba(10, 14, 26, 0.92);
  box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  overflow: hidden;
  --t: #e8f1ff;
  --m: #93a2c4;
  --bd: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09);
}
.md-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  padding: 16px 22px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bd);
}
.md-top .gs-mk {
  flex: 0 0 46px;
  height: 46px;
  font-size: 11px;
}
.md-top h2 {
  margin: 0;
  color: #fff;
  font:
    800 20px "Segoe UI",
    system-ui,
    sans-serif;
}
.md-top small {
  display: block;
  color: var(--m);
  font-size: 12px;
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.md-top .sp {
  flex: 1;
}
.md-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 210px 1fr 300px;
  min-height: 0;
}
#mdSteps {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 14px;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--bd);
  overflow: auto;
}
#mdSteps button {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: center;
  text-align: left;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--m);
  font:
    700 13px "Segoe UI",
    system-ui,
    sans-serif;
  cursor: pointer;
}
#mdSteps button i {
  font-style: normal;
  font-size: 16px;
}
#mdSteps button:hover {
  color: #fff;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
}
#mdSteps button.on {
  color: #fff;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 140, 66, 0.22), rgba(255, 140, 66, 0.05));
  border-color: rgba(255, 140, 66, 0.4);
}
#mdBody {
  overflow: auto;
  padding: 16px 20px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
}
#mdRes {
  overflow: auto;
  padding: 14px;
  border-left: 1px solid var(--bd);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
}
.md-rh {
  font:
    800 10.5px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  color: #7fd6ff;
}
.md-res {
  padding: 9px 11px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bd);
  border-radius: 11px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
}
.md-res.bad {
  border-color: rgba(255, 107, 107, 0.55);
  background: rgba(255, 107, 107, 0.07);
}
.md-rl {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--m);
}
.md-rl b {
  color: var(--t);
  font:
    700 12px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
}
.md-rb {
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  margin: 6px 0 5px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.md-rb i {
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #38bdf8, #4ade80);
}
.md-res.bad .md-rb i {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ff8c42, #ff5a5a);
}
.md-res small {
  color: var(--m);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  line-height: 1.35;
  display: block;
}
.md-iss,
.md-wrn,
.md-okk {
  font-size: 11.5px;
  line-height: 1.4;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border-radius: 10px;
}
.md-iss {
  background: rgba(255, 90, 90, 0.12);
  color: #ffb3b3;
}
.md-wrn {
  background: rgba(255, 209, 102, 0.1);
  color: #ffe0a0;
}
.md-okk {
  background: rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.1);
  color: #a9f5c4;
}
.md-h h3 {
  margin: 4px 0 2px;
  color: #fff;
  font:
    800 15.5px "Segoe UI",
    system-ui,
    sans-serif;
}
.md-h p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--m);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.md-role {
  padding: 9px 12px;
  border-radius: 11px;
  background: rgba(90, 209, 255, 0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(90, 209, 255, 0.25);
  color: #cfeeff;
  font-size: 12.5px;
}
.md-opts {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr));
  gap: 9px;
}
.md-opt {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  text-align: left;
  padding: 11px 12px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bd);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  color: var(--t);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  transition: 0.15s;
}
.md-opt:hover {
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
}
.md-opt.on {
  border-color: #ff8c42;
  background: rgba(255, 140, 66, 0.1);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 140, 66, 0.35);
}
.md-opt i {
  font-style: normal;
  font-size: 20px;
}
.md-opt b {
  font-size: 13px;
}
.md-opt small {
  color: var(--m);
  font-size: 11.3px;
  line-height: 1.4;
}
.md-st {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 4px;
  margin-top: 3px;
}
.md-st em {
  font:
    700 10px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  font-style: normal;
  color: #bfe9ff;
  background: rgba(90, 209, 255, 0.09);
  border-radius: 5px;
  padding: 2px 5px;
}
.md-seg {
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.md-seg button {
  padding: 8px 14px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bd);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  color: var(--t);
  font:
    700 12.5px "Segoe UI",
    system-ui,
    sans-serif;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.md-seg button.on {
  background: #ff8c42;
  color: #1d0c04;
  border-color: #ff8c42;
}
.md-team {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr));
  gap: 8px;
}
.md-team label {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--m);
}
.md-in {
  font:
    600 13px "Segoe UI",
    system-ui,
    sans-serif;
  color: #fff;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  border-radius: 9px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.md-roles {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 8px;
}
.md-rc {
  padding: 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bd);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 3px;
}
.md-rc i {
  font-style: normal;
  font-size: 18px;
}
.md-rc b {
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 12.5px;
}
.md-rc small {
  color: var(--m);
  font-size: 11px;
}
.md-rc em {
  font-style: normal;
  color: #ffb38a;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 12px;
  margin-top: 3px;
}
.md-simrow {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: center;
}
.md-sim {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 8px;
}
.md-sim div {
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bd);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
}
.md-sim span {
  display: block;
  color: var(--m);
  font-size: 11px;
}
.md-sim b {
  color: #fff;
  font:
    800 20px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
}
.md-sim em {
  font-style: normal;
  font-size: 11px;
  margin-left: 6px;
}
.md-sim em.up {
  color: #4ade80;
}
.md-sim em.dn {
  color: #ff8a8a;
}
.md-why {
  margin: 0;
  padding-left: 18px;
  color: var(--t);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}
.md-hist {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
}
.md-hist span {
  font:
    700 11px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  color: var(--m);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border-radius: 7px;
  padding: 4px 8px;
}
.md-appr {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
}
.md-appr button {
  padding: 9px 14px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bd);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  color: var(--t);
  font:
    700 12.5px "Segoe UI",
    system-ui,
    sans-serif;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.md-appr button.on {
  border-color: rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.6);
  background: rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.1);
}
.md-code {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto 1fr auto;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: center;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--m);
}
.m2-mini2 {
  font:
    700 12px "Segoe UI",
    system-ui,
    sans-serif;
  color: #fff;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
  border-radius: 9px;
  padding: 8px 11px;
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.md-go {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
.md-go small {
  color: var(--m);
  font-size: 12px;
}
.md-go .cbtn:disabled,
#mdSim:disabled {
  opacity: 0.45;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}
.md-lb {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: var(--t);
}
.md-lb th {
  color: var(--m);
  text-align: left;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 6px 8px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bd);
}
.md-lb td {
  padding: 7px 8px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}
.md-saved {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(240px, 1fr));
  gap: 8px;
}
.md-saved button {
  text-align: left;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bd);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  color: #fff;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 3px;
  font-family: "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
}
.md-saved small {
  color: var(--m);
  font-size: 11px;
}
.wr-score {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 14px;
  margin: 6px 0 10px;
}
.wr-score b {
  font:
    900 46px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  color: #fff;
}
.wr-score em {
  font:
    900 30px "Segoe UI",
    system-ui,
    sans-serif;
  font-style: normal;
  color: #ffd166;
  border: 2px solid #ffd166;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 0 12px;
}
.wr-parts {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
  gap: 3px 14px;
  text-align: left;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #cdd6f0;
  margin: 0 auto 10px;
  max-width: 330px;
}
.wr-parts b {
  color: #fff;
  font-family: ui-monospace, monospace;
}
.wr-why {
  text-align: left;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.55;
  color: #cdd6f0;
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  padding-left: 18px;
  max-height: 150px;
  overflow: auto;
}
@media (max-width: 980px) {
  .md-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  #mdSteps {
    flex-direction: row;
    overflow-x: auto;
    border-right: none;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bd);
  }
  #mdRes {
    border-left: none;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--bd);
    max-height: 220px;
  }
  .md-roles {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }
  .md-sim {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }
  .md-code {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  }
}
#ngScreen {
  z-index: 45;
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background:
    radial-gradient(900px 600px at 25% 15%, rgba(255, 120, 60, 0.16), transparent),
    radial-gradient(900px 700px at 80% 90%, rgba(40, 80, 160, 0.22), transparent),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #07080f, #0d0f1a);
}
.ng-wrap {
  width: min(1020px, 96vw);
  max-height: 94vh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: rgba(12, 14, 24, 0.94);
  box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  overflow: hidden;
  --t: #eef2fb;
  --m: #9aa5c0;
  --bd: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09);
}
.ng-top {
  padding: 22px 28px 14px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bd);
}
.ng-top small {
  display: block;
  font:
    800 11px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  letter-spacing: 0.3em;
  color: #ffb38a;
}
.ng-top h2 {
  margin: 6px 0 0;
  color: #fff;
  font:
    800 28px "Segoe UI",
    system-ui,
    sans-serif;
}
#ngBody {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;
  gap: 22px;
  padding: 20px 28px;
  overflow: auto;
}
.ng-left {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}
.ng-lbl {
  font:
    700 11.5px "Segoe UI",
    system-ui,
    sans-serif;
  color: var(--m);
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-top: 8px;
}
.ng-name {
  font-size: 15px;
  padding: 11px 13px;
}
.ng-modes {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 10px;
}
.ng-mode {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: center;
  text-align: left;
  padding: 14px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bd);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  color: var(--t);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  transition: 0.15s;
}
.ng-mode:hover {
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
}
.ng-mode.on {
  border-color: #ff8c42;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 140, 66, 0.16), rgba(255, 140, 66, 0.03));
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 140, 66, 0.4);
}
.ng-ic {
  flex: 0 0 46px;
  height: 46px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  color: #ffb38a;
}
.ng-ic svg {
  width: 30px;
  height: 30px;
}
.ng-mode.on .ng-ic {
  background: rgba(255, 140, 66, 0.2);
  color: #ffd2b3;
}
.ng-mode b {
  display: block;
  font-size: 15px;
}
.ng-mode small {
  display: block;
  color: var(--m);
  font-size: 12px;
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.ng-tg {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: 12px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bd);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
}
.ng-tg b {
  display: block;
  color: var(--t);
  font-size: 13.5px;
}
.ng-tg small {
  color: var(--m);
  font-size: 12px;
}
.ng-right {
  padding: 16px 18px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bd);
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}
.ng-right h4 {
  margin: 0;
  color: #fff;
  font:
    800 16px "Segoe UI",
    system-ui,
    sans-serif;
}
.ng-right p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--m);
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.55;
}
.ng-dl {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: max-content 1fr;
  gap: 6px 14px;
  margin: 6px 0 0;
  font-size: 12.5px;
}
.ng-dl dt {
  color: var(--m);
}
.ng-dl dd {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--t);
}
.ng-ul {
  margin: 4px 0 0;
  padding-left: 18px;
  color: var(--t);
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.7;
}
.ng-best {
  margin-top: auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 10px;
  padding-top: 10px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--bd);
}
.ng-best span {
  color: var(--m);
  font-size: 12px;
  flex: 1;
}
.ng-best b {
  color: #fff;
  font:
    800 22px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
}
.ng-best em {
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #ffd166;
}
.ng-foot {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 14px 28px 20px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--bd);
}
.ng-foot .cbtn {
  min-width: 180px;
}
#mdSteps button i {
  font-style: normal;
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  font:
    800 11.5px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
  color: var(--m);
}
#mdSteps button.on i {
  background: #ff8c42;
  color: #1d0c04;
}
.md-opt {
  position: relative;
  padding-right: 30px;
}
.md-ck {
  position: absolute;
  top: 12px;
  right: 12px;
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
}
.md-opt.on .md-ck {
  border-color: #ff8c42;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, #ff8c42 45%, transparent 50%);
}
.md-nav {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-top: 6px;
}
.md-nav .m2-mini2:disabled {
  opacity: 0.35;
}
.md-iss,
.md-wrn,
.md-okk {
  border-left: 3px solid;
}
.md-iss {
  border-color: #ff6b6b;
}
.md-wrn {
  border-color: #ffd166;
}
.md-okk {
  border-color: #4ade80;
}
.md-top .gs-mk {
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}
.ng-diffs {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 8px;
}
.ng-df {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 3px;
  padding: 12px 13px;
  border-radius: 13px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bd);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  color: var(--t);
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: left;
  font-family: "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  transition:
    border-color 0.2s,
    background 0.25s,
    transform 0.15s;
}
.ng-df:hover {
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.ng-df b {
  font-size: 14.5px;
}
.ng-df small {
  color: var(--m);
  font-size: 11.5px;
}
.ng-pips {
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.ng-pips i {
  width: 16px;
  height: 4px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  transition: background 0.3s;
}
.ng-df[data-lv="1"] {
  --c: #4ade80;
}
.ng-df[data-lv="2"] {
  --c: #ffb347;
}
.ng-df[data-lv="3"] {
  --c: #ff5d5d;
}
.ng-df[data-lv="1"] .ng-pips i:nth-child(-n + 1),
.ng-df[data-lv="2"] .ng-pips i:nth-child(-n + 2),
.ng-df[data-lv="3"] .ng-pips i {
  background: var(--c);
}
.ng-df.on {
  border-color: var(--c);
  background: linear-gradient(
    160deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 16%, transparent),
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02)
  );
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 45%, transparent),
    0 8px 22px -12px var(--c);
}
.ng-dbox {
  margin-top: 4px;
  padding: 13px 14px 12px;
  border-radius: 13px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bd);
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--c);
  transition: border-color 0.35s;
}
.ng-dbox[data-lv="1"] {
  --c: #4ade80;
}
.ng-dbox[data-lv="2"] {
  --c: #ffb347;
}
.ng-dbox[data-lv="3"] {
  --c: #ff5d5d;
}
.ng-dbox p {
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  color: var(--t);
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.55;
  min-height: 40px;
}
.ng-rows {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 7px;
}
.ng-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 128px 1fr 118px;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  font-size: 12.5px;
}
.ng-row span {
  color: var(--m);
}
.ng-bar {
  position: relative;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.ng-bar i {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: #9aa5c0;
  transition:
    width 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1),
    background 0.4s;
}
.ng-bar i.good {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #16a34a, #4ade80);
}
.ng-bar i.bad {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #c2410c, #ff5d5d);
}
.ng-bar u {
  position: absolute;
  left: 62.5%;
  top: -2px;
  bottom: -2px;
  width: 1px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
}
.ng-row em {
  font-style: normal;
  text-align: right;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--m);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.ng-row em.good {
  color: #4ade80;
}
.ng-row em.bad {
  color: #ff7a6b;
}
.ng-fade {
  animation: ngFade 0.35s ease;
}
.ng-pop {
  animation: ngPop 0.35s ease;
}
@keyframes ngFade {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(4px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}
@keyframes ngPop {
  0% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateX(6px);
  }
  100% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}
#ngScreen::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -50%;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0.55;
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(1.2px 1.2px at 20px 30px, #fff, transparent),
    radial-gradient(1px 1px at 140px 80px, #cfd8ff, transparent),
    radial-gradient(1.4px 1.4px at 260px 160px, #fff, transparent),
    radial-gradient(1px 1px at 90px 210px, #ffd2b3, transparent),
    radial-gradient(1px 1px at 330px 40px, #fff, transparent);
  background-size: 380px 260px;
  animation: ngStars 90s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes ngStars {
  to {
    transform: translate(380px, 260px);
  }
}
#ngScreen.ng-in {
  animation: ngBg 0.45s ease both;
}
#ngScreen.ng-in .ng-wrap {
  animation: ngWrap 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both;
}
#ngScreen.ng-in .ng-top > *,
#ngScreen.ng-in .ng-left > *,
#ngScreen.ng-in .ng-right,
#ngScreen.ng-in .ng-foot {
  animation: ngUp 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both;
}
#ngScreen.ng-in .ng-top > *:nth-child(2) {
  animation-delay: 0.08s;
}
#ngScreen.ng-in .ng-left > *:nth-child(1) {
  animation-delay: 0.12s;
}
#ngScreen.ng-in .ng-left > *:nth-child(2) {
  animation-delay: 0.16s;
}
#ngScreen.ng-in .ng-left > *:nth-child(3) {
  animation-delay: 0.2s;
}
#ngScreen.ng-in .ng-left > *:nth-child(4) {
  animation-delay: 0.24s;
}
#ngScreen.ng-in .ng-left > *:nth-child(5) {
  animation-delay: 0.3s;
}
#ngScreen.ng-in .ng-left > *:nth-child(6) {
  animation-delay: 0.36s;
}
#ngScreen.ng-in .ng-right {
  animation-delay: 0.22s;
}
#ngScreen.ng-in .ng-foot {
  animation-delay: 0.4s;
}
#ngScreen.ng-in .ng-bar i {
  animation: ngGrow 0.9s 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1) both;
}
#ngScreen.ng-out {
  animation: ngBgOut 0.3s ease forwards;
}
#ngScreen.ng-out .ng-wrap {
  animation: ngWrapOut 0.28s ease forwards;
}
#ngScreen.ng-launch {
  animation: ngBgOut 0.42s ease forwards;
}
#ngScreen.ng-launch .ng-wrap {
  animation: ngLaunch 0.42s cubic-bezier(0.5, 0, 0.75, 0) forwards;
}
@keyframes ngBg {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}
@keyframes ngBgOut {
  to {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}
@keyframes ngWrap {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(26px) scale(0.96);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}
@keyframes ngWrapOut {
  to {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(16px) scale(0.97);
  }
}
@keyframes ngLaunch {
  to {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-40px) scale(1.04);
    filter: blur(4px);
  }
}
@keyframes ngUp {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(12px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}
@keyframes ngGrow {
  from {
    width: 0;
  }
}
.ng-wrap {
  position: relative;
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  #ngScreen *,
  #ngScreen,
  #ngScreen::before {
    animation: none !important;
    transition: none !important;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 620px) {
  .ng-diffs {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .ng-row {
    grid-template-columns: 100px 1fr 96px;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 820px) {
  #ngBody {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .ng-modes {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}
.cm-sent {
  height: 100%;
  overflow: auto;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
  padding-right: 4px;
}
.cm-rp {
  border: 1px solid rgba(141, 156, 192, 0.2);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 11px 13px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.025);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}
.cm-rph {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.cm-rph b {
  font:
    800 14px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
}
.cm-rph .mut,
.mut {
  color: var(--m);
  font:
    600 11px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
}
.cm-pipe {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.cm-pipe span {
  font:
    700 11px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  color: var(--m);
  padding: 4px 8px;
  border-radius: 7px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(141, 156, 192, 0.25);
}
.cm-pipe span.on {
  color: #4ade80;
  border-color: rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.45);
  background: rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.07);
}
.cm-pipe i {
  flex: 0 0 16px;
  height: 2px;
  background: rgba(141, 156, 192, 0.3);
}
.cm-rpc {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 5px;
}
.cm-rpc .chip {
  font-size: 11.5px;
  padding: 3px 9px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(141, 156, 192, 0.28);
  background: #111a38;
}
.cm-eta {
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: #cdd6f0;
}
/* iletim animasyonu */
.cm-tx {
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 12px;
}
.cm-dish {
  width: min(320px, 70%);
}
.cm-waves path {
  fill: none;
  stroke: #5ad1ff;
  stroke-width: 3;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  opacity: 0;
  animation: cmWave 1s infinite;
}
@keyframes cmWave {
  0% {
    opacity: 0;
  }
  30% {
    opacity: 1;
  }
  100% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translate(16px, -10px);
  }
}
.cm-txh {
  font:
    800 15px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  display: flex;
  gap: 14px;
  align-items: center;
}
.cm-txpct {
  color: #5ad1ff;
}
.cm-txbar {
  width: min(460px, 80%);
  height: 10px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: #0a1024;
  border: 1px solid var(--bd);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.cm-txbar i {
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
  width: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #5ad1ff, #4ade80);
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px #5ad1ff;
}
.cm-txlog {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  width: min(460px, 80%);
  font:
    600 12px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  color: var(--m);
}
.cm-txlog li {
  opacity: 0.25;
  padding: 2px 0;
  transition: 0.3s;
}
.cm-txlog li::before {
  content: "▸ ";
  color: #5ad1ff;
}
.cm-txlog li.on {
  opacity: 1;
  color: var(--t);
}
/* hud rozeti */
#commBadge {
  position: absolute;
  right: 11px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  padding: 7px 10px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  background: rgba(11, 16, 36, 0.88);
  border: 1px solid rgba(90, 209, 255, 0.3);
  color: #e8f1ff;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  pointer-events: none;
}
#commBadge .ci {
  font-size: 18px;
}
#commBadge b {
  display: block;
  font-size: 12px;
}
#commBadge small {
  display: block;
  font:
    600 10px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  color: #8d9cc0;
}
#commBadge.new {
  border-color: #ff8c42;
  animation: cmPulse 1.6s infinite;
}
#commBadge.wait {
  border-color: rgba(90, 209, 255, 0.45);
}
#commBadge.log {
  border-color: rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.35);
}
@keyframes cmPulse {
  50% {
    box-shadow:
      0 0 0 4px rgba(255, 140, 66, 0.25),
      0 8px 22px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  }
}
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .cm-cols,
  .cm-inbox {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    overflow: auto;
  }
  .cm-body {
    overflow: auto !important;
  }
  .ltr {
    padding: 16px 14px;
  }
}

#bookScreen {
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(10, 6, 4, 0.45), rgba(2, 2, 4, 0.85));
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  z-index: 45;
}
.bk-wrap {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 18px;
  animation: bookIn 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.2, 1.3, 0.5, 1);
}
@keyframes bookIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(30px) scale(0.92) rotateX(12deg);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}
.book {
  position: relative;
  width: min(900px, 82vw);
  height: min(600px, 78vh, calc(82vw / 1.5));
  perspective: 2400px;
}
.book-cover {
  position: absolute;
  inset: -14px -16px -16px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6a3820, #4a2312 55%, #331709);
  box-shadow:
    0 34px 90px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75),
    inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(255, 210, 150, 0.18),
    inset 0 0 0 7px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28);
}
.book-cover::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 6px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1.5px dashed rgba(255, 205, 140, 0.28);
}
.book-pages {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  transform-style: preserve-3d;
}
.page {
  position: relative;
  width: 50%;
  height: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  color: #3a2716;
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02)),
    repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 0 23px, rgba(120, 90, 50, 0.07) 23px 24px), #f3e8cf;
  font:
    clamp(11px, 1.75vh, 13.5px)/1.5 Georgia,
    "Times New Roman",
    serif;
}
.page.left {
  border-radius: 6px 0 0 6px;
  box-shadow:
    inset -22px 0 30px -18px rgba(70, 40, 15, 0.55),
    inset 1px 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
}
.page.right {
  border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0;
  box-shadow: inset 22px 0 30px -18px rgba(70, 40, 15, 0.55);
}
.spine {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 4px;
  margin-left: -2px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(60, 30, 10, 0.35), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), rgba(60, 30, 10, 0.35));
  pointer-events: none;
}
.pg-in {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  padding: clamp(18px, 3.6vh, 30px) clamp(20px, 3vw, 32px) 34px;
}
.pg-num {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 12px;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  text-align: center;
  font:
    italic 12px Georgia,
    serif;
  color: #8a6a45;
}
.pg-end {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  font-size: 40px;
  color: #c9b48a;
}
.page h2 {
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  font:
    700 clamp(17px, 2.8vh, 22px)/1.15 Georgia,
    serif;
  color: #7a2a12;
  border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(122, 42, 18, 0.25);
  padding-bottom: 6px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.page h2 small {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  font:
    700 10px "Segoe UI",
    sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.24em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #a07850;
}
.page h2.danger {
  color: #a3200e;
}
.page h3 {
  margin: 10px 0 4px;
  font:
    700 15px Georgia,
    serif;
  color: #7a2a12;
}
.page p {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
}
.page ul,
.page ol {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  padding-left: 20px;
}
.page li {
  margin-bottom: 3px;
}
.page .sm {
  font-size: 0.9em;
  color: #6a5236;
}
.page b {
  color: #2a1a0c;
}
.page kbd {
  display: inline-block;
  min-width: 18px;
  padding: 0 5px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  border: 1px solid #a88a5e;
  border-bottom-width: 2px;
  background: #fff8e6;
  font:
    700 11px ui-monospace,
    Consolas,
    monospace;
  color: #3a2716;
  text-align: center;
}
.page .tip {
  margin: 8px 0;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(46, 125, 79, 0.1);
  border-left: 4px solid #2f7d4f;
}
.page .warn {
  margin: 8px 0;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(190, 40, 20, 0.1);
  border-left: 4px solid #b4321c;
  color: #5a1408;
}
.page .note {
  margin-top: 12px;
  font-style: italic;
  color: #8a6a45;
  font-size: 0.92em;
}
.bk-ic {
  width: 1.5em;
  height: 1.5em;
  vertical-align: -0.4em;
}
.bk-ic.r {
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  margin-left: auto;
}
.page table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  margin: 6px 0 8px;
}
.page td {
  padding: 4px 6px;
  border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(120, 90, 50, 0.3);
  vertical-align: top;
}
.page table.keys td:first-child {
  width: 38%;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.page table.cal td:first-child {
  width: 24%;
  font-weight: 700;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.page table.cal tr.today td {
  background: rgba(255, 179, 71, 0.22);
}
.page .ev {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 1px 7px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font:
    700 0.85em "Segoe UI",
    sans-serif;
  margin: 1px 2px;
}
.ev.st {
  background: rgba(255, 140, 66, 0.2);
  color: #8a3a10;
}
.ev.rd {
  background: rgba(132, 204, 22, 0.22);
  color: #3f6212;
}
.ev.ok {
  color: #8a7a5a;
  font-weight: 400;
}
.page table.emg td:first-child {
  width: 42%;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.page .deck {
  margin: 6px 0;
  padding: 7px 10px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(60, 70, 110, 0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(60, 70, 110, 0.2);
}
.page .deck b {
  display: block;
  color: #2a3a6a;
}
.page .deck span {
  font-size: 0.92em;
}
.toc {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0 !important;
}
.toc li {
  margin: 0;
}
.toc a {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 4px 2px;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: #3a2716;
  border-radius: 4px;
}
.toc a:hover {
  background: rgba(122, 42, 18, 0.08);
  color: #7a2a12;
}
.toc em {
  flex: 1;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted rgba(120, 90, 50, 0.5);
}
.pg-cover {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 30px;
}
.pg-cover h1 {
  margin: 14px 0 4px;
  font:
    700 clamp(24px, 4.4vh, 34px) Georgia,
    serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  color: #7a2a12;
}
.pg-cover .sub {
  font:
    italic 15px Georgia,
    serif;
  color: #8a6a45;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}
.pg-cover .c {
  margin: 4px 0;
}
.pg-cover .sig {
  margin-top: 22px;
  font:
    italic 14px Georgia,
    serif;
  color: #6a5236;
}
.emb {
  position: relative;
  width: 104px;
  height: 104px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 40% 35%, #ff9a5a, #b4321c 55%, #5a1408);
  border: 5px double #d9b46a;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(90, 40, 10, 0.35);
}
.emb span {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  font:
    800 15px "Segoe UI",
    sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  color: #fff3dc;
}
.emb i {
  position: absolute;
  width: 150%;
  height: 26%;
  border: 2px solid rgba(255, 230, 190, 0.7);
  border-radius: 50%;
  transform: rotate(-20deg);
}
.flip {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  width: 50%;
  height: 100%;
  transform-style: preserve-3d;
  transition: transform 0.75s cubic-bezier(0.45, 0.05, 0.2, 1);
  z-index: 6;
}
.flip.r {
  left: 50%;
  transform-origin: left center;
}
.flip.l {
  left: 0;
  transform-origin: right center;
}
.flip.r.go {
  transform: rotateY(-180deg);
}
.flip.l.go {
  transform: rotateY(180deg);
}
.flip .face {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  backface-visibility: hidden;
  -webkit-backface-visibility: hidden;
}
.flip .back {
  transform: rotateY(180deg);
}
.flip .face::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(60, 30, 10, 0.28), transparent 45%);
  opacity: 0;
  animation: flipShade 0.75s ease-in-out;
}
@keyframes flipShade {
  50% {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}
.bk-nav {
  flex: 0 0 48px;
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 205, 140, 0.45);
  background: rgba(60, 30, 14, 0.85);
  color: #ffd08a;
  font-size: 18px;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
  transition: 0.15s;
}
.bk-nav:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: #7a3a1a;
  transform: scale(1.08);
}
.bk-nav:disabled {
  opacity: 0.25;
  cursor: default;
}
.bk-bar {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: -46px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
  font:
    700 13px ui-monospace,
    Consolas,
    monospace;
  color: #e8d4b0;
}
.bk-x {
  padding: 7px 14px;
  border-radius: 9px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 205, 140, 0.45);
  background: rgba(60, 30, 14, 0.85);
  color: #ffd08a;
  font:
    700 12px "Segoe UI",
    sans-serif;
  cursor: pointer;
}
/* --- kompakt mod: kitap sol kenarda, oyun görünür kalır --- */
#bookScreen {
  position: absolute;
  inset: auto;
  left: 18px;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  background: none;
  backdrop-filter: none;
  display: block;
  padding: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}
#bookScreen .bk-wrap {
  pointer-events: auto;
  display: block;
  width: min(640px, 48vw);
  animation: bookInL 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.2, 1.2, 0.5, 1);
}
@keyframes bookInL {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateX(-40px) scale(0.96);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}
#bookScreen .book {
  width: 100%;
  height: min(430px, 64vh);
}
#bookScreen .book-cover {
  inset: -9px -10px -11px;
  border-radius: 11px;
  box-shadow:
    0 22px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6),
    inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(255, 210, 150, 0.18),
    inset 0 0 0 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28);
}
#bookScreen .page {
  font:
    clamp(9.5px, 1.5vh, 11.5px)/1.42 Georgia,
    "Times New Roman",
    serif;
}
#bookScreen .pg-in {
  padding: 14px 16px 24px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color: rgba(122, 42, 18, 0.35) transparent;
}
#bookScreen .page h2 {
  font-size: clamp(13px, 2.1vh, 16px);
  margin-bottom: 7px;
  padding-bottom: 4px;
}
#bookScreen .page h2 small {
  font-size: 8.5px;
}
#bookScreen .page h3 {
  font-size: 12.5px;
}
#bookScreen .page kbd {
  font-size: 9.5px;
  min-width: 15px;
  padding: 0 4px;
}
#bookScreen .bk-ic.r {
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
}
#bookScreen .page .tip,
#bookScreen .page .warn {
  padding: 6px 8px;
  margin: 6px 0;
}
#bookScreen .page td {
  padding: 3px 4px;
}
#bookScreen .pg-cover {
  padding: 18px;
}
#bookScreen .pg-cover h1 {
  font-size: clamp(17px, 3vh, 22px);
  margin: 8px 0 2px;
}
#bookScreen .pg-cover .sub {
  font-size: 11.5px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}
#bookScreen .pg-cover .sig {
  margin-top: 12px;
  font-size: 11.5px;
}
#bookScreen .emb {
  width: 68px;
  height: 68px;
  border-width: 4px;
}
#bookScreen .emb span {
  font-size: 11px;
}
#bookScreen .pg-num {
  bottom: 7px;
  font-size: 10px;
}
#bookScreen .pg-end {
  font-size: 28px;
}
#bookScreen .bk-nav {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 5px;
  width: 26px;
  height: 26px;
  font-size: 10px;
  z-index: 8;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
}
#bookScreen #bkPrev {
  left: 6px;
}
#bookScreen #bkNext {
  right: 6px;
}
#bookScreen .bk-bar {
  bottom: 6px;
  left: 50%;
  right: auto;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 8;
  font-size: 10px;
  gap: 6px;
  color: #6a4a2a;
  background: rgba(243, 232, 207, 0.92);
  padding: 2px 4px 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 9px;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(60, 30, 10, 0.25);
}
#bookScreen .bk-x {
  padding: 3px 8px;
  font-size: 10px;
}
#bookScreen .pg-num {
  display: none;
}
#marketScreen #shop,
#marketScreen .stock-sec {
  display: none !important;
}
.cap-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(150px, 1fr));
  gap: 10px;
}
.cap-cell {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 10px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(141, 156, 192, 0.2);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.045), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.012));
}
.cap-cell.pop {
  animation: capPop 0.38s cubic-bezier(0.2, 1.4, 0.5, 1) both;
}
@keyframes capPop {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(12px) scale(0.94);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}
.cap-cell.empty .cap-art img {
  filter: grayscale(1) brightness(0.55);
  opacity: 0.55;
}
.cap-art {
  position: relative;
  height: 88px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 38%, rgba(90, 209, 255, 0.2), rgba(10, 16, 36, 0.7) 72%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(90, 209, 255, 0.2);
}
.cap-art img {
  width: 80px;
  height: 80px;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 6px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55)) drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(90, 209, 255, 0.18));
}
.cap-art::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 22%;
  right: 22%;
  bottom: 10px;
  height: 12px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(90, 209, 255, 0.28), rgba(90, 209, 255, 0) 70%);
}
.cap-n {
  position: absolute;
  right: 6px;
  bottom: 6px;
  font:
    900 15px ui-monospace,
    Consolas,
    monospace;
  color: #fff;
  background: rgba(255, 140, 66, 0.92);
  border-radius: 7px;
  padding: 1px 7px;
}
.cap-cell.empty .cap-n {
  background: rgba(120, 130, 160, 0.7);
}
.cap-nm {
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: 13.5px;
}
.cap-ds {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--m);
  line-height: 1.35;
  min-height: 29px;
}
.cap-bar {
  height: 5px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: #0a1024;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid rgba(141, 156, 192, 0.2);
}
.cap-bar i {
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #1f7fb8, #7fe0ff);
}
.cap-meta {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font:
    700 10px ui-monospace,
    Consolas,
    monospace;
  color: var(--m);
}
.cap-act {
  display: flex;
  gap: 5px;
}
.cap-act .cbtn {
  flex: 1;
  padding: 6px 4px;
  font-size: 12px;
}
#capIc img {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
}
.sic.o2 {
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 32% 28%, #c3f7ff, #22d3ee 55%, #0e7490);
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.45);
}
.sic.o2 b {
  font:
    900 11px "Segoe UI",
    system-ui;
  color: #fff;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  text-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
}
.fill.o2 {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #0e7490, #67e8f9);
}
.slot img.ic {
  width: 38px;
  height: 38px;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5));
}
#ui.con-open #toast {
  top: auto;
  bottom: calc(92px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
}
#ui.con-open #hint {
  display: none !important;
}
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  #stats {
    bottom: calc(228px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
  }
}

/* ---- çürük hasat yazışmaları ---- */
.rot-row {
  width: 100%;
  margin-top: 6px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(214, 192, 138, 0.35);
  background: rgba(120, 90, 40, 0.12);
}
.ltr-act {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin: 12px 0 6px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border: 1px dashed rgba(29, 43, 79, 0.35);
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: rgba(255, 140, 66, 0.07);
}
.ltr-act .cbtn {
  min-width: 220px;
}
.ltr-act .cbtn:disabled {

  cursor: default;
}
.ltr-act small {
