  font-size: 12px;
}
.ltr-scale {
  display: flex;
  gap: 2px;
  margin: 8px 0 10px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  overflow: hidden;
  font:
    800 10.5px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  color: #10202a;
}
.ltr-scale span {
  padding: 6px 8px;
  text-align: center;
}
/* ---- DZ-7 radyasyon ölçer arayüzü ---- */
#radUI {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 30;
}
#radUI .rd-lb {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 7vh;
  background: #000;
  transition: transform 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}
#radUI .rd-lb.t {
  top: 0;
  transform: translateY(-100%);
}
#radUI .rd-lb.b {
  bottom: 0;
  transform: translateY(100%);
}
#radUI.rd-open .rd-lb {
  transform: none;
}
.rd-dev {
  position: absolute;
  right: 4vw;
  bottom: calc(7vh + 18px);
  width: 268px;
  padding: 14px 14px 12px;
  border-radius: 30px;
  background: linear-gradient(165deg, #3a4256, #1c212e 55%, #131722);
  border: 4px solid #ff8c42;
  box-shadow:
    0 22px 46px -14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8),
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18),
    inset 0 -4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
  transform: translateY(130%) rotate(4deg);
  opacity: 0;
  transition:
    transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),
    opacity 0.4s;
  font-family: "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  color: #e6e9f2;
}
#radUI.rd-open .rd-dev {
  transform: none;
  opacity: 1;
}
#radUI.rd-close .rd-dev {
  transform: translateY(130%) rotate(-3deg);
  opacity: 0;
}
.rd-probe {
  position: absolute;
  left: 34px;
  top: -46px;
  width: 8px;
  height: 46px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #6b7590, #c9d1e4, #6b7590);
}
.rd-probe::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: -11px;
  top: -12px;
  width: 30px;
  height: 16px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%, #7fe7ff, #1b6b80 60%, #0d2a33);
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(127, 231, 255, 0.5);
}
.rd-head {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0 6px 10px;
}
.rd-brand {
  font:
    900 16px "Segoe UI",
    sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: #ffb347;
}
.rd-brand small {
  display: block;
  font-size: 8.5px;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  color: #9aa5c0;
  margin-top: 1px;
}
.rd-led {
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #4a1a1a;
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
}
.rd-led.on {
  background: #ff4d4d;
  box-shadow:
    0 0 10px #ff4d4d,
    0 0 2px #fff;
}
.rd-scr {
  position: relative;
  border-radius: 18px;
  padding: 10px 12px 10px;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%, #17223d, #0a0f1d 70%);
  border: 2px solid #0a0c12;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 22px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
  color: #7fe7ff;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.rd-ring {
  position: relative;
  width: 150px;
  height: 150px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}
.rd-ring svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}
.rd-trk {
  fill: none;
  stroke: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
  stroke-width: 5;
}
.rd-seg {
  fill: none;
  stroke-width: 5;
  opacity: 0.85;
}
.rd-arc {
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 9;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  transition: stroke-dasharray 0.12s;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px currentColor);
}
.rd-num {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}
.rd-num b {
  font:
    800 30px ui-monospace,
    "Consolas",
    monospace;
  color: #f8fafc;
  text-shadow: 0 0 14px currentColor;
  line-height: 1;
}
.rd-num small {
  font:
    700 10.5px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  opacity: 0.75;
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.rd-num em {
  font:
    700 9.5px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  font-style: normal;
  opacity: 0.6;
  margin-top: 6px;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
}
.rd-hist {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 2px;
  height: 22px;
  margin: 8px 0 4px;
  padding: 0 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(127, 231, 255, 0.2);
}
.rd-hist i {
  flex: 1;
  height: 8%;
  background: currentColor;
  opacity: 0.7;
  border-radius: 2px 2px 0 0;
  transition: height 0.1s;
}
.rd-prog {
  height: 3px;
  background: rgba(127, 231, 255, 0.12);
  border-radius: 2px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.rd-prog i {
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
  width: 0;
  background: currentColor;
  transition: width 0.15s;
}
.rd-st {
  margin-top: 8px;
  font:
    600 12.5px "Segoe UI",
    sans-serif;
  text-align: center;
  min-height: 17px;
  color: #e6e9f2;
}
.rd-foot {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 10px 6px 0;
  font:
    800 10px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  color: #9aa5c0;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}
.rd-keys {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
}
.rd-keys i {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 40% 35%, #ffc58f, #ff8c42 55%, #b4561a);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #7a3a10;
}
.rd-zones {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  gap: 3px;
  margin: 8px 0 2px;
  font:
    800 9px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  text-align: center;
}
.rd-zones span {
  flex: 1;
  padding: 3px 0 2px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  opacity: 0.35;
  transition:
    opacity 0.2s,
    transform 0.2s;
  color: #071008;
}
.rd-zones span small {
  display: block;
  font-size: 7.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  opacity: 0.8;
}
#rdZ0 {
  background: #4ade80;
}
#rdZ1 {
  background: #fbbf24;
}
#rdZ2 {
  background: #ff5d5d;
}
.rd-zones span.on {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
#rdMark {
  position: absolute;
  top: -6px;
  width: 0;
  height: 0;
  margin-left: -5px;
  border: 5px solid transparent;
  border-top: 6px solid #f8fafc;
  transition: left 0.12s;
}
.rd-vd {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1px;
  padding: 4px 6px;
  border: 1.5px solid currentColor;
  border-radius: 6px;
  animation: rdVd 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.2, 1.6, 0.4, 1);
}
.rd-vd b {
  font-size: 16px !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}
.rd-vd small {
  font-size: 10.5px;
  opacity: 0.85;
}
@keyframes rdVd {
  from {
    transform: scale(1.35);
    opacity: 0;
  }
  to {
    transform: none;
    opacity: 1;
  }
}
#radUI.lv0 .rd-scr {
  color: #4ade80;
}
#radUI.lv1 .rd-scr {
  color: #fbbf24;
}
#radUI.lv0 .rd-st,
#radUI.lv1 .rd-st,
#radUI.lv2 .rd-st {
  color: inherit;
}
#radUI.lv2 .rd-scr {
  color: #ff6b5d;
}
#radUI.lv0 .rd-dev,
#radUI.lv1 .rd-dev,
#radUI.lv2 .rd-dev {
  animation: rdStamp 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 1.6, 0.4, 1);
}
#radUI.lv0 .rd-st b,
#radUI.lv1 .rd-st b,
#radUI.lv2 .rd-st b {
  font-size: 15px;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
}
@keyframes rdStamp {
  0% {
    transform: scale(1);
  }
  35% {
    transform: scale(1.05);
  }
  100% {
    transform: scale(1);
  }
}
@media (max-width: 620px) {
  .rd-dev {
    right: 50%;
    margin-right: -145px;
    bottom: calc(7vh + 90px);
  }
}

.ai-qa {
  margin: 10px 0 12px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(29, 43, 79, 0.18);
  border-radius: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.ai-q {
  padding: 8px 12px;
  background: rgba(29, 43, 79, 0.06);
  font-style: italic;
  color: #1f2a44;
}
.ai-q span,
.ai-a span {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-right: 8px;
  padding: 1px 7px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  font:
    800 9.5px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  font-style: normal;
  vertical-align: 1px;
}
.ai-q span {
  background: #1d2b4f;
  color: #fff;
}
.ai-a {
  padding: 8px 12px 2px;
  border-left: 3px solid #7c3aed;
}
.ai-a span {
  background: #7c3aed;
  color: #fff;
}
.ai-a p {
  margin: 6px 0 8px;
}
.ai-ft {
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: #6b7280;
  border-top: 1px dashed rgba(29, 43, 79, 0.25);
  padding-top: 8px;
  margin-top: 10px;
}
.gs-dl {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
  gap: 3px 10px;
  margin: 8px 0 0;
  font-size: 11.5px;
}
.gs-dl dt {
  color: #8d9cc0;
  font:
    700 10px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  align-self: center;
}
.gs-dl dd {
  margin: 0;
  color: #e6e9f2;
  font:
    600 11.5px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
}

.sat {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.55fr) minmax(220px, 1fr);
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.sat-map {
  position: relative;
  align-self: start;
  border-radius: 12px;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid rgba(141, 156, 192, 0.22);
  background: #2a130c;
}
.sat-map svg {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  aspect-ratio: 2/1;
}
.sat-grid line {
  stroke: rgba(255, 220, 200, 0.1);
  stroke-width: 0.5;
}
.sat-eq {
  stroke: rgba(255, 220, 200, 0.25);
  stroke-width: 0.6;
  stroke-dasharray: 3 3;
}
.sat-cov {
  fill: rgba(127, 231, 255, 0.06);
  stroke: rgba(127, 231, 255, 0.35);
  stroke-width: 0.7;
  stroke-dasharray: 2 2;
}
.sat-cov.on {
  fill: rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.12);
  stroke: rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.7);
}
.sat-past {
  fill: none;
  stroke: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28);
  stroke-width: 1;
  stroke-dasharray: 2 3;
}
.sat-fut {
  fill: none;
  stroke: #7fe7ff;
  stroke-width: 1.2;
  opacity: 0.85;
}
.sat-link {
  stroke: #4ade80;
  stroke-width: 1;
  stroke-dasharray: 3 2;
}
.sat-site {
  fill: #ff8c42;
  stroke: #fff;
  stroke-width: 1;
}
.sat-flag {
  fill: #ff8c42;
  stroke: #fff;
  stroke-width: 0.6;
}
.sat-ic rect {
  fill: #e6f6ff;
  stroke: #1b6b80;
  stroke-width: 0.5;
}
.sat-legend {
  position: absolute;
  left: 8px;
  bottom: 6px;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 4px 10px;
  font:
    700 9.5px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  color: #f3e6dc;
  text-shadow: 0 1px 2px #000;
}
.sat-legend i {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 9px;
  height: 9px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  margin-right: 4px;
  vertical-align: -1px;
}
.lg-site {
  background: #ff8c42;
}
.lg-sat {
  background: #7fe7ff;
}
.lg-fut {
  height: 2px !important;
  border-radius: 1px !important;
  background: #7fe7ff;
  vertical-align: 2px !important;
  width: 12px !important;
}
.lg-cov {
  border: 1px dashed #4ade80;
}
.sat-side {
  border-radius: 12px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(141, 156, 192, 0.22);
  background: rgba(10, 16, 36, 0.55);
  padding: 10px 12px;
}
.sat-hd {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  padding-bottom: 8px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(141, 156, 192, 0.18);
}
.sat-hd small {
  display: block;
  font:
    800 9px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  color: #8d9cc0;
}
.sat-hd > div > b {
  font:
    800 15px "Segoe UI",
    sans-serif;
  color: #e6f6ff;
}
.sat-on,
.sat-off {
  font:
    800 9.5px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  padding: 3px 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
}
.sat-on {
  color: #4ade80;
  background: rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.12);
  border: 1px solid rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.45);
}
.sat-off {
  color: #9aa5c0;
  background: rgba(154, 165, 192, 0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(154, 165, 192, 0.3);
}
.sat-dl {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
  gap: 5px 10px;
  margin: 0;
}
.sat-dl dt {
  font:
    700 9.5px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  color: #8d9cc0;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  align-self: center;
}
.sat-dl dd {
  margin: 0;
  font:
    600 11.5px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  color: #e6e9f2;
  text-align: right;
}
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .sat {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}
/* analiz numuneleri */
.ana-row {
  width: 100%;
  margin-top: 6px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.35);
  background: rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.1);
}
.ana-tag {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-left: 6px;
  padding: 1px 6px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  font:
    800 9px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: #e9d5ff;
  background: rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.45);
  vertical-align: 1px;
}
.mn-tbl {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  margin: 6px 0 10px;
  font-size: 12.5px;
}
.mn-tbl td {
  padding: 4px 8px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(29, 43, 79, 0.12);
}
.mn-tbl td:first-child {
  color: #4b5563;
  width: 42%;
}
.mn-bar {
  display: flex;
  height: 14px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 6px 0 4px;
}
.mn-bar span {
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
}
.mn-leg {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 4px 12px;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: #374151;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.mn-leg i {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 9px;
  height: 9px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  margin-right: 4px;
  vertical-align: -1px;
}
.mn-hz {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  margin: 8px 0 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.mn-hz.ok {
  background: rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.1);
  border: 1px solid rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.4);
  color: #166534;
}
.mn-hz.wa {
  background: rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.1);
  border: 1px solid rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.45);
  color: #92400e;
}
.mn-hz.dg {
  background: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.1);
  border: 1px solid rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.5);
  color: #991b1b;
}
.mn-hz b {
  font:
    800 11px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: #fff;
}
.mn-hz.ok b {
  background: #16a34a;
}
.mn-hz.wa b {
  background: #d97706;
}
.mn-hz.dg b {
  background: #dc2626;
}
.slot-gap {
  width: 10px;
}
body.cine #hud,
body.cine #quest,
body.cine #stats,
body.cine #inv,
body.cine #hint,
body.cine #toast,
body.cine #qDone,
body.cine #commBadge,
body.cine #alerts,
body.cine #pad,
body.cine #map,
body.cine #mapWrap,
body.cine #miniMap,
body.cine #eBtn,
body.cine #fBtn,
body.cine #gBtn,
body.cine #notif,
body.cine #notes {
  visibility: hidden !important;
}
#quest .qh:has(.qs-l) {
  background: none;
  border: 0;
  padding: 2px 0 0;
}
#quest.hold {
  opacity: 0.42;
  filter: grayscale(0.7);
  transition:
    opacity 0.4s,
    filter 0.4s;
}
#quest.hold::after {
  content: attr(data-hold);
  position: absolute;
  left: 10px;
  right: 10px;
  bottom: -24px;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: rgba(60, 20, 12, 0.9);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 120, 80, 0.5);
  font:
    800 9.5px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  color: #ffb39a;
  text-align: center;
  filter: none;
}
#quest {
  position: relative;
}
.qs-l {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.qs {
  display: flex;
  gap: 7px;
  align-items: flex-start;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  line-height: 1.35;
  color: #7f8fb2;
}
.qs i {
  flex: 0 0 16px;
  height: 16px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  font:
    800 9.5px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  font-style: normal;
  border: 1px solid rgba(160, 180, 220, 0.3);
  color: #8fa0c4;
  margin-top: 1px;
}
.qs.ok {
  color: #7fd9a0;
  opacity: 0.75;
}
.qs.ok span {
  text-decoration: line-through;
  text-decoration-color: rgba(127, 217, 160, 0.5);
}
.qs.ok i {
  background: #22c55e;
  border-color: #22c55e;
  color: #04140a;
}
.qs.cur {
  color: #eef3ff;
}
.qs.cur i {
  background: #ff8a3d;
  border-color: #ff8a3d;
  color: #1a0a02;
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 138, 61, 0.6);
}
.qs b {
  color: #ffb27a;
}
#stGoal.bump {
  animation: sgBump 0.5s ease;
}
@keyframes sgBump {
  30% {
    transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1.06);
  }
}
/* ---------- UYANIŞ ---------- */
#wake {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 58;
  pointer-events: none;
}
#wake.hidden {
  display: none;
}
#wake .wk-bar {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 0;
  background: #000;
  transition: height 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);
}
#wake .wk-bar.t {
  top: 0;
}
#wake .wk-bar.b {
  bottom: 0;
}
#wake.on .wk-bar {
  height: 10vh;
}
#wkCard {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  bottom: calc(10vh + 28px);
  transform: translate(-50%, 10px);
  padding: 18px 60px 16px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(2, 4, 10, 0.78), rgba(2, 4, 10, 0) 72%);
  text-align: center;
  opacity: 0;
  transition:
    opacity 0.9s ease,
    transform 1.1s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);
  text-shadow: 0 2px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
}
#wake.card #wkCard {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translate(-50%, 0);
}
.wk-k {
  font:
    800 12px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  letter-spacing: 0.42em;
  color: #ff9a4d;
}
.wk-t {
  font:
    200 clamp(30px, 5.4vw, 64px)/1.1 Inter,
    system-ui,
    sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  color: #fff;
  margin: 10px 0 8px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.wk-ln {
  height: 2px;
  width: 0;
  margin: 0 auto 10px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #ff8c42, transparent);
  transition: width 1.4s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1) 0.2s;
}
#wake.card .wk-ln {
  width: min(520px, 70vw);
}
.wk-s {
  font:
    600 13px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  color: #b9c6e6;
}
.wk-r {
  margin-top: 14px;
  font:
    500 15px Inter,
    system-ui,
    sans-serif;
  color: #dff4ff;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.6s ease 1.5s;
}
.wk-r b {
  font:
    800 10px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  color: #5ad1ff;
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 5px;
}
#wake.card .wk-r {
  opacity: 1;
}
#wake .wk-skip {
  position: absolute;
  right: 22px;
  bottom: calc(10vh + 12px);
  font:
    600 11px Inter,
    system-ui,
    sans-serif;
  color: rgba(220, 230, 255, 0.55);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.5s ease 1s;
}
#wake.on .wk-skip {
  opacity: 1;
}
#wake .wk-skip kbd {
  font:
    700 10px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  padding: 1px 5px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
  margin-left: 4px;
}
/* ---------- HİKÂYE ANLARI ---------- */
#story {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 60;
  pointer-events: auto;
  cursor: pointer;
}
#story.hidden {
  display: none;
}
#story .st-bar {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 0;
  background: #000;
  transition: height 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);
}
#story .st-top {
  top: 0;
}
#story .st-bot {
  bottom: 0;
}
#story.on .st-bar {
  height: 9vh;
}
#stBox {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  bottom: calc(9vh + 18px);
  transform: translate(-50%, 14px);
  width: min(760px, 92vw);
  display: flex;
  gap: 16px;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 14px 20px 14px 14px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(10, 14, 26, 0.86), rgba(6, 8, 16, 0.92));
  border: 1px solid rgba(160, 190, 255, 0.16);
  box-shadow:
    0 18px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55),
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  opacity: 0;
  transition:
    opacity 0.4s ease,
    transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);
}
#story.on #stBox {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translate(-50%, 0);
}
#stAv {
  flex: 0 0 58px;
  height: 58px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #2a3550, #0b1020);
  border: 2px solid #ffb36b;
  box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(255, 150, 80, 0.35);
}
#stAv svg {
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
}
#stBox.radio #stAv {
  border-color: #5ad1ff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(90, 209, 255, 0.4);
}
#stAv::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -6px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid currentColor;
  opacity: 0;
  color: #ffb36b;
}
#stBox.talk #stAv::after {
  animation: stPulse 1.1s ease-out infinite;
}
#stBox.radio #stAv::after {
  color: #5ad1ff;
}
@keyframes stPulse {
  0% {
    opacity: 0.7;
    transform: scale(0.9);
  }
  100% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(1.25);
  }
}
.st-tx {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}
#stWho {
  font:
    800 10.5px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  color: #ffb36b;
  margin-bottom: 5px;
}
#stBox.radio #stWho {
  color: #5ad1ff;
}
#stLine {
  font:
    500 19px/1.4 Inter,
    system-ui,
    sans-serif;
  color: #f3f6ff;
  min-height: 27px;
  text-shadow: 0 1px 2px #000;
}
#stBox:not(.radio) #stLine {
  font-style: italic;
}
#stNext {
  position: absolute;
  right: 16px;
  bottom: -24px;
  font:
    600 11px Inter,
    system-ui,
    sans-serif;
  color: rgba(220, 230, 255, 0.6);
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}
#stNext kbd {
  font:
    700 10px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  padding: 1px 5px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
  margin-left: 4px;
}
#stDots {
  display: flex;
  gap: 5px;
  margin-top: 8px;
}
#stDots i {
  width: 16px;
  height: 3px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
}
#stDots i.on {
  background: #ffb36b;
}
#stBox.radio #stDots i.on {
  background: #5ad1ff;
}
#stGoal {
  position: fixed;
  top: var(--sgTop, 14px);
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 40;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 9px 16px 9px 12px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(40, 14, 10, 0.88), rgba(22, 8, 6, 0.9));
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 120, 80, 0.45);
  box-shadow:
    0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45),
    0 0 24px rgba(255, 90, 50, 0.18);
  font:
    600 13px Inter,
    system-ui,
    sans-serif;
  color: #ffe9de;
  pointer-events: none;
  animation: sgIn 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);
}
#stGoal.hidden {
  display: none;
}
#stGoal .sg-ic {
  width: 26px;
  height: 26px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  background: #ff6a3d;
  color: #fff;
  font:
    900 14px Inter,
    sans-serif;
  animation: sgBlink 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
#stGoal .sg-k {
  font:
    800 9.5px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  color: #ff9a72;
}
#stGoalD {
  font:
    700 11px ui-monospace,
    monospace;
  color: #ffc2a8;
  margin-left: 6px;
}
#stGoal.ok {
  border-color: rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.55);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(8, 34, 18, 0.9), rgba(5, 20, 10, 0.92));
  color: #dcfce7;
}
#stGoal.ok .sg-ic {
  background: #22c55e;
  animation: none;
}
#stGoal.ok .sg-k {
  color: #86efac;
}
@keyframes sgIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translate(-50%, -14px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translate(-50%, 0);
  }
}
@keyframes sgBlink {
  50% {
    box-shadow:
      0 0 0 6px rgba(255, 106, 61, 0),
      0 0 14px rgba(255, 106, 61, 0.8);
  }
}
body.story #hud,
body.story #quest,
body.story #stats,
body.story #inv,
body.story #hint,
body.story #toast,
body.story #qDone,
body.story #commBadge,
body.story #alerts,
body.story #pad,
body.story #bioStat,
body.story #eBtn,
body.story #fBtn,
body.story #gBtn,
body.story #stGoal,
body.story #map,
body.story #mapWrap,
body.story #miniMap {
  visibility: hidden !important;
}

</style>
</head>

<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<div id="ui">

  <div id="menuScreen">
    <canvas id="menuBg"></canvas>
    <div class="mn-top"><div class="mn-badge"><span class="mn-patch"><b>ARES</b><i>1</i></span><span><b>ARES-1</b><small>Mars yüzey görevi</small></span></div><div class="mn-tele" id="mnTele"></div></div>
    <div id="menuCol">
      <div class="mn-kick"><i></i>ARES PROGRAMI</div>
      <h1>SOL<span>ZERO</span></h1>
      <div class="sub">Mars'ta hayatta kal · keşfet · Dünya'ya raporla</div>

    '<div class="pg-cover"><div class="emb"><span>ARES-1</span><i></i></div>\n    <h1>SAHA REHBERİ</h1><div class="sub">Mars Yüzey Operasyonları El Kitabı</div>\n    <p class="c">Bu kitap çantanda hep durur. <kbd>R</kbd> ile aç / kapat.</p>\n    <p class="c sm">Sayfa çevirmek için ◀ ▶ düğmeleri ya da klavyede <kbd>←</kbd> <kbd>→</kbd>.</p>\n    <p class="c sm">Kitap açıkken oyun zamanı durur.</p>\n    <div class="sig">— ARES-1 Görev Kontrol</div></div>':
      '<div class="pg-cover"><div class="emb"><span>ARES-1</span><i></i></div>\n    <h1>FIELD GUIDE</h1><div class="sub">Mars Surface Operations Handbook</div>\n    <p class="c">This book always stays in your bag. Open / close it with <kbd>R</kbd>.</p>\n    <p class="c sm">Turn pages with the ◀ ▶ buttons or the <kbd>←</kbd> <kbd>→</kbd> keys.</p>\n    <p class="c sm">Game time is paused while the book is open.</p>\n    <div class="sig">— ARES-1 Mission Control</div></div>',
    "İlk adımlar ve kontroller": "First steps and controls",
    Oksijen: "Oxygen",
    "Yemek ve su": "Food and water",
    "Roketin içi": "Inside the rocket",
    Tarım: "Farming",
    "Numuneler ve kargo": "Samples and cargo",
    "⚠ Kum fırtınası": "⚠ Sandstorm",
    "⚠ Radyasyon dalgası": "⚠ Radiation wave",
    "⚠ Meteor yağmuru": "⚠ Meteor shower",
    "Motor onarımı": "Engine repair",
    "Uyku ve zaman": "Sleep and time",
    "Felaket takvimi": "Disaster calendar",
    "Dünya ile iletişim": "Communicating with Earth",
    "Kıyafet & roket geliştirme": "Suit & rocket upgrades",
    "Acil durum listesi": "Emergency checklist",
    "Görev mimarisi": "Mission architecture",
    '<h2>İçindekiler</h2><ol class="toc">{0}</ol>\n    <div class="note">İpucu: bir başlığa tıklarsan o sayfaya gidersin.</div>':
      '<h2>Contents</h2><ol class="toc">{0}</ol>\n    <div class="note">Tip: click a heading to jump to that page.</div>',
    '<h2><small>Bölüm 1</small>İlk adımlar</h2>\n    <table class="keys"><tr><td><kbd>W A S D</kbd></td><td>Yürü · <kbd>Shift</kbd> koş (enerji harcar)</td></tr>\n    <tr><td><kbd>1</kbd>…<kbd>7</kbd></td><td>Eşyayı eline al · aynı tuşa tekrar bas = bırak (su, yiyecek, medikit: kullan)</td></tr>\n    <tr><td><kbd>F</kbd></td><td>Topla · elindekiyle ek, sula, iç, ye</td></tr>\n    <tr><td><kbd>E</kbd></td><td>Rokete gir · istasyonu kullan</td></tr>\n    <tr><td><kbd>G</kbd></td><td>Medikit kullan</td></tr>\n    <tr><td>Sol tık</td><td>Çapa elindeyken yeri kaz</td></tr>\n    <tr><td><kbd>R</kbd></td><td>Bu rehberi aç</td></tr></table>\n    <div class="tip"><b>Altın kural:</b> sadece <u>elindeki</u> eşyayı kullanırsın. Çapa elindeyken su içemezsin; önce suyu eline al.</div>\n    <p>Sol üstte <b>gün ve saat</b>, altında <b>görev kartı</b> var. Görev kartındaki 💡 satırı ne yapacağını adım adım söyler.</p>':
      '<h2><small>Chapter 1</small>First steps</h2>\n    <table class="keys"><tr><td><kbd>W A S D</kbd></td><td>Walk · <kbd>Shift</kbd> run (uses energy)</td></tr>\n    <tr><td><kbd>1</kbd>…<kbd>7</kbd></td><td>Hold an item · press the same key again = put away (water, food, medkit: use)</td></tr>\n    <tr><td><kbd>F</kbd></td><td>Collect · plant, water, drink, eat with what you hold</td></tr>\n    <tr><td><kbd>E</kbd></td><td>Enter the rocket · use a station</td></tr>\n    <tr><td><kbd>G</kbd></td><td>Use a medkit</td></tr>\n    <tr><td>Left click</td><td>Dig the ground while holding the hoe</td></tr>\n    <tr><td><kbd>R</kbd></td><td>Open this guide</td></tr></table>\n    <div class="tip"><b>Golden rule:</b> you can only use the item <u>in your hand</u>. You can\'t drink water while holding the hoe; take the water first.</div>\n    <p>Top left shows the <b>day and time</b>, with the <b>mission card</b> below it. The 💡 line on the mission card tells you what to do, step by step.</p>',
    "<h2><small>Bölüm 2</small>Oksijen {0}</h2>\n    <p>Mars'ın havası solunamaz. Giysindeki oksijen dışarıda yaklaşık <b>3,5 dakikada</b> biter. Koşarken %35, fırtınada %25 daha hızlı azalır.</p>\n    <ul><li><b>%30</b>'da uyarı alırsın, <b>%10</b>'da alarm çalar.</li>\n    <li><b>%0</b>'da her saniye ~5 can kaybedersin, ekran kararır.</li>\n    <li>Roketin içinde oksijen azalmaz.</li></ul>\n    <div class=\"tip\"><b>Doldurma:</b> rokete gir → makine dairesi → <b>O₂ tüpleri</b> → <kbd>E</kbd>. Hortum sırt çantana bağlanır ve giysi dolar.</div>\n    <p>Tüplerin de bir kapasitesi var. Boşalırsa oksijen jeneratörü onları yavaşça yeniden doldurur; tüp göstergesini takip et.</p>":
      '<h2><small>Chapter 2</small>Oxygen {0}</h2>\n    <p>The Martian air is not breathable. Your suit\'s oxygen runs out in about <b>3.5 minutes</b> outside. It drains 35% faster while running and 25% faster in a storm.</p>\n    <ul><li>You get a warning at <b>30%</b> and an alarm at <b>10%</b>.</li>\n    <li>At <b>0%</b> you lose ~5 health per second and the screen darkens.</li>\n    <li>Oxygen does not drain inside the rocket.</li></ul>\n    <div class="tip"><b>Refilling:</b> enter the rocket → engine room → <b>O₂ tanks</b> → <kbd>E</kbd>. The hose connects to your backpack and fills your suit.</div>\n    <p>The tanks have a limited capacity too. When empty, the oxygen generator slowly refills them; keep an eye on the tank gauge.</p>',
    "<h2><small>Bölüm 3</small>Yemek ve su {0}</h2>\n    <p><b>Su</b> yaklaşık 4, <b>tokluk</b> yaklaşık 5,5 dakikada biter. Biri sıfırlanırsa saniyede 4 can gider.</p>\n    <ul><li>{1} <b>Su şişesi:</b> +35 su. Eline al ve <kbd>F</kbd>'ye bas.</li>\n    <li>{2} <b>Patates:</b> +35 tokluk. Eline al ve <kbd>F</kbd>'ye bas.</li></ul>\n    <div class=\"tip\"><b>Mutfak:</b> yaşam güvertesindeki mutfakta <kbd>E</kbd> → envanteri açılır. Oradan çantana alabilir ya da hemen içip yiyebilirsin.</div>\n    <p>Su stoku sınırlıdır ama <b>su geri dönüştürücü</b> her 2,5 dakikada 1 şişe üretir. Patatesi ise tarlada sen yetiştirirsin.</p>":
      '<h2><small>Chapter 3</small>Food and water {0}</h2>\n    <p><b>Water</b> runs out in about 4 minutes, <b>food</b> in about 5.5 minutes. If either reaches zero you lose 4 health per second.</p>\n    <ul><li>{1} <b>Water bottle:</b> +35 water. Hold it and press <kbd>F</kbd>.</li>\n    <li>{2} <b>Potato:</b> +35 food. Hold it and press <kbd>F</kbd>.</li></ul>\n    <div class="tip"><b>Kitchen:</b> press <kbd>E</kbd> at the kitchen on the living deck → its inventory opens. You can take items into your bag or eat and drink right away.</div>\n    <p>Water stock is limited, but the <b>water recycler</b> produces 1 bottle every 2.5 minutes. Potatoes you grow yourself in the field.</p>',
    '<h2><small>Bölüm 4</small>Roketin içi</h2>\n    <p>Roket 3 katlıdır. Merdivenin yanında <kbd>W</kbd>/<kbd>S</kbd> ile kat değiştirirsin.</p>\n    <div class="deck"><b>3 · Komuta güvertesi</b><span>Navigasyon (kalkış) · Kargo terminali</span></div>\n    <div class="deck"><b>2 · Yaşam güvertesi</b><span>Uyku kabini · Mutfak · Revir · Yemek kapsülü</span></div>\n    <div class="deck"><b>1 · Makine dairesi</b><span>Hava kilidi (çıkış) · Alet sandığı · O₂ tüpleri · Ana motor · Tamir tezgâhı</span></div>\n    <div class="tip">Roketin gövdesi seni <b>radyasyondan, fırtınadan ve meteorlardan</b> korur. Bir felaket yaklaşırken en güvenli yer burasıdır.</div>':
      '<h2><small>Chapter 4</small>Inside the rocket</h2>\n    <p>The rocket has 3 decks. Next to a ladder, change decks with <kbd>W</kbd>/<kbd>S</kbd>.</p>\n    <div class="deck"><b>3 · Command deck</b><span>Navigation (launch) · Cargo terminal</span></div>\n    <div class="deck"><b>2 · Living deck</b><span>Sleeping cabin · Kitchen · Sick bay · Food capsule</span></div>\n    <div class="deck"><b>1 · Engine room</b><span>Airlock (exit) · Tool chest · O₂ tanks · Main engine · Workbench</span></div>\n    <div class="tip">The rocket\'s hull protects you from <b>radiation, storms and meteors</b>. When a disaster approaches, this is the safest place.</div>',
    '<h2><small>Bölüm 5</small>Tarım {0}</h2>\n    <ol><li>Alet sandığından {1} <b>çapayı</b> al. Çapayı eline al ve yere <b>sol tıkla</b>.</li>\n    <li>{2} <b>Tohumu</b> eline al, çukurun yanında <kbd>F</kbd>.</li>\n    <li>{3} <b>Suyu</b> eline al, <kbd>F</kbd> ile sula. Islak toprak bitkiyi 2,4 kat hızlı büyütür.</li>\n    <li>Halka <b>sarı</b> olunca <kbd>F</kbd> ile hasat et: 1–2 patates + 1 tohum.</li></ol>\n    <p>Büyümesi sulamadan yaklaşık 75 saniye sürer. Bitki aşamaları: filiz → fide → çiçekli bitki → hasat.</p>\n    <div class="warn">Kum fırtınasında bitkiler sallanır ama zarar görmez. Parselleri roketin yakınına aç ki fırtınada kaybolmayasın.</div>':
      '<h2><small>Chapter 5</small>Farming {0}</h2>\n    <ol><li>Take the {1} <b>hoe</b> from the tool chest. Hold the hoe and <b>left-click</b> the ground.</li>\n    <li>Hold a {2} <b>seed</b> and press <kbd>F</kbd> next to the hole.</li>\n    <li>Hold {3} <b>water</b> and water it with <kbd>F</kbd>. Wet soil makes the plant grow 2.4 times faster.</li>\n    <li>When the ring turns <b>yellow</b>, harvest with <kbd>F</kbd>: 1–2 potatoes + 1 seed.</li></ol>\n    <p>Without watering it takes about 75 seconds to grow. Plant stages: sprout → seedling → flowering plant → harvest.</p>\n    <div class="warn">During a sandstorm plants sway but are not damaged. Dig your plots close to the rocket so you don\'t get lost in a storm.</div>',
    '<h2><small>Bölüm 6</small>Numuneler ve kargo {0}</h2>\n    <p>Görevin bilimsel amacı Mars numunelerini Dünya\'ya götürmek.</p>\n    <ul><li>{1} <b>Metal numune</b> = 1 puan. Haritada ◆ olarak görünür.</li>\n    <li>{2} <b>Yıldız kristali</b> = 2 puan. Meteor çarpınca kraterde kalabilir.</li></ul>\n    <div class="tip">Roketin yanında <kbd>F</kbd> ya da komuta güvertesindeki <b>kargo terminali</b> ile kargoya yükle. Hedef: <b>10 numune</b>.</div>\n    <p>Çantana en fazla {3} metal numune sığar. Dolunca rokete dönüp boşalt.</p>':
      '<h2><small>Chapter 6</small>Samples and cargo {0}</h2>\n    <p>The scientific goal of the mission is to bring Martian samples to Earth.</p>\n    <ul><li>{1} <b>Metal sample</b> = 1 point. Shown as ◆ on the map.</li>\n    <li>{2} <b>Star crystal</b> = 2 points. Can be left in a crater after a meteor impact.</li></ul>\n    <div class="tip">Load them into cargo with <kbd>F</kbd> next to the rocket or at the <b>cargo terminal</b> on the command deck. Goal: <b>10 samples</b>.</div>\n    <p>Your bag holds at most {3} metal samples. When it\'s full, return to the rocket and unload.</p>',
    '<h2 class="danger"><small>Bölüm 7 · Felaket</small>🌪 Kum fırtınası (1/2)</h2>\n    <p><b>Ne zaman?</b> İlki <b>2. gün</b> gelir, sonra <b>her 5 günde bir</b> tekrarlar (7, 12, 17…). Günün 01:30\'unda başlar, <b>2,5 dakika</b> sürer.</p>\n    <p><b>Uyarı:</b> başlamadan <b>45 saniye</b> önce turuncu bir kart çıkar ve geri sayar.</p>\n    <p><b>Neler olur?</b></p>\n    <ul><li>Görüş birkaç metreye düşer, gökyüzü kararır.</li>\n    <li>Rüzgâr (130 km/s\'ye kadar) seni savurur, rüzgâra karşı yürümek zorlaşır.</li>\n    <li>Harita sinyali kaybolur: "SİNYAL ZAYIF".</li>\n    <li>Oksijen %25 daha hızlı tükenir.</li>\n    <li>Ani esintiler ekranı sarsar.</li></ul>':
      '<h2 class="danger"><small>Chapter 7 · Disaster</small>🌪 Sandstorm (1/2)</h2>\n    <p><b>When?</b> The first one arrives on <b>day 2</b>, then repeats <b>every 5 days</b> (7, 12, 17…). It starts at 01:30 and lasts <b>2.5 minutes</b>.</p>\n    <p><b>Warning:</b> an orange card appears <b>45 seconds</b> before it starts and counts down.</p>\n    <p><b>What happens?</b></p>\n    <ul><li>Visibility drops to a few metres and the sky darkens.</li>\n    <li>Wind (up to 130 km/h) pushes you around; walking against it is hard.</li>\n    <li>The map signal is lost: "WEAK SIGNAL".</li>\n    <li>Oxygen drains 25% faster.</li>\n    <li>Sudden gusts shake the screen.</li></ul>',
    '<h2 class="danger"><small>Bölüm 7 · Felaket</small>🌪 Kum fırtınası (2/2)</h2>\n    <div class="warn"><b>İLK FIRTINA ROKETİ VURUR!</b> 2. gündeki fırtına zirvedeyken sert bir esinti roketi savurur ve <b>ana motor bozulur</b>. Motordan duman yükselir, kalkış kilitlenir.</div>\n    <p><b>Ne yapmalı?</b></p>\n    <ol><li>Uyarı kartını görünce işini bırak, <b>rokete dön</b>.</li>\n    <li>Fırtına bitene kadar içeride kal. Bu arada ye, iç, oksijen doldur.</li>\n    <li>Dışarıda yakalanırsan haritadaki roket okunu takip et.</li>\n    <li>Fırtına bitince motoru onar (Bölüm 10).</li></ol>\n    <p class="sm">Sonraki fırtınalarda motor <b>%60</b> olasılıkla yeniden bozulabilir; fırtına kalkanı bu riski azaltır (Bölüm 14).</p>':
      '<h2 class="danger"><small>Chapter 7 · Disaster</small>🌪 Sandstorm (2/2)</h2>\n    <div class="warn"><b>THE FIRST STORM HITS THE ROCKET!</b> At the peak of the day-2 storm, a violent gust shakes the rocket and <b>the main engine breaks down</b>. Smoke rises from the engine and launch is locked.</div>\n    <p><b>What to do?</b></p>\n    <ol><li>When you see the warning card, drop what you\'re doing and <b>return to the rocket</b>.</li>\n    <li>Stay inside until the storm ends. Meanwhile eat, drink and refill oxygen.</li>\n    <li>If you\'re caught outside, follow the rocket arrow on the map.</li>\n    <li>When the storm is over, repair the engine (Chapter 10).</li></ol>\n    <p class="sm">In later storms the engine can break down again with a <b>60%</b> chance; the storm shield reduces this risk (Chapter 14).</p>',
    '<h2 class="danger"><small>Bölüm 8 · Felaket</small>☢ Radyasyon dalgası</h2>\n    <p><b>Ne zaman?</b> Güneş patlaması <b>3. günden itibaren her 3 günde bir</b> (3, 6, 9…), günün en başında (00:00) gelir ve <b>1,5 dakika</b> sürer.</p>\n    <p><b>Uyarı:</b> önceki günün bitmesine <b>40 saniye</b> kala yeşil kart çıkar.</p>\n    <ul><li>Dışarıdaysan ekran <b>yeşile</b> döner ve saniyede ~3 can kaybedersin — standart giysiyle 30 saniyede ölürsün! Kalkan Mk-III ve ARES Elite setleri hasarı büyük ölçüde azaltır.</li>\n    <li>Başının üstünde "☢" hasar yazıları belirir.</li>\n    <li>Dalganın tamamını dışarıda geçirmek kesin ölümdür!</li></ul>\n    <div class="tip"><b>Korunma:</b> rokete gir. Gövde zırhı radyasyonu tamamen keser, içeride can kaybetmezsin. En iyi taktik: dalga gecesinde roketin <b>uyku kabininde</b> uyumak.</div>':
      '<h2 class="danger"><small>Chapter 8 · Disaster</small>☢ Radiation wave</h2>\n    <p><b>When?</b> A solar flare arrives <b>every 3 days from day 3 on</b> (3, 6, 9…) at the very start of the day (00:00) and lasts <b>1.5 minutes</b>.</p>\n    <p><b>Warning:</b> a green card appears <b>40 seconds</b> before the previous day ends.</p>\n    <ul><li>If you\'re outside, the screen turns <b>green</b> and you lose ~3 health per second — in the standard suit you die within 30 seconds! The Shield Mk-III and ARES Elite sets greatly reduce the damage.</li>\n    <li>"☢" damage numbers appear above your head.</li>\n    <li>Spending the whole wave outside means certain death!</li></ul>\n    <div class="tip"><b>Protection:</b> enter the rocket. The hull armour blocks radiation completely; you lose no health inside. Best tactic: sleep in the rocket\'s <b>sleeping cabin</b> on the night of the wave.</div>',
    '<h2 class="danger"><small>Bölüm 9 · Felaket</small>☄ Meteor yağmuru</h2>\n    <p>Meteorlar <b>uyarı vermeden</b>, rastgele zamanlarda 1–3 tane düşer. Kum fırtınası sırasında düşmez.</p>\n    <p><b>Belirtiler:</b> önce yükselen bir uğultu duyulur. Gökyüzünde iz bırakan bir ateş topu belirir ve yerde <b>büyüyen bir gölge</b> oluşur. Gölge çarpma noktasıdır!</p>\n    <ul><li>Çarpma yarıçapı ~9 m, hasar <b>26 can</b>.</li>\n    <li>Çarpma kalıcı bir krater bırakır. Krater bir süre sıcak kalır ve tüter.</li></ul>\n    <div class="tip"><b>Fırsat:</b> kraterlerde sık sık {0} <b>yıldız kristali</b> ya da metal numune kalır. Gölgeden uzaklaş, çarpmadan sonra topla.</div>':
      '<h2 class="danger"><small>Chapter 9 · Disaster</small>☄ Meteor shower</h2>\n    <p>Meteors fall <b>without warning</b>, 1–3 at a time, at random moments. They don\'t fall during a sandstorm.</p>\n    <p><b>Signs:</b> first you hear a rising rumble. A fireball with a trail appears in the sky and a <b>growing shadow</b> forms on the ground. The shadow is the impact point!</p>\n    <ul><li>Impact radius ~9 m, damage <b>26 health</b>.</li>\n    <li>The impact leaves a permanent crater. The crater stays hot and smokes for a while.</li></ul>\n    <div class="tip"><b>Opportunity:</b> craters often contain a {0} <b>star crystal</b> or a metal sample. Move away from the shadow and collect after the impact.</div>',
    '<h2><small>Bölüm 10</small>Motor onarımı 🔧</h2>\n    <p>Makine dairesinde <b>ANA MOTOR</b> → <kbd>E</kbd>. Onarım 4 aşamadır; tamamladığın aşamalar kaydedilir.</p>\n    <ol><li><b>Kablolar:</b> renkli kabloları aynı renkteki sokete sürükle.</li>\n    <li><b>Sigortalar:</b> kararmış sigortalara tıkla, sonra ana şalteri kaldır. Sağlamlara dokunma!</li>\n    <li><b>Basınç:</b> ibre yeşil bölgedeyken KİLİTLE ya da <kbd>Space</kbd>. 3 kez başarman gerekir.</li>\n    <li><b>Ateşleme:</b> ışık dizisini izle, aynı sırayla bas.</li></ol>\n    <div class="tip">Onarım bitince kalkış kilidi açılır ve görevler seni Dünya\'ya yönlendirir.</div>':
      '<h2><small>Chapter 10</small>Engine repair 🔧</h2>\n    <p>In the engine room: <b>MAIN ENGINE</b> → <kbd>E</kbd>. The repair has 4 stages; completed stages are saved.</p>\n    <ol><li><b>Cables:</b> drag the coloured cables to the socket of the same colour.</li>\n    <li><b>Fuses:</b> click the blackened fuses, then raise the main switch. Don\'t touch the good ones!</li>\n    <li><b>Pressure:</b> press LOCK or <kbd>Space</kbd> while the needle is in the green zone. You need to succeed 3 times.</li>\n    <li><b>Ignition:</b> watch the light sequence and press in the same order.</li></ol>\n    <div class="tip">Once the repair is done, the launch lock is released and the missions guide you back to Earth.</div>',
    '<h2><small>Bölüm 11</small>Uyku ve zaman</h2>\n    <p>Mars\'ta <b>1 gün = 6 dakika</b>. Sol üstteki çubuk günün ilerleyişini, turuncu çizgiler olayları gösterir.</p>\n    <ul><li>Uyku kabininde uyursan <b>zaman 2 kat hızlanır</b>, can hızla yenilenir.</li>\n    <li>Sabah olunca kendiliğinden uyanırsın. Aç ya da susuz kalırsan erken uyanırsın.</li>\n    <li>Uyurken mahsul de 2 kat hızlı büyür.</li></ul>\n    <div class="tip">Radyasyon gecesinde ya da uzun bir fırtınada uyumak, tehlikeyi güvenle atlatmanın en kolay yolu.</div>':
      '<h2><small>Chapter 11</small>Sleep and time</h2>\n    <p>On Mars <b>1 day = 6 minutes</b>. The bar at the top left shows the day\'s progress; orange marks show events.</p>\n    <ul><li>If you sleep in the sleeping cabin, <b>time runs 2× faster</b> and health regenerates quickly.</li>\n    <li>You wake up automatically in the morning. If you get hungry or thirsty, you wake up early.</li>\n    <li>Crops also grow 2× faster while you sleep.</li></ul>\n    <div class="tip">Sleeping through a radiation night or a long storm is the easiest way to get through the danger safely.</div>',
    '<h2><small>Bölüm 12</small>Felaket takvimi</h2>\n    <p class="sm">Bugün: <b>Gün {0}</b> · gün bitimine <b>{1}</b> · sonraki fırtına <b>Gün {2}</b></p>\n    <table class="cal">{3}</table>\n    <p class="sm">Meteorlar takvime girmez: her an düşebilir.</p>':
      '<h2><small>Chapter 12</small>Disaster calendar</h2>\n    <p class="sm">Today: <b>Day {0}</b> · until day\'s end <b>{1}</b> · next storm <b>Day {2}</b></p>\n    <table class="cal">{3}</table>\n    <p class="sm">Meteors are not on the calendar: they can fall at any time.</p>',
    "<h2><small>Bölüm 13</small>Dünya ile iletişim 📡</h2>\n    <p>Görevin asıl amacı: Mars'ta yaşadıklarını ve topladığın bilgileri <b>Dünya'ya aktarmak</b>. Komuta güvertesinin solundaki <b>İLETİŞİM</b> masasına <kbd>E</kbd>.</p>\n    <ul><li><b>Saha günlüğü</b> fırtına, radyasyon, meteor, arıza, numune, tarım ve kritik değerleri <b>otomatik</b> kaydeder.</li>\n    <li>Kayıtları seç, kendi notunu yaz (sorunlarını, sorularını), öncelik belirle ve gönder.</li>\n    <li>Görev Kontrol <b>~½ sol</b> sonra (ACİL: ~¼ sol) resmî bir yanıt yollar: analiz, talimatlar ve 5 sollük tahmin.</li>\n    <li>Kum fırtınası sırasında anten tozla kapanır, <b>gönderim yapılamaz</b>.</li>\n    <li><b>🛰️ Yer Birimi</b> sekmesi, raporlarını alan yer istasyonlarını ve görev kontrol merkezlerini gösterir.</li></ul>\n    <div class=\"tip\">Görev Kontrol bazen kendiliğinden yazar: hava bültenleri, telemetri uyarıları, rapor talepleri. Sağ üstteki rozet yeni mesajı gösterir.</div>":
      '<h2><small>Chapter 13</small>Communicating with Earth 📡</h2>\n    <p>The real goal of the mission: <b>transmitting to Earth</b> what you experience on Mars and the data you collect. Press <kbd>E</kbd> at the <b>COMMS</b> desk on the left of the command deck.</p>\n    <ul><li>The <b>field log</b> <b>automatically</b> records storms, radiation, meteors, breakdowns, samples, farming and critical values.</li>\n    <li>Select entries, write your own note (your problems, your questions), set a priority and send.</li>\n    <li>Mission Control sends an official reply after <b>~½ sol</b> (URGENT: ~¼ sol): analysis, instructions and a 5-sol forecast.</li>\n    <li>During a sandstorm the antenna is clogged with dust and <b>nothing can be sent</b>.</li>\n    <li>The <b>🛰️ Ground Segment</b> tab shows the ground stations and mission control centers that receive your reports.</li></ul>\n    <div class="tip">Mission Control sometimes writes on its own: weather bulletins, telemetry alerts, report requests. The badge at the top right shows new messages.</div>',
    '<h2><small>Bölüm 14</small>Kıyafet & roket geliştirme 🧬</h2>\n    <p>Yaşam güvertesindeki <b>Fabrikasyon Atölyesi</b> <kbd>E</kbd> ile açılır.</p>\n    <ul><li><b>Kıyafet setleri</b> (Kaşif → Öncü → Kalkan → ARES Elite) metal numune, yıldız kristali ve nadir taşlarla sırayla üretilir. Her set oksijen tüketimini, yürüme hızını, radyasyon ve fırtına korumasını artırır.</li>\n    <li><b>Roket geliştirme</b> meteor kraterlerinin çevresine saçılan <b>altın parçaları</b> ve titanyum cevheriyle yapılır. Fırtına kalkanı 3 seviyedir; son seviyede fırtına motoru bozamaz.</li>\n    <li>İlk fırtınadan sonraki her fırtınada motor <b>%60</b> olasılıkla bozulur — kalkan bunu azaltır.</li>\n    <li>Altınla rokete yeni boyalar da alabilirsin.</li></ul>\n    <div class="tip">Meteor düştükten sonra krater çevresini tara: parıldayan sarı parçalar altındır. Uzak bölgelerde tarayıcının bip sesini takip et: <b>bilinmeyen taşlar</b> (titanyum, olivin, Ares taşı) üst seviye geliştirmeler için şart — çıkarmak için saha kiti gerekir.</div>':
      '<h2><small>Chapter 14</small>Suit & rocket upgrades 🧬</h2>\n    <p>The <b>Fabrication Workshop</b> on the living deck opens with <kbd>E</kbd>.</p>\n    <ul><li><b>Suit sets</b> (Explorer → Pioneer → Shield → ARES Elite) are built in order from metal samples, star crystals and rare stones. Each set improves oxygen use, walking speed, and radiation and storm protection.</li>\n    <li><b>Rocket upgrades</b> are made with the <b>gold fragments</b> scattered around meteor craters and with titanium ore. The storm shield has 3 levels; at the last level storms can no longer break the engine.</li>\n    <li>In every storm after the first one, the engine breaks down with a <b>60%</b> chance — the shield reduces this.</li>\n    <li>With gold you can also buy new paint jobs for the rocket.</li></ul>\n    <div class="tip">After a meteor falls, search around the crater: the glittering yellow fragments are gold. In remote areas follow the scanner\'s beep: <b>unknown stones</b> (titanium, olivine, Ares stone) are required for top-tier upgrades — you need the field kit to extract them.</div>',
    '<h2><small>Bölüm 15</small>Acil durum listesi</h2>\n    <table class="emg"><tr><td>🫁 Oksijen &lt; %30</td><td>Rokete dön → O₂ tüpleri</td></tr>\n    <tr><td>❤ Can düşük</td><td>Medikit (<kbd>G</kbd>), revir ya da uyku</td></tr>\n    <tr><td>💧 / 🍽 bitti</td><td>Mutfak ya da yemek kapsülü</td></tr>\n    <tr><td>🌪 Turuncu kart</td><td>45 sn içinde rokete gir</td></tr>\n    <tr><td>☢ Yeşil kart</td><td>Rokete gir, mümkünse uyu</td></tr>\n    <tr><td>☄ Uğultu + gölge</td><td>Gölgeden uzaklaş</td></tr>\n    <tr><td>💨 Motordan duman</td><td>Ana motoru onar</td></tr></table>\n    <h3>Eve dönüş</h3><p>Sol üstteki görev kartını takip et: numune → kit → tarım → ilk rapor → fırtına → motor onarımı → radyasyon → hasat → Dünya\'nın yanıtı → altın → nadir taş → yeni kıyafet → kargo (10). Sonra komuta güvertesinde <b>NAVİGASYON</b> → <b>EVE DÖN</b>.</p>':
      '<h2><small>Chapter 15</small>Emergency checklist</h2>\n    <table class="emg"><tr><td>🫁 Oxygen &lt; 30%</td><td>Back to the rocket → O₂ tanks</td></tr>\n    <tr><td>❤ Low health</td><td>Medkit (<kbd>G</kbd>), sick bay or sleep</td></tr>\n    <tr><td>💧 / 🍽 empty</td><td>Kitchen or food capsule</td></tr>\n    <tr><td>🌪 Orange card</td><td>Enter the rocket within 45 s</td></tr>\n    <tr><td>☢ Green card</td><td>Enter the rocket, sleep if possible</td></tr>\n    <tr><td>☄ Rumble + shadow</td><td>Move away from the shadow</td></tr>\n    <tr><td>💨 Smoke from the engine</td><td>Repair the main engine</td></tr></table>\n    <h3>Going home</h3><p>Follow the mission card at the top left: samples → kit → farming → first report → storm → engine repair → radiation → harvest → Earth\'s reply → gold → rare stone → new suit → cargo (10). Then on the command deck: <b>NAVIGATION</b> → <b>GO HOME</b>.</p>',
    '<h2><small>Bölüm 16</small>Görev mimarisi 📐</h2>\n    <p>ARES-1 bir uzay görevinin tüm parçalarıyla tasarlandı. İletişim terminalindeki <b>📐 Görev Mimarisi</b> sekmesi bunları canlı gösterir.</p>\n    <ul><li><b>Görev segmentleri:</b> fırlatma, uzay, yer ve kullanıcı segmentleri birlikte çalışır.</li>\n    <li><b>Kavram olgunluğu:</b> görev bir fikirle başlar; fizibilite analizi ve ödünleşim çalışmalarından geçerek nokta tasarıma ulaşır.</li>\n    <li><b>Alt sistemler:</b> itki, yaşam desteği, ısıl koruma, yapı ve iletişim ayrı ayrı izlenir.</li></ul>\n    <div class="tip">ARES-1 kurgusal bir görevdir; oyundaki sayılar oyun için basitleştirilmiştir.</div>':
      '<h2><small>Chapter 16</small>Mission architecture 📐</h2>\n    <p>ARES-1 was designed with all the parts of a space mission. The <b>📐 Mission Architecture</b> tab of the communications terminal shows them live.</p>\n    <ul><li><b>Mission segments:</b> the launch, space, ground and user segments work together.</li>\n    <li><b>Concept maturity:</b> a mission starts as an idea and reaches a point design through feasibility analysis and trade studies.</li>\n    <li><b>Subsystems:</b> propulsion, life support, thermal protection, structure and communications are tracked separately.</li></ul>\n    <div class="tip">ARES-1 is a fictional mission; the numbers in the game are simplified for gameplay.</div>',

      '<div class="ltr">\n  <div class="ltr-hd"><div class="ltr-seal"><b>ARES</b><span>MC</span></div>\n    <div class="ltr-org"><b>ARES-1 MISSION CONTROL CENTER</b><span>Via the ground station network</span></div>\n    <div class="ltr-cls {0}">{1}OFFICIAL<br><small>CREW ONLY</small></div></div>\n  <table class="ltr-meta">\n    <tr><td>Document No</td><td>{2}</td><td>Date</td><td>{3} (Mars local)</td></tr>\n    <tr><td>To</td><td>ARES-1 Commander</td><td>Ref.</td><td>{4}</td></tr>\n    <tr><td>Subject</td><td colspan="3"><b>{5}</b></td></tr></table>\n  <div class="ltr-body">{6}</div>\n  {7}\n  <div class="ltr-sign">{8}</div>\n  {9}\n  <div class="ltr-ft">This message was transmitted with a {10} min light delay · Encrypted channel AES-256 · {11}</div>\n</div>',
