/* roket her gezegende aynı sabit konumda; market ve çadırın işlevleri roketin içinde */
const ROCKET = { x: 300, y: -60 };
const DAY_SECONDS = 360,
  SLEEP_MULTIPLIER = 2,
  RADIATION_DURATION = 90,
  RADIATION_DAMAGE_PER_SECOND = 5.5,
  RAD_WARN = 40; // 1 gün = 10 dk
/* tarım parselleri artık dinamik: kazmayla açılır */
const PLOTS_LEGACY = [
  { x: -40, y: 50 },
  { x: 66, y: 50 },
  { x: -40, y: 190 },
  { x: 66, y: 190 },
]; // eski kayıt göçü için

function spawnStones(scene) {
  const L = CFG.worldHalf - 120,
    arr = [],
    r2 = rng(42 + PLANETS[scene].order * 17);
  const lp = (game && game.plots && game.plots[scene]) || [];
  let guard = 0;
  while (arr.length < CFG.stoneCount && guard++ < 20000) {
    // ilk 34 numune roketin çevresinde (ilk görevler için), kalanı tüm haritaya dağılır
    let x, y;
    if (arr.length < 34) {
      const a = r2() * 6.283,
        d = 300 + r2() * 1900;
      x = ROCKET.x + Math.cos(a) * d;
      y = ROCKET.y + Math.sin(a) * d;
    } else {
      x = (r2() * 2 - 1) * L;
      y = (r2() * 2 - 1) * L;
    }
    if (Math.hypot(x - ROCKET.x, y - ROCKET.y) <= 240) continue;
    if (lp.some((pl) => Math.hypot(x - pl.x, y - pl.y) < 150)) continue;
    arr.push({ x, y, ph: r2() * 6, taken: false });
  }
  return arr;
}
let stones = [],
  drops = [];

/* ============== PARÇACIKLAR ============== */
const parts = [],
  floats = [];
function burst(x, y, n, color, o) {
  n = Math.max(1, Math.round(n * (settings.parts || 1)));
  o = o || {};
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * 6.283,
      sp = (o.sp || 70) * (0.35 + Math.random() * 0.9),
      life = o.life || 0.6;
    parts.push({
      x,
      y,
      vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
      vy: Math.sin(a) * sp - (o.up || 0),
      life,
      max: life,
      color,
      size: (o.size || 4) * (0.55 + Math.random() * 0.9),
      g: o.g == null ? 150 : o.g,
      drag: o.drag == null ? 2.2 : o.drag,
    });
  }
}
function addFloat(x, y, txt, color) {
  if (settings.floats === false) return;
  floats.push({ x, y, txt, life: 1.1, color: color || "#eef0ff" });
}
function updateParticles(dt) {
  for (let i = parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const q = parts[i];
    q.life -= dt;
    if (q.life <= 0) {
      parts.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }
    q.vx -= q.vx * q.drag * dt;
    q.vy -= q.vy * q.drag * dt;
    q.vy += q.g * dt;
    q.x += q.vx * dt;
    q.y += q.vy * dt;
  }
  for (let i = floats.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const f = floats[i];
    f.life -= dt;
    f.y -= 42 * dt;
    if (f.life <= 0) floats.splice(i, 1);
  }
  if (parts.length > 500) parts.splice(0, parts.length - 500);
}
function drawParticles() {
  for (const q of parts) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, q.life / q.max);
    ctx.fillStyle = q.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(q.x, q.y, q.size, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.font = "700 17px sans-serif";
  for (const f of floats) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, f.life * 1.4);
    ctx.fillStyle = f.color;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.6)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.strokeText(f.txt, f.x, f.y);
    ctx.fillText(f.txt, f.x, f.y);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function rr(x, y, w, h, r, c) {
  ctx.fillStyle = c;
  ctx.beginPath();
  if (ctx.roundRect) ctx.roundRect(x, y, w, h, r);
  else ctx.rect(x, y, w, h);
  ctx.fill();
}

function heldItemKey() {
  if (!game) return null;
  if (p && p.action === "dig") return "pickaxe";
  if (p && p.action === "mine") return "pick";
  if (p && p.action === "drink") return "water";
  if (p && p.action === "eat") return "potato";
  if (p && p.action === "use") return "medkit";
  const k = (game.slotOrder || [])[selSlot];
  if (!k) return null;
  if (k === "kit") return game.kitCarried ? "pickaxe" : null;
  if (isRareSlot(k)) return slotCount(k) > 0 ? k : null;
  return (game.inventory[k] || 0) > 0 ? k : null;
}

/* ============== ASTRONOT — gelişmiş 2D iskelet modeli ==============
   Uzuvlar iki eklemli (kalça-diz-bot, omuz-dirsek-eldiven), kazma iki elle
   IK ile kavranır, göğüs paneli canlı veri gösterir, vizör yansımalıdır. */
const SUIT = {
  white: "#f6f7fc",
  light: "#e3e7f3",
  shade: "#c4cbde",
  dark: "#98a1bd",
  line: "#5f6886",
  orange: "#ff8c42",
  orangeD: "#c75d1e",
  navy: "#232b4d",
  steel: "#7f879f",
  glove: "#ff9a52",
};
function rrp(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  if (ctx.roundRect) ctx.roundRect(x, y, w, h, r);
  else ctx.rect(x, y, w, h);
}
function rotP(lx, ly, a) {
  const c = Math.cos(a),
    s = Math.sin(a);
  return { x: lx * c - ly * s, y: lx * s + ly * c };
}
function capsule(x1, y1, x2, y2, w, fill, stroke) {
  ctx.lineCap = "round";
  if (stroke) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = stroke;
    ctx.lineWidth = w + 2.6;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
    ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.strokeStyle = fill;
  ctx.lineWidth = w;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
  ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
  ctx.stroke();
}
/* iki kemikli ters kinematik: omuzdan hedefe uzanan kolun dirsek konumu */
function ik2(sx, sy, hx, hy, l1, l2, bend) {
  let dx = hx - sx,
    dy = hy - sy,
    d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const mx = l1 + l2 - 0.05,
    mn = Math.abs(l1 - l2) + 0.05;
  if (d > mx) {
    dx *= mx / d;
    dy *= mx / d;
    d = mx;
  }
  if (d < mn) d = mn;
  const a = Math.acos(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, (l1 * l1 + d * d - l2 * l2) / (2 * l1 * d))));
  const ea = Math.atan2(dy, dx) + bend * a;
  return { ex: sx + Math.cos(ea) * l1, ey: sy + Math.sin(ea) * l1, hx: sx + dx, hy: sy + dy };
}
let ASTRO_POSE = null; // sinematikler için: {b:[uyluk,baldır],f:[uyluk,baldır],ns:gölgesiz}
function drawLeg(hx, hy, ph, S, back) {
  let a1 = Math.sin(ph) * S; // uyluk açısı (ileri +)
  const bend = Math.max(0, Math.cos(ph)) * S * 1.15; // diz bükülmesi: bacak öne salınırken
  let a2 = a1 - bend;
  if (ASTRO_POSE && ASTRO_POSE.b) {
    const q = back ? ASTRO_POSE.b : ASTRO_POSE.f;
    a1 = q[0];
    a2 = q[1];
  }
  const L1 = 15,
    L2 = 14;
  const kx = hx + Math.sin(a1) * L1,
    ky = hy + Math.cos(a1) * L1;
  const fx = kx + Math.sin(a2) * L2,
    fy = ky + Math.cos(a2) * L2;
  const fill = back ? SUIT.shade : SUIT.light,
    line = back ? SUIT.dark : SUIT.line;
  capsule(hx, hy, kx, ky, 10, fill, line);
  ctx.fillStyle = back ? SUIT.dark : SUIT.steel;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(kx, ky, 4.2, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill(); // diz eklemi
  capsule(kx, ky, fx, fy, 9, fill, line);
  // bot
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(fx, fy);
  ctx.rotate(-a2 * 0.35);
  ctx.fillStyle = back ? SUIT.orangeD : SUIT.orange;
  rrp(-6, -4, 14, 9, 4);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(90,40,10,.6)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.3;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(40,20,10,.55)";
  rrp(-6, 3, 14, 2.5, 1);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.3)";
  rrp(-4, -3, 6, 2, 1);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
  return { fx, fy };
}
function armSegs(sx, sy, ex, ey, hx, hy, back) {
  const fill = back ? SUIT.shade : SUIT.light,
    line = back ? SUIT.dark : SUIT.line;
  capsule(sx, sy, ex, ey, 8.5, fill, line);
  ctx.fillStyle = back ? SUIT.dark : SUIT.steel;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ex, ey, 3.6, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill(); // dirsek
  capsule(ex, ey, hx, hy, 7.5, fill, line);
  // bilek bandı
  const dx = hx - ex,
    dy = hy - ey,
    d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
  ctx.strokeStyle = back ? SUIT.orangeD : SUIT.orange;
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(hx - (dx / d) * 4 - (dy / d) * 4.5, hy - (dy / d) * 4 + (dx / d) * 4.5);
  ctx.lineTo(hx - (dx / d) * 4 + (dy / d) * 4.5, hy - (dy / d) * 4 - (dx / d) * 4.5);
  ctx.stroke();
}
function drawArm(sx, sy, a1, a2, back) {
  const L1 = 13,
    L2 = 12;
  const ex = sx + Math.sin(a1) * L1,
    ey = sy + Math.cos(a1) * L1;
  const hx = ex + Math.sin(a1 + a2) * L2,
    hy = ey + Math.cos(a1 + a2) * L2;
  armSegs(sx, sy, ex, ey, hx, hy, back);
  return { hx, hy };
}
function glove(x, y, back) {
  ctx.fillStyle = back ? SUIT.orangeD : SUIT.glove;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y, 5, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(110,45,10,.65)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.3;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.35)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x - 1.5, y - 1.8, 1.6, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
}
/* vektörel kazma: sap + çelik başlık (sivri uç ileri bakar) */
function drawPickaxe(px, py, rot) {
  drawHoe(px, py, rot);
}
/* vektörel çapa: uzun ahşap sap + öne bakan geniş çelik ağız */
function drawHoe(px, py, rot) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(px, py);
  ctx.rotate(rot);
  ctx.scale(1.4, 1.4);
  const wg = ctx.createLinearGradient(-2.2, 0, 2.2, 0);
  wg.addColorStop(0, "#8a5a2b");
  wg.addColorStop(0.5, "#d39a58");
  wg.addColorStop(1, "#6e4320");
  ctx.fillStyle = wg;
  rrp(-2.2, -28, 4.4, 44, 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(60,30,10,.6)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 0.9;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(80,45,15,.45)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 0.7;
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-1.4, -20 + i * 7);
    ctx.lineTo(1, -16 + i * 7);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2a2f3f";
  rrp(-2.8, 6, 5.6, 9, 1.5);
  ctx.fill(); // kauçuk tutamak
  ctx.fillStyle = "#7a8299";
  rrp(-3.6, -31, 7.2, 6, 1.5);
  ctx.fill(); // bağlantı bileziği
  ctx.fillStyle = "#3f475f";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -28, 1.1, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  const sg = ctx.createLinearGradient(2, -34, 18, -14);
  sg.addColorStop(0, "#f1f4fa");
  sg.addColorStop(0.45, "#a7b0c8");
  sg.addColorStop(1, "#5c6684");
  ctx.fillStyle = sg;
  ctx.beginPath(); // boyun + geniş ağız
  ctx.moveTo(3, -31);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(10, -33, 13, -28);
  ctx.lineTo(19, -27);
  ctx.lineTo(21, -13);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(14, -11, 9, -13);
  ctx.lineTo(10, -26);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(7, -28, 3, -27);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#3f475f";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.1;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.75)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(10, -13.4);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(15, -12, 20.6, -13.6);
  ctx.stroke(); // bilenmiş kenar
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.35)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(13, -26);
  ctx.lineTo(17, -25.6);
  ctx.lineTo(18, -17);
  ctx.lineTo(14, -17);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(140,80,50,.55)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(16, -14.6, 3.5, 1.2, 0, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill(); // toprak izi
  ctx.restore();
}

function astronaut(x, y, running, heldKey, actionT) {
  const t = performance.now() / 1000,
    ph = p.t,
    walk = p.walk;
  const S = CFG.legSwing * walk * (running ? 1.3 : 1);
  const bob = Math.abs(Math.sin(ph)) * 2.6 * walk; // adımda yukarı-aşağı
  const breathe = Math.sin(t * 2.4) * (1 - walk); // dururken nefes
  let lean = running ? 0.14 * walk : 0; // koşuda öne eğilme
  if (p.action === "mine" && actionT > 0) {
    // kazmayla vururken belden bükülme: kaldırırken geriye, vururken öne
    const pr = 1 - Math.min(1, actionT / (p.actionDur || 0.62)),
      E = (v) => v * v * (3 - 2 * v);
    lean =
      pr < 0.4
        ? -0.16 * E(pr / 0.4)
        : pr < 0.46
          ? -0.16
          : pr < 0.56
            ? -0.16 + 0.62 * ((pr - 0.46) / 0.1)
            : pr < 0.72
              ? 0.46
              : 0.46 * (1 - E((pr - 0.72) / 0.28));
  }
  const hpLow = !!(game && game.hp < 35);
  const storm = stormFx.I > 0.25 || !!(game && game.radiationActive && !insideRocket);
  const dig = heldKey === "pickaxe" || heldKey === "pick",
    acting = actionT > 0 && !dig;
  const prog = acting ? 1 - Math.min(1, actionT / (p.actionDur || 0.9)) : 0;
  const raise = !acting ? 0 : prog < 0.2 ? prog / 0.2 : prog > 0.85 ? (1 - prog) / 0.15 : 1; // kolu kaldır-tut-indir
  const blink = Math.sin(t * 6) > 0;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.scale(p.dir * p.sx, p.sy);
  // gölge
  if (!(ASTRO_POSE && ASTRO_POSE.ns)) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.32)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 44, 24 - bob * 0.8, 7 - bob * 0.3, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  // kask lambası: fırtına/radyasyonda zemine ışık konisi
  if (storm) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,230,160," + (0.09 + Math.sin(t * 9) * 0.02) + ")";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(6, -56);
    ctx.lineTo(110, -6);
    ctx.lineTo(110, 34);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.translate(0, -bob);

  // --- bacaklar
  drawLeg(-3, 16, ph + Math.PI, S, true);
  drawLeg(3, 16, ph, S, false);

  // --- üst gövde (kalçadan eğilir)
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(0, 16);
  ctx.rotate(lean);
  ctx.translate(0, -16 - breathe * 0.5);

  // kol planı: önce hedefler hesaplanır, çizim sırası korunur
  let drawBackArm,
    drawFrontArm,
    drawItem = null;
  if (dig) {
    // dururken: omuzda hafif nefes salınımı · yürürken: adımla birlikte sallanır
    const idle =
      Math.sin(ph) * 0.13 * walk +
      (running ? Math.sin(ph * 2) * 0.08 : 0) +
      breathe * 0.035 +
      Math.sin(t * 1.3) * 0.02 * (1 - walk);
    let rot = 0.6 + idle,
      px = 4 + Math.sin(ph) * 2 * walk,
      py = 6 + Math.abs(Math.cos(ph)) * 1.6 * walk + breathe * 0.6;
    if (actionT > 0 && p.action === "dig") {
      const pr = 1 - Math.min(1, actionT / (p.actionDur || 1)),
        E = (v) => v * v * (3 - 2 * v);
      if (pr < 0.36) {
        const q = E(pr / 0.36);
        rot = 0.6 + (-1.05 - 0.6) * q;
        px = 4 - 4 * q;
        py = 6 - 12 * q;
      } // geriye, baş üstüne kaldır
      else if (pr < 0.44) {
        const q = (pr - 0.36) / 0.08;
        rot = -1.05 - 0.07 * Math.sin(q * Math.PI);
        px = 0;
        py = -6;
      } // tepe noktasında kısa bekleme
      else if (pr < 0.55) {
        const q = (pr - 0.44) / 0.11;
        rot = -1.05 + (1.85 + 1.05) * q * q;
        px = 12 * q;
        py = -6 + 18 * q;
      } // ivmeli, sert iniş
      else if (pr < 0.67) {
        const q = (pr - 0.55) / 0.12;
        rot = 1.85 - 0.09 * Math.sin(q * Math.PI * 3) * (1 - q);
        px = 12;
        py = 12;
      } // toprağa saplanma titreşimi
      else {
        const q = E((pr - 0.67) / 0.33);
        rot = 1.85 + (0.6 - 1.85) * q + 0.25 * Math.sin(q * Math.PI);
        px = 12 - 8 * q;
        py = 12 - 6 * q;
      } // toprağı çekip geri al
    }
    if (actionT > 0 && p.action === "mine") {
      // kazma: başın üstünden tam savurma → taşa sert vuruş
      const pr = 1 - Math.min(1, actionT / (p.actionDur || 0.62)),
        E = (v) => v * v * (3 - 2 * v);
      if (pr < 0.4) {
        const q = E(pr / 0.4);
        rot = 0.5 + (-1.45 - 0.5) * q;
        px = 4 - 7 * q;
        py = 4 - 14 * q;
      } else if (pr < 0.46) {
        rot = -1.45 - 0.05 * Math.sin(((pr - 0.4) / 0.06) * Math.PI);
        px = -3;
        py = -10;
      } else if (pr < 0.56) {
        const q = (pr - 0.46) / 0.1;
        rot = -1.45 + (1.5 + 1.45) * q * q;
        px = -3 + 19 * q;
        py = -10 + 22 * q;
      } else if (pr < 0.72) {
        const q = (pr - 0.56) / 0.16;
        rot = 1.5 - 0.12 * Math.sin(q * Math.PI * 4) * (1 - q);
        px = 16;
        py = 12;
      } else {
        const q = E((pr - 0.72) / 0.28);
        rot = 1.5 + (0.5 - 1.5) * q;
        px = 16 - 12 * q;
        py = 12 - 8 * q;
      }
    }
    const g1 = rotP(0, 3, rot),
      g2 = rotP(0, -14, rot);
    const h1 = { x: px + g1.x, y: py + g1.y },
      h2 = { x: px + g2.x, y: py + g2.y };
    drawBackArm = () => {
      const k = ik2(-11, -13, h2.x, h2.y, 13, 12, 1);
      armSegs(-11, -13, k.ex, k.ey, k.hx, k.hy, true);
    };
    drawFrontArm = () => {
      const k = ik2(11, -13, h1.x, h1.y, 13, 12, 1);
      armSegs(11, -13, k.ex, k.ey, k.hx, k.hy, false);
    };
    drawItem = () => {
      if (heldKey === "pick") drawGeoPick(ctx, px, py, rot);
      else drawPickaxe(px, py, rot);
      glove(h2.x, h2.y, true);
      glove(h1.x, h1.y, false);
    };
  } else {
    const swing = Math.sin(ph) * S * 0.85;
    const bendB = 0.3 + Math.max(0, Math.sin(ph)) * 0.4,
      bendF = 0.3 + Math.max(0, -Math.sin(ph)) * 0.4;
    drawBackArm = () => {
      const h = drawArm(-11, -13, swing - 0.1, bendB, true);
      glove(h.hx, h.hy, true);
    };
    if (heldKey) {
      const rest = { x: 19, y: 3 + Math.sin(ph) * 2 * walk + breathe * 0.6 },
        vis = { x: 11, y: -36 };
      const hx = rest.x + (vis.x - rest.x) * raise,
        hy = rest.y + (vis.y - rest.y) * raise;
      drawFrontArm = () => {
        const k = ik2(11, -13, hx, hy, 13, 12, 1);
        armSegs(11, -13, k.ex, k.ey, k.hx, k.hy, false);
        glove(k.hx, k.hy, false);
      };
      drawItem = () => {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(hx + 3, hy - 8);
        drawHeldArt(heldKey, acting, prog);
        ctx.restore();
      };
    } else {
      drawFrontArm = () => {
        const h = drawArm(11, -13, -swing + 0.1, bendF, false);
        glove(h.hx, h.hy, false);
      };
    }
  }

  // sırt çantası (yaşam destek ünitesi)
  const pg = ctx.createLinearGradient(-29, 0, -13, 0);
  pg.addColorStop(0, "#aab2cc");
  pg.addColorStop(1, "#dde2ee");
  ctx.fillStyle = pg;
  rrp(-29, -19, 16, 36, 5);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = SUIT.line;
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
  ctx.stroke();
  for (const ty of [-14, -2]) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#f0f2f8";
    rrp(-27, ty, 12, 9, 4);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = SUIT.dark;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = ty < -10 ? "#38bdf8" : "#4ade80";
    ctx.fillRect(-27, ty + 3, 12, 2.2);
  }
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(60,70,100,.5)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-26, 9 + i * 2.2);
    ctx.lineTo(-16, 9 + i * 2.2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = blink ? "#4ade80" : "#1f6a38";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(-18, 14, 1.4, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  if (game && game.kitCarried && !dig) {
    // çapa: elde değilken sırtta çapraz taşınır
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(-20, -4 + Math.sin(ph) * 1.2 * walk);
    ctx.rotate(-0.55 + Math.sin(ph) * 0.05 * walk);
    ctx.scale(0.62, 0.62);
    drawHoe(0, 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();
  }
  // hortum: çantadan kaska
  ctx.lineCap = "round";
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#b9c1d8";
  ctx.lineWidth = 3.2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-24, -19);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-31, -40, -15, -45);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(60,70,100,.5)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-24, -19);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-31, -40, -15, -45);
  ctx.stroke();

  drawBackArm();

  // gövde
  const tg = ctx.createLinearGradient(-18, 0, 18, 0);
  tg.addColorStop(0, SUIT.white);
  tg.addColorStop(0.55, SUIT.light);
  tg.addColorStop(1, SUIT.shade);
  ctx.fillStyle = tg;
  rrp(-18, -24, 36, 44, 12);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = SUIT.line;
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.8;
  ctx.stroke();
  for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
    ctx.fillStyle = SUIT.orange;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(s * 13, -17, 7, 5, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = SUIT.orangeD;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(95,104,134,.35)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-15, -6);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, -3, 15, -6);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-16, 4);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, 7, 16, 4);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = SUIT.orange;
  rrp(-18, 11, 36, 6, 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = SUIT.navy;
  rrp(-4, 10, 8, 8, 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // göğüs kontrol paneli (canlı veri)
  ctx.fillStyle = SUIT.navy;
  rrp(-11, -13, 22, 15, 3.5);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#4a5580";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1230";
  rrp(-8.5, -11, 11, 6, 1.5);
  ctx.fill();
  const hpF = game ? game.hp / 100 : 1,
    o2F = game ? game.thirst / 100 : 1;
  ctx.fillStyle = hpF < 0.35 ? "#ff5a5a" : "#4ade80";
  ctx.fillRect(-7.5, -10, 9 * hpF, 1.6);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#38bdf8";
  ctx.fillRect(-7.5, -7.6, 9 * o2F, 1.6);
  ctx.fillStyle = hpLow && blink ? "#ff3b3b" : hpLow ? "#5a1a1a" : "#4ade80";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(5.5, -9.5, 1.8, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  if (hpLow && blink) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,60,60,.35)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(5.5, -9.5, 4.5, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = Math.sin(t * 3) > 0 ? "#ffd34d" : "#7a5a1a";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(5.5, -5, 1.8, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#8d96b8";
  for (const bx of [-8, -4, 0]) ctx.fillRect(bx, -3.2, 2.6, 2.2);
  // görev rozeti
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff5a4a";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(13, -3, 3.2, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(13, -3, 1.2, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  suitDecoTorso(t);
  suitDecoShoulders();

  // boyun halkası + kask
  ctx.fillStyle = SUIT.steel;
  rrp(-9, -29, 18, 8, 3);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = SUIT.line;
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
  ctx.stroke();
  const headTilt =
    Math.sin(ph * 0.5) * 0.04 * walk +
    (acting ? -0.1 * raise : 0) +
    (running ? 0.08 * walk : 0) +
    Math.sin(t * 0.7) * 0.02 * (1 - walk);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(2, -40);
  ctx.rotate(headTilt);
  const hg = ctx.createRadialGradient(-7, -8, 3, 0, 0, 22);
  hg.addColorStop(0, SUIT.white);
  hg.addColorStop(0.7, SUIT.light);
  hg.addColorStop(1, SUIT.shade);
  ctx.fillStyle = hg;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, 20, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = SUIT.line;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.stroke();
  // vizör (altın kaplama, yansımalı)
  const vg = ctx.createLinearGradient(-6, -12, 16, 10);
  vg.addColorStop(0, SUITX.visor[0]);
  vg.addColorStop(0.35, SUITX.visor[1]);
  vg.addColorStop(0.7, SUITX.visor[2]);
  vg.addColorStop(1, SUITX.visor[3]);
  ctx.fillStyle = vg;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(6, 0, 13.5, 11.5, 0, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#aab1cf";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = SUITX.trim;
  ctx.lineWidth = 0.9;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(6, 0, 12, 10, 0, 0, 7);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(6, 0, 13, 11, 0, 0, 7);
  ctx.clip();
  const sh = Math.sin(t * 0.9) * 2; // yansıma yavaşça kayar
  ctx.fillStyle = PLANETS[scene] ? PLANETS[scene].ground : "#b3392a";
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3;
  ctx.fillRect(-10, 5, 30, 8);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.7)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(2 + sh * 0.3, -5.5, 5, 2.8, -0.55, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.45)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-3 + sh, 6);
  ctx.lineTo(10 + sh, -8);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(1 + sh, 8);
  ctx.lineTo(13 + sh, -4);
  ctx.stroke();
  for (const [gx, gy] of [
    [12, -2],
    [9, 5],
  ]) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + (0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(t * 3 + gx)) + ")";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(gx, gy, 0.9, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
  // kask lambası
  ctx.fillStyle = SUIT.steel;
  rrp(-6, -22, 10, 5, 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = storm ? "#fff3b0" : "#ffe08a";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(2, -19.5, 2, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  if (storm) {
    const lg = ctx.createRadialGradient(2, -19.5, 1, 2, -19.5, 14);
    lg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,235,170,.55)");
    lg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,235,170,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = lg;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(2, -19.5, 14, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  // yan iletişim kutusu + anten
  ctx.fillStyle = SUIT.steel;
  rrp(-21, -4, 6, 9, 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = SUIT.line;
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#c3c9e0";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.8;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-14, -14);
  ctx.lineTo(-19, -25);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = Math.sin(t * 4) > 0 ? "#ff5a5a" : "#7a2a2a";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(-19.5, -26, 2.4, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  suitDecoHelmet(t);
  ctx.restore(); // kask

  drawFrontArm();
  if (drawItem) drawItem();
  ctx.restore(); // üst gövde
  ctx.restore();
}

/* ============== ROKET — ortak gövde modeli (oyun içi + sinematik) ============== */
function rocketBody(o) {
  const t = o.t != null ? o.t : performance.now() / 1000;
  const flame = Math.max(0, o.flame || 0),
    broken = !!o.broken,
    rep = o.repairing;
  // --- motor alevleri (3 nozul)
  if (flame > 0.01) {
    for (const [nx, k] of [
      [-13, 0.68],
      [13, 0.68],
      [0, 1],
    ]) {
      const L = flame * (40 + Math.random() * 16) * k,
        w = 10 * k;
      const gl = ctx.createRadialGradient(nx, 38, 2, nx, 38, L * 0.8);
      gl.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,170,80,.45)");
      gl.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,120,40,0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = gl;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(nx, 38, L * 0.8, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
      const fg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 36, 0, 36 + L);
      fg.addColorStop(0, "#ffb347");
      fg.addColorStop(0.5, "#ff7a2a");
      fg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,80,20,0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = fg;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(nx - w, 36);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(nx - w * 1.2, 36 + L * 0.45, nx, 36 + L);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(nx + w * 1.2, 36 + L * 0.45, nx + w, 36);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      const ig = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 36, 0, 36 + L * 0.65);
      ig.addColorStop(0, "#ffffff");
      ig.addColorStop(0.4, "#ffe9a8");
      ig.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,220,120,0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = ig;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(nx - w * 0.5, 36);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(nx - w * 0.6, 36 + L * 0.3, nx, 36 + L * 0.65);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(nx + w * 0.6, 36 + L * 0.3, nx + w * 0.5, 36);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      if (flame > 0.6 && k === 1) {
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.55)";
        for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(nx, 36 + L * 0.18 * i, w * 0.28, w * 0.14, 0, 0, 7);
          ctx.fill();
        }
      }
    }
  }
  // --- arka merkez kanat
  ctx.fillStyle = RSK.cfin;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-6, 10);
  ctx.lineTo(6, 10);
  ctx.lineTo(4, 44);
  ctx.lineTo(-4, 44);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  // --- gövde
  const hull = () => {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -78);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(26, -40, 24, 30);
    ctx.lineTo(24, 34);
    ctx.lineTo(-24, 34);
    ctx.lineTo(-24, 30);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-26, -40, 0, -78);
    ctx.closePath();
  };
  const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(-26, 0, 26, 0);
  bg.addColorStop(0, RSK.hull[0]);
  bg.addColorStop(0.3, RSK.hull[1]);
  bg.addColorStop(0.7, RSK.hull[2]);
  bg.addColorStop(1, RSK.hull[3]);
  ctx.fillStyle = bg;
  hull();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.save();
  hull();
  ctx.clip();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(70,78,110,.35)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
  for (const py of [-46, -20, 20]) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-26, py);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, py + 3, 26, py);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(60,68,100,.5)";
  for (const py of [-44, -18, 22])
    for (let rx = -20; rx <= 20; rx += 8) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(rx, py + (1 - Math.abs(rx) / 26) * 2.6, 0.9, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  // burun konisi
  const ng2 = ctx.createLinearGradient(-14, 0, 14, 0);
  ng2.addColorStop(0, RSK.nose[0]);
  ng2.addColorStop(0.45, RSK.nose[1]);
  ng2.addColorStop(1, RSK.nose[2]);
  ctx.fillStyle = ng2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, -80);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(14, -66, 16, -52);
  ctx.lineTo(-16, -52);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-14, -66, 0, -80);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#3b4260";
  ctx.fillRect(-18, -53, 36, 3);
  // renk bandı + isim + rozet
  ctx.fillStyle = RSK.band;
  ctx.fillRect(-26, -10, 52, 8);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#232b4d";
  ctx.fillRect(-26, -2, 52, 1.8);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(-16, 10);
  ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
  ctx.font = "700 6.5px 'Segoe UI',sans-serif";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillStyle = RSK.text;
  ctx.fillText("ARES-1", 0, 0);
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#232b4d";
  ctx.fillRect(12, -18, 8, 6);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff5a4a";
  ctx.fillRect(12, -15, 8, 1.2);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
  ctx.fillRect(12, -17, 8, 0.8);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2d3246";
  for (const rx of [-9, 9]) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(rx, -49, 1.6, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  } // RCS iticiler
  const sm = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 12, 0, 34);
  sm.addColorStop(0, "rgba(40,30,30,0)");
  sm.addColorStop(1, "rgba(40,30,30,.45)");
  ctx.fillStyle = sm;
  ctx.fillRect(-26, 12, 52, 22);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.6)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
  ctx.lineCap = "round";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-13, -56);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-20, -14, -17, 24);
  ctx.stroke();
  rocketDecoInside(t);
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.strokeStyle = RSK.line;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  hull();
  ctx.stroke();
  // --- yan kanatlar
  const fin = (sx) => {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(sx * 22, 4);
    ctx.lineTo(sx * 44, 42);
    ctx.lineTo(sx * 42, 46);
    ctx.lineTo(sx * 18, 34);
    ctx.closePath();
  };
  for (const sx of [-1, 1]) {
    ctx.save();
    if (broken && sx === -1) {
      ctx.translate(-22, 6);
      ctx.rotate(-0.45);
      ctx.translate(22, -6);
    }
    const fg = ctx.createLinearGradient(sx * 18, 10, sx * 44, 44);
    fg.addColorStop(0, RSK.fin[0]);
    fg.addColorStop(1, RSK.fin[1]);
    ctx.fillStyle = fg;
    fin(sx);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = RSK.finLine;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.35)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(sx * 24, 10);
    ctx.lineTo(sx * 40, 40);
    ctx.stroke();
    if (broken && sx === -1) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(20,10,10,.55)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(-34, 34, 8, 5, 0.6, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
  // --- motor eteği + nozullar
  const sk = ctx.createLinearGradient(-27, 0, 27, 0);
  sk.addColorStop(0, "#7d849e");
  sk.addColorStop(0.5, "#4a5068");
  sk.addColorStop(1, "#2d3246");
  ctx.fillStyle = sk;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-24, 22);
  ctx.lineTo(24, 22);
  ctx.lineTo(27, 36);
  ctx.lineTo(-27, 36);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#20243a";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.12)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let i = -20; i <= 20; i += 8) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(i, 23);
    ctx.lineTo(i * 1.12, 35);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (const [nx, k] of [
    [-13, 0.7],
    [13, 0.7],
    [0, 1],
  ]) {
    const w1 = 5 * k,
      w2 = 8.5 * k,
      y0 = 35,
      y1 = 35 + 10 * k;
    const ng = ctx.createLinearGradient(nx - w2, 0, nx + w2, 0);
    ng.addColorStop(0, "#c3c9dc");
    ng.addColorStop(0.5, "#5b6178");
    ng.addColorStop(1, "#23283b");
    ctx.fillStyle = ng;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(nx - w1, y0);
    ctx.lineTo(nx + w1, y0);
    ctx.lineTo(nx + w2, y1);
    ctx.lineTo(nx - w2, y1);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#15182a";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    ctx.stroke();
    if (flame > 0.01) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,200,120," + (0.5 * flame).toFixed(2) + ")";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(nx, y1, w2 * 0.8, 1.6, 0, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  // --- pencere (kabin ışıklı)
  const wr = ctx.createLinearGradient(-13, -43, 13, -17);
  wr.addColorStop(0, "#f3f5fb");
  wr.addColorStop(1, "#7a829f");
  ctx.fillStyle = wr;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -30, 15, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#4a5170";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.stroke();
  const wg = ctx.createRadialGradient(-4, -34, 2, 0, -30, 12);
  wg.addColorStop(0, "#d8f3ff");
  wg.addColorStop(0.5, "#3f8fd8");
  wg.addColorStop(1, "#13335c");
  ctx.fillStyle = wg;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -30, 11.5, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -30, 11.5, 0, 7);
  ctx.clip();
  if (!broken) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,220,150," + (0.22 + 0.1 * Math.sin(t * 2)).toFixed(2) + ")";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(3, -27, 6, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.55)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-8, -22);
  ctx.lineTo(4, -39);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-4, -20);
  ctx.lineTo(8, -36);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#3b4260";
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    const a = (i * Math.PI) / 3 + 0.3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(Math.cos(a) * 13.4, -30 + Math.sin(a) * 13.4, 1, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  // --- kapak + merdiven
  const hg = ctx.createLinearGradient(-9, 0, 9, 0);
  hg.addColorStop(0, "#dfe3ef");
  hg.addColorStop(1, "#a3abc6");
  ctx.fillStyle = hg;
  rrp(-9, -1, 18, 20, 4);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#4a5170";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#1b2a4a";
  rrp(-5, 2, 10, 6, 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#7a829f";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffb347";
  rrp(-2, 11, 4, 5, 1);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#6f7698";
  for (const hy of [2, 15]) ctx.fillRect(-9.5, hy, 2, 2.5);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(60,68,100,.55)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(12, 2 + i * 5);
    ctx.lineTo(19, 2 + i * 5);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  rocketDecoOutside(t);
  // --- anten + uyarı ışığı
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#c3c9e0";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, -80);
  ctx.lineTo(0, -92);
  ctx.stroke();
  const bl = Math.sin(t * 5) > 0;
  ctx.fillStyle = bl ? "#ff5a5a" : "#6a2222";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -93, 2.2, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  if (bl) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,90,90,.25)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, -93, 6, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  // --- hasar katmanı
  if (broken) {
    ctx.save();
    hull();
    ctx.clip();
    for (const [sx, sy, r] of [
      [12, -10, 16],
      [-14, 16, 12],
      [6, -50, 9],
    ]) {
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(sx, sy, 1, sx, sy, r);
      g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(20,16,20,.7)");
      g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(20,16,20,0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(sx, sy, r, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = "#6f7698";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(10, -14);
    ctx.lineTo(22, -18);
    ctx.lineTo(24, -4);
    ctx.lineTo(14, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(8, -6);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2a3047";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(13, -12);
    ctx.lineTo(21, -15);
    ctx.lineTo(22, -6);
    ctx.lineTo(15, -3);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(30,34,52,.85)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(14, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(10, 8);
    ctx.lineTo(13, 14);
    ctx.lineTo(8, 22);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-12, -40);
    ctx.lineTo(-8, -34);
    ctx.lineTo(-12, -28);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
    // sarkan kablo + kıvılcım
    const wx = 28 + Math.sin(t * 3) * 1.5;
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#2a2f45";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(22, -6);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(30, 4, 26, 14, wx, 22);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#ffb347";
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(22, -5);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(29, 4, 25, 14, wx - 1, 21);
    ctx.stroke();
    if (Math.sin(t * 23) > 0.75) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fff6c0";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(wx, 22, 2.6, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,230,140,.9)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        const a = t * 40 + i * 1.6;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(wx, 22);
        ctx.lineTo(wx + Math.cos(a) * 6, 22 + Math.sin(a) * 6);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
    // yerinden çıkmış panel
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(-20, -20);
    ctx.rotate(0.5 + Math.sin(t * 2) * 0.03);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#c5ccdf";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 9, 12);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#4a5170";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.strokeRect(0, 0, 9, 12);
    ctx.restore();
  }
  // --- tamir iskelesi + kaynak
  if (rep != null && rep !== false) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#c9a23a";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.8;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(30, 34);
    ctx.lineTo(30, -40);
    ctx.moveTo(40, 34);
    ctx.lineTo(40, -40);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    for (let yy = -40; yy < 34; yy += 14) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(30, yy);
      ctx.lineTo(40, yy + 14);
      ctx.moveTo(40, yy);
      ctx.lineTo(30, yy + 14);
      ctx.moveTo(26, yy);
      ctx.lineTo(40, yy);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    const wy = 24 - 64 * Math.min(1, rep),
      wx = 24;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(120,220,160,.18)";
    ctx.fillRect(-24, wy, 48, 24 - wy);
    if (Math.sin(t * 31) > -0.2) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fffbe0";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(wx, wy, 2.2 + Math.random() * 1.5, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(wx, wy, 1, wx, wy, 16);
      g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(180,220,255,.6)");
      g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(180,220,255,0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(wx, wy, 16, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,210,120,.9)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const a = Math.random() * 6.28,
          l = 4 + Math.random() * 9;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(wx, wy);
        ctx.lineTo(wx + Math.cos(a) * l, wy + Math.sin(a) * l);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
  }
}

function drawRocket(x, y) {
  const t = performance.now() / 1000,
    PI = Math.PI;
  const rp = (game && game.repair) || { state: "ok", end: 0 };
  const broken = rp.state !== "ok",
    stg = broken ? rp.stage || 0 : 0,
    repairing = broken && stg > 0;
  const repProg = repairing ? stg / 4 : false;

  /* --- iniş platformu --- */
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y + 58);
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.32)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(6, 8, 98, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  const ag = ctx.createRadialGradient(-20, -24, 10, 0, 0, 96);
  ag.addColorStop(0, "#4a5069");
  ag.addColorStop(1, "#2b2f44");
  ctx.fillStyle = ag;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, 94, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#aab3d6";
  ctx.lineWidth = 5;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.25)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    const a = (i * PI) / 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(Math.cos(a) * 30, Math.sin(a) * 30);
    ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(a) * 92, Math.sin(a) * 92);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.lineWidth = 7;
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#1b1e2e";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, 80, 0, 7);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#ffb347";
  ctx.setLineDash([13, 13]);
  ctx.lineDashOffset = -t * 10;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, 80, 0, 7);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  ctx.lineDashOffset = 0;
  const ig = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, -10, 4, 0, 0, 64);
  ig.addColorStop(0, "#616887");
  ig.addColorStop(1, "#474d68");
  ctx.fillStyle = ig;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, 64, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(170,180,214,.6)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.22)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, 40, 0, 7);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-52, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(52, 0);
  ctx.moveTo(0, -52);
  ctx.lineTo(0, 52);
  ctx.stroke();
  const sg = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, -8, 4, 0, -8, 34);
  sg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(15,12,18,.6)");
  sg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(15,12,18,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = sg;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -8, 34, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    const a = (i * PI) / 4,
      on = (Math.floor(t * 2.5) + i) % 2 === 0,
      lx = Math.cos(a) * 88,
      ly = Math.sin(a) * 88;
    if (on) {
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(lx, ly, 1, lx, ly, 12);
      g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,180,70,.55)");
      g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,180,70,0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(lx, ly, 12, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = on ? "#ffd34d" : "#6a4a2a";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(lx, ly, 3.6, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#2b2f44";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();

  /* --- servis kulesi (sağ) --- */
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x + 70, y + 52);
  const tw = 14,
    th = 150;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2b2f44";
  rrp(-12, -4, 24, 8, 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#9aa3bf";
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-tw / 2, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(-tw / 2, -th);
  ctx.moveTo(tw / 2, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(tw / 2, -th);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#6f7698";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  for (let yy = 0; yy > -th; yy -= 18) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-tw / 2, yy);
    ctx.lineTo(tw / 2, yy - 18);
    ctx.moveTo(tw / 2, yy);
    ctx.lineTo(-tw / 2, yy - 18);
    ctx.moveTo(-tw / 2, yy);
    ctx.lineTo(tw / 2, yy);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = "#aab3d6";
  rrp(-tw / 2 - 4, -108, tw + 8, 4, 1);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#aab3d6";
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-tw / 2, -106);
  ctx.lineTo(-44, -96);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#6f7698";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-tw / 2, -96);
  ctx.lineTo(-44, -96);
  ctx.stroke();
  // yakıt hortumu: hafif salınır
  const sw = Math.sin(t * 1.3) * 3;
  ctx.lineCap = "round";
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#ff8c42";
  ctx.lineWidth = 3.2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-44, -94);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(-38 + sw, -72, -58 + sw, -66, -48, -52);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.35)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-44, -94);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(-38 + sw, -72, -58 + sw, -66, -48, -52);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#3b4260";
  rrp(-51, -55, 6, 6, 1.5);
  ctx.fill();
  // durum ekranı
  const col = repairing ? "#ffd34d" : broken ? "#ff5a5a" : "#4ade80";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1230";
  rrp(-9, -60, 18, 12, 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#3a4675";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
  ctx.stroke();
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    ctx.fillStyle = (broken ? Math.sin(t * 6 + i) > 0 : true) ? col : "#1a2140";
    ctx.fillRect(-6 + i * 4.5, -56, 3, 4);
  }
  // tepe feneri (dönen huzme)
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2b2f44";
  rrp(-5, -th - 8, 10, 8, 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(0, -th - 10);
  ctx.rotate(t * 2.4);
  const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 38, 0);
  bg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,90,90,.45)");
  bg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,90,90,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = bg;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(38, -7);
  ctx.lineTo(38, 7);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff5a5a";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -th - 10, 3.4, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

  /* --- iniş ayakları + roket gövdesi --- */
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  for (const sx of [-1, 1]) {
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#5b6178";
    ctx.lineWidth = 5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(sx * 20, 24);
    ctx.lineTo(sx * 40, 56);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#c3c9dc";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(sx * 20, 24);
    ctx.lineTo(sx * 40, 56);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#5b6178";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(sx * 27, 42);
    ctx.lineTo(sx * 23, 30);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#3b4260";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(sx * 41, 58, 9, 3.5, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  const idle = broken || repairing ? 0 : 0.24 + Math.sin(t * 17) * 0.04;
  rocketBody({ flame: idle, broken, repairing: repProg, t });
  // kaza izi: tamir edilene kadar hasarlı bölgeden duman + kıvılcım + alev
  drawExSmoke(broken, repairing, t);
  ctx.restore();
}

/* ---------- roket dış duman sistemi: yumuşak, rüzgârla sürüklenen, yükseldikçe açılan duman ---------- */
const exSmoke = [],
  exEmb = [];
let exLast = 0,
  exAcc = 0,
  exBurstT = 0;
function drawExSmoke(broken, repairing, t) {
  const now = performance.now() / 1000,
    dt = Math.min(0.05, exLast ? now - exLast : 0);
  exLast = now;
  if (!broken && !exSmoke.length && !exEmb.length) return;
  const SI = Math.min(1, stormFx.I || 0),
    wx = Math.cos(stormFx.ang || 0) * (14 + SI * 150),
    HX = 16,
    HY = -10;
  const rate = broken ? (repairing ? 10 : 32) : 0;
  if (broken) {
    exAcc += dt * rate;
    exBurstT -= dt;
    if (exBurstT <= 0 && !repairing) {
      exBurstT = 2.5 + Math.random() * 3.5;
      exAcc += 9;
      for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++)
        exEmb.push({
          x: HX,
          y: HY,
          vx: (Math.random() - 0.3) * 90,
          vy: -60 - Math.random() * 110,
          l: 0,
          m: 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.7,
        });
    }
    while (exAcc > 1) {
      exAcc--;
      const dark = Math.random() < (repairing ? 0.25 : 0.7);
      exSmoke.push({
        x: HX + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8,
        y: HY + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 14 + 4,
        vy: -34 - Math.random() * 30,
        r: 5 + Math.random() * 5,
        l: 0,
        m: 4 + Math.random() * 3,
        dark,
        rot: Math.random() * 6,
        sp: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8,
        seed: Math.random() * 9,
      });
    }
    if (!repairing && Math.random() < dt * 9)
      exEmb.push({
        x: HX + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6,
        y: HY,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.4) * 50,
        vy: -40 - Math.random() * 70,
        l: 0,
        m: 0.7 + Math.random() * 0.9,
      });
  }
  if (exSmoke.length > 140) exSmoke.splice(0, exSmoke.length - 140);
  if (broken && !repairing) {
    const fl = 0.6 + 0.25 * Math.sin(t * 23) + 0.15 * Math.sin(t * 37 + 1);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
    const hg = ctx.createRadialGradient(HX, HY, 1, HX, HY, 22 * fl);
    hg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,220,140,.85)");
    hg.addColorStop(0.35, "rgba(255,120,40,.45)");
    hg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,60,20,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = hg;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(HX, HY, 22 * fl, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const h = 8 + 6 * Math.sin(t * (11 + i * 3) + i * 2) + 6,
        w = 3.2 - i * 0.6,
        ox = (i - 1) * 3;
      const fg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, HY, 0, HY - h);
      fg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,230,160,.9)");
      fg.addColorStop(0.5, "rgba(255,130,40,.7)");
      fg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,60,20,0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = fg;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(HX + ox - w, HY);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(
        HX + ox - w * 0.6 + Math.sin(t * 15 + i) * 2,
        HY - h * 0.6,
        HX + ox + Math.sin(t * 9 + i) * 2.5,
        HY - h,
      );
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(HX + ox + w * 0.6, HY - h * 0.5, HX + ox + w, HY);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
  const pd = puff("rgba(34,32,36,A)"),
    pl = puff("rgba(150,146,150,A)"),
    pw = puff("rgba(255,140,60,A)");
  for (let i = exSmoke.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const q = exSmoke[i];
    q.l += dt;
    const k = q.l / q.m;
    if (k >= 1) {
      exSmoke.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }
    q.vy *= 1 - dt * 0.25;
    q.vx += (wx - q.vx) * dt * (0.35 + k * 0.6) + Math.sin(now * 1.3 + q.seed) * dt * 10;
    q.x += q.vx * dt;
    q.y += q.vy * dt;
    q.r += dt * (9 + k * 14);
    q.rot += q.sp * dt;
    const a = Math.min(1, k * 7) * Math.pow(1 - k, 1.4) * (q.dark ? 0.9 : 0.65),
      R = q.r * 2.2;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(q.x, q.y);
    ctx.rotate(q.rot);
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, a * (1 - k * 0.75) * (q.dark ? 1.25 : 0.6));
    ctx.drawImage(pd, -R / 2, -R / 2, R, R);
    ctx.globalAlpha = a * (0.12 + k * 0.85);
    ctx.drawImage(pl, (-R / 2) * 1.05, (-R / 2) * 0.95, R * 1.05, R * 0.95);
    if (broken && !repairing && k < 0.12) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - k / 0.12) * 0.5;
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
      ctx.drawImage(pw, -R / 3, -R / 3, R / 1.5, R / 1.5);
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
  for (let i = exEmb.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const e = exEmb[i];
    e.l += dt;
    if (e.l > e.m) {
      exEmb.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }
    e.vy += dt * 60;
    e.vx += (wx * 0.6 - e.vx) * dt * 0.8;
    const px = e.x,
      py = e.y;
    e.x += e.vx * dt;
    e.y += e.vy * dt;
    const k = e.l / e.m;
    ctx.strokeStyle =
      "rgba(255," +
      Math.round(200 - k * 120) +
      "," +
      Math.round(90 - k * 70) +
      "," +
      (1 - k).toFixed(3) +
      ")";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(px, py);
    ctx.lineTo(e.x, e.y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}
function drawStone(s) {
  const t = performance.now() / 500 + s.ph,
    k = 1 + Math.sin(t) * 0.05;
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(s.x, s.y + 6, 2, s.x, s.y + 6, 30);
  g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(220,230,255,.22)");
  g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(220,230,255,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(s.x, s.y + 6, 30, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(s.x, s.y);
  ctx.scale(k, k);
  drawItemArt(ctx, "stone", 44, { ph: s.ph || 0 });
  ctx.restore();
}
function drawDrop(d) {
  if (d.type === "gold") {
    drawGoldNugget(d.x, d.y, performance.now() / 1000, d.seed || 0);
    return;
  }
  const t = performance.now() / 400,
    bob = Math.sin(t + d.x) * 2.5;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(d.x, d.y + bob);
  drawItemArt(ctx, d.type === "star" ? "star" : "stone", d.type === "star" ? 42 : 40, { ph: d.x });
  ctx.restore();
}

/* ============== DEKOR ÇİZİMİ ============== */
function drawDecor(c) {
  const S = PLANETS[scene];
  if (c.type === "speck") {
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.1;
    ctx.fillStyle = S.dot;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(c.x, c.y, c.r * 2.4, c.r * 1.5, c.rot, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  } else if (c.type === "crater") {
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.32)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(c.x, c.y, c.r * 0.85, c.r * 0.6, c.rot, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.75;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.28)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(c.x, c.y, c.r * 0.95, c.r * 0.68, c.rot, 0.6, 3.4);
    ctx.stroke();
  } else if (c.type === "rock") {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(c.x - c.r, c.y - c.r, c.x + c.r, c.y + c.r);
    g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,.30)");
    g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,.34)");
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.85;
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(c.x, c.y, c.r * 0.7, c.r * 0.48, c.rot, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.3)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();
  } else if (c.type === "grass") {
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#39a35f";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    for (let i = -2; i <= 2; i++) {
      const bx = c.x + i * 7,
        by = c.y + Math.abs(i) * 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(bx, by);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(bx + i * 3, by - c.r * 0.5, bx + i * 7, by - c.r * 0.85);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  } else if (c.type === "crack") {
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.55;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.5)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(c.x - c.r, c.y);
    for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) ctx.lineTo(c.x - c.r + c.r * 0.4 * i, c.y + Math.sin(i * 2.1 + c.rot) * 10);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.4)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(c.x - c.r, c.y + 4);
    for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++)
      ctx.lineTo(c.x - c.r + c.r * 0.4 * i, c.y + 4 + Math.sin(i * 2.1 + c.rot) * 10);
    ctx.stroke();
  } else if (c.type === "ice") {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(c.x, c.y - c.r, c.x, c.y + c.r * 0.4);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#ffffff");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#7fd0ff");
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.85;
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(c.x, c.y - c.r * 0.7);
    ctx.lineTo(c.x + c.r * 0.35, c.y);
    ctx.lineTo(c.x, c.y + c.r * 0.3);
    ctx.lineTo(c.x - c.r * 0.35, c.y);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.stroke();
  } else if (c.type === "crystal") {
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#a78bfa";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(c.x, c.y - c.r * 0.8);
    ctx.lineTo(c.x + c.r * 0.3, c.y);
    ctx.lineTo(c.x, c.y + c.r * 0.2);
    ctx.lineTo(c.x - c.r * 0.3, c.y);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.55)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(c.x, c.y - c.r * 0.8);
    ctx.lineTo(c.x + c.r * 0.12, c.y);
    ctx.lineTo(c.x, c.y + c.r * 0.2);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

/* ============== TARIM ============== */
function farmArr() {
  if (!game.plots) game.plots = {};
  if (!Array.isArray(game.plots[scene])) game.plots[scene] = [];
  return game.plots[scene];
}
function plotStage(g) {
  return Math.min(1, g / CFG.farmGrow);
}
/* ============== ROKET İÇİ — 3 güverteli 2D kesit simülasyonu ==============
   Oyuncu hava kilidinden girer; A/D ile güvertede yürür, merdivende W/S ile
   güverte değiştirir, E ile istasyonları kullanır. Market ve çadır işlevleri
   buradaki istasyonlara taşındı. */
let insideRocket = false,
  bedOpen = false;
const ip = { deck: 0, x: -150, y: 0, dir: 1, climb: null };
const DECKS = [
  { name: T("MAKİNE DAİRESİ"), floor: 500, ceil: 372, xmin: -200, xmax: 200 },
  { name: T("YAŞAM GÜVERTESİ"), floor: 340, ceil: 206, xmin: -190, xmax: 190 },
  { name: T("KOMUTA GÜVERTESİ"), floor: 170, ceil: 34, xmin: -150, xmax: 150 },
];
const LADDERS = [
  { from: 0, to: 1, x: -196 },
  { from: 1, to: 2, x: 140 },
];
const STATIONS = [
  { deck: 0, x: -150, w: 30, key: "exit", name: T("Hava kilidi"), hint: T("<b>E</b>: Dışarı çık") },
  { deck: 0, x: -92, w: 24, key: "kit", name: T("Alet sandığı"), hint: T("<b>E</b>: Alet sandığını aç") },
  { deck: 0, x: -16, w: 38, key: "o2", name: T("O₂ tüpü"), hint: T("<b>E</b>: Oksijen doldur") },

const DECK_H = 136;
function interiorScale() {
  return Math.min(W / 560, (H - 120) / 700);
}
function enterRocket() {
  insideRocket = true;
  ip.deck = 0;
  ip.x = -130;
  if (game.repair.state !== "ok") prewarmSmoke();
  else {
    inSmoke.length = 0;
    smokeLevel = 0;
  }
  ip.dir = 1;
  ip.climb = null;
  ip.y = DECKS[0].floor;
  p.walk = 0;
  keys.KeyW = keys.KeyS = keys.ArrowUp = keys.ArrowDown = false;
  sfx("click");
  toast(T("🚀 Roketin içindesin — <b>A/D</b> yürü · merdivende <b>W/S</b> · <b>E</b> kullan"));
}
function exitRocket() {
  insideRocket = false;
  game.sleeping = false;
  p.x = ROCKET.x;
  p.y = ROCKET.y + 118;
  p.dir = 1;
  sfx("click");
  toast(T("Hava kilidinden çıktın"));
}
function nearStation() {
  if (!insideRocket) return null;
  let b = null,
    bd = 1e9;
  for (const s of STATIONS) {
    if (s.deck !== ip.deck) continue;
    const d = Math.abs(ip.x - s.x);
    if (d < s.w && d < bd) {
      bd = d;
      b = s;
    }
  }
  return b;
}
function nearLadder() {
  for (const l of LADDERS) {
    if ((l.from === ip.deck || l.to === ip.deck) && Math.abs(ip.x - l.x) < 24) return l;
  }
  return null;
}
function stationAction() {
  const s = nearStation();
  if (!s) {
    sfx("error");
    toast(T("Yakında kullanılacak bir istasyon yok"));
    return;
  }
  switch (s.key) {
    case "exit":
      exitRocket();
      break;
    case "kit":
      openCapsule("kit");
      break;
    case "food":
      openCapsule("food");
      break;
    case "o2":
      startO2Fill();
      break;
    case "repair":
    case "engine":
      openRepair();
      break;
    case "bed":
      openBed();
      break;
    case "kitchen":
      openCapsule("kitchen");
      break;
    case "med":
      openCapsule("med");
      break;
    case "upg":
      openUpg();
      break;
    case "nav":
      openRocket("nav");
      break;
    case "comm":
      openComm();
      break;
    case "trade":
      openMarket();
      break;
  }
}
function insideF() {
  const s = nearStation();
  if (s && s.key === "trade") {
    depositSamples();
    return;
  }
  if (s && s.key === "kitchen") {
    useKitchen();
    return;
  }
  sfx("error");
  toast(T("Numuneleri komuta güvertesindeki <b>stok terminalinden</b> kargoya yükle"));
}
/* numuneleri (metal + yıldız) roketin kargo bölmesine yükle */
function sampleCount() {
  return (game.inventory.stone || 0) + (game.inventory.star || 0);
}
function depositSamples() {
  const st = game.inventory.stone || 0,
    sr = game.inventory.star || 0;
  if (st + sr <= 0) {
    sfx("error");
    toast(T("Çantanda numune yok — dışarıda metal ve ⭐ topla"));
    return 0;
  }
  const pts = st + sr * 2;
  game.cargo = (game.cargo || 0) + pts;
  game.inventory.stone = 0;
  game.inventory.star = 0;
  updateInv();
  if (!insideRocket) burst(ROCKET.x, ROCKET.y, 20, "#c9d2e0", { sp: 120, life: 0.7, size: 5, up: 120 });
  sfx("pickup");
  toast(
    "📦 " +
      pts +
      T(" numune kargoya yüklendi · kargo ") +
      Math.min(game.cargo, CFG.cargoGoal) +
      "/" +
      CFG.cargoGoal,
  );
  bumpQuest("loaded", pts);
  if (marketOpen) openMarket();
  return pts;
}
function useKitchen() {
  // her seferinde tek eylem: önce hangisi daha düşükse
  const S = game.stock;
  const drink = () => {
    if (S.water > 0) S.water--;
    else if ((game.inventory.water || 0) > 0) game.inventory.water--;
    else return false;
    game.thirst = Math.min(100, game.thirst + CFG.drinkThirst);
    startAct("drink", 1.8);
    sfx("drink");
    bumpQuest("drunk");
    return true;
  };
  const eat = () => {
    if (S.potato > 0) S.potato--;
    else if ((game.inventory.potato || 0) > 0) game.inventory.potato--;
    else return false;
    game.hunger = Math.min(100, game.hunger + CFG.eatHunger);
    startAct("eat", 2.0);
    sfx("eat");
    return true;
  };
  let did = false;
  if (game.thirst < 95 && (game.thirst <= game.hunger || game.hunger >= 95))
    did = drink() || (game.hunger < 95 && eat());
  else if (game.hunger < 95) did = eat() || (game.thirst < 95 && drink());
  if (did) {
    updateInv();
    updateStats();
    toast(T("🍽️ Yemek kapsülü stoku: 💧") + S.water + " 🥔" + S.potato);
  } else if (game.thirst >= 95 && game.hunger >= 95) {
    sfx("full");
    toast(T("Şu an aç ya da susuz değilsin"));
  } else {
    sfx("error");
    toast(T("Yemek kapsülü boş — patates yetiştir, su geri dönüştürücüyü bekle"));
  }
}
/* su geri dönüştürücü aralığı: zorluk susuzluğu hızlandırırsa geri dönüşüm de hızlanır → su hep yeter */
function recycleInt() {
  return CFG.waterRecycle / Math.max(1, dif().water || 1);
}
/* --- Mars saha kiti (takım çantası) --- */
function toggleKit() {
  game.kitCarried = !game.kitCarried;
  updateInv();
  if (game.kitCarried) bumpQuest("kit");
  sfx(game.kitCarried ? "pickup" : "click");
  toast(
    game.kitCarried
      ? T("Çapa sırtında — dışarıda yere <b>sol tıkla</b>, toprağı kaz")
      : T("Çapa alet sandığına bırakıldı"),
  );
}
/* --- yatak kabini: uyu / uyan sistemi --- */
let sleepT = 0,
  sleepDay = 0;
function updateSleep(dt) {
  if (!game || !game.sleeping) return;
  sleepT += dt;
  game.hp = Math.min(100, game.hp + CFG.hpRegen * (dif().regen || 1) * dt * 2.5); // uykuda hızlı iyileşme
  if (game.hunger < 15 || game.thirst < 15) {
    wakeUp(T("Açlık/susuzluktan uyandın — mutfağa git"));
    return;
  }
  if (gameDayNumber() > sleepDay) {
    wakeUp(T("🌅 Yeni güne uyandın"));
    return;
  }
}
function wakeUp(msg) {
  if (!game.sleeping) return;
  game.sleeping = false;
  sleepT = 0;
  updateBedPanel();
  if (bedOpen) $("bedScreen").classList.remove("hidden");
  sfx("harvest2");
  toast(msg);
}
function drawSleepOverlay() {
  if (!game || !game.sleeping) return;
  const a = Math.min(0.78, sleepT * 0.6);
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(2,3,12," + a + ")";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + a + ")";
  ctx.font = "800 " + Math.round(Math.min(W, H) * 0.06) + "px 'Segoe UI',sans-serif";
  const inDay = (game.worldTime || 0) % DAY_SECONDS;
  ctx.fillText(T("😴 Uyuyorsun…"), W / 2, H * 0.42);
  ctx.font = "600 16px 'Segoe UI',sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,208,138," + a + ")";
  ctx.fillText(
    T("Gün ") + gameDayNumber() + T(" · sabaha ") + fmtTime(DAY_SECONDS - inDay) + T(" · zaman 2× hızlı"),
    W / 2,
    H * 0.42 + 34,
  );
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + a * 0.7 + ")";
  ctx.font = "600 14px 'Segoe UI',sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText(T("E: uyan"), W / 2, H * 0.42 + 60);
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(200,210,255," + a * 0.8 + ")";
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const ph = (sleepT * 0.5 + i * 0.33) % 1;
    ctx.font = "700 " + (14 + ph * 18) + "px sans-serif";
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1 - ph;
    ctx.fillText("z", W / 2 + 60 + ph * 40, H * 0.42 - 20 - ph * 60);
  }
  ctx.restore();
}
/* --- yatak kabini --- */
function updateBedPanel() {
  if (!game) return;
  const inDay = (game.worldTime || 0) % DAY_SECONDS;
  $("bedClock").textContent = T("Gün ") + gameDayNumber() + T(" · sabaha ") + fmtTime(DAY_SECONDS - inDay);
  $("bedMeters").innerHTML =
    conMeter(T("CAN"), game.hp, "linear-gradient(90deg,#16a34a,#4ade80)") +
    conMeter(T("TOKLUK"), game.hunger, "linear-gradient(90deg,#c2410c,#ffb347)") +
    conMeter(T("SU"), game.thirst, "linear-gradient(90deg,#1f7fb8,#7fe0ff)");
  $("bedStatus").textContent = game.sleeping
    ? T("Uyuyorsun; oyun zamanı 2× hızlanıyor. Roket gövdesi radyasyonu keser.")
    : radiationActiveNow()
      ? T("☢️ Dışarıda radyasyon var. Roket içindeyken güvendesin.")
      : T(
          "Uyumak zamanı 2× hızlandırır: mahsul daha çabuk büyür, can hızla yenilenir. Sabah olunca kendiliğinden uyanırsın.",
        );
  $("bedSleep").textContent = game.sleeping ? T("☀️ Uyan") : T("🛌 Uyu");
}
function openBed() {
  bedOpen = true;
  game.sleeping = false;
  $("bedScreen").classList.remove("hidden");
  updateBedPanel();
  focusGame();
}
function closeBed() {
  if (game) game.sleeping = false;
  sleepT = 0;
  bedOpen = false;
  $("bedScreen").classList.add("hidden");
  focusGame();
}
function toggleSleep() {
  if (!game || !bedOpen) return;
  if (game.sleeping) {
    wakeUp(T("Uyandın"));
    return;
  }
  game.sleeping = true;
  sleepT = 0;
  sleepDay = gameDayNumber();
  updateBedPanel();
  $("bedScreen").classList.add("hidden");
  focusGame();
  toast(game.sleeping ? T("Uyku başladı — zaman 2× hızlanıyor") : T("Uyandın"));
}
$("bedSleep").onclick = toggleSleep;
$("bedExit").onclick = closeBed;
$("bedX").onclick = closeBed;

/* --- iç mekân güncelleme --- */
function updateInside(dt, ix, iy, running) {
  const d = DECKS[ip.deck];
  if (ip.climb) {
    const c = ip.climb;
    c.t += dt * 2.2;
    ip.y = c.y0 + (c.y1 - c.y0) * Math.min(1, c.t);
    ip.x = c.x;
    p.t += dt * CFG.springSpeed * 0.8;
    p.walk = 1;
    if (c.t >= 1) {
      ip.deck = c.to;
      ip.y = DECKS[c.to].floor;
      ip.climb = null;
      sfx("click");
    }
    return;
  }
  const sp = CFG.walkSpeed * (running ? CFG.runMultiplier : 1) * 0.78 * moveMul();
  const nd = DECKS[ip.deck];
  if (ip.vx == null) {
    ip.vx = 0;
    ip.z = 0;
    ip.vz = 0;
  }
  if (cabinGravFail()) {
    // jeneratör arızalı: içerisi de 0,38 g
    gravMove(ip, ix * sp, null, dt);
    gravHop(ip, Math.abs(ix) > 0.05, running, dt, nd.floor - nd.ceil - 100);
    gravLand(ip, ip.x, -9999);
    if (keys.Space) {
      keys.Space = false;
      gravJump(ip);
    }
  } else {
    ip.vx = ix * sp;
    if (ip.z > 0 || ip.vz > 0) {
      gravHop(ip, false, false, dt);
      ip.landed = 0;
    }
    if (keys.Space) {
      keys.Space = false;
      gravJump(ip);
    }
  }
  const nx = Math.max(nd.xmin, Math.min(nd.xmax, ip.x + ip.vx * dt));
  if (nx === nd.xmin || nx === nd.xmax) ip.vx = 0;
  ip.x = nx;
  if (ix > 0.1) ip.dir = 1;
  if (ix < -0.1) ip.dir = -1;
  if (Math.abs(ix) > 0.05) {
    p.t += dt * CFG.springSpeed * (running ? 1.4 : 1);
    p.walk = Math.min(1, p.walk + dt * 8);
  } else p.walk = Math.max(0, p.walk - dt * 8);
  const k = Math.min(1, dt * 10);
  p.sx += (1 - p.sx) * k;
  p.sy += (1 - p.sy) * k;
  if (Math.abs(iy) > 0.5) {
    const l = nearLadder();
    if (l && !(ip.z > 1)) {
      const up = iy < 0,
        to = up ? Math.max(l.from, l.to) : Math.min(l.from, l.to);
      if (to !== ip.deck && (l.from === to || l.to === to)) {
        ip.climb = { t: 0, to, x: l.x, y0: DECKS[ip.deck].floor, y1: DECKS[to].floor };
        ip.dir = 1;
        sfx("click");
      }
    }
  }
  p.dir = ip.dir;
  p._running = running;
  p.actionT = Math.max(0, (p.actionT || 0) - dt);
  if (p.actionT <= 0) p.action = null;
}
function insideHint() {
  if (ip.climb) return "";
  const s = nearStation();
  if (s) {
    if (s.key === "o2")
      return (
        T("<b>E</b>: Oksijen doldur · giysi %") +
        Math.round(game.o2) +
        T(" · tüp %") +
        Math.round((game.o2Tank / o2Max()) * 100)
      );
    if (s.key === "kit" || s.key === "food" || s.key === "kitchen") {
      let n = 0;
      CAPSULES[s.key].items.forEach(([k]) => (n += capCount(k)));
      return s.hint + " · " + n + T(" öğe");
    }
    if (s.key === "comm") {
      const u = commUnread(),
        n = commUnsent().length;
      return (
        T("<b>E</b>: İletişim terminali") +
        (u ? " · 📨 " + u + T(" yeni mesaj") : "") +
        (n ? " · 📝 " + n + T(" gözlem") : "")
      );
    }
    if (s.key === "trade")
      return T("<b>E</b>: Kargo terminali") + (sampleCount() > 0 ? T(" · <b>F</b>: numuneleri yükle") : "");
    if (s.key === "repair" || s.key === "engine") {
      if (game.repair.state === "ok")
        return (s.key === "engine" ? T("Ana motor") : T("Tamir tezgâhı")) + T(" — motor çalışıyor ✔");
      return T("<b>E</b>: Ana motoru onar · aşama ") + ((game.repair.stage || 0) + 1) + "/4";
    }
    if (s.key === "med")
      return (
        s.hint +
        T(" · medikit ") +
        game.stock.medkit +
        T(" · çanta ") +
        (game.inventory.medkit || 0) +
        (game.hp < 100 ? T(" · <b>G</b>: hızlı kullan") : "")
      );
    if (s.key === "upg") {
      ensureUpg();
      ensureRare();
      const rr = RARE_ALL.filter((k) => (game.rare[k] || 0) > 0)
        .map((k) => " · " + rareShort(k) + " " + game.rare[k])
        .join("");
      return s.hint + T(" · metal ") + (game.inventory.stone || 0) + T(" · altın ") + (game.gold || 0) + rr;
    }
    return s.hint;
  }
  const l = nearLadder();
  if (l)
    return (
      T("<b>W</b>/<b>S</b>: Merdivenle ") +
      (ip.deck === Math.min(l.from, l.to) ? T("yukarı çık") : T("aşağı in"))
    );
  return "";
}

/* ============== İÇ MEKÂN ÇİZİMİ ============== */
function screenBox(x, y, w, h, col, glow) {
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0a1024";
  rrp(x, y, w, h, 3);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = col;
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
  ctx.stroke();
  if (glow) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.25;
    ctx.fillStyle = col;
    rrp(x - 2, y - 2, w + 4, h + 4, 5);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }
}
function waveScreen(x, y, w, h, col, t, ph) {
  screenBox(x, y, w, h, col, true);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.rect(x + 2, y + 2, w - 4, h - 4);
  ctx.clip();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.08)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let gx = x + 2; gx < x + w; gx += 8) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(gx, y);
    ctx.lineTo(gx, y + h);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (let gy = y + 2; gy < y + h; gy += 8) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, gy);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w, gy);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.strokeStyle = col;
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let i = 0; i <= w; i += 2) {
    const xx = x + i,
      yy = y + h / 2 + Math.sin(i * 0.18 + t * 3 + ph) * h * 0.22 + Math.sin(i * 0.6 - t * 5 + ph) * h * 0.08;
    i ? ctx.lineTo(xx, yy) : ctx.moveTo(xx, yy);
  }
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}
function radarScreen(x, y, r, col, t) {
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0a1024";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = col;
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, 7);
  ctx.clip();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.12)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let k = 1; k <= 2; k++) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, (r * k) / 3, 0, 7);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x - r, y);
  ctx.lineTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.moveTo(x, y - r);
  ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
  ctx.stroke();
  const a = (t * 2) % (Math.PI * 2);
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 1, x, y, r);
  g.addColorStop(0, col);
  g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.45;
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x, y);
  ctx.arc(x, y, r, a - 0.9, a);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
  for (const [bx, by] of [
    [0.4, -0.3],
    [-0.5, 0.2],
    [0.1, 0.6],
  ]) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x + bx * r, y + by * r, 1.4, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}
function led(x, y, col, on) {
  ctx.fillStyle = on ? col : "rgba(60,60,80,.9)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y, 2, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  if (on) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.35;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, 4.5, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
}
function pipe(pts, w, col) {
  ctx.lineCap = "round";
  ctx.lineJoin = "round";
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#20243a";
  ctx.lineWidth = w + 2.4;
  ctx.beginPath();
  pts.forEach((q, i) => (i ? ctx.lineTo(q[0], q[1]) : ctx.moveTo(q[0], q[1])));
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = col;
  ctx.lineWidth = w;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.25)";
  ctx.lineWidth = w * 0.3;
  ctx.stroke();
}
function hullPath() {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, -176);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(95, -120, 160, 20);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(222, 150, 236, 300);
  ctx.lineTo(240, 522);
  ctx.lineTo(-240, 522);
  ctx.lineTo(-236, 300);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-222, 150, -160, 20);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-95, -120, 0, -176);
  ctx.closePath();
}
function drawInterior() {
  const t = performance.now() / 1000,
    z = interiorScale();
  const S = PLANETS[scene];
