    const d = DECKS[ip.deck];
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,211,77," + (0.08 + 0.05 * Math.sin(t * 5)) + ")";
    rrp(near.x - near.w, d.ceil + 8, near.w * 2, d.floor - d.ceil - 8, 6);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,211,77,.5)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  drawQuestTarget(t);
  const py = (ip.climb ? ip.y : DECKS[ip.deck].floor) - 45;
  if (ip.deck === 0 && !game.sleeping && !ip.climb) drawO2FillFx(DECKS[0].floor, DECKS[0].ceil, t, ip.x, py); // hortum gövdenin arkasında
  if (ip.climb) {
    // tırmanma: merdivene yaslı, kollar yukarı
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(ip.x, py);
    ctx.scale(0.92, 1);
    ctx.translate(-ip.x, -py);
    astronaut(ip.x, py, false, null, 0);
    ctx.restore();
  } else if (game.wake) {
    drawWakeAstro(t);
  } else if (game.sleeping) {
    // kapsülde sırt üstü
    const F1 = DECKS[1].floor,
      pd = p.dir;
    p.dir = 1;
    ASTRO_POSE = { ns: true, b: [0, 0], f: [0, 0] };
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(-120, F1 - 37);
    ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
    ctx.scale(0.52, 0.52 + Math.sin(t * 1.6) * 0.008);
    astronaut(0, -16, false, null, 0);
    ctx.restore();
    ASTRO_POSE = null;
    p.dir = pd;
  } else {
    const hk = heldItemKey();
    drawAstroGrav(ip.x, py, ip.climb ? 0 : ip.z || 0, p._running, hk, p.actionT);
  }
  drawPodCanopy(t);

  ctx.restore(); // hull clip
  // cidar konturu
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#5f6886";
  ctx.lineWidth = 5;
  hullPath();
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#c9d2e0";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  hullPath();
  ctx.stroke();
  // kesit perçinleri
  ctx.fillStyle = "#9aa3bf";
  for (let yy = -120; yy < 520; yy += 40) {
    for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
      const xx =
        s * (yy < 20 ? 60 + (yy + 176) * 0.55 : yy < 300 ? 160 + (yy - 20) * 0.27 : 236 + (yy - 300) * 0.018);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(xx * 0.985, yy, 1.6, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  // dış kanatlar (kesit dışında dekor)
  ctx.fillStyle = "#b7291f";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-238, 380);
  ctx.lineTo(-300, 522);
  ctx.lineTo(-240, 522);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(238, 380);
  ctx.lineTo(300, 522);
  ctx.lineTo(240, 522);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  // güverte adı rozeti
  ctx.restore();
  const dn = DECKS[ip.deck];
  ctx.save();
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.font = "800 13px 'Segoe UI',sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.55)";
  const alH = $("alerts").offsetHeight,
    by = 14 + (alH ? alH + 8 : 0);
  rrp(W / 2 - 110, by, 220, 24, 8);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd08a";
  ctx.fillText("🚀 " + dn.name, W / 2, by + 17);
  ctx.restore();
  // iç vinyet
  const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(
    W / 2,
    H / 2,
    Math.min(W, H) * 0.3,
    W / 2,
    H / 2,
    Math.max(W, H) * 0.75,
  );
  vg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
  vg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,.5)");
  ctx.fillStyle = vg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  if (flash > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,60,60," + flash * 0.4 * (settings.noflash ? 0.35 : 1) + ")";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }
}

/* ============== ANA MOTOR ONARIMI — 4 aşamalı mini oyun ==============
   1) Kabloları bağla  2) Yanık sigortaları değiştir + ana şalter
   3) Basınç kalibrasyonu (zamanlama)  4) Ateşleme dizisi (hafıza)
   Tamamlanan aşamalar game.repair.stage içinde saklanır. */
let repairOpen = false;
const RP_STEPS = [
  { ic: "🔌", nm: T("Kablolar") },
  { ic: "⚡", nm: T("Sigortalar") },
  { ic: "🎚️", nm: T("Basınç") },
  { ic: "🔥", nm: T("Ateşleme") },
];
const rp = { stage: 0, cleanup: [], timers: [], raf: 0, busy: false };
const SVGNS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
function svgEl(tag, attrs, parent) {
  const e = document.createElementNS(SVGNS, tag);
  for (const k in attrs) e.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]);
  if (parent) parent.appendChild(e);
  return e;
}
function svgPt(svg, ev) {
  const pt = svg.createSVGPoint();
  pt.x = ev.clientX;
  pt.y = ev.clientY;
  return pt.matrixTransform(svg.getScreenCTM().inverse());
}
function rpLater(fn, ms) {
  const id = setTimeout(fn, ms);
  rp.timers.push(id);
  return id;
}
function rpCleanup() {
  rp.cleanup.forEach((f) => {
    try {
      f();
    } catch (e) {}
  });
  rp.cleanup = [];
  rp.timers.forEach(clearTimeout);
  rp.timers = [];
  cancelAnimationFrame(rp.raf);
  rp.busy = false;
}
function rpBase(area) {
  const svg = svgEl(
    "svg",
    { viewBox: "0 0 460 260", width: "100%", height: "100%", preserveAspectRatio: "xMidYMid meet" },
    area,
  );
  const defs = svgEl("defs", {}, svg);
  defs.innerHTML = `
    <linearGradient id="rpSteel" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#3b4670"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#222a4a"/></linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="rpGlass" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#cfe9ff" stop-opacity=".55"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#7fb6e0" stop-opacity=".18"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#cfe9ff" stop-opacity=".4"/></linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="rpHole"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#000"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#1a2140"/></radialGradient>
    <pattern id="rpGrid" width="20" height="20" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><path d="M20 0H0V20" fill="none" stroke="rgba(120,160,255,.07)" stroke-width="1"/></pattern>`;
  svgEl("rect", { x: 0, y: 0, width: 460, height: 260, fill: "url(#rpGrid)" }, svg);
  return svg;
}
function screw(svg, x, y) {
  svgEl("circle", { cx: x, cy: y, r: 3.2, fill: "#8d96b8", stroke: "#1a2140", "stroke-width": 1 }, svg);
  svgEl("line", { x1: x - 2, y1: y - 2, x2: x + 2, y2: y + 2, stroke: "#1a2140", "stroke-width": 1 }, svg);
}
function sparkAt(svg, x, y, col) {
  const g = svgEl("g", {}, svg);
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * 6.28,
      l = 8 + Math.random() * 12;
    svgEl(
      "line",
      {
        x1: x,
        y1: y,
        x2: x + Math.cos(a) * l,
        y2: y + Math.sin(a) * l,
        stroke: col || "#ffe9a8",
        "stroke-width": 1.6,
        "stroke-linecap": "round",
      },
      g,
    );
  }
  svgEl("circle", { cx: x, cy: y, r: 5, fill: "#fff" }, g);
  g.animate(
    [
      { opacity: 1, transform: "scale(1)" },
      { opacity: 0, transform: "scale(1.4)" },
    ],
    { duration: 420, easing: "ease-out" },
  ).onfinish = () => g.remove();
  g.style.transformOrigin = x + "px " + y + "px";
}
function shakeStage() {
  $("rpStage").animate(
    [
      { transform: "translateX(0)" },
      { transform: "translateX(-6px)" },
      { transform: "translateX(5px)" },
      { transform: "translateX(-3px)" },
      { transform: "translateX(0)" },
    ],
    { duration: 260 },
  );
}

/* ---------- açma / kapama ---------- */
function openRepair() {
  if (!game.repair || game.repair.state === "ok") {
    sfx("click");
    toast(T("✅ Ana motor çalışıyor — onarım gerekmiyor"));
    return;
  }
  repairOpen = true;
  rp.stage = Math.max(0, Math.min(3, game.repair.stage || 0));
  $("repairScreen").classList.remove("hidden");
  renderRepair();
}
function closeRepair() {
  repairOpen = false;
  rpCleanup();
  $("repairScreen").classList.add("hidden");
  focusGame();
}
function renderRepair() {
  rpCleanup();
  const st = $("rpSteps");
  st.innerHTML = "";
  RP_STEPS.forEach((s, i) => {
    const d = document.createElement("div");
    d.className = "step" + (i < rp.stage ? " done" : i === rp.stage ? " on" : "");
    d.innerHTML = `<span class="si">${i < rp.stage ? "✔" : s.ic}</span><span>${i + 1}. ${s.nm}</span>`;
    st.appendChild(d);
  });
  $("rpChip").textContent = T("AŞAMA ") + Math.min(4, rp.stage + 1) + "/4";
  $("rpFootR").textContent = T("İLERLEME ") + Math.round((rp.stage / 4) * 100) + "%";
  const area = $("rpStage");
  area.innerHTML = "";
  [rpWires, rpFuses, rpPressure, rpIgnite][rp.stage](area);
}
function rpStageDone(label) {
  if (rp.busy) return;
  rp.busy = true;
  sfx("star");
  rp.stage++;
  game.repair.stage = rp.stage;
  const area = $("rpStage");
  const ok = document.createElement("div");
  ok.className = "rp-ok";
  ok.innerHTML = "<b>✔</b>" + label;
  area.appendChild(ok);
  if (rp.stage >= 4) {
    rpLater(finishRepair, 900);
    return;
  }
  rpLater(renderRepair, 1000);
}
function finishRepair() {
  rpCleanup();
  game.repair = { state: "ok", end: 0, stage: 0 };
  bumpQuest("repaired");
  if (rkArmor() === 0) storyTrigger("stormLesson");
  RP_STEPS.forEach((s, i) => {
    const d = $("rpSteps").children[i];
    if (d) {
      d.className = "step done";
      d.firstChild.textContent = "✔";
    }
  });
  $("rpChip").textContent = T("TAMAMLANDI");
  $("rpFootR").textContent = T("İLERLEME 100%");
  $("rpIns").innerHTML = T("Tüm sistemler <b>çevrimiçi</b>. Roket kalkışa hazır.");
  const area = $("rpStage");
  area.innerHTML = "";
  const svg = rpBase(area);
  const g = svgEl("g", {}, svg);
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const c = svgEl(
      "circle",
      { cx: 230, cy: 92, r: 40, fill: "none", stroke: "#4ade80", "stroke-width": 2, opacity: 0.6 },
      g,
    );
    c.animate(
      [
        { r: 40, opacity: 0.6 },
        { r: 110, opacity: 0 },
      ],
      { duration: 1600, delay: i * 500, iterations: Infinity },
    );
  }
  svgEl("circle", { cx: 230, cy: 92, r: 44, fill: "#0f2a24", stroke: "#4ade80", "stroke-width": 3 }, svg);
  const ck = svgEl(
    "path",
    {
      d: "M208 93 L224 109 L254 76",
      fill: "none",
      stroke: "#4ade80",
      "stroke-width": 8,
      "stroke-linecap": "round",
      "stroke-linejoin": "round",
      "stroke-dasharray": 80,
      "stroke-dashoffset": 80,
    },
    svg,
  );
  ck.animate([{ strokeDashoffset: 80 }, { strokeDashoffset: 0 }], {
    duration: 500,
    fill: "forwards",
    easing: "ease-out",
  });
  const tx = svgEl(
    "text",
    {
      x: 230,
      y: 168,
      "text-anchor": "middle",
      fill: "#e8f1ff",
      "font-size": 17,
      "font-weight": 800,
      "letter-spacing": "3",
    },
    svg,
  );
  tx.textContent = T("MOTOR ÇEVRİMİÇİ");
  const t2 = svgEl(
    "text",
    {
      x: 230,
      y: 188,
      "text-anchor": "middle",
      fill: "#8d9cc0",
      "font-size": 11,
      "font-family": "ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace",
    },
    svg,
  );
  t2.textContent = T("İTKİ ÇEKİRDEĞİ STABİL · KALKIŞ KİLİDİ AÇIK");
  const b = document.createElement("button");
  b.className = "cbtn pri rp-close";
  b.textContent = T("Harika — kapat");
  b.onclick = closeRepair;
  area.appendChild(b);
  sfx("travel");
  toast(T("🔧 Ana motor onarıldı — roket kalkışa hazır!"));
  shake = Math.max(shake, 6);
}

/* ---------- 1) KABLOLAR ---------- */
function rpWires(area) {
  $("rpIns").innerHTML = T(
    "Kopan <b>güç kablolarını</b> aynı renkteki motor soketlerine sürükle (ya da önce kabloya, sonra sokete tıkla).",
  );
  const svg = rpBase(area);
  const COLS = ["#ff5a5a", "#ffd34d", "#38bdf8", "#4ade80"],
    DARK = ["#8a2626", "#8a6d12", "#155f86", "#1d7a43"];
  let order = [0, 1, 2, 3];
  do {
    order.sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);
  } while (order.every((v, i) => v === i));
  const Y = (i) => 52 + i * 52;
  // paneller
  for (const [px, lab] of [
    [14, T("GÜÇ ÜNİTESİ")],
    [376, T("ANA MOTOR")],
  ]) {
    svgEl(
      "rect",
      {
        x: px,
        y: 22,
        width: 70,
        height: 222,
        rx: 10,
        fill: "url(#rpSteel)",
        stroke: "#5b6aa0",
        "stroke-width": 1.2,
      },
      svg,
    );
    const t = svgEl(
      "text",
      {
        x: px + 35,
        y: 16,
        "text-anchor": "middle",
        fill: "#8d9cc0",
        "font-size": 9,
        "font-weight": 700,
        "letter-spacing": "1.5",
        "font-family": "ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace",
      },
      svg,
    );
    t.textContent = lab;
    screw(svg, px + 8, 30);
    screw(svg, px + 62, 30);
    screw(svg, px + 8, 236);
    screw(svg, px + 62, 236);
  }
  // ortadaki uyarı
  const warn = svgEl(
    "text",
    {
      x: 230,
      y: 134,
      "text-anchor": "middle",
      fill: "#ff5a5a",
      "font-size": 13,
      "font-weight": 800,
      "letter-spacing": "4",
      opacity: 0.35,
    },
    svg,
  );
  warn.textContent = T("⚠ DEVRE AÇIK");
  warn.animate([{ opacity: 0.15 }, { opacity: 0.5 }], {
    duration: 600,
    iterations: Infinity,
    direction: "alternate",
  });
  const wiresG = svgEl("g", {}, svg);
  // soketler (sağ)
  const sockets = order.map((ci, j) => {
    const y = Y(j),
      g = svgEl("g", { style: "cursor:pointer" }, svg);
    svgEl("rect", { x: 384, y: y - 16, width: 52, height: 32, rx: 8, fill: "#141b36", stroke: "#3a4675" }, g);
    const ring = svgEl(
      "circle",
      { cx: 398, cy: y, r: 11, fill: "url(#rpHole)", stroke: COLS[ci], "stroke-width": 3 },
      g,
    );
    svgEl("circle", { cx: 398, cy: y, r: 3, fill: "#000" }, g);
    const led = svgEl("circle", { cx: 424, cy: y, r: 4, fill: "#3a2020" }, g);
    return { x: 398, y, ci, ring, led, g, done: false };
  });
  // fişler (sol)
  const plugs = [0, 1, 2, 3].map((i) => {
    const y = Y(i),
      g = svgEl("g", { style: "cursor:grab" }, svg);
    svgEl("rect", { x: 20, y: y - 16, width: 52, height: 32, rx: 8, fill: "#141b36", stroke: "#3a4675" }, g);
    svgEl(
      "line",
      { x1: 24, y1: y, x2: 62, y2: y, stroke: DARK[i], "stroke-width": 10, "stroke-linecap": "round" },
      g,
    );
    svgEl(
      "line",
      { x1: 24, y1: y, x2: 62, y2: y, stroke: COLS[i], "stroke-width": 6, "stroke-linecap": "round" },
      g,
    );
    const head = svgEl(
      "rect",
      { x: 60, y: y - 9, width: 22, height: 18, rx: 4, fill: COLS[i], stroke: DARK[i], "stroke-width": 2 },
      g,
    );
    svgEl("rect", { x: 80, y: y - 4, width: 8, height: 3, fill: "#c9d2e0" }, g);
    svgEl("rect", { x: 80, y: y + 1, width: 8, height: 3, fill: "#c9d2e0" }, g);
    // kopuk tel uçları
    const fr = svgEl(
      "path",
      { d: `M84 ${y} l6 -5 l4 7 l5 -6`, fill: "none", stroke: "#ffe9a8", "stroke-width": 1.2, opacity: 0.0 },
      g,
    );
    fr.animate([{ opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1 }, { opacity: 0 }], {
      duration: 300 + i * 90,
      iterations: Infinity,
    });
    return { x: 86, y, i, g, head, done: false };
  });
  function wirePath(x1, y1, x2, y2, ci) {
    const g = svgEl("g", { style: "pointer-events:none" }, wiresG);
    const d = `M${x1} ${y1} C ${x1 + 110} ${y1}, ${x2 - 110} ${y2}, ${x2} ${y2}`;
    svgEl(
      "path",
      {
        d,
        fill: "none",
        stroke: "rgba(0,0,0,.45)",
        "stroke-width": 11,
        "stroke-linecap": "round",
        transform: "translate(2,4)",
      },
      g,
    );
    svgEl("path", { d, fill: "none", stroke: DARK[ci], "stroke-width": 10, "stroke-linecap": "round" }, g);
    svgEl("path", { d, fill: "none", stroke: COLS[ci], "stroke-width": 6, "stroke-linecap": "round" }, g);
    svgEl(
      "path",
      {
        d,
        fill: "none",
        stroke: "rgba(255,255,255,.35)",
        "stroke-width": 1.6,
        "stroke-linecap": "round",
        transform: "translate(0,-1.5)",
      },
      g,
    );
    return g;
  }
  let drag = null,
    sel = null,
    count = 0;
  function connect(pl, sk) {
    if (sk.done || pl.done) return false;
    if (sk.ci !== pl.i) {
      sfx("error");
      sparkAt(svg, sk.x, sk.y, "#ff7b7b");
      shakeStage();
      sk.ring.animate([{ strokeWidth: 3 }, { strokeWidth: 7 }, { strokeWidth: 3 }], { duration: 300 });
      return false;
    }
    pl.done = sk.done = true;
    count++;
    wirePath(pl.x, pl.y, sk.x, sk.y, pl.i);
    sk.led.setAttribute("fill", "#4ade80");
    sk.led.style.filter = "drop-shadow(0 0 4px #4ade80)";
    pl.g.style.cursor = "default";
    pl.g.style.opacity = ".85";
    sparkAt(svg, sk.x, sk.y);
    sfx("pickup");
    if (count === 4) {
      warn.textContent = T("✔ DEVRE KAPALI");
      warn.setAttribute("fill", "#4ade80");
      rpLater(() => rpStageDone(T("Kablolar bağlandı")), 350);
    }
    return true;
  }
  function sockAt(p) {
    return sockets.find((s) => Math.hypot(p.x - s.x, p.y - s.y) < 24);
  }
  function plugAt(p) {
    return plugs.find((q) => !q.done && p.x > 14 && p.x < 96 && Math.abs(p.y - q.y) < 20);
  }
  svg.addEventListener("pointerdown", (ev) => {
    const p = svgPt(svg, ev);
    const pl = plugAt(p);
    if (pl) {
      drag = { pl, sx: p.x, sy: p.y, moved: false, el: null };
      svg.setPointerCapture(ev.pointerId);
      plugs.forEach((q) => q.head.setAttribute("stroke-width", 2));
      pl.head.setAttribute("stroke-width", 4);
      sfx("click");
      return;
    }
    const sk = sockAt(p);
    if (sk && sel) {
      connect(sel, sk);
      sel.head.setAttribute("stroke-width", 2);
      sel = null;
    }
  });
  svg.addEventListener("pointermove", (ev) => {
    if (!drag) return;
    const p = svgPt(svg, ev);
    if (Math.hypot(p.x - drag.sx, p.y - drag.sy) > 5) drag.moved = true;
    if (!drag.moved) return;
    if (drag.el) drag.el.remove();
    drag.el = wirePath(drag.pl.x, drag.pl.y, p.x, p.y, drag.pl.i);
  });
  svg.addEventListener("pointerup", (ev) => {
    if (!drag) return;
    const p = svgPt(svg, ev);
    if (drag.el) drag.el.remove();
    if (!drag.moved) {
      sel = drag.pl;
    } // tıkla-bağla modu
    else {
      const sk = sockAt(p);
      if (sk) connect(drag.pl, sk);
      else sfx("full");
      drag.pl.head.setAttribute("stroke-width", 2);
      sel = null;
    }
    drag = null;
  });
}

/* ---------- 2) SİGORTALAR ---------- */
function rpFuses(area) {
  $("rpIns").innerHTML = T(
    "Kısa devre <b>sigortaları yaktı</b>. Kararmış olanlara tıklayıp değiştir, sonra <b>ana şalteri</b> kaldır. Sağlamlara dokunma!",
  );
  const svg = rpBase(area);
  svgEl(
    "rect",
    {
      x: 18,
      y: 20,
      width: 310,
      height: 222,
      rx: 12,
      fill: "url(#rpSteel)",
      stroke: "#5b6aa0",
      "stroke-width": 1.2,
    },
    svg,
  );
  screw(svg, 28, 30);
  screw(svg, 318, 30);
  screw(svg, 28, 232);
  screw(svg, 318, 232);
  const lab = svgEl(
    "text",
    {
      x: 173,
      y: 40,
      "text-anchor": "middle",
      fill: "#8d9cc0",
      "font-size": 9,
      "font-weight": 700,
      "letter-spacing": "2",
      "font-family": "ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace",
    },
    svg,
  );
  lab.textContent = T("SİGORTA PANOSU · 40A");
  const N = 10,
    burnt = new Set();
  while (burnt.size < 4) burnt.add(Math.floor(Math.random() * N));
  let left = 4;
  const fuses = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    const col = i % 5,
      row = Math.floor(i / 5),
      x = 48 + col * 57,
      y = 56 + row * 92;
    const g = svgEl("g", { style: "cursor:pointer" }, svg);
    svgEl(
      "rect",
      { x: x - 16, y: y - 6, width: 32, height: 76, rx: 6, fill: "#141b36", stroke: "#3a4675" },
      g,
    );
    svgEl("rect", { x: x - 9, y: y - 2, width: 18, height: 10, rx: 2, fill: "#aab3d6" }, g);
    svgEl("rect", { x: x - 9, y: y + 54, width: 18, height: 10, rx: 2, fill: "#aab3d6" }, g);
    const tube = svgEl("rect", { x: x - 8, y: y + 8, width: 16, height: 46, rx: 3 }, g);
    const fil = svgEl("path", { fill: "none", "stroke-width": 1.8, "stroke-linecap": "round" }, g);
    const soot = svgEl("ellipse", { cx: x, cy: y + 31, rx: 6, ry: 12, fill: "rgba(0,0,0,.6)" }, g);
    svgEl("rect", { x: x - 8, y: y + 8, width: 16, height: 46, rx: 3, fill: "url(#rpGlass)" }, g);
    const led = svgEl("circle", { cx: x, cy: y + 76, r: 3.5 }, svg);
    const f = { i, x, y, g, tube, fil, soot, led, bad: burnt.has(i) };
    fuses.push(f);
    paint(f);
    g.addEventListener("pointerdown", () => clickFuse(f));
  }
  function paint(f) {
    const { x, y } = f;
    if (f.bad) {
      f.tube.setAttribute("fill", "#1b1210");
      f.fil.setAttribute("d", `M${x} ${y + 10} l-3 7 l5 6 M${x} ${y + 52} l3 -8 l-4 -6`);
      f.fil.setAttribute("stroke", "#5a3a2a");
      f.soot.setAttribute("opacity", 1);
      f.led.setAttribute("fill", "#ff3b3b");
      if (!f.blink)
        f.blink = f.led.animate([{ opacity: 1 }, { opacity: 0.15 }], {
          duration: 420 + Math.random() * 300,
          iterations: Infinity,
          direction: "alternate",
        });
    } else {
      f.tube.setAttribute("fill", "#2a2410");
      f.fil.setAttribute("d", `M${x} ${y + 10} l-3 7 l6 7 l-6 7 l6 7 l-6 7 l3 7`);
      f.fil.setAttribute("stroke", "#ffd34d");
      f.fil.style.filter = "drop-shadow(0 0 3px #ffb347)";
      f.soot.setAttribute("opacity", 0);
      f.led.setAttribute("fill", "#4ade80");
      if (f.blink) {
        f.blink.cancel();
        f.blink = null;
      }
    }
  }
  function clickFuse(f) {
    if (lever.on) return;
    if (!f.bad) {
      sfx("error");
      sparkAt(svg, f.x, f.y + 30, "#ff7b7b");
      shakeStage();
      return;
    }
    f.bad = false;
    left--;
    f.g.animate(
      [{ transform: "translateY(0)" }, { transform: "translateY(-10px)" }, { transform: "translateY(0)" }],
      { duration: 280, easing: "ease-out" },
    );
    f.g.style.transformOrigin = "center";
    paint(f);
    sparkAt(svg, f.x, f.y + 30, "#fff3b0");
    sfx("pickup");
    cnt.textContent = T("YANIK: ") + left;
    if (left === 0) {
      cnt.textContent = T("ŞALTERİ KALDIR");
      cnt.setAttribute("fill", "#ffd34d");
      leverHint.animate([{ opacity: 0.2 }, { opacity: 1 }], {
        duration: 500,
        iterations: Infinity,
        direction: "alternate",
      });
    }
  }
  // ana şalter
  svgEl(
    "rect",
    {
      x: 346,
      y: 20,
      width: 96,
      height: 222,
      rx: 12,
      fill: "url(#rpSteel)",
      stroke: "#5b6aa0",
      "stroke-width": 1.2,
    },
    svg,
  );
  const t = svgEl(
    "text",
    {
      x: 394,
      y: 40,
      "text-anchor": "middle",
      fill: "#8d9cc0",
      "font-size": 9,
      "font-weight": 700,
      "letter-spacing": "2",
      "font-family": "ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace",
    },
    svg,
  );
  t.textContent = T("ANA ŞALTER");
  svgEl("rect", { x: 376, y: 64, width: 36, height: 130, rx: 8, fill: "#0a1024", stroke: "#3a4675" }, svg);
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++)
    svgEl(
      "rect",
      {
        x: 369,
        y: 70 + i * 22,
        width: 8,
        height: 4,
        fill: i < 2 ? "#4ade80" : i < 4 ? "#ffd34d" : "#ff5a5a",
        opacity: 0.7,
      },
      svg,
    );
  const leverG = svgEl("g", { style: "cursor:pointer" }, svg);
  svgEl("rect", { x: 388, y: 76, width: 12, height: 106, rx: 6, fill: "#20284a" }, leverG);
  const handle = svgEl("g", {}, leverG);
  svgEl(
    "rect",
    { x: 378, y: 160, width: 32, height: 22, rx: 6, fill: "#c0392b", stroke: "#6e1a14", "stroke-width": 2 },
    handle,
  );
  svgEl("rect", { x: 382, y: 163, width: 24, height: 5, rx: 2, fill: "rgba(255,255,255,.35)" }, handle);
  const cnt = svgEl(
    "text",
    {
      x: 394,
      y: 216,
      "text-anchor": "middle",
      fill: "#ff7b7b",
      "font-size": 10,
      "font-weight": 800,
      "font-family": "ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace",
    },
    svg,
  );
  cnt.textContent = T("YANIK: 4");
  const leverHint = svgEl(
    "text",
    { x: 394, y: 232, "text-anchor": "middle", fill: "#ffd34d", "font-size": 14, opacity: 0 },
    svg,
  );
  leverHint.textContent = "▲";
  const lever = { on: false };
  leverG.addEventListener("pointerdown", () => {
    if (lever.on) return;
    if (left > 0) {
      sfx("error");
      shakeStage();
      cnt.animate([{ opacity: 1 }, { opacity: 0.2 }, { opacity: 1 }], { duration: 300 });
      return;
    }
    lever.on = true;
    handle.animate([{ transform: "translateY(0)" }, { transform: "translateY(-84px)" }], {
      duration: 280,
      fill: "forwards",
      easing: "cubic-bezier(.3,1.6,.6,1)",
    });
    leverHint.getAnimations().forEach((a) => a.cancel());
    leverHint.setAttribute("opacity", 0);
    cnt.textContent = T("GÜÇ VAR");
    cnt.setAttribute("fill", "#4ade80");
    sfx("boom");
    shake = Math.max(shake, 5);
    fuses.forEach((f, k) =>
      rpLater(() => {
        f.led.style.filter = "drop-shadow(0 0 5px #4ade80)";
        f.fil.animate([{ opacity: 0.3 }, { opacity: 1 }], { duration: 200 });
      }, k * 40),
    );
    rpLater(() => rpStageDone(T("Sigortalar değiştirildi")), 600);
  });
}

/* ---------- 3) BASINÇ KALİBRASYONU ---------- */
function rpPressure(area) {
  $("rpIns").innerHTML = T(
    "İbre <b>yeşil bölgedeyken</b> KİLİTLE'ye bas (ya da <b>Space</b>). 3 başarılı kilit gerekli; her kilitte bölge daralır.",
  );
  const svg = rpBase(area);
  const cx = 170,
    cy = 206,
    R = 150;
  svgEl(
    "rect",
    {
      x: 14,
      y: 16,
      width: 312,
      height: 228,
      rx: 12,
      fill: "url(#rpSteel)",
      stroke: "#5b6aa0",
      "stroke-width": 1.2,
    },
    svg,
  );
  screw(svg, 24, 26);
  screw(svg, 316, 26);
  screw(svg, 24, 234);
  screw(svg, 316, 234);
  const lab = svgEl(
    "text",
    {
      x: cx,
      y: 236,
      "text-anchor": "middle",
      fill: "#8d9cc0",
      "font-size": 9,
      "font-weight": 700,
      "letter-spacing": "2",
      "font-family": "ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace",
    },
    svg,
  );
  lab.textContent = T("YAKIT HATTI BASINCI · kPa");
  const P = (a) => ({
    x: cx + Math.cos(Math.PI + a * Math.PI) * R * 0.82,
    y: cy + Math.sin(Math.PI + a * Math.PI) * R * 0.82,
  });
  const arc = (a0, a1, r) => {
    const s = { x: cx + Math.cos(Math.PI + a0 * Math.PI) * r, y: cy + Math.sin(Math.PI + a0 * Math.PI) * r },
      e = { x: cx + Math.cos(Math.PI + a1 * Math.PI) * r, y: cy + Math.sin(Math.PI + a1 * Math.PI) * r };
    return `M${s.x} ${s.y} A ${r} ${r} 0 0 1 ${e.x} ${e.y}`;
  };
  svgEl("path", { d: arc(0, 1, R * 0.82), fill: "none", stroke: "#0a1024", "stroke-width": 26 }, svg);
  svgEl("path", { d: arc(0, 0.12, R * 0.82), fill: "none", stroke: "#7a2a2a", "stroke-width": 22 }, svg);
  svgEl("path", { d: arc(0.88, 1, R * 0.82), fill: "none", stroke: "#7a2a2a", "stroke-width": 22 }, svg);
  const zone = svgEl(
    "path",
    {
      fill: "none",
      stroke: "#4ade80",
      "stroke-width": 22,
      style: "filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(74,222,128,.7))",
    },
    svg,
  );
  for (let i = 0; i <= 20; i++) {
    const a = i / 20,
      r1 = R * 0.66,
      r2 = R * (i % 5 ? 0.7 : 0.73);
    svgEl(
      "line",
      {
        x1: cx + Math.cos(Math.PI + a * Math.PI) * r1,
        y1: cy + Math.sin(Math.PI + a * Math.PI) * r1,
        x2: cx + Math.cos(Math.PI + a * Math.PI) * r2,
        y2: cy + Math.sin(Math.PI + a * Math.PI) * r2,
        stroke: "#8d9cc0",
        "stroke-width": i % 5 ? 1 : 2,
      },
      svg,
    );
  }
  const needle = svgEl("g", {}, svg);
  svgEl(
    "polygon",
    {
      points: `${cx - 4},${cy} ${cx + 4},${cy} ${cx},${cy - R * 0.78}`,
      fill: "#ff8c42",
      stroke: "#7a3a12",
      "stroke-width": 1,
    },
    needle,
  );
  svgEl("circle", { cx, cy, r: 11, fill: "#2a3354", stroke: "#aab3d6", "stroke-width": 2 }, svg);
  svgEl("circle", { cx, cy, r: 4, fill: "#ff8c42" }, svg);
  const read = svgEl(
    "text",
    {
      x: cx,
      y: cy - 34,
      "text-anchor": "middle",
      fill: "#e8f1ff",
      "font-size": 18,
      "font-weight": 800,
      "font-family": "ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace",
    },
    svg,
  );
  // sağ: lambalar + düğme
  svgEl(
    "rect",
    {
      x: 340,
      y: 16,
      width: 106,
      height: 228,
      rx: 12,
      fill: "url(#rpSteel)",
      stroke: "#5b6aa0",
      "stroke-width": 1.2,
    },
    svg,
  );
  const lamps = [0, 1, 2].map((i) =>
    svgEl(
      "circle",
      { cx: 363 + i * 30, cy: 48, r: 9, fill: "#20284a", stroke: "#3a4675", "stroke-width": 2 },
      svg,
    ),
  );
  const tl = svgEl(
    "text",
    {
      x: 393,
      y: 74,
      "text-anchor": "middle",
      fill: "#8d9cc0",
      "font-size": 9,
      "font-weight": 700,
      "letter-spacing": "1.5",
      "font-family": "ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace",
    },
    svg,
  );
  tl.textContent = T("KİLİT 0/3");
  const btnG = svgEl("g", { style: "cursor:pointer" }, svg);
  svgEl("circle", { cx: 393, cy: 160, r: 44, fill: "#141b36", stroke: "#3a4675", "stroke-width": 2 }, btnG);
  const btn = svgEl(
    "circle",
    { cx: 393, cy: 156, r: 36, fill: "#e8692a", stroke: "#ffb27a", "stroke-width": 2 },
    btnG,
  );
  svgEl("ellipse", { cx: 385, cy: 142, rx: 16, ry: 7, fill: "rgba(255,255,255,.25)" }, btnG);
  const bt = svgEl(
    "text",
    {
      x: 393,
      y: 161,
      "text-anchor": "middle",
      fill: "#1d0c04",
      "font-size": 13,
      "font-weight": 900,
      "letter-spacing": "1",
    },
    btnG,
  );
  bt.textContent = T("KİLİTLE");
  let hits = 0,
    pos = 0,
    dir = 1,
    speed = 0.55,
    zw = 0.2,
    z0 = 0,
    last = performance.now(),
    cool = 0;
  function newZone() {
    z0 = 0.15 + Math.random() * (0.7 - zw);
    zone.setAttribute("d", arc(z0, z0 + zw, R * 0.82));
  }
  newZone();
  function loop(now) {
    const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000);
    last = now;
    pos += dir * speed * dt;
    if (pos > 1) {
      pos = 1;
      dir = -1;
    }
    if (pos < 0) {
      pos = 0;
      dir = 1;
    }
    const a = -90 + pos * 180;
    needle.setAttribute("transform", `rotate(${a} ${cx} ${cy})`);
    const inZ = pos >= z0 && pos <= z0 + zw;
    read.textContent = String(Math.round(180 + pos * 620)).padStart(3, "0");
    read.setAttribute("fill", inZ ? "#4ade80" : "#e8f1ff");
    rp.raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  rp.raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  function lock() {
    if (rp.busy || performance.now() < cool) return;
    cool = performance.now() + 180;
    btn.animate(
      [{ transform: "translateY(0)" }, { transform: "translateY(4px)" }, { transform: "translateY(0)" }],
      { duration: 140 },
    );
    if (pos >= z0 && pos <= z0 + zw) {
      lamps[hits].setAttribute("fill", "#4ade80");
      lamps[hits].style.filter = "drop-shadow(0 0 6px #4ade80)";
      hits++;
      tl.textContent = T("KİLİT ") + hits + "/3";
      sfx("pickup");
      const pt = P(pos);
      sparkAt(svg, pt.x, pt.y, "#b8ffcf");
      if (hits >= 3) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(rp.raf);
        rpStageDone(T("Basınç kalibre edildi"));
        return;
      }
      zw = Math.max(0.08, zw * 0.7);
      speed *= 1.3;
      newZone();
    } else {
      sfx("error");
      shakeStage();
      if (hits > 0) {
        hits--;
        lamps[hits].setAttribute("fill", "#20284a");
        lamps[hits].style.filter = "";
      }
      tl.textContent = T("KİLİT ") + hits + "/3";
      zone.animate([{ stroke: "#ff5a5a" }, { stroke: "#4ade80" }], { duration: 350 });
    }
  }
  btnG.addEventListener("pointerdown", lock);
  const kh = (e) => {
    if (e.code === "Space" && repairOpen) {
      e.preventDefault();
      lock();
    }
  };
  addEventListener("keydown", kh);
  rp.cleanup.push(() => removeEventListener("keydown", kh));
}

/* ---------- 4) ATEŞLEME DİZİSİ ---------- */
function rpIgnite(area) {
  $("rpIns").innerHTML = T("Ateşleme dizisini <b>izle</b>, sonra düğmelere <b>aynı sırayla</b> bas.");
  const svg = rpBase(area);
  const COLS = ["#ff5a5a", "#ffd34d", "#38bdf8", "#4ade80"],
    DIM = ["#5a2222", "#5a4a14", "#163e5a", "#1a4a2e"],
    FREQ = [330, 440, 554, 660],
    LBL = ["A", "B", "C", "D"];
  svgEl(
    "rect",
    {
      x: 14,
      y: 16,
      width: 236,
      height: 228,
      rx: 12,
      fill: "url(#rpSteel)",
      stroke: "#5b6aa0",
      "stroke-width": 1.2,
    },
    svg,
  );
  screw(svg, 24, 26);
  screw(svg, 240, 26);
  screw(svg, 24, 234);
  screw(svg, 240, 234);
  const pads = [0, 1, 2, 3].map((i) => {
    const x = 36 + (i % 2) * 104,
      y = 36 + Math.floor(i / 2) * 104,
      g = svgEl("g", { style: "cursor:pointer" }, svg);
    svgEl(
      "rect",
      { x, y, width: 92, height: 92, rx: 16, fill: "#0a1024", stroke: "#3a4675", "stroke-width": 2 },
      g,
    );
    const face = svgEl("rect", { x: x + 8, y: y + 8, width: 76, height: 76, rx: 12, fill: DIM[i] }, g);
    svgEl("rect", { x: x + 14, y: y + 12, width: 64, height: 16, rx: 6, fill: "rgba(255,255,255,.08)" }, g);
    const t = svgEl(
      "text",
      {
        x: x + 46,
        y: y + 56,
        "text-anchor": "middle",
        fill: "rgba(255,255,255,.55)",
        "font-size": 22,
        "font-weight": 900,
        "font-family": "ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace",
      },
      g,
    );
    t.textContent = LBL[i];
    g.addEventListener("pointerdown", () => press(i));
    return { g, face };
  });
  // sağ ekran
  svgEl(
    "rect",
    {
      x: 264,
      y: 16,
      width: 182,
      height: 228,
      rx: 12,
      fill: "url(#rpSteel)",
      stroke: "#5b6aa0",
      "stroke-width": 1.2,
    },
    svg,
  );
  svgEl(
    "rect",
    {
      x: 278,
      y: 34,
      width: 154,
      height: 84,
      rx: 8,
      fill: "#0a1024",
      stroke: "#5ad1ff",
      "stroke-opacity": 0.5,
    },
    svg,
  );
  const s1 = svgEl(
    "text",
    {
      x: 355,
      y: 68,
      "text-anchor": "middle",
      fill: "#5ad1ff",
      "font-size": 15,
      "font-weight": 800,
      "letter-spacing": "2",
      "font-family": "ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace",
    },
    svg,
  );
  const s2 = svgEl(
    "text",
    {
      x: 355,
      y: 94,
      "text-anchor": "middle",
      fill: "#8d9cc0",
      "font-size": 10,
      "font-family": "ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace",
    },
    svg,
  );
  const L = 5,
    seq = Array.from({ length: L }, () => Math.floor(Math.random() * 4));
  const dots = seq.map((_, k) =>
    svgEl(
      "circle",
      {
        cx: 355 - (L - 1) * 12 + k * 24,
        cy: 146,
        r: 7,
        fill: "#20284a",
        stroke: "#3a4675",
        "stroke-width": 2,
      },
      svg,
    ),
  );
  const rb = svgEl("g", { style: "cursor:pointer" }, svg);
  svgEl("rect", { x: 300, y: 180, width: 110, height: 40, rx: 10, fill: "#20284a", stroke: "#3a4675" }, rb);
  const rt = svgEl(
    "text",
    {
      x: 355,
      y: 205,
      "text-anchor": "middle",
      fill: "#aab3d6",
      "font-size": 11,
      "font-weight": 800,
      "letter-spacing": "1",
    },
    rb,
  );
  rt.textContent = T("↻ TEKRAR İZLE");
  let input = [],
    playing = false;
  function light(i, ms) {
    const f = pads[i].face;
    f.setAttribute("fill", COLS[i]);
    f.style.filter = `drop-shadow(0 0 14px ${COLS[i]})`;
    tone(FREQ[i], (ms / 1000) * 0.9, "triangle", 0.22);
    rpLater(() => {
      f.setAttribute("fill", DIM[i]);
      f.style.filter = "";
    }, ms);
  }
  function setDots(n, col) {
    dots.forEach((d, k) => {
      d.setAttribute("fill", k < n ? col : "#20284a");
    });
  }
  function play() {
    playing = true;
    input = [];
    setDots(0);
    s1.textContent = T("İZLE");
    s1.setAttribute("fill", "#ffd34d");
    s2.textContent = T("Dizi oynatılıyor…");
    seq.forEach((v, k) =>
      rpLater(
        () => {
          light(v, 340);
          setDots(k + 1, "#ffd34d");
        },
        500 + k * 520,
      ),
    );
    rpLater(
      () => {
        playing = false;
        setDots(0);
        s1.textContent = T("SIRA SENDE");
        s1.setAttribute("fill", "#5ad1ff");
        s2.textContent = "0 / " + L;
      },
      500 + L * 520,
    );
  }
  function press(i) {
    if (playing || rp.busy) return;
    light(i, 220);
    input.push(i);
    const k = input.length - 1;
    if (seq[k] !== i) {
      sfx("error");
      shakeStage();
      s1.textContent = T("HATA");
      s1.setAttribute("fill", "#ff5a5a");
      s2.textContent = T("Dizi yeniden oynatılıyor");
      setDots(seq.length, "#ff5a5a");
      playing = true;
      rpLater(play, 900);
      return;
    }
    setDots(input.length, "#4ade80");
    s2.textContent = input.length + " / " + L;
    if (input.length === L) {
      s1.textContent = T("ATEŞLEME");
      s1.setAttribute("fill", "#4ade80");
      s2.textContent = T("İtki çekirdeği aktif");
      pads.forEach((p, j) => rpLater(() => light(j, 300), j * 90));
      rpLater(() => rpStageDone(T("Ateşleme dizisi doğru")), 500);
    }
  }
  rb.addEventListener("pointerdown", () => {
    if (!playing && !rp.busy) play();
  });
  play();
}

/* ---------- İÇ MEKÂN DUMAN SİSTEMİ (arızada) ---------- */
const inSmoke = [],
  inSparks = [];
let smokeLast = 0,
  smokeAcc = 0,
  smokeLevel = 0;
const puffCache = {};
function puff(col) {
  if (puffCache[col]) return puffCache[col];
  const c = document.createElement("canvas");
  c.width = c.height = 64;
  const g = c.getContext("2d");
  const gr = g.createRadialGradient(32, 32, 1, 32, 32, 32);
  gr.addColorStop(0, col.replace("A", "1"));
  gr.addColorStop(0.5, col.replace("A", ".55"));
  gr.addColorStop(1, col.replace("A", "0"));
  g.fillStyle = gr;
  g.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
  return (puffCache[col] = c);
}
function prewarmSmoke() {
  inSmoke.length = 0;
  smokeLevel = 1;
  smokeLast = 0;
  const D0 = DECKS[0],
    D1 = DECKS[1],
    LX = LADDERS[0].x;
  for (let k = 0; k < 230; k++) {
    const deck = k < 185 ? 0 : 1,
      d = DECKS[deck];
    const col = deck === 0 && k < 45; // motorun üstünde yükselen sütun
    const x = col
      ? 84 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30
      : deck === 0
        ? d.xmin - 20 + Math.random() * (d.xmax - d.xmin + 40)
        : LX + Math.random() * 200;
    const y = col ? D0.ceil + 20 + Math.random() * 40 : d.ceil + 10 + Math.random() * (deck === 0 ? 50 : 30);
    inSmoke.push({
      x,
      y,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 20,
      vy: col ? -40 : 0,
      r: 16 + Math.random() * 22,
      life: 1 + Math.random() * 4,
      max: 7 + Math.random() * 6,
      dark: Math.random() < 0.55,
      deck,
    });
  }
}
function updateDrawInSmoke(broken, t) {
  const now = performance.now() / 1000;
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, smokeLast ? now - smokeLast : 0);
  smokeLast = now;
  smokeLevel = broken ? Math.min(1, smokeLevel + dt * 0.35) : Math.max(0, smokeLevel - dt * 0.25);
  const D0 = DECKS[0],
    D1 = DECKS[1],
    LX = LADDERS[0].x;
  if (broken) {
    smokeAcc += dt * (34 + smokeLevel * 56);
    while (smokeAcc > 1) {
      smokeAcc--;
      const r = Math.random();
      const src =
        r < 0.6
          ? { x: 94, y: D0.ceil + 52, vx: (Math.random() - 0.2) * 40 }
          : r < 0.9
            ? { x: 40, y: D0.ceil + 42, vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 70 }
            : { x: -16, y: D0.ceil + 64, vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30 };
      inSmoke.push({
        x: src.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 12,
        y: src.y,
        vx: src.vx,
        vy: -35 - Math.random() * 45,
        r: 9 + Math.random() * 9,
        life: 0,
        max: 7 + Math.random() * 6,
        dark: Math.random() < 0.55,
        deck: 0,
      });
    }
    if (Math.random() < dt * 14) {
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++)
        inSparks.push({
          x: 94,
          y: D0.ceil + 54,
          vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 160,
          vy: -60 - Math.random() * 90,
          life: 0,
          max: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.4,
        });
    }
    if (inSmoke.length > 340) inSmoke.splice(0, inSmoke.length - 340);
  }
  // tavan sisi (birikmiş duman bandı)
  if (smokeLevel > 0) {
    for (const [d, amt] of [
      [D0, 1],
      [D1, 0.55],
    ]) {
      const h = 50 + smokeLevel * 58 * amt;
      const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, d.ceil, 0, d.ceil + h);
      g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(46,49,62," + 0.9 * smokeLevel * amt + ")");
      g.addColorStop(0.55, "rgba(70,74,90," + 0.45 * smokeLevel * amt + ")");
      g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(70,74,90,0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.fillRect(d.xmin - 40, d.ceil, d.xmax - d.xmin + 80, h);
    }
    // kırmızı alarm darbesi
    const al = (Math.sin(t * 5) * 0.5 + 0.5) * 0.12 * smokeLevel;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,40,40," + al + ")";
    ctx.fillRect(-240, D0.ceil, 480, D0.floor - D0.ceil);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,40,40," + al * 0.6 + ")";
    ctx.fillRect(-240, D1.ceil, 480, D1.floor - D1.ceil);
    for (const [bx, by] of [
      [0, D0.ceil + 4],
      [-60, D1.ceil + 4],
    ]) {
      // dönen alarm lambaları
      ctx.fillStyle = "#3a1414";
      rrp(bx - 7, by, 14, 7, 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(bx, by + 8);
      ctx.rotate(t * 4);
      const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 90, 0);
      bg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,60,60," + 0.35 * smokeLevel + ")");
      bg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,60,60,0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = bg;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
      ctx.lineTo(90, -14);
      ctx.lineTo(90, 14);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.rotate(Math.PI);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
      ctx.lineTo(90, -14);
      ctx.lineTo(90, 14);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
      ctx.fillStyle = Math.sin(t * 8) > 0 ? "#ff5a5a" : "#a02020";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(bx, by + 8, 4, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  // partiküller: düşük çözünürlüklü ayrı katmana çizilir (yumuşak + hızlı)
  const SD = 3,
    cv = ctx.canvas;
  if (!updateDrawInSmoke.c) updateDrawInSmoke.c = document.createElement("canvas");
  const sc = updateDrawInSmoke.c,
    sw = Math.ceil(cv.width / SD),
    sh = Math.ceil(cv.height / SD);
  if (sc.width !== sw || sc.height !== sh) {
    sc.width = sw;
    sc.height = sh;
  }
  const sx = sc.getContext("2d"),
    m = ctx.getTransform();
  sx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
  sx.clearRect(0, 0, sw, sh);
  sx.setTransform(m.a / SD, m.b / SD, m.c / SD, m.d / SD, m.e / SD, m.f / SD);
  for (let i = inSmoke.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const s = inSmoke[i];
    s.life += dt;
    if (s.life > s.max) {
      inSmoke.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }
    s.r += dt * Math.max(3, 13 - s.life * 1.2);
    s.vy = Math.max(-60, s.vy - dt * 16);
    s.x += s.vx * dt;
    s.y += s.vy * dt;
    s.vx *= 1 - dt * 0.35;
    const d = DECKS[s.deck];
    if (s.deck === 0 && Math.abs(s.x - LX) < 16 && s.y < D0.ceil + 24) {
      s.deck = 1;
      s.vy = Math.min(s.vy, -40);
    } // merdiven boşluğundan yukarı sızar
    if (s.deck === 1 && s.y > D1.floor - 4) s.x += (LX - s.x) * Math.min(1, dt * 5);
    const ceil = DECKS[s.deck].ceil + 8 + s.r * 0.3;
    if (s.y < ceil) {
      s.y = ceil;
      s.vy = 0;
      const away = s.deck === 0 ? (s.x < 70 ? -1 : 1) : 1;
      s.vx = Math.max(-55, Math.min(55, s.vx + away * 36 * dt));
    }
    if (s.x < d.xmin - 30) {
      s.x = d.xmin - 30;
      s.vx = Math.abs(s.vx) * 0.3;
    }
    if (s.x > d.xmax + 30) {
      s.x = d.xmax + 30;
      s.vx = -Math.abs(s.vx) * 0.3;
    }
    const a = Math.min(1, s.life * 2.5) * (1 - s.life / s.max) * (s.dark ? 0.82 : 0.6);
    sx.globalAlpha = a;
    const img = puff(s.dark ? "rgba(38,40,52,A)" : "rgba(150,156,176,A)");
    const rr = Math.min(s.r, 56);
    sx.drawImage(img, s.x - rr, s.y - rr, rr * 2, rr * 2);
  }
  sx.globalAlpha = 1;
  if (inSmoke.length) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
    ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
    ctx.drawImage(sc, 0, 0, sw * SD, sh * SD);
    ctx.restore();
  }
  for (let i = inSparks.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const k = inSparks[i];
    k.life += dt;
    if (k.life > k.max) {
      inSparks.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }
    k.vy += 260 * dt;
    k.x += k.vx * dt;
    k.y += k.vy * dt;
    if (k.y > D0.floor) {
      k.y = D0.floor;
      k.vy *= -0.35;
      k.vx *= 0.6;
    }
    ctx.strokeStyle =
      "rgba(255," + Math.round(200 + 55 * (1 - k.life / k.max)) + ",140," + (1 - k.life / k.max) + ")";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(k.x, k.y);
    ctx.lineTo(k.x - k.vx * 0.03, k.y - k.vy * 0.03);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

$("rpX").onclick = closeRepair;
/* ============== KUM FIRTINASI — takvimli + gerçekçi ==============
   İlk fırtına 2. gün gelir ve sağlam motoru bozar; sonra her 5 günde bir.
   Gün içinde: 0:10'da uyarı, 0:45'te başlar, ~2 dakika sürer. */
const STORM_START = 90,
  STORM_DUR = 150,
  STORM_WARN = 45; // gün içinde 1:30'da başlar, 2:30 sürer, 45 sn önce uyarı
const stormFx = {
  I: 0,
  k: 0,
  gust: 0,
  gustT: 4,
  gustDur: 0,
  phase: "none",
  u: 0,
  tLeft: 0,
  tTo: 0,
  ang: 0,
  broke: false,
};
function resetStormFx() {
  Object.assign(stormFx, { I: 0, k: 0, gust: 0, gustT: 4, gustDur: 0, phase: "none" });
  windAudio(0, 0);
}
const isStormDay = (d) => d >= 2 && (d - 2) % 5 === 0;
const smooth = (x) => {
  x = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, x));
  return x * x * (3 - 2 * x);
};
function stormInfo() {
  const wt = Math.max(0, Number(game.worldTime) || 0),
    day = Math.floor(wt / DAY_SECONDS) + 1,
    inDay = wt % DAY_SECONDS;
  if (isStormDay(day)) {
    if (inDay < STORM_START && inDay >= STORM_START - STORM_WARN - desFx().stormWarn)
      return { phase: "warn", k: 0, tTo: STORM_START - inDay };
    if (inDay >= STORM_START && inDay < STORM_START + STORM_DUR) {
      const u = inDay - STORM_START;
      return {
        phase: "active",
        u,
        k: Math.min(smooth(u / 20), smooth((STORM_DUR - u) / 24)),
        tLeft: STORM_START + STORM_DUR - inDay,
      };
    }
  }
  return { phase: "none", k: 0 };
}
/* bir sonraki fırtınaya kalan oyun saniyesi */
function nextStormIn() {
  const wt = Math.max(0, Number(game.worldTime) || 0),
    day = Math.floor(wt / DAY_SECONDS) + 1,
    inDay = wt % DAY_SECONDS;
  for (let d = day; d < day + 12; d++) {
    if (!isStormDay(d)) continue;
    const start = (d - 1) * DAY_SECONDS + STORM_START;
    if (start + STORM_DUR > wt) return Math.max(0, start - wt);
  }
  return Infinity;
}
function updateStorm(simDt, dt) {
  if (!game || scene === "earth") {
    stormFx.I = Math.max(0, stormFx.I - dt);
    stormFx.phase = "none";
    windAudio(0, 0);
    showStormBanner(null);
    return;
  }
  const S = stormInfo();
  stormFx.phase = S.phase;
  stormFx.k = S.k;
  stormFx.tLeft = S.tLeft || 0;
  stormFx.tTo = S.tTo || 0;
  stormFx.u = S.u || 0;
  // esinti (gust): fırtına zirvedeyken ani rüzgâr darbeleri
  stormFx.gustT -= dt;
  if (S.phase === "active" && S.k > 0.55 && stormFx.gustT <= 0) {
    stormFx.gustDur = 1.1 + Math.random() * 0.9;
    stormFx.gustT = 4 + Math.random() * 6;
    if (!insideRocket) shake = Math.max(shake, 4 + S.k * 4);
  }
  stormFx.gustDur = Math.max(0, stormFx.gustDur - dt);
  const gTarget = stormFx.gustDur > 0 ? Math.sin(Math.min(1, stormFx.gustDur / 1.6) * Math.PI) : 0;
  stormFx.gust += (gTarget - stormFx.gust) * Math.min(1, dt * 6);
  const t = performance.now() / 1000;
  const target =
    S.k * (0.82 + 0.12 * Math.sin(t * 0.9) + 0.06 * Math.sin(t * 2.7)) + stormFx.gust * 0.3 * S.k;
  stormFx.I += (Math.min(1.15, target) - stormFx.I) * Math.min(1, dt * 2.2);
  if (stormFx.I < 0.002) stormFx.I = 0;
  stormFx.ang = 0.18 * Math.sin(t * 0.13) + 0.06 * Math.sin(t * 0.7);
  // ilk fırtına: zirvede roketi vurur
  if (S.phase === "active" && S.u > 30 && game.repair.state === "ok") {
    const dn = gameDayNumber();
    if (!game.stormBroke) stormBreakRocket();
    else if (game.stormRoll !== dn) {
      game.stormRoll = dn;
      const A = rkArmor(),
        ch = A ? ARMOR[A - 1].chance : BASE_STORM_BREAK;
      if (Math.random() < ch) stormBreakRocket();
      else if (A > 0) toast(T("🛡️ Fırtına kalkanı roketi korudu — motor sağlam"));
    }
  }
  if (insideRocket && stormFx.I > 0.05)
    shake = Math.max(shake, (stormFx.I * 1.6 + stormFx.gust * 3) * (1 - rkArmor() * 0.22)); // gövde sarsılır
  windAudio(
    (insideRocket ? stormFx.I * 0.35 : stormFx.I) * ((settings.amb == null ? 80 : settings.amb) / 80),
    stormFx.gust,
  );
  showStormBanner(S);
}
function stormBreakRocket() {
  storyTrigger("engine");
  game.stormBroke = true;
  game.repair = { state: "broken", end: 0, stage: 0 };
  {
    const C = commState();
    if (C.trk.st) C.trk.st.broke = true;
    C.flags.brokeAt = game.worldTime;
    commsObs("engine_fail", {});
  }
  shake = Math.max(shake, 22);
  flash = Math.max(flash, 0.35);
  sfx("boom");
  setTimeout(() => sfx("boom"), 260);
  if (!insideRocket) {
    burst(ROCKET.x + 14, ROCKET.y - 16, 46, "#ffb347", { sp: 280, life: 0.9, size: 6 });
    burst(ROCKET.x + 10, ROCKET.y - 30, 30, "#9aa0b4", { sp: 120, life: 1.4, size: 9, up: 90 });
  }
  toast(T("💥 Şiddetli bir esinti roketi savurdu — motordan duman yükseliyor!"));
}
/* rüzgâr sesi: döngüsel gürültü → bant geçiren filtre */
const WA = { src: null, f: null, g: null };
function windAudio(level, gust) {
  if (!AU.ac || !AU.ready) return;
  try {
    if (!WA.src) {
      const ac = AU.ac,
        len = ac.sampleRate * 2,
        buf = ac.createBuffer(1, len, ac.sampleRate),
        d = buf.getChannelData(0);
      let last = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        const w = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
        last = (last + 0.02 * w) / 1.02;
        d[i] = last * 3.2 + w * 0.08;
      }
      WA.src = ac.createBufferSource();
      WA.src.buffer = buf;
      WA.src.loop = true;
      WA.f = ac.createBiquadFilter();
      WA.f.type = "bandpass";
      WA.f.Q.value = 0.8;
      WA.f.frequency.value = 400;
      WA.g = ac.createGain();
      WA.g.gain.value = 0;
      WA.src.connect(WA.f);
      WA.f.connect(WA.g);
      WA.g.connect(AU.sfxG);
      WA.src.start();
    }
    const now = AU.ac.currentTime;
    WA.g.gain.setTargetAtTime(Math.min(0.9, level * 0.55 + gust * 0.25), now, 0.25);
    WA.f.frequency.setTargetAtTime(260 + level * 420 + gust * 520, now, 0.3);
  } catch (e) {}
}

/* --- toz bulutu dokusu (döşenebilir fbm gürültü) --- */
let dustTex = null;
function buildDustTex() {
  const N = 256,
    c = document.createElement("canvas");
  c.width = c.height = N;
  const g = c.getContext("2d"),
    img = g.createImageData(N, N);
  const H1 = (x, y) => {
    const n = Math.sin(x * 127.1 + y * 311.7) * 43758.5453;
    return n - Math.floor(n);
  };
  const vn = (x, y, p) => {
    const xi = Math.floor(x),
      yi = Math.floor(y),
      u = x - xi,
      v = y - yi,
      s = (a) => a * a * (3 - 2 * a),
      m = (a) => ((a % p) + p) % p;
    const a = H1(m(xi), m(yi)),
      b = H1(m(xi + 1), m(yi)),
      cc = H1(m(xi), m(yi + 1)),
      d = H1(m(xi + 1), m(yi + 1)),
      su = s(u),
      sv = s(v);
    return (a + (b - a) * su) * (1 - sv) + (cc + (d - cc) * su) * sv;
  };
  for (let y = 0; y < N; y++)
    for (let x = 0; x < N; x++) {
      let sum = 0,
        amp = 0.55,
        f = 4;
      for (let o = 0; o < 5; o++) {
        sum += amp * vn((x / N) * f, (y / N) * f, f);
        amp *= 0.5;
        f *= 2;
      }
      const a = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (sum - 0.36) * 2.1)),
        i = (y * N + x) * 4;
      img.data[i] = 200 + sum * 40;
      img.data[i + 1] = 120 + sum * 40;
      img.data[i + 2] = 64 + sum * 30;
      img.data[i + 3] = a * 255;
    }
  g.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
  dustTex = { c, pat: null };
}
function drawSandstorm() {
  const I = Math.min(1.1, stormFx.I);
  if (I <= 0.003) return;
  if (!dustTex) buildDustTex();
  const t = performance.now() / 1000,
    z = (CFG.zoom * Math.min(W, H)) / 700,
    a = stormFx.ang,
    ca = Math.cos(a),
    sa = Math.sin(a);
  ctx.save();
  // 1) güneş kararır + turuncu pus
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(22,9,4," + (0.28 * I).toFixed(3) + ")";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(176,96,48," + (0.3 * I).toFixed(3) + ")";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  // 2) parallax toz bulutları (kamera + rüzgârla akar)
  if (!dustTex.pat) dustTex.pat = ctx.createPattern(dustTex.c, "repeat");
  const layers = [
    [3.6, 0.55, 0.55],
    [2.4, 1.0, 0.48],
    [1.5, 1.7, 0.36],
  ];
  for (const [sc, spd, al] of layers) {
    const tile = 256 * sc,
      ox = -(t * spd * 230 * (0.6 + I * 0.6)) - p.x * z * spd * 0.7,
      oy = Math.sin(t * 0.4 * spd) * 30 * sc - p.y * z * spd * 0.7 + ox * sa * 0.6;
    const m = new DOMMatrix()
      .translateSelf((((ox % tile) + tile) % tile) - tile, (((oy % tile) + tile) % tile) - tile)
      .scaleSelf(sc, sc);
    dustTex.pat.setTransform(m);
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, al * I * (1 + stormFx.gust * 0.5));
    ctx.fillStyle = dustTex.pat;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  // 3) kum taneleri: rüzgâr yönünde hızlı ince çizgiler
  const n = Math.round(260 * Math.min(1, I));
  ctx.lineCap = "round";
  for (let pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = pass
      ? "rgba(255,226,186," + (0.55 * I).toFixed(3) + ")"
      : "rgba(214,150,96," + (0.5 * I).toFixed(3) + ")";
    ctx.lineWidth = pass ? 1.1 : 1.8;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = pass; i < n; i += 2) {
      const sp = 900 + (i % 7) * 180 + stormFx.gust * 900,
        L = 18 + (i % 5) * 12 + I * 26;
      const x = ((i * 173.3 + t * sp) % (W + 300)) - 150,
        y0 = ((i * 97.7) % (H + 60)) - 30;
      const y = y0 + Math.sin(t * 3 + i) * 10 + x * sa * 0.3;
      ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      ctx.lineTo(x - L * ca, y - L * sa);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  // 4) iri kum zerreleri
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,214,170," + (0.5 * I).toFixed(3) + ")";
  for (let i = 0; i < Math.round(90 * Math.min(1, I)); i++) {
    const x = ((i * 131.7 + t * (1300 + (i % 5) * 220)) % (W + 60)) - 30,
      y = ((i * 71.3 + Math.sin(t * 5 + i) * 26) % (H + 30)) - 15;
    ctx.fillRect(x, y, 1.5 + (i % 3) * 0.8, 1.5 + (i % 3) * 0.8);
  }
  // 5) esinti dalgası: ekranı süpüren yoğun toz perdesi
  if (stormFx.gust > 0.05) {
    const gx = W * (1.4 - ((t * 0.55) % 1) * 1.8),
      gw = W * 0.7;
    const gg = ctx.createLinearGradient(gx - gw, 0, gx + gw, 0);
    gg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(190,110,60,0)");
    gg.addColorStop(0.5, "rgba(205,128,70," + (0.45 * stormFx.gust * I).toFixed(3) + ")");
    gg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(190,110,60,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = gg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }
  // 6) görüş mesafesi: oyuncu çevresi hariç her yer tozla kaplanır
  const r0 = Math.min(W, H) * (0.42 - 0.28 * Math.min(1, I)),
    r1 = Math.max(W, H) * (0.95 - 0.4 * Math.min(1, I));
  const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H / 2, r0, W / 2, H / 2, r1);
  vg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(150,80,40,0)");
  vg.addColorStop(0.55, "rgba(150,80,40," + (0.55 * I).toFixed(3) + ")");
  vg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(120,62,30," + (0.92 * Math.min(1, I)).toFixed(3) + ")");
  ctx.fillStyle = vg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.restore();
}
/* zemin seviyesinde savrulan kum şeritleri (dünya uzayında) */
function drawGroundDrift() {
  const I = Math.min(1, stormFx.I);
  if (I <= 0.02) return;
  const t = performance.now() / 1000;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.lineCap = "round";
  for (let i = 0; i < 46; i++) {
    const span = 1600,
      ox = ((i * 211 + t * (260 + (i % 4) * 60)) % span) - span / 2,
      y = p.y + ((i * 137) % 1200) - 600 + Math.sin(t * 0.8 + i) * 14;
    const x = p.x + ox,
      L = 60 + (i % 5) * 30;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(240,190,140," + (0.22 * I).toFixed(3) + ")";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3 + (i % 3);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, y);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(x - L * 0.33, y - 6, x - L * 0.66, y + 6, x - L, y + Math.sin(i) * 4);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

/* ============== UYARI KARTLARI (fırtına + radyasyon) ============== */
const AL_ICONS = {
  storm:
    '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="24" height="24" fill="none" stroke="#2a0e04" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M3 8h10.5a3 3 0 1 0-3-3"/><path d="M3 12.5h15.5a3 3 0 1 1-3 3"/><path d="M3 17h7a2.4 2.4 0 1 1-2.4 2.4"/></svg>',
  rad: '<svg class="spin" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="26" height="26"><path fill="#1a0b00" d="M12 12 7.5 4.2A9 9 0 0 1 16.5 4.2ZM12 12 21 12A9 9 0 0 1 16.5 19.8ZM12 12 7.5 19.8A9 9 0 0 1 3 12Z"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3.4" fill="#facc15"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2" fill="#1a0b00"/></svg>',
  safe: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="22" height="22" fill="none" stroke="#04210f" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 3 4.5 6v5.5c0 4.6 3.2 8 7.5 9.5 4.3-1.5 7.5-4.9 7.5-9.5V6Z"/><path d="m8.6 12.2 2.4 2.4 4.5-4.6"/></svg>',
};
const mmss = (s) => {
  s = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(s));
  return Math.floor(s / 60) + ":" + String(s % 60).padStart(2, "0");
};
function setAlert(id, cls, icon, title, sub, bar, time) {
  const el = $(id);
  if (!cls) {
    if (!el.classList.contains("hidden")) el.classList.add("hidden");
    el._k = "";
    return;
  }
  const key = cls + "|" + icon;
  if (el._k !== key) {
    el._k = key;
    el.className = "alert " + cls;
    el.innerHTML = `<div class="al-ic">${AL_ICONS[icon]}</div><div class="al-tx"><b></b><span></span><div class="al-bar"><i></i></div></div><div class="al-time"></div>`;
  }
  el.querySelector("b").textContent = title;
  el.querySelector("span").textContent = sub;
  el.querySelector(".al-bar i").style.width = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, bar * 100)) + "%";
  el.querySelector(".al-time").textContent = time;
}
function showStormBanner(S) {
  if (!S || S.phase === "none" || mode !== "play") {
    setAlert("stormBanner");
    return;
  }
  if (S.phase === "warn") {
    setAlert(
      "stormBanner",
      "storm warn",
      "storm",
      T("Kum fırtınası yaklaşıyor"),
      insideRocket ? T("Roketin içindesin — güvendesin") : T("Rüzgâr hızlanıyor · görüş azalacak"),
      1 - S.tTo / STORM_WARN,
      mmss(S.tTo),
    );
    return;
  }
  const kmh = Math.round(40 + stormFx.I * 95 + stormFx.gust * 30);
  if (insideRocket)
    setAlert(
      "stormBanner",
      "storm safe",
      "safe",
      T("Roket içi güvenli"),
      T("Dışarıda kum fırtınası · rüzgâr ") + kmh + " km/s",
      S.tLeft / STORM_DUR,
      mmss(S.tLeft),
    );
  else
    setAlert(
      "stormBanner",
      "storm",
      "storm",
      T("Kum fırtınası"),
      T("Rüzgâr ") + kmh + T(" km/s · görüş çok düşük"),
      S.tLeft / STORM_DUR,
      mmss(S.tLeft),
    );
}

/* ============== EŞYA ÇİZİMLERİ — tek kaynak: canvas ==============
   drawItemArt(c,key,size,o) 48×48'lik birim kutuya çizer (0,0 merkez).
   Aynı çizim envanter ikonu (dataURL), kapsül ekranı, el ve yerde kullanılır. */
function drawItemArt(c, key, size, o) {
  o = o || {};
  c.save();
  c.scale(size / 48, size / 48);
  c.lineJoin = "round";
  c.lineCap = "round";
  switch (key) {
    case "pick": {
      drawPickArt(c);
      break;
    }
    case "water": {
      // plastik su şişesi
      const fill = o.fill == null ? 1 : Math.max(0, Math.min(1, o.fill)),
        tilt = o.tilt || 0;
      const body = () => {
        c.beginPath();
        c.moveTo(-5, -14);
        c.lineTo(5, -14);
        c.lineTo(5, -11);
        c.bezierCurveTo(5, -8.5, 9.5, -8, 9.5, -3);
        c.lineTo(9.5, 16);
        c.quadraticCurveTo(9.5, 21, 4.5, 21);
        c.lineTo(-4.5, 21);
        c.quadraticCurveTo(-9.5, 21, -9.5, 16);
        c.lineTo(-9.5, -3);
        c.bezierCurveTo(-9.5, -8, -5, -8.5, -5, -11);
        c.closePath();
      };
      c.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.18)";
      c.beginPath();
      c.ellipse(1, 21.5, 10, 2.4, 0, 0, 7);
      c.fill();
      c.save();
      body();
      c.clip();
      c.fillStyle = "rgba(210,236,255,.22)";
      c.fillRect(-12, -16, 24, 40);
      if (fill > 0) {
        const lvl = 21 - 27 * fill;
        c.save();
        c.translate(0, lvl);
        c.rotate(-tilt);
        const wg = c.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 30);
        wg.addColorStop(0, "#7fd8ff");
        wg.addColorStop(1, "#1773c4");
        c.fillStyle = wg;
        c.fillRect(-30, 0, 60, 60);
        c.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.55)";
        c.fillRect(-30, -0.6, 60, 1.6);
        c.restore();
        if (o.bubbles) {
          const t = performance.now() / 1000;
          c.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.75)";
          for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            const ph = (t * 1.6 + i * 0.21) % 1;
            c.beginPath();
            c.arc(-4 + i * 2, 19 - ph * (21 - lvl + 2), 0.9 + (i % 2) * 0.5, 0, 7);
            c.fill();
          }
        }
      }
      c.restore();
      body();
      c.strokeStyle = "rgba(150,200,236,.95)";
      c.lineWidth = 1.3;
      c.stroke();
      c.strokeStyle = "rgba(150,200,236,.55)";
      c.lineWidth = 1;
      for (const y of [-1, 14]) {
        c.beginPath();
        c.moveTo(-9.5, y);
        c.quadraticCurveTo(0, y + 1.6, 9.5, y);
        c.stroke();
      }
      c.fillStyle = "#f4f8ff";
      c.fillRect(-9.5, 3, 19, 8);
      c.fillStyle = "#1f6fd1";
      c.fillRect(-9.5, 3, 19, 1.6);
      c.fillRect(-9.5, 9.4, 19, 1.6);
      c.fillStyle = "#1f8fe0";
      c.beginPath();
      c.moveTo(0, 4.6);
      c.quadraticCurveTo(2.6, 7.4, 1.9, 8.4);
      c.arc(0, 8, 1.95, 0, Math.PI);
      c.quadraticCurveTo(-2.6, 7.4, 0, 4.6);
      c.fill();
      c.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.7)";
      c.fillRect(-7.5, -4, 1.8, 22);
      const cg = c.createLinearGradient(-6, 0, 6, 0);
      cg.addColorStop(0, "#1a5fb8");
      cg.addColorStop(0.5, "#3d8cf0");
      cg.addColorStop(1, "#164f9c");
      c.fillStyle = cg;
      rrc(c, -6, -21, 12, 7, 1.6);
      c.fill();
      c.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.25)";
      c.lineWidth = 0.8;
      for (let x = -4; x <= 4; x += 2) {
        c.beginPath();
        c.moveTo(x, -20.4);
        c.lineTo(x, -14.6);
        c.stroke();
      }
      c.fillStyle = "#0e3f80";
      c.fillRect(-5.5, -14.5, 11, 1.3);
      break;
    }
    case "potato": {
      // yumrulu patates (ısırık izleriyle)
      const bites = o.bites || 0,
        B = [
          [11, -5, 6.5],
          [13.5, 3, 6],
          [6, -11, 5.6],
        ];
      c.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.2)";
      c.beginPath();
      c.ellipse(1, 13, 15, 3.4, 0, 0, 7);
      c.fill();
      c.save();
      if (bites > 0) {
        c.beginPath();
        c.rect(-30, -30, 60, 60);
        for (let i = 0; i < bites; i++) {
          const b = B[i];
          c.moveTo(b[0] + b[2], b[1]);
          c.arc(b[0], b[1], b[2], 0, 7, true);
        }
        c.clip("evenodd");
      }
      const pg = c.createRadialGradient(-5, -6, 2, 0, 0, 18);
      pg.addColorStop(0, "#ecc488");
      pg.addColorStop(0.6, "#c48a4a");
      pg.addColorStop(1, "#8a5a2a");
      c.fillStyle = pg;
      c.beginPath();
      c.moveTo(-15, -1);
      c.bezierCurveTo(-16, -9, -8, -13, -1, -12);
      c.bezierCurveTo(6, -14, 15, -10, 15, -2);
      c.bezierCurveTo(16, 6, 10, 12, 1, 11.5);
      c.bezierCurveTo(-7, 12.5, -14, 8, -15, -1);
      c.closePath();
      c.fill();
      c.strokeStyle = "#6e4520";
      c.lineWidth = 1.2;
      c.stroke();
      c.fillStyle = "rgba(110,70,32,.75)";
      for (const [x, y, r] of [
        [-8, -4, 1.3],
        [-2, 4, 1.1],
        [6, -6, 1.2],
        [8, 5, 1],
        [-10, 4, 0.9],
        [1, -8, 0.9],
      ]) {
        c.beginPath();
        c.ellipse(x, y, r * 1.4, r, 0.4, 0, 7);
        c.fill();
      }
      c.fillStyle = "rgba(255,236,200,.45)";
      c.beginPath();
      c.ellipse(-6, -7, 5, 2.2, -0.4, 0, 7);
      c.fill();
      c.fillStyle = "rgba(90,55,25,.35)";
      for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
        c.fillRect(-12 + ((i * 7.3) % 24), -8 + ((i * 5.1) % 16), 0.9, 0.9);
      }
      c.restore();
      for (let i = 0; i < bites; i++) {
        const b = B[i];
        c.strokeStyle = "#f6e6b2";
        c.lineWidth = 2.2;
        c.beginPath();
        c.arc(b[0], b[1], b[2] + 0.6, Math.PI * 0.55, Math.PI * 1.45);
        c.stroke();
      }
      break;
    }
    case "rotten": {
      // çürük patates: kararmış, buruşmuş, küf lekeli
      const t = performance.now() / 1000;
      c.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.22)";
      c.beginPath();
      c.ellipse(1, 13, 14, 3, 0, 0, 7);
      c.fill();
      const pg = c.createRadialGradient(-4, -5, 2, 0, 0, 18);
      pg.addColorStop(0, "#8a7350");
      pg.addColorStop(0.55, "#5c4630");
      pg.addColorStop(1, "#2e2216");
      c.fillStyle = pg;
      c.beginPath();
      c.moveTo(-14, 0);
      c.bezierCurveTo(-15, -8, -8, -11, -2, -10);
      c.bezierCurveTo(4, -13, 13, -9, 14, -2);
      c.bezierCurveTo(15, 5, 9, 11, 1, 10.5);
      c.bezierCurveTo(-6, 11.5, -13, 7, -14, 0);
      c.closePath();
      c.fill();
      c.strokeStyle = "#1f160c";
      c.lineWidth = 1.2;
      c.stroke();
      c.strokeStyle = "rgba(20,12,6,.6)";
      c.lineWidth = 0.9;
      c.beginPath();
      c.moveTo(-9, -3);
      c.quadraticCurveTo(-4, -1, -6, 4);
      c.moveTo(3, -7);
      c.quadraticCurveTo(7, -3, 5, 2);
      c.stroke();
      c.fillStyle = "#1a120a";
      for (const [x, y, r] of [
        [-6, -4, 3.4],
        [5, 3, 4],
        [8, -5, 2.4],
        [-3, 5, 2],
      ]) {
        c.beginPath();
        c.ellipse(x, y, r, r * 0.75, 0.3, 0, 7);
        c.fill();
      }
      c.fillStyle = "#9fb86a";
      for (const [x, y, r] of [
        [-7, -5, 1.3],
        [6, 2, 1.6],
        [4, 4, 1],
        [-2, 6, 1],
        [9, -5, 0.9],
      ]) {
        c.beginPath();
        c.arc(x, y, r, 0, 7);
        c.fill();
      }
      c.fillStyle = "#d8e6b8";
      for (const [x, y] of [
        [6.4, 1.6],
        [-7.3, -5.3],
      ]) {
        c.beginPath();
        c.arc(x, y, 0.6, 0, 7);
        c.fill();
      }
      if (o.sparkle !== false) {
        c.strokeStyle = "rgba(170,190,110,.55)";
        c.lineWidth = 1.2;
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
          const ph = (t * 0.6 + i / 3) % 1,
            x = -6 + i * 6;
          c.globalAlpha = 1 - ph;
          c.beginPath();
          c.moveTo(x, -12 - ph * 10);
          c.quadraticCurveTo(x + 3, -15 - ph * 10, x, -18 - ph * 10);
          c.stroke();
        }
        c.globalAlpha = 1;
      }
      break;
    }
    case "radmeter": {
      // DZ-7: grafit gövde, turuncu tampon, yuvarlak renkli ekran, üstte sensör çubuğu
      const t = performance.now() / 1000,
        act = !!o.active;
      c.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.22)";
      c.beginPath();
      c.ellipse(0, 19, 14, 3, 0, 0, 7);
      c.fill();
      c.strokeStyle = "#9aa5c0";
      c.lineWidth = 2;
      c.beginPath();
      c.moveTo(-6, -15);
      c.lineTo(-9, -24);
      c.stroke(); // sensör çubuğu
      c.fillStyle = "#2a303f";
      c.beginPath();
      c.ellipse(-9.5, -25.5, 4.2, 2.4, -0.3, 0, 7);
      c.fill();
      c.fillStyle = act ? "#7fe7ff" : "#3fb3c9";
      c.beginPath();
      c.ellipse(-9.5, -25.8, 2.6, 1.3, -0.3, 0, 7);
      c.fill();
      c.fillStyle = "#ff8c42";
      rrc(c, -13, -17, 26, 35, 7);
      c.fill(); // turuncu tampon
      const bg = c.createLinearGradient(-11, -15, 11, 16);
      bg.addColorStop(0, "#3a4256");
      bg.addColorStop(1, "#161a24");
      c.fillStyle = bg;
      rrc(c, -11, -15, 22, 31, 5.5);
      c.fill();
      c.fillStyle = "#0a1020";
      c.beginPath();
      c.arc(0, -4, 8, 0, 7);
      c.fill(); // yuvarlak ekran
      const u = act ? 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * 3) : 0.35,
        col = u < 0.33 ? "#4ade80" : u < 0.66 ? "#fbbf24" : "#ff5d5d";
      c.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.12)";
      c.lineWidth = 2.2;
      c.beginPath();
      c.arc(0, -4, 5.6, Math.PI * 0.75, Math.PI * 2.25);
      c.stroke();
      c.strokeStyle = col;
      c.beginPath();
      c.arc(0, -4, 5.6, Math.PI * 0.75, Math.PI * 0.75 + Math.PI * 1.5 * Math.max(0.08, u));
      c.stroke();
      c.fillStyle = col;
      c.fillRect(-2.2, -4.8, 4.4, 1.8);
      c.fillStyle = "#ff8c42";
      for (const bx of [-5, 0, 5]) {
        c.beginPath();
        c.arc(bx, 9, 1.7, 0, 7);
        c.fill();
      } // tuşlar
      c.fillStyle = "#9aa5c0";
      for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) c.fillRect(-6 + k * 4, 13, 2.4, 1.2); // hoparlör ızgarası
      c.fillStyle = act && Math.sin(t * 22) > 0.4 ? "#ff5d5d" : "#5a2020";
      c.beginPath();
      c.arc(8, -12.5, 1.3, 0, 7);
      c.fill();
      c.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.18)";
      c.beginPath();
      c.ellipse(-3, -8, 3.5, 1.6, -0.6, 0, 7);
      c.fill();
      break;
    }
    case "seed": {
      // tohum paketi
      c.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.2)";
      c.beginPath();
      c.ellipse(1, 21, 12, 2.6, 0, 0, 7);
      c.fill();
      const pg = c.createLinearGradient(-11, 0, 11, 0);
      pg.addColorStop(0, "#efe2c4");
      pg.addColorStop(1, "#d8c69c");
      c.fillStyle = pg;
      c.beginPath();
      c.moveTo(-11, -14);
      for (let i = 0; i <= 11; i++) c.lineTo(-11 + i * 2, -14 - (i % 2 ? 2 : 0));
      c.lineTo(11, 19);
      c.quadraticCurveTo(11, 21, 9, 21);
      c.lineTo(-9, 21);
      c.quadraticCurveTo(-11, 21, -11, 19);
      c.closePath();
      c.fill();
      c.strokeStyle = "#9c8758";
      c.lineWidth = 1;
      c.stroke();
      c.fillStyle = "#3f8f4f";
      rrc(c, -9, -9, 18, 17, 2);
      c.fill();
      const sg = c.createLinearGradient(0, -9, 0, 8);
      sg.addColorStop(0, "#bfe8ff");
      sg.addColorStop(1, "#e8d4a8");
      c.fillStyle = sg;
      rrc(c, -8, -8, 16, 15, 1.6);
      c.fill();
      c.fillStyle = "#7a4f2a";
      c.fillRect(-8, 3, 16, 4);
      c.strokeStyle = "#2f7d4f";
      c.lineWidth = 1.4;
      c.beginPath();
      c.moveTo(0, 3);
      c.quadraticCurveTo(1, -1, 0, -4);
      c.stroke();
      c.fillStyle = "#3fa866";
      for (const [x, y, r] of [
        [-3.4, -2, -0.6],
        [3.4, -3, 0.6],
        [-1.5, -5.6, -0.3],
        [2, -6.4, 0.4],
      ]) {
        c.beginPath();
        c.ellipse(x, y, 2.8, 1.5, r, 0, 7);
        c.fill();
      }
      c.fillStyle = "#e2a85e";
      c.beginPath();
      c.ellipse(-3, 4.6, 2.2, 1.4, 0, 0, 7);
      c.fill();
      c.beginPath();
      c.ellipse(3, 5, 2, 1.3, 0, 0, 7);
      c.fill();
      c.fillStyle = "#2f5d3a";
      c.fillRect(-9, 10, 18, 4);
      c.fillStyle = "#fff";
      c.fillRect(-6.5, 11.3, 8, 1.2);
      c.fillRect(3, 11.3, 3, 1.2);
      c.fillStyle = "#8a6a3c";
      for (const [x, y] of [
        [-6, 17],
        [-2, 18],
        [2.5, 16.8],
        [6, 18],
      ]) {
        c.beginPath();
        c.ellipse(x, y, 1.2, 0.8, 0.5, 0, 7);
        c.fill();
      }
      break;
    }
    case "medkit": {
      // ilk yardım çantası
      c.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.22)";
      c.beginPath();
      c.ellipse(0, 17, 17, 3, 0, 0, 7);
      c.fill();
      c.strokeStyle = "#8a93ad";
      c.lineWidth = 2.6;
      c.beginPath();
      c.moveTo(-6, -10);
      c.lineTo(-6, -14);
      c.quadraticCurveTo(-6, -16, -4, -16);
      c.lineTo(4, -16);
      c.quadraticCurveTo(6, -16, 6, -14);
      c.lineTo(6, -10);
      c.stroke();
      const bg = c.createLinearGradient(0, -10, 0, 16);
      bg.addColorStop(0, "#ffffff");
      bg.addColorStop(1, "#cfd6e6");
      c.fillStyle = bg;
      rrc(c, -16, -10, 32, 26, 4);
      c.fill();
      c.strokeStyle = "#8a93ad";
      c.lineWidth = 1.2;
      c.stroke();
      c.fillStyle = "#e2e7f2";
      c.fillRect(-16, -2, 32, 1.6);
      c.fillStyle = "#ef4444";
      rrc(c, -3.5, -7, 7, 18, 1);
      c.fill();
      rrc(c, -9, -1.5, 18, 7, 1);
      c.fill();
      c.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.35)";
      c.fillRect(-3.5, -7, 7, 2);
      c.fillStyle = "#8a93ad";
      c.fillRect(-14, -3, 3, 4);
      c.fillRect(11, -3, 3, 4);
      c.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.7)";
      c.fillRect(-14, -8, 6, 1.6);
      break;
    }
    case "kit": {
      // çapa ikonu
      c.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.22)";
      c.beginPath();
      c.ellipse(0, 19, 16, 3, 0, 0, 7);
      c.fill();
      c.save();
      c.rotate(0.62);
      const wg = c.createLinearGradient(-2.6, 0, 2.6, 0);
      wg.addColorStop(0, "#8a5a2b");
      wg.addColorStop(0.5, "#d39a58");
      wg.addColorStop(1, "#6e4320");
      c.fillStyle = wg;
      rrc(c, -2.6, -20, 5.2, 40, 2.4);
      c.fill();
      c.strokeStyle = "#5a3416";
      c.lineWidth = 1;
