function rrc(c, x, y, w, h, r) {
  c.beginPath();
  if (c.roundRect) c.roundRect(x, y, w, h, r);
  else c.rect(x, y, w, h);
}
const _iconCache = {};
function itemIconURL(key) {
  if (_iconCache[key]) return _iconCache[key];
  const cv = document.createElement("canvas");
  cv.width = cv.height = 192;
  const c = cv.getContext("2d");
  c.translate(96, 96);
  // zemin gölgesi: nesne masada duruyormuş gibi
  const sh = c.createRadialGradient(0, 70, 2, 0, 70, 62);
  sh.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,.45)");
  sh.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
  c.fillStyle = sh;
  c.save();
  c.scale(1, 0.28);
  c.beginPath();
  c.arc(0, 250, 62, 0, 7);
  c.fill();
  c.restore();
  drawItemArt(c, key, 160, { sparkle: false });
  // hacim: sol üstten ışık, sağ alttan gölge (yalnızca nesnenin üstüne)
  c.globalCompositeOperation = "source-atop";
  const lg = c.createLinearGradient(-70, -80, 70, 80);
  lg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,.22)");
  lg.addColorStop(0.45, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
  lg.addColorStop(0.7, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
  lg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,.28)");
  c.fillStyle = lg;
  c.fillRect(-96, -96, 192, 192);
  c.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
  return (_iconCache[key] = cv.toDataURL());
}
const ITEM_NAMES = {
  pick: T("Jeolog kazması"),
  rotten: T("Çürük patates"),
  radmeter: T("DZ-7 radyasyon ölçer"),
  water: T("Su şişesi"),
  potato: T("Patates"),
  seed: T("Patates tohumu"),
  medkit: T("Medikit"),
  kit: T("Çapa"),
  stone: T("Metal numune"),
  star: T("Yıldız kristali"),
  ceramic: T("Seramik kalkan"),
  tuber: T("Tohumluk patates"),
};

/* --- eylem animasyonları: içme / yeme / medikit --- */
function startAct(kind, dur) {
  p.action = kind;
  p.actionT = dur;
  p.actionDur = dur;
  if (kind === "drink") {
    // yudum sesleri
    [380, 820, 1240].forEach((ms) =>
      setTimeout(() => {
        tone(210, 0.09, "sine", 0.2, 120);
        tone(150, 0.07, "sine", 0.12, 90, 0.05);
      }, ms),
    );
  } else if (kind === "eat") {
    // ısırık + çiğneme
    [420, 900, 1380].forEach((ms) =>
      setTimeout(() => {
        noiseBurst(0.07, 0.16, 1800);
        tone(240, 0.06, "square", 0.08, 180, 0.02);
      }, ms),
    );
  }
}
/* el: tutulan eşyayı çiz; içerken şişe vizöre eğilir ve boşalır, yerken ısırık alınır */
const _rareHeld = {};
function drawHeldArt(key, acting, prog) {
  const t = performance.now() / 1000;
  if (isRareSlot(key)) {
    const u = rareIconURL(key.slice(2));
    let im = _rareHeld[u];
    if (!im) {
      im = _rareHeld[u] = new Image();
      im.src = u;
    }
    if (im.complete && im.naturalWidth) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.rotate(Math.sin(t * 2) * 0.05);
      ctx.drawImage(im, -15, -24, 30, 30);
      ctx.restore();
    }
    return;
  }
  const hold = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (prog - 0.2) / 0.65));
  if (key === "pickaxe") {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.scale(0.55, 0.55);
    drawHoe(0, 10, 0.4);
    ctx.restore();
    return;
  }
  const k = key === "pickaxe" ? "kit" : key;
  if (acting && p.action === "drink" && k === "water") {
    const tilt =
      -1.25 * Math.min(1, prog / 0.25) * (prog > 0.85 ? (1 - prog) / 0.15 : 1) +
      Math.sin(t * 9) * 0.04 * hold;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.rotate(tilt);
    drawItemArt(ctx, "water", 28, { fill: 1 - hold * 0.95, tilt, bubbles: hold > 0 && hold < 1 });
    ctx.restore();
    return;
  }
  if (acting && p.action === "eat" && k === "potato") {
    const bites = Math.min(3, Math.floor(hold * 3.4));
    ctx.save();
    ctx.rotate(-0.35 * Math.min(1, prog / 0.2));
    drawItemArt(ctx, "potato", 24, { bites });
    ctx.restore();
    // kırıntılar
    if (hold > 0 && hold < 1) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#e8c88a";
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const ph = (t * 1.8 + i * 0.2) % 1;
        ctx.fillRect(-4 + i * 2.2 + ph * 3, 4 + ph * 22, 1.6, 1.6);
      }
    }
    return;
  }
  drawItemArt(ctx, k, k === "kit" ? 22 : k === "radmeter" ? 24 : 21, { active: k === "radmeter" && !!radM });
}

/* ============== OKSİJEN ==============
   Dışarıda giysi oksijeni azalır; roket içinde azalmaz ama yalnızca
   makine dairesindeki O₂ tüpünden doldurulur. Tüp jeneratörle yavaşça dolar. */
const O2 = { drain: 100 / 220, runMul: 1.35, tankMax: 400, tankRegen: 1.2, fillRate: 42, hpDrain: 5 }; // tüp jeneratörü en kötü koşulda bile tüketimi karşılar → O₂ görev boyunca yeter
function o2Max() {
  return (game && game.design && game.design.fx && game.design.fx.tankMax) || O2.tankMax;
}
let o2Fill = null;
function updateO2(simDt, dt, running) {
  if (game.o2 == null) game.o2 = 100;
  if (game.o2Tank == null) game.o2Tank = o2Max();
  if (!insideRocket && scene !== "earth") {
    const prev = game.o2;
    game.o2 = Math.max(
      0,
      game.o2 -
        O2.drain *
          suitSt().o2 *
          dif().o2 *
          (running ? O2.runMul : 1) *
          (1 + stormFx.I * 0.25 * suitSt().storm) *
          simDt,
    );
    if (prev > 30 && game.o2 <= 30) {
      sfx("warn");
      toast(T("🫁 Oksijen %30 — rokete dönüp tüpten doldur"));
    }
    if (prev > 10 && game.o2 <= 10) {
      sfx("warn");
      toast(T("⚠️ Oksijen kritik! Hemen rokete dön"));
    }
    if (game.o2 <= 0) {
      game.hp = Math.max(0, game.hp - O2.hpDrain * simDt);
    }
  }
  if (scene === "earth") game.o2 = Math.min(100, game.o2 + 20 * simDt);
  if (o2Fill) {
    o2Fill.t += dt;
    const amt = Math.min(O2.fillRate * dt, 100 - game.o2, game.o2Tank);
    game.o2 += amt;
    game.o2Tank -= amt;
    if (Math.random() < dt * 10 && o2Fill.t > 0.3) o2Fill.puffs++;
    if (
      game.o2 >= 99.9 ||
      game.o2Tank <= 0 ||
      !insideRocket ||
      ip.deck !== 0 ||
      (nearStation() || {}).key !== "o2"
    )
      stopO2Fill(game.o2 >= 99.9);
  } else {
    const fx = desFx();
    game.o2Tank = Math.min(
      o2Max(),
      game.o2Tank +
        O2.tankRegen *
          fx.regen *
          (fx.solar && stormFx.phase === "active" ? Math.max(0.6, fx.stormRegen) : 1) *
          simDt,
    );
  }
  hissAudio(o2Fill ? 0.5 : 0);
}
function startO2Fill() {
  if (game.o2 >= 99.5) {
    sfx("full");
    toast(T("🫁 Giysi oksijeni zaten dolu"));
    return;
  }
  if (game.o2Tank < 2) {
    sfx("error");
    toast(T("O₂ tüpü boş — jeneratör dolduruyor, biraz bekle"));
    return;
  }
  o2Fill = { t: 0, from: game.o2, puffs: 0 };
  p.dir = 1;
  ip.dir = 1;
  ip.x = 18; // sırt çantası tüplere dönük
  sfx("click");
  tone(900, 0.12, "sine", 0.12, 500);
}
function stopO2Fill(full) {
  if (!o2Fill) return;
  o2Fill = null;
  hissAudio(0);
  if (full) {
    sfx("heal");
    toast(T("🫁 Oksijen dolu · tüp %") + Math.round((game.o2Tank / o2Max()) * 100));
  } else if (game.o2Tank <= 0) {
    sfx("error");
    toast(T("O₂ tüpü boşaldı — jeneratör dolduruyor"));
  }
}
/* tıslama sesi */
const HS = { src: null, g: null };
function hissAudio(level) {
  if (!AU.ac || !AU.ready) return;
  try {
    if (!HS.src) {
      const ac = AU.ac,
        len = ac.sampleRate,
        buf = ac.createBuffer(1, len, ac.sampleRate),
        d = buf.getChannelData(0);
      for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) d[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
      HS.src = ac.createBufferSource();
      HS.src.buffer = buf;
      HS.src.loop = true;
      const f = ac.createBiquadFilter();
      f.type = "highpass";
      f.frequency.value = 2600;
      HS.g = ac.createGain();
      HS.g.gain.value = 0;
      HS.src.connect(f);
      f.connect(HS.g);
      HS.g.connect(AU.sfxG);
      HS.src.start();
    }
    HS.g.gain.setTargetAtTime(level * 0.22, AU.ac.currentTime, 0.08);
  } catch (e) {}
}
/* roket içi: O₂ tüpleri + dolum efekti */
function drawO2Tanks(F, C, t) {
  const lvl = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, game.o2Tank / o2Max()));
  for (const [tx, lab] of [
    [-36, "A"],
    [4, "B"],
  ]) {
    const tg = ctx.createLinearGradient(tx - 18, 0, tx + 18, 0);
    tg.addColorStop(0, "#7a9cc0");
    tg.addColorStop(0.4, "#eef7ff");
    tg.addColorStop(1, "#4a6a90");
    ctx.fillStyle = tg;
    rrp(tx - 18, C + 56, 36, F - C - 62, 13);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#20243a";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#1d6f9c";
    ctx.fillRect(tx - 18, C + 72, 36, 6);
    ctx.fillRect(tx - 18, F - 28, 36, 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = "900 9px 'Segoe UI',sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("O₂", tx, C + 77.5);
    const gx = tx - 6,
      gy = C + 84,
      gh = F - C - 118;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#0a1024";
    rrp(gx, gy, 12, gh, 3);
    ctx.fill();
    const lg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, gy + gh - gh * lvl, 0, gy + gh);
    lg.addColorStop(0, "#bff3ff");
    lg.addColorStop(1, "#2aa0d8");
    ctx.fillStyle = lg;
    if (lvl > 0.01) {
      rrp(gx + 1, gy + gh - gh * lvl + 1, 10, Math.max(0, gh * lvl - 2), 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const bph = (t * 0.6 + i * 0.33 + (lab === "A" ? 0.2 : 0)) % 1;
      if (bph < lvl) {
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.6)";
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(gx + 4 + i * 2.5, gy + gh - bph * gh, 1.2, 0, 7);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#5ad1ff";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    rrp(gx, gy, 12, gh, 3);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  // ortak manifold + vana
  ctx.fillStyle = "#5b6178";
  rrp(-40, C + 46, 48, 8, 3);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#20243a";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.stroke();
  const vx = -16,
    vy = C + 44;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(vx, vy);
  ctx.rotate(o2Fill ? t * 8 : 0);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#ef4444";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.4;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, 6, 0, 7);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-6, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(6, 0);
  ctx.moveTo(0, -6);
  ctx.lineTo(0, 6);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
  // durum ekranı
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0a1024";
  rrp(-34, F - 22, 36, 13, 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#5ad1ff";
  ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = lvl < 0.15 ? "#ff7b7b" : "#7fe0ff";
  ctx.font = "700 7px monospace";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillText("O₂ " + Math.round(lvl * 100) + "%", -16, F - 13);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#d9dcea";
  ctx.font = "700 7px monospace";
  ctx.fillText(T("OKSİJEN"), -16, C + 40 - 6);
}
function drawO2FillFx(F, C, t, px, py) {
  if (!o2Fill) return;
  const vx = -16,
    vy = C + 44,
    bx = px - 21 * ip.dir,
    by = py + 2;
  // hortum (sarkık bezier) + akış ışıkları
  const c1x = vx,
    c1y = vy + 70,
    c2x = bx - 30 * ip.dir,
    c2y = by + 40;
  const bez = (u) => {
    const a = 1 - u;
    return {
      x: a * a * a * vx + 3 * a * a * u * c1x + 3 * a * u * u * c2x + u * u * u * bx,
      y: a * a * a * vy + 3 * a * a * u * c1y + 3 * a * u * u * c2y + u * u * u * by,
    };
  };
  const k = Math.min(1, o2Fill.t / 0.35); // hortum takılma animasyonu
  ctx.lineCap = "round";
  const path = () => {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(vx, vy);
    for (let i = 1; i <= 24; i++) {
      const q = bez((i / 24) * k);
      ctx.lineTo(q.x, q.y);
    }
  };
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#1b2140";
  ctx.lineWidth = 6;
  path();
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#3a7fb0";
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  path();
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.35)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
  path();
  ctx.stroke();
  if (k >= 1) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      const u = (t * 1.4 + i / 7) % 1,
        q = bez(u);
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(q.x, q.y, 0, q.x, q.y, 5);
      g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(200,250,255,.95)");
      g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(90,209,255,0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(q.x, q.y, 5, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    // bağlantı uçları
    ctx.fillStyle = "#c9d2e0";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(bx, by, 3, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    // soğuk gaz buharı
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      const ph = (t * 1.1 + i * 0.1) % 1,
        src = i % 2 ? { x: vx, y: vy } : { x: bx, y: by };
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(225,245,255," + 0.38 * (1 - ph) + ")";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(src.x + Math.sin(i * 2.1 + t) * 6 * ph + ((i % 3) - 1) * 4, src.y - ph * 26, 3 + ph * 9, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    // giysi parıltısı
    const pul = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * 6);
    const ag = ctx.createRadialGradient(px, py - 10, 8, px, py - 10, 62);
    ag.addColorStop(0, "rgba(120,230,255," + (0.18 + 0.1 * pul) + ")");
    ag.addColorStop(1, "rgba(90,209,255,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = ag;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(px, py - 10, 62, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      const a = t * 2 + i * 0.785,
        r = 30 + 8 * Math.sin(t * 3 + i);
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(190,245,255," + (0.5 + 0.4 * Math.sin(t * 5 + i)) + ")";
      ctx.fillRect(px + Math.cos(a) * r, py - 10 + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.9, 2, 2);
    }
  }
  // baş üstünde dolum halkası
  const hx = px,
    hy = py - 96,
    v = game.o2 / 100;
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(10,16,36,.85)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(hx, hy, 15, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(90,209,255,.25)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 3.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(hx, hy, 12, 0, 7);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#7fe0ff";
  ctx.shadowColor = "#5ad1ff";
  ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(hx, hy, 12, -Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2 + v * Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#e8fbff";
  ctx.font = "800 7.5px ui-monospace,monospace";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillText(Math.round(game.o2) + "%", hx, hy + 2.5);
}

/* ============== KAPSÜLLER (Kit + Yemek) ==============
   Açılabilir basınçlı saklama bölmeleri: kapak açılır, içerik ve adetler görünür. */
const CAPSULES = {
  kit: {
    title: T("Alet Sandığı"),
    ic: "kit",
    sub: "Makine dairesi · saha aletleri ve tohum",
    items: [
      ["kit", T("Toprağı kazar ve parsel açar"), 1],
      ["pick", T("Yalnızca bilinmeyen (?) taşları kırar"), 1],
      ["radmeter", T("Toprağın radyasyonunu ölçer · ekimden önce kullan"), 1],
      ["seed", T("Dışarıdaki parsele ekilir"), 12],
      ["ceramic", T("Parsele kurulur · Q ile açılıp kapanır · kapalıyken radyasyondan korur"), 6],
    ],
  },
  med: {
    title: T("Revir"),
    ic: "medkit",
    sub: T("Yaşam güvertesi · tıbbi dolap ve sedye"),
    items: [["medkit", T("Canı +") + 40 + T(" yeniler · yanında taşıyıp G ile kullan"), 8]],
  },
  kitchen: {
    title: T("Mutfak"),
    ic: "water",
    sub: T("Yaşam güvertesi · dolaplar, su sebili ve buzdolabı"),
    items: [
      ["water", T("Şişe su · su sebilinden geri dönüştürülür"), 12],
      ["potato", T("Haşlanmış patates · açlığı giderir"), 16],
    ],
  },
  food: {
    title: T("Yemek Kapsülü"),
    ic: "potato",
    sub: T("Yaşam güvertesi · soğuk saklama + su geri dönüştürücü"),
    items: [
      ["water", T("Susuzluğu giderir · geri dönüştürülür"), 12],
      ["potato", T("Açlığı giderir · tarladan yetişir"), 16],
    ],
  },
};
let capOpen = null;
const capAnim = { kit: 0, food: 0 };
function capCount(key) {
  if (key === "kit") return game.kitCarried ? 0 : 1;
  if (key === "radmeter") return game.inventory.radmeter > 0 ? 0 : 1;
  if (key === "pick") return (game.inventory.pick || 0) > 0 ? 0 : 1;
  return game.stock[key] || 0;
}
function bagCount(key) {
  if (key === "kit") return game.kitCarried ? 1 : 0;
  return game.inventory[key] || 0;
}
function openCapsule(kind) {
  capOpen = kind;
  sfx("click");
  noiseBurst(0.45, 0.14, 3200);
  tone(140, 0.3, "sine", 0.12, 90);
  $("capScreen").classList.remove("hidden");
  renderCapsule(true);
}
function closeCapsule() {
  capOpen = null;
  $("capScreen").classList.add("hidden");
  focusGame();
}
function renderCapsule(first) {
  const C = CAPSULES[capOpen];
  if (!C) return;
  $("capTitle").textContent = C.title;
  $("capSub").textContent = C.sub;
  $("capPutTo").textContent = capOpen === "kit" ? T("sandığa") : T("kapsüle");
  $("capIc").innerHTML = '<img src="' + itemIconURL(C.ic) + '" alt="">';
  const items = C.items;
  let tot = 0,
    cap = 0;
  items.forEach(([k, , m]) => {
    tot += capCount(k);
    cap += m;
  });
  $("capChip").textContent = tot + " / " + cap;
  const g = $("capGrid");
  g.innerHTML = "";
  items.forEach(([k, desc, max], i) => {
    const n = capCount(k),
      b = bagCount(k);
    const el = document.createElement("div");
    el.className = "cap-cell" + (n <= 0 ? " empty" : "") + (first ? " pop" : "");
    el.style.animationDelay = i * 70 + "ms";
    el.innerHTML = Tf(
      `<div class="cap-art"><img src="{0}" alt=""><span class="cap-n">×{1}</span></div>
      <div class="cap-nm">{2}</div><div class="cap-ds">{3}</div>
      <div class="cap-bar"><i style="width:{4}%"></i></div>
      <div class="cap-meta"><span>{5} {6}/{7}</span><span>ÇANTA {8}</span></div>`,
      [
        itemIconURL(k),
        n,
        ITEM_NAMES[k],
        desc,
        Math.min(100, (n / max) * 100),
        capOpen === "kit" ? T("SANDIK") : T("KAPSÜL"),
        n,
        max,
        b,
      ],
    );
    const act = document.createElement("div");
    act.className = "cap-act";
    const take = document.createElement("button");
    take.className = "cbtn pri";
    take.textContent = T("Al");
    take.disabled = n <= 0;
    take.onclick = () => {
      if (capCount(k) <= 0) return;
      if (k === "kit") {
        game.kitCarried = true;
        bumpQuest("kit");
      } else if (k === "radmeter") {
        game.inventory.radmeter = 1;
      } else if (k === "pick") {
        game.inventory.pick = 1;
      } else {
        game.stock[k]--;
        game.inventory[k] = (game.inventory[k] || 0) + 1;
      }
      sfx("pickup");
      updateInv();
      renderCapsule();
    };
    const put = document.createElement("button");
    put.className = "cbtn";
    put.textContent = T("Koy");
    put.disabled = b <= 0 || n >= max;
    put.onclick = () => {
      if (bagCount(k) <= 0 || capCount(k) >= max) return;
      if (k === "kit") game.kitCarried = false;
      else if (k === "radmeter") game.inventory.radmeter = 0;
      else if (k === "pick") game.inventory.pick = 0;
      else {
        game.inventory[k]--;
        game.stock[k] = (game.stock[k] || 0) + 1;
      }
      sfx("click");
      updateInv();
      renderCapsule();
    };
    act.append(take, put);
    if (k === "medkit") {
      const use = document.createElement("button");
      use.className = "cbtn";
      use.textContent = T("Kullan");
      use.disabled = n <= 0 || game.hp >= 100;
      use.onclick = () => {
        if (game.stock.medkit <= 0) return;
        if (game.hp >= 100) {
          sfx("full");
          return;
        }
        game.stock.medkit--;
        game.hp = Math.min(100, game.hp + CFG.healAmount);
        startAct("use", 1.2);
        sfx("heal");
        updateStats();
        updateInv();
        closeCapsule();
        toast(T("❤️ Revirde tedavi oldun · +") + CFG.healAmount + T(" can"));
      };
      act.appendChild(use);
    }
    if (k === "water" || k === "potato") {
      const use = document.createElement("button");
      use.className = "cbtn";
      use.textContent = k === "water" ? T("İç") : T("Ye");
      use.disabled = n <= 0;
      use.onclick = () => {
        if (game.stock[k] <= 0) return;
        if (k === "water") {
          if (game.thirst >= 99) {
            sfx("full");
            return;
          }
          game.stock.water--;
          game.thirst = Math.min(100, game.thirst + CFG.drinkThirst);
          startAct("drink", 1.8);
          sfx("drink");
          bumpQuest("drunk");
        } else {
          if (game.hunger >= 99) {
            sfx("full");
            return;
          }
          game.stock.potato--;
          game.hunger = Math.min(100, game.hunger + CFG.eatHunger);
          startAct("eat", 2.0);
          sfx("eat");
        }
        updateStats();
        closeCapsule();
      };
      act.appendChild(use);
    }
    el.appendChild(act);
    g.appendChild(el);
  });
  if (capOpen === "med") {
    $("capFootR").textContent = T("CAN %") + Math.round(game.hp);
    return;
  }
  $("capFootR").textContent =
    capOpen === "food" || capOpen === "kitchen"
      ? T("💧 +1 su / ") + Math.round((recycleInt() / 60) * 10) / 10 + T(" dk")
      : T("KİLİT: AÇIK");
}
/* roket içi kapsül çizimi (lx: merkez, F: zemin) */
function drawCapsule(kind, lx, F, C, t) {
  const a = (capAnim[kind] = capAnim[kind] + ((capOpen === kind ? 1 : 0) - capAnim[kind]) * 0.14);
  const W2 = 22,
    top = C + 40,
    h = F - top;
  // taban
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2a2f47";
  rrp(lx - W2 - 3, F - 8, (W2 + 3) * 2, 8, 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // gövde
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(lx - W2, 0, lx + W2, 0);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#6f7698");
  g.addColorStop(0.35, "#e3e8f4");
  g.addColorStop(1, "#4e5578");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  rrp(lx - W2, top + 8, W2 * 2, h - 14, 10);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#20243a";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = kind === "food" ? "#16a34a" : "#ff8c42";
  ctx.fillRect(lx - W2, top + 20, W2 * 2, 4);
  ctx.fillRect(lx - W2, F - 22, W2 * 2, 3);
  // iç bölme (kapak açılınca görünür)
  const wy = top + 30,
    wh = h - 58;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0e1430";
  rrp(lx - W2 + 5, wy, W2 * 2 - 10, wh, 6);
  ctx.fill();
  const lightA = 0.15 + 0.75 * a;
  const ig = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, wy, 0, wy + wh);
  ig.addColorStop(0, "rgba(190,240,255," + lightA * 0.55 + ")");
  ig.addColorStop(1, "rgba(90,209,255," + lightA * 0.08 + ")");
  ctx.fillStyle = ig;
  rrp(lx - W2 + 5, wy, W2 * 2 - 10, wh, 6);
  ctx.fill();
  // içerik silüetleri: rafta küçük eşyalar
  const C2 = CAPSULES[kind].items;
  ctx.save();
  rrp(lx - W2 + 5, wy, W2 * 2 - 10, wh, 6);
  ctx.clip();
  C2.forEach(([k], i) => {
    const n = capCount(k),
      row = wy + 10 + (i * (wh - 14)) / C2.length;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.12)";
    ctx.fillRect(lx - W2 + 6, row + 12, W2 * 2 - 12, 1.4);
    for (let j = 0; j < Math.min(3, n); j++) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(lx - 10 + j * 10, row + 4);
      drawItemArt(ctx, k, 12, { sparkle: false });
      ctx.restore();
    }
  });
  ctx.restore();
  // kayar kapak (yukarı açılır)
  ctx.save();
  rrp(lx - W2 + 4, wy - 2, W2 * 2 - 8, wh + 4, 6);
  ctx.clip();
  const lid = wh * a;
  const lg = ctx.createLinearGradient(lx - W2, 0, lx + W2, 0);
  lg.addColorStop(0, "#8b93b3");
  lg.addColorStop(0.5, "#d5dbea");
  lg.addColorStop(1, "#6f7698");
  ctx.fillStyle = lg;
  ctx.fillRect(lx - W2 + 4, wy - 2 - lid, W2 * 2 - 8, wh + 4);
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(19,51,92,.85)";
  rrp(lx - 8, wy + wh / 2 - 10 - lid, 16, 20, 8);
  ctx.fill(); // kapak penceresi
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.35)";
  ctx.fillRect(lx - 5, wy + wh / 2 - 7 - lid, 2, 12);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(40,46,70,.6)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let y = wy + 6; y < wy + wh; y += 8) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(lx - W2 + 6, y - lid);
    ctx.lineTo(lx + W2 - 6, y - lid);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();
  // açılırken buhar
  if (a > 0.05 && a < 0.95) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const ph = (t * 1.5 + i / 6) % 1;
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(230,245,255," + 0.35 * (1 - ph) + ")";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(lx - 14 + i * 5.5, wy - ph * 20, 2 + ph * 6, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  // tepe kubbe + sayaç ekranı
  ctx.fillStyle = "#5b6178";
  rrp(lx - W2 + 2, top, W2 * 2 - 4, 12, 6);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#20243a";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.stroke();
  let tot = 0;
  C2.forEach(([k]) => (tot += capCount(k)));
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0a1024";
  rrp(lx - 13, F - 38, 26, 11, 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = tot > 0 ? "#7fe0ff" : "#ff7b7b";
  ctx.font = "700 7px monospace";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillText(tot + T(" ÖĞE"), lx, F - 30);
  led(lx + W2 - 6, top + 6, a > 0.5 ? "#ffd34d" : "#4ade80", true);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#d9dcea";
  ctx.font = "700 6.5px monospace";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillText(kind === "food" ? T("YEMEK KAPSÜLÜ") : T("KİT KAPSÜLÜ"), lx, top - 4);
}

/* makine dairesi: alet sandığı (kapak menteşeden açılır) */
function drawToolChest(lx, F, t) {
  const a = (capAnim.kit = capAnim.kit + ((capOpen === "kit" ? 1 : 0) - capAnim.kit) * 0.14);
  const w = 64,
    h = 34,
    x0 = lx - w / 2,
    y0 = F - h - 4;
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.35)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(lx, F - 1, w * 0.58, 4, 0, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2a2f47";
  ctx.fillRect(x0 + 4, F - 5, 8, 5);
  ctx.fillRect(x0 + w - 12, F - 5, 8, 5); // ayaklar
  // iç ışık (kapak açıkken)
  if (a > 0.02) {
    const ig = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, y0 - 40 * a, 0, y0);
    ig.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,214,120,0)");
    ig.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,214,120," + 0.35 * a + ")");
    ctx.fillStyle = ig;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x0 + 4, y0);
    ctx.lineTo(x0 - 10, y0 - 46 * a);
    ctx.lineTo(x0 + w + 10, y0 - 46 * a);
    ctx.lineTo(x0 + w - 4, y0);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }
  // gövde: ahşap paneller + metal köşebent
  const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, y0, 0, y0 + h);
  bg.addColorStop(0, "#8a5a2b");
  bg.addColorStop(1, "#5c3818");
  ctx.fillStyle = bg;
  rrp(x0, y0, w, h, 3);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#3b2410";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(40,22,8,.55)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let i = 1; i < 3; i++) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x0 + 2, y0 + (i * h) / 3);
    ctx.lineTo(x0 + w - 2, y0 + (i * h) / 3);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = "#9aa3bd";
  for (const cx of [x0, x0 + w - 6])
    for (const cy of [y0, y0 + h - 6]) {
      rrp(cx, cy, 6, 6, 1);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  ctx.fillStyle = "#7a8299";
  ctx.fillRect(x0 + w / 2 - 14, y0, 3, h);
  ctx.fillRect(x0 + w / 2 + 11, y0, 3, h);
  // ön etiket + kilit
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff8c42";
  rrp(lx - 15, y0 + h / 2 - 4, 30, 9, 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#3a1a05";

  ctx.textAlign = "center";

      ctx.restore();
    }
    if ((game.stock.seed || 0) > 0) {

  ctx.lineWidth = 1.3;

$("capX").onclick = closeCapsule;
/* ============== KAZILMIŞ TOPRAK (gerçekçi parsel) ============== */
const plotShapes = new WeakMap(),
  plotBorn = new WeakMap();
function plotShape(pl) {
  let s = plotShapes.get(pl);
  if (s) return s;
  const r = rng((Math.abs(Math.round(pl.x * 7.3 + pl.y * 13.1)) % 2147483646) + 1);
  const N = 22,
    hole = [],
    mound = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    const a = (i / N) * Math.PI * 2;
    hole.push([Math.cos(a) * (40 + r() * 7), Math.sin(a) * (23 + r() * 4)]);
    mound.push([Math.cos(a) * (52 + r() * 10), Math.sin(a) * (31 + r() * 7)]);
  }
  const clods = [],
    pebbles = [],
    specks = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
    const a = r() * 6.28,
      d = 0.75 + r() * 0.45;
    clods.push([Math.cos(a) * 48 * d, Math.sin(a) * 29 * d, 2.5 + r() * 4.5, r() * 3]);
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) pebbles.push([(r() - 0.5) * 70, (r() - 0.5) * 36, 1.2 + r() * 1.8]);
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) specks.push([(r() - 0.5) * 78, (r() - 0.5) * 42, r()]);
  s = { hole, mound, clods, pebbles, specks, seedR: r() };
  plotShapes.set(pl, s);
  return s;
}
function polyPath(pts, cx, cy, k) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  pts.forEach(([x, y], i) => {
    const X = cx + x * k,
      Y = cy + y * k;
    i ? ctx.lineTo(X, Y) : ctx.moveTo(X, Y);
  });
  ctx.closePath();
}
function drawPlot(pl, g) {
  if (pl.fill > 0) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1 - pl.fill;
    drawPlot0(pl, g, 1 - pl.fill * 0.55);
    ctx.restore();
    return;
  }
  drawPlot0(pl, g, 1);
}
function drawPlot0(pl, g, shrink) {
  const x = pl.x,
    y = pl.y,
    S = plotShape(pl),
    t = performance.now() / 1000;
  if (!plotBorn.has(pl)) plotBorn.set(pl, t - 5);
  const age = t - plotBorn.get(pl),
    grow = Math.min(1, age / 0.45),
    k = (0.35 + 0.65 * (1 - Math.pow(1 - grow, 3))) * shrink;
  const wet = g && g.wet > 0 ? Math.min(1, g.wet / 10) : 0;
  // atılan toprak yığını (kenar)
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.22)";
  polyPath(S.mound, x + 3, y + 6, k);
  ctx.fill();
  const mg = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y - 10, 10, x, y, 62 * k);
  mg.addColorStop(0, "#9a5e3c");
  mg.addColorStop(1, "#7a4128");
  ctx.fillStyle = mg;
  polyPath(S.mound, x, y, k);
  ctx.fill();
  for (const [cx, cy, r, rot] of S.clods) {
    // topaklar
    ctx.fillStyle = "#6a3820";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x + cx * k + 1, y + cy * k + 1.5, r, r * 0.7, rot, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#a56a44";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x + cx * k, y + cy * k, r, r * 0.7, rot, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,210,170,.25)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x + cx * k - r * 0.3, y + cy * k - r * 0.25, r * 0.45, r * 0.28, rot, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  // çukur
  const hg = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, y - 26 * k, x, y + 24 * k);
  hg.addColorStop(0, wet ? "#2a160c" : "#3b2214");
  hg.addColorStop(0.5, wet ? "#3a2112" : "#56331d");
  hg.addColorStop(1, wet ? "#4a2c18" : "#6e4428");
  ctx.fillStyle = hg;
  polyPath(S.hole, x, y, k);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.save();
  polyPath(S.hole, x, y, k);
  ctx.clip();
  // iç gölge (derinlik): üst kenar koyu
  const sh = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, y - 26 * k, x, y - 6 * k);
  sh.addColorStop(0, "rgba(10,4,2,.6)");
  sh.addColorStop(1, "rgba(10,4,2,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = sh;
  ctx.fillRect(x - 60, y - 30, 120, 30);
  // sürülmüş sıralar (sırt + gölge)
  for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
    const ry = y + i * 10 * k;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(20,8,3,.5)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x - 40 * k, ry + 2.5);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, ry + 6, x + 40 * k, ry + 2.5);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = wet ? "rgba(120,80,50,.55)" : "rgba(170,110,70,.6)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.4;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x - 40 * k, ry - 1);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, ry + 2.5, x + 40 * k, ry - 1);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (const [sx, sy, v] of S.specks) {
    ctx.fillStyle = v < 0.5 ? "rgba(20,8,3,.45)" : "rgba(200,140,95,.35)";
    ctx.fillRect(x + sx * k, y + sy * k, 1.5, 1.5);
  }
  for (const [px2, py2, r] of S.pebbles) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#8a7d74";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x + px2 * k, y + py2 * k, r, r * 0.75, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.35)";
    ctx.fillRect(x + px2 * k - r * 0.4, y + py2 * k - r * 0.5, r * 0.6, r * 0.4);
  }
  if (wet) {
    // ıslak parlama + küçük su birikintisi
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(140,200,255," + 0.18 * wet + ")";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x - 12, y + 6, 14, 4, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + 0.3 * wet + ")";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x - 16, y + 5, 5, 1.2, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + 0.18 * wet + ")";
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) ctx.fillRect(x - 30 + i * 14, y - 6 + (i % 2) * 10, 3, 1);
  }
  ctx.restore();
  // alt kenar ışığı
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,190,140,.3)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
  ctx.beginPath();
  S.hole.forEach(([hx, hy], i) => {
    if (hy < 4) return;
    const X = x + hx * k,
      Y = y + hy * k;
    ctx.lineTo(X, Y);
  });
  ctx.stroke();
  if (age < 0.6) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(200,130,80," + 0.5 * (1 - age / 0.6) + ")";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, 60 * (1 + age), 30 * (1 + age), 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  if (!g || g.g <= 0) {
    // boş: ekim çukurcukları
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(15,6,2,.55)";
    for (const ox of [-20, 0, 20]) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(x + ox * k, y + 1, 3.2, 1.8, 0, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    if (g && g.cov) drawCeramicDome(x, y, k, t, g);
    return;
  }
  const burnt = !domeSafe(g) && game.radiationActive && scene !== "earth";
  drawPotatoPlant(
    x,
    y,
    plotStage(g.g),
    t,
    g.g >= CFG.farmGrow,
    (g.g >= CFG.farmGrow * 0.75 && plotRots(g)) || burnt,
  );
  if (g.cov) drawCeramicDome(x, y, k, t, g);
}
/* ============== SERAMİK KALKAN ==============
   Parsele kurulan iki kanatlı seramik kubbe. Q ile açılır/kapanır (servo + hidrolik pistonlar).
   Kapalıyken radyasyon dalgasını keser ama bitkiye erişilemez (sulama/hasat için açmak gerekir).
   g.cov = kalkan kurulu · g.shut = hedef durum (1 kapalı) · g.oa = kapanma animasyonu (0 açık → 1 kapalı) */
const DOME_SPEED = 1 / 1.1; // tam açılma/kapanma ~1,1 sn
function domeClosed(g) {
  return !!(g && g.cov && g.shut && (g.oa == null ? 1 : g.oa) >= 0.98);
}
function domeSafe(g) {
  return domeClosed(g);
}
function domeMoving(g) {
  return !!(g && g.cov && Math.abs((g.shut ? 1 : 0) - (g.oa || 0)) > 0.01);
}
function updateDomes(dt) {
  for (const g of farmArr()) {
    if (!g || !g.cov) continue;
    if (g.oa == null) g.oa = g.shut ? 1 : 0;
    const tg = g.shut ? 1 : 0;
    if (g.oa === tg) continue;
    const was = g.oa;
    g.oa = tg > g.oa ? Math.min(1, g.oa + dt * DOME_SPEED) : Math.max(0, g.oa - dt * DOME_SPEED);
    if (g.oa === tg) {
      // hareket bitti: kilit sesi + toz
      if (tg === 1) {
        tone(110, 0.16, "square", 0.06, 70);
        noiseBurst(0.18, 0.1, 900);
        burst(g.x, g.y + 12, 10, "#d9cfbd", { sp: 60, life: 0.6, size: 3, up: 10 });
      } else {
        tone(180, 0.1, "triangle", 0.05, 140);
      }
    } else if (Math.floor(was * 6) !== Math.floor(g.oa * 6))
      tone(tg ? 520 + g.oa * 260 : 780 - g.oa * 260, 0.05, "sawtooth", 0.012); // servo vızıltısı
  }
}
function setDome(g, shut, quiet) {
  if (!g || !g.cov) return;
  if (g.oa == null) g.oa = g.shut ? 1 : 0;
  g.shut = shut ? 1 : 0;
  if (!quiet) {
    noiseBurst(0.35, 0.06, 2600);
    tone(shut ? 440 : 620, 0.28, "sine", 0.035, shut ? 300 : 900);

  }
}
function drawCeramicDome(x, y, k, t, g) {
  const c = g.oa == null ? (g.shut ? 1 : 0) : g.oa,
    R = 50 * k,
    Hh = 64 * k,
    by = y + 14 * k,
    open = 1 - c,
    ang = open * 1.32;
  const rad = game.radiationActive && scene !== "earth",
    moving = domeMoving(g);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0," + (0.12 + 0.1 * c) + ")";
  ctx.beginPath();

    ctx.translate(hx, hy);
    ctx.rotate(sd * ang);
    ctx.translate(-hx, -hy);

    ctx.clip();

    dg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,250,238,.84)");
    dg.addColorStop(0.5, "rgba(232,222,204,.72)");
    dg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(160,148,128,.86)");
    ctx.fillStyle = dg;

    ctx.clip();

      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x - R * 0.48, by - Hh * 0.86, x - R * 0.08, by - Hh * 0.98);

    ctx.lineWidth = open > 0.02 ? 2.2 : 1.4;

    ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;

    if (rad && c >= 0.98) {
      const pu = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * 5);
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(163,230,53," + (0.35 + 0.35 * pu) + ")";
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.shadowColor = "#a3e635";
      ctx.shadowBlur = 12;

      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    }
    ctx.restore();
    // hidrolik piston: tabandan kanadın ortasına
    if (open > 0.03) {
      const ax = x + sd * R * 0.55,
        ay = by - 2,
        mx = x + sd * R * 0.5,
        my = by - Hh * 0.55;
      const q = rotP(mx - hx, my - hy, sd * ang),
        ex = hx + q.x,
        ey = hy + q.y;
      const midx = ax + (ex - ax) * 0.55,
        midy = ay + (ey - ay) * 0.55;
      ctx.lineCap = "round";
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#2b3248";
      ctx.lineWidth = 5.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(ax, ay);
      ctx.lineTo(midx, midy);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#d7dce8";
      ctx.lineWidth = 2.4;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(midx, midy);
      ctx.lineTo(ex, ey);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#7b8ba8";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(ax, ay, 2.6, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(ex, ey, 2.2, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  // tarama ışığı: hareket sırasında kubbeyi yukarıdan aşağı süpürür
  if (moving) {
    const sy = by - Hh * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * 7));
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.55;
    const lg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, sy - 6, 0, sy + 6);
    lg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(90,209,255,0)");
    lg.addColorStop(0.5, "rgba(140,230,255,.9)");
    lg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(90,209,255,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = lg;
    ctx.fillRect(x - R - 8, sy - 6, R * 2 + 16, 12);
    ctx.restore();
  }
  // taban halkası (ön yarı) + durum ışığı
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#3e4860";
  ctx.lineWidth = 7;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(x, by, R + 2, 7 * k, 0, 0, Math.PI);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#7b8ba8";
  ctx.lineWidth = 4.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(x, by, R + 2, 7 * k, 0, 0, Math.PI);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.35)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;

function coverPlot(g) {

    return false;
  }
  if (g.cov) {
    sfx("full");
    toast(T("Bu parselde zaten seramik kalkan var · <b>Q</b> ile aç/kapat"));
    return false;
  }
  if ((game.inventory.ceramic || 0) <= 0) {
    sfx("error");
    toast(T("Seramik kalkan yok — roketteki alet sandığından al"));
    return false;
  }
  game.inventory.ceramic--;
  updateInv();
  const planted = g.g > 0;
  g.cov = 1;
  g.oa = 0;
  g.shut = 0;
  g.idle = 0;
  g.fill = 0;
  if (planted)
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (g.cov && !g.shut) {
        setDome(g, 1);
        toast(T("🛡️ Kalkan kapanıyor — içerideki bitki artık radyasyondan korunuyor"));
      }
    }, 650);
  p.dir = g.x < p.x ? -1 : 1;
  burst(g.x, g.y - 20, 18, "#efe6d4", { sp: 110, life: 0.6, size: 4, up: 60 });
  addFloat(g.x, g.y - 70, T("🛡️ Kalkan kuruldu"), "#efe6d4");
  sfx("plant");
  tone(660, 0.08, "triangle", 0.05);
  tone(990, 0.12, "triangle", 0.045, null, 0.08);
  bumpQuest("covered");
  if (!planted) toast(T("🛡️ Kalkan kuruldu. Tohumu ek, sonra <b>Q</b> ile kapat."));
  storyTrigger("domeFirst");
  return true;
}
/* Q: en yakın kalkanı aç/kapat · Shift+Q: boş parseldeki kalkanı sök */
function nearestDome() {
  let b = null,

  farmArr().forEach((g) => {
    if (!g || !g.cov) return;
    const d = Math.hypot(p.x - g.x, p.y - g.y);
    if (d < bd) {
      bd = d;
      b = g;
    }
  });

}
function pressQ(shift) {

    commOpen ||
    upgOpen ||
    o2Fill ||
    bookOpen ||
    bedOpen ||
    winOpen ||
    fly ||
    radM ||
    brk
  )
    return;
  const g = nearestDome();
  if (!g) {
    sfx("error");
    toast(T("Yakında seramik kalkan yok — kalkanlı bir parselin yanına git"));
    return;
  }
  p.dir = g.x < p.x ? -1 : 1;
  if (shift) {
    if (g.g > 0) {
      sfx("error");
      toast(T("Kalkan yalnızca boş parselden sökülür — önce hasat et"));
      return;
    }
    g.cov = 0;
    g.shut = 0;
    g.oa = 0;
    game.inventory.ceramic = (game.inventory.ceramic || 0) + 1;
    updateInv();
    burst(g.x, g.y - 10, 14, "#efe6d4", { sp: 90, life: 0.6, size: 4, up: 40 });
    addFloat(g.x, g.y - 60, T("+1 🛡️ kalkan söküldü"), "#efe6d4");
    sfx("pickup");
    return;
  }
  const close = !g.shut;
  setDome(g, close);
  if (close) {
    if ((game.qstats.domeOpen || 0) > 0) bumpQuest("domeCycle");
    addFloat(g.x, g.y - 74, T("🔒 Kalkan kapanıyor"), "#cfe8ff");
  } else {
    game.qstats.domeOpen = (game.qstats.domeOpen || 0) + 1;
    updateQuest();
    addFloat(g.x, g.y - 74, T("🔓 Kalkan açılıyor"), "#ffd8a8");
    if (game.radiationActive && scene !== "earth" && g.g > 0)
      toast(T("☢️ Dikkat! Radyasyon dalgası sürüyor — açık kalkan bitkiyi korumaz"));
    else if (!game._domeOpenTip) {
      game._domeOpenTip = 1;
      toast(
        T("🔓 Kalkan açıkken sulayıp hasat edebilirsin. Radyasyon gelmeden <b>Q</b> ile kapatmayı unutma."),
      );
    }
  }
}
function drawPotatoPlant(x, y, k, t, ready, rot) {
  const sway = Math.sin(t * 1.6 + x * 0.01) * (1 + stormFx.I * 6) * 0.04;
  const leaf = (lx, ly, len, ang, col) => {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(lx, ly);
    ctx.rotate(ang + sway);
    ctx.fillStyle = col;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(len * 0.5, -len * 0.42, len, 0);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(len * 0.5, len * 0.42, 0, 0);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(20,60,30,.5)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(len * 0.92, 0);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  };
  if (k < 0.15) {
    // filiz: iki çenek yaprağı
    const s = k / 0.15;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#7fbf5a";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, y + 2);
    ctx.lineTo(x, y - 4 - 6 * s);
    ctx.stroke();
    leaf(x, y - 4 - 6 * s, 5 + 4 * s, -2.6, "#8fd16a");
    leaf(x, y - 4 - 6 * s, 5 + 4 * s, -0.5, "#8fd16a");
    return;
  }
  const wilt = rot ? (ready ? 1 : 0.45) : 0,
    stems = k < 0.6 ? 3 : 5,
    H = (12 + 34 * k) * (1 - 0.22 * wilt),
    cols = rot
      ? ready
        ? ["#6b5a2a", "#8a7434"]
        : ["#5f8a3a", "#7a9a3a"]
      : ready
        ? ["#7a9a3a", "#93ad48"]
        : ["#2f7d4f", "#3fa866"];
  for (let i = 0; i < stems; i++) {
    const a = -Math.PI / 2 + (i - (stems - 1) / 2) * (0.42 + 0.5 * wilt) + sway,
      h = H * (0.75 + (0.25 * ((i * 7) % 3)) / 2);
    const ex = x + Math.cos(a) * h * 0.55,
      ey = y + 2 + Math.sin(a) * h;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#2f6d3f";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + (i - (stems - 1) / 2) * 3, y + 3);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + Math.cos(a) * h * 0.2, y - h * 0.5, ex, ey);
    ctx.stroke();
    // bileşik yapraklar
    for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
      const u = 0.45 + j * 0.25,
        lx = x + (ex - x) * u,
        ly = y + (ey - y) * u;
      leaf(lx, ly, 6 + 8 * k, a - 0.9, cols[j % 2]);
      leaf(lx, ly, 6 + 8 * k, a + 0.9 - Math.PI * 0, cols[(j + 1) % 2]);
    }
    leaf(ex, ey, 7 + 8 * k, a, cols[0]);
    if (k >= 0.85 && !(rot && ready)) {
      // çiçekler
      ctx.fillStyle = "#f5f0ff";
      for (let f = 0; f < 5; f++) {
        const fa = f * 1.256 + t * 0.2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(ex + Math.cos(fa) * 2.6, ey - 3 + Math.sin(fa) * 2.6, 1.8, 1.1, fa, 0, 7);
        ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd34d";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(ex, ey - 3, 1.2, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  if (ready && rot) {
    // çürümüş: kararmış yumrular, sinekler, soluk halka
    for (const [ox, oy, r] of [
      [-18, 6, 1],
      [16, 8, 0.9],
      [0, 12, 1.1],
    ]) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(x + ox, y + oy);
      drawItemArt(ctx, "rotten", 16 * r, { sparkle: false });
      ctx.restore();
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = "#141414";
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      const a = t * (2.4 + i * 0.5) + i * 1.7,
        fx = x + Math.cos(a) * (18 + i * 5),
        fy = y - 18 + Math.sin(a * 1.3) * 9;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(fx, fy, 1.4, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(220,220,220,.5)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(fx - 1.5, fy - 1.4, 1.6, 0.8, -0.5 + Math.sin(t * 40 + i) * 0.4, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#141414";
    }
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(150,130,80,.7)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.4;
    ctx.setLineDash([3, 7]);
    ctx.lineDashOffset = -t * 8;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, 62, 36, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
  } else if (ready) {
    // topraktan görünen patatesler + parıltı halkası
    for (const [ox, oy, r] of [
      [-18, 6, 1],
      [16, 8, 0.9],
      [0, 12, 1.1],
    ]) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(x + ox, y + oy);
      drawItemArt(ctx, "potato", 16 * r, {});
      ctx.restore();
    }
    const pu = 0.45 + 0.35 * Math.sin(t * 4.5);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,211,77," + pu + ")";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.4;
    ctx.setLineDash([6, 6]);
    ctx.lineDashOffset = -t * 20;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, 62, 36, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
  } else {
    // büyüme halkası
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.35)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, 60, 34, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(127,224,140,.85)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.4;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, 60, 34, 0, -Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2 + k * Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

/* ============== METEOR DÜŞÜŞLERİ (gerçekçi) ==============
   Gökyüzünden çapraz giren alev topu → iz dumanı → çarpma: parlama,
   şok dalgası, toz bulutu, saçılan kaya parçaları, kalıcı tüten krater. */
const MET_T = 2.6,
  MET_ALT = 1100;
const metFx = [],
  craters = {};
let mflash = 0;
function spawnMeteor() {
  const a = Math.random() * 6.283,
    dist = 140 + Math.random() * 420;
  const x = Math.max(-CFG.worldHalf + 60, Math.min(CFG.worldHalf - 60, p.x + Math.cos(a) * dist)),
    y = Math.max(-CFG.worldHalf + 60, Math.min(CFG.worldHalf - 60, p.y + Math.sin(a) * dist));
  const dir = Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
  ev.meteors.push({
    x,
    y,
    t: MET_T,
    T: MET_T,
    dx: dir * (0.55 + Math.random() * 0.35),
    size: 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.6,
    seed: Math.random() * 1000,
  });
  // yaklaşma uğultusu
  meteorWhoosh(MET_T);
  commsObs("meteor", { n: 1, near: Math.hypot(x - p.x, y - p.y) });
}
function metHead(m) {
  const u = Math.max(0, m.t / m.T),
    alt = u * u * MET_ALT;
  return { x: m.x - m.dx * alt, y: m.y - alt * 0.85, alt, u };
}
function updateMeteorFx(dt) {
  for (const m of ev.meteors) {
    // iz: duman + kıvılcım
    const h = metHead(m);
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++)
      metFx.push({
        k: "smoke",
        x: h.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8,
        y: h.y + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 12,
        vy: -6 - Math.random() * 8,
        r: 5 + m.size * 5,
        life: 0,
        max: 1.6 + Math.random() * 1.4,
      });
    if (Math.random() < 0.8)
      metFx.push({
        k: "spark",
        x: h.x,
        y: h.y,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 160 + m.dx * -60,
        vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 160,
        life: 0,
        max: 0.35 + Math.random() * 0.3,
      });
  }
  for (let i = metFx.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const f = metFx[i];
    f.life += dt;
    if (f.life > f.max) {
      metFx.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }
    if (f.k === "debris") {
      f.vz -= 520 * dt;
      f.z += f.vz * dt;
      f.x += f.vx * dt;
      f.y += f.vy * dt;
      if (f.z <= 0) {
        f.z = 0;
        f.vz *= -0.35;
        f.vx *= 0.6;
        f.vy *= 0.6;
        if (Math.abs(f.vz) < 30) f.vz = 0;
      }
      f.rot += f.vr * dt;
    } else if (f.k === "dust") {
      f.x += f.vx * dt;
      f.y += f.vy * dt;
      f.vx *= 1 - dt * 1.6;
      f.vy *= 1 - dt * 1.6;
      f.r += dt * (28 - f.life * 6);
    } else if (f.k === "smoke" || f.k === "spark") {
      f.x += f.vx * dt;
      f.y += f.vy * dt;
      if (f.k === "smoke") {
        f.r += dt * 16;
        f.vx *= 1 - dt;
      }
    }
  }
  if (metFx.length > 700) metFx.splice(0, metFx.length - 700);
  mflash = Math.max(0, mflash - dt * 2.2);
  const cr = craters[scene];
  if (cr)
    for (const c of cr) {
      c.heat = Math.max(0, c.heat - dt / 24);
    }
}
function impact(m) {
  const d = Math.hypot(p.x - m.x, p.y - m.y),
    near = Math.max(0, 1 - d / 900),
    S = m.size;
  // krater (kalıcı)
  (craters[scene] = craters[scene] || []).push({ x: m.x, y: m.y, r: 34 + S * 22, heat: 1, seed: m.seed });
  if (craters[scene].length > 40) craters[scene].shift();
  // toz bulutu
  for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * 6.28,
      sp = 60 + Math.random() * 190;
    metFx.push({
      k: "dust",
      x: m.x,
      y: m.y,
      vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
      vy: Math.sin(a) * sp * 0.6 - 20,
      r: 14 + Math.random() * 16,
      life: 0,
      max: 2.2 + Math.random() * 1.6,
    });
  }
  // kaya parçaları (yükseklikli, gölgeli)
  for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * 6.28,
      sp = 80 + Math.random() * 260;
    metFx.push({
      k: "debris",
      x: m.x,
      y: m.y,
      z: 4,
      vz: 180 + Math.random() * 320,
      vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
      vy: Math.sin(a) * sp * 0.7,
      s: 2 + Math.random() * 4.5,
      rot: 0,
      vr: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 14,
      life: 0,
      max: 2.4 + Math.random(),
      hot: Math.random() < 0.45,
    });
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * 6.28,
      sp = 120 + Math.random() * 320;
    metFx.push({
      k: "spark",
      x: m.x,
      y: m.y,
      vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
      vy: Math.sin(a) * sp,
      life: 0,
      max: 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.5,
    });
  }
  metFx.push({ k: "shock", x: m.x, y: m.y, life: 0, max: 0.7, R: 220 + S * 80 });
  metFx.push({ k: "flash", x: m.x, y: m.y, life: 0, max: 0.35, R: 120 + S * 40 });
  mflash = Math.max(mflash, 0.55 * near + 0.05);
  shake = Math.max(shake, 4 + 16 * near);
  meteorImpact(Math.max(0.25, near), Math.min(0.7, d * 0.00055)); // ses mesafeye göre gecikir
  if (d < CFG.meteorRadius && !insideRocket) {
    const md = Math.round(CFG.meteorDmg * dif().met);
    damage(md);
    addFloat(p.x, p.y - 56, "-" + md + " ❤️", "#ff5a5a");
  }
  if (Math.random() < 0.7)
    drops.push({ x: m.x, y: m.y, type: Math.random() < 0.55 ? "star" : "stone", taken: false });
  if (scene !== "earth" && Math.random() < 0.8) {
    const n = 1 + (Math.random() < 0.45 ? 1 : 0) + (S > 1.2 && Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : 0);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * 6.28,
        r = 30 + Math.random() * 50;
      drops.push({
        x: m.x + Math.cos(a) * r,
        y: m.y + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.7,
        type: "gold",
        n: 1,
        taken: false,
        seed: Math.random() * 10,
      });
    }
  }
}
/* zeminde: kraterler (dekordan sonra) */
function drawCraters(vis) {
  const cr = craters[scene];
  if (!cr) return;
  const t = performance.now() / 1000;
  for (const c of cr) {
    if (!vis(c)) continue;
    const r = c.r;
    const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(c.x, c.y, r * 0.5, c.x, c.y, r * 1.9);
    rg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(25,8,4,.45)");
    rg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(25,8,4,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = rg;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(c.x, c.y, r * 1.9, r * 1.15, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill(); // yanık iz
    ctx.fillStyle = "#8a4a30";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(c.x, c.y + 2, r * 1.12, r * 0.68, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill(); // sırt
    const ig = ctx.createLinearGradient(c.x, c.y - r * 0.6, c.x, c.y + r * 0.6);
    ig.addColorStop(0, "#1e0b06");
    ig.addColorStop(1, "#5a2a18");
    ctx.fillStyle = ig;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(c.x, c.y, r * 0.9, r * 0.52, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,190,150,.35)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(c.x, c.y + 1, r * 0.95, r * 0.56, 0, 0.2, Math.PI - 0.2);
    ctx.stroke();
    if (c.heat > 0) {
      // soğuyan sıcak merkez + tütme
      const hg = ctx.createRadialGradient(c.x, c.y, 1, c.x, c.y, r * 0.7);
      hg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,200,90," + 0.9 * c.heat + ")");
      hg.addColorStop(0.5, "rgba(255,90,30," + 0.55 * c.heat + ")");
      hg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(120,20,0,0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = hg;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(c.x, c.y, r * 0.7, r * 0.42, 0, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const ph = (t * 0.4 + i * 0.2 + c.seed) % 1;
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(120,110,105," + 0.32 * c.heat * (1 - ph) + ")";
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(c.x + Math.sin(i * 2.3 + t) * 10 + ph * 14, c.y - ph * 70, 6 + ph * 16, 0, 7);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }
  }
}
/* zeminde: yaklaşan meteorun gölgesi + ısınan zemin */
function drawMeteor(m) {
  const k = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, m.t / m.T)),
    q = 1 - k,
    sh = 10 + 46 * q;
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(20,6,4," + (0.08 + 0.32 * q) + ")";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(m.x, m.y, sh, sh * 0.45, 0, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  const hg = ctx.createRadialGradient(m.x, m.y, 1, m.x, m.y, sh * 1.6);
  hg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,170,80," + 0.45 * q * q + ")");
  hg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,120,40,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = hg;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, sh * 1.6, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
}
/* gökyüzünde: alev topu + iz + çarpma efektleri (her şeyin üstünde) */
function drawMeteorSky() {
  const t = performance.now() / 1000;
  // önce duman/toz (arkada), sonra parlak öğeler
  for (const f of metFx) {
    const a = 1 - f.life / f.max;
    if (f.k === "smoke") {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(70,58,54," + 0.28 * a + ")";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.r, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
    } else if (f.k === "dust") {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(176,104,64," + 0.42 * a + ")";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.r, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(214,150,104," + 0.22 * a + ")";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(f.x - f.r * 0.25, f.y - f.r * 0.3, f.r * 0.6, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  for (const f of metFx) {
    const a = 1 - f.life / f.max;
    if (f.k === "debris") {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0," + 0.3 * a + ")";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(f.x, f.y, f.s, f.s * 0.45, 0, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(f.x, f.y - f.z);
      ctx.rotate(f.rot);
      ctx.fillStyle = f.hot && f.life < 1.2 ? "#ff8a3c" : "#5a3a30";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-f.s, -f.s * 0.4);
      ctx.lineTo(0, -f.s);
      ctx.lineTo(f.s, 0);
      ctx.lineTo(f.s * 0.3, f.s * 0.8);
      ctx.lineTo(-f.s * 0.8, f.s * 0.6);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      if (f.hot && f.life < 1.2) {
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,220,140," + (0.8 - f.life * 0.6) + ")";
        ctx.fillRect(-f.s * 0.3, -f.s * 0.3, f.s * 0.6, f.s * 0.6);
      }
      ctx.restore();
    } else if (f.k === "spark") {
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255," + (180 + Math.round(70 * a)) + ",120," + a + ")";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.8;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(f.x, f.y);
      ctx.lineTo(f.x - f.vx * 0.03, f.y - f.vy * 0.03);
      ctx.stroke();
    } else if (f.k === "shock") {
      const u = f.life / f.max,
        R = f.R * (1 - Math.pow(1 - u, 3));
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,226,190," + 0.75 * (1 - u) + ")";
      ctx.lineWidth = 8 * (1 - u) + 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(f.x, f.y, R, R * 0.55, 0, 0, 7);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(200,120,70," + 0.45 * (1 - u) + ")";
      ctx.lineWidth = 16 * (1 - u);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(f.x, f.y, R * 0.8, R * 0.44, 0, 0, 7);
      ctx.stroke();
    } else if (f.k === "flash") {
      const u = f.life / f.max,
        g = ctx.createRadialGradient(f.x, f.y, 0, f.x, f.y, f.R * (1 + u));
      g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,240," + (1 - u) + ")");
      g.addColorStop(0.3, "rgba(255,200,110," + 0.8 * (1 - u) + ")");
      g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,120,40,0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.R * (1 + u), 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  for (const m of ev.meteors) {
    const h = metHead(m),
      S = m.size,
      len = 180 + 260 * (1 - h.u) * 0 + 220 * S;
    // iyonize iz (konik)
    const tx = h.x - m.dx * len * 0.9,
      ty = h.y - len * 0.78; // iz: geldiği yöne doğru (arkada)
    const ang = Math.atan2(ty - h.y, tx - h.x),
      nx = -Math.sin(ang),
      ny = Math.cos(ang),
      w = 10 * S;
    const tg = ctx.createLinearGradient(h.x, h.y, tx, ty);
    tg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,236,190,.95)");
    tg.addColorStop(0.25, "rgba(255,150,60,.65)");
    tg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,90,30,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = tg;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(h.x + nx * w, h.y + ny * w);
    ctx.lineTo(tx, ty);
    ctx.lineTo(h.x - nx * w, h.y - ny * w);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    // plazma başı + korona
    const fl = 0.85 + 0.15 * Math.sin(t * 40 + m.seed);
    const R0 = 46 * S * fl;
    const cg = ctx.createRadialGradient(h.x, h.y, 0, h.x, h.y, R0);
    cg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,240,1)");
    cg.addColorStop(0.18, "rgba(255,236,170,.95)");
    cg.addColorStop(0.45, "rgba(255,140,50,.45)");
    cg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,80,20,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = cg;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(h.x, h.y, R0, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    // ön yüzde sıkışan şok parlaması (hareket yönünde basık)
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(h.x, h.y);
    ctx.rotate(Math.atan2(0.85, m.dx));
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,250,225,.95)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(2, 0, 9 * S, 6 * S, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,1)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(3, 0, 4.5 * S, 3.2 * S, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

/* ============== METEOR SESLERİ ============== */
function _noiseSrc(dur, brown) {
  const ac = AU.ac,
    len = Math.max(1, Math.floor(ac.sampleRate * dur)),
    b = ac.createBuffer(1, len, ac.sampleRate),
    d = b.getChannelData(0);
  let l = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
    const w = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
    if (brown) {
      l = (l + 0.03 * w) / 1.03;
      d[i] = l * 3.2;
    } else d[i] = w;
  }
  const s = ac.createBufferSource();
  s.buffer = b;
  return s;
}
/* yaklaşan meteor: yükselen hava yırtılması + derin gürleme + atmosfer çıtırtısı */
function meteorWhoosh(dur) {
  if (!AU.ac || !AU.ready) return;
  try {
    const ac = AU.ac,
      t = ac.currentTime;
    const n = _noiseSrc(dur + 0.4, true),
      bp = ac.createBiquadFilter();
    bp.type = "bandpass";
    bp.Q.value = 1.1;
    bp.frequency.setValueAtTime(220, t);
    bp.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(1900, t + dur * 0.88);
    bp.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(500, t + dur + 0.2);
    const g = ac.createGain();
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.55, t + dur * 0.92);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + dur + 0.3);
    n.connect(bp);
    bp.connect(g);
    g.connect(AU.sfxG);
    n.start(t);
    n.stop(t + dur + 0.4);
    const o = ac.createOscillator();
    o.type = "sawtooth";
    o.frequency.setValueAtTime(36, t);
    o.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(62, t + dur);
    const lp = ac.createBiquadFilter();
    lp.type = "lowpass";
    lp.frequency.value = 140;
    const g2 = ac.createGain();
    g2.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
    g2.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.22, t + dur * 0.95);
    g2.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + dur + 0.12);
    o.connect(lp);
    lp.connect(g2);
    g2.connect(AU.sfxG);
    o.start(t);
    o.stop(t + dur + 0.2);
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      // plazma çıtırtısı
      const tt = t + dur * (0.35 + 0.6 * Math.random()),
        c = _noiseSrc(0.04, false),
        hp = ac.createBiquadFilter();
      hp.type = "highpass";
      hp.frequency.value = 3200;
      const cg = ac.createGain();
      cg.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, tt);
      cg.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.08 + 0.06 * Math.random(), tt + 0.005);
      cg.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, tt + 0.04);
      c.connect(hp);
      hp.connect(cg);
      cg.connect(AU.sfxG);
      c.start(tt);
    }
  } catch (e) {}
}
/* çarpma: derin gümleme + patlama dalgası + düşen kaya pıtırtısı */
function meteorImpact(v, delay) {
  if (!AU.ac || !AU.ready) return;
  try {
    const ac = AU.ac,
      t = ac.currentTime + delay;
    const o = ac.createOscillator();
    o.type = "sine";
    o.frequency.setValueAtTime(95, t);
    o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(26, t + 1.1);
    const g = ac.createGain();
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.95 * v, t + 0.012);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + 1.8);
    o.connect(g);
    g.connect(AU.sfxG);
    o.start(t);
    o.stop(t + 1.9);
    const n = _noiseSrc(2.2, true),
      lp = ac.createBiquadFilter();
    lp.type = "lowpass";
    lp.frequency.setValueAtTime(2400, t);
    lp.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(140, t + 1.4);
    const ng = ac.createGain();
    ng.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
    ng.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.9 * v, t + 0.02);
    ng.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + 2.1);
    n.connect(lp);
    lp.connect(ng);
    ng.connect(AU.sfxG);
    n.start(t);
    n.stop(t + 2.2);
    const cr = _noiseSrc(0.12, false),
      hp = ac.createBiquadFilter();
    hp.type = "highpass";
    hp.frequency.value = 1500; // ilk çatlama
    const cg = ac.createGain();
    cg.gain.setValueAtTime(0.5 * v, t);
    cg.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + 0.12);
    cr.connect(hp);
    hp.connect(cg);
    cg.connect(AU.sfxG);
    cr.start(t);
    for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
      // geri düşen kaya parçaları
      const tt = t + 0.35 + Math.random() * 1.4,
        c = _noiseSrc(0.07, false),
        bp = ac.createBiquadFilter();
      bp.type = "bandpass";
      bp.frequency.value = 700 + Math.random() * 1600;
      bp.Q.value = 3;
      const pg = ac.createGain();
      pg.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, tt);
      pg.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime((0.12 + 0.12 * Math.random()) * v, tt + 0.006);
      pg.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, tt + 0.07);
      c.connect(bp);
      bp.connect(pg);
      pg.connect(AU.sfxG);
      c.start(tt);
    }
  } catch (e) {}
}

/* ============== MÜZİK — sakin, uzay temalı ambient ==============
   Am9 → Fmaj7 → Cmaj7 → G6 dizisi: yumuşak pad, derin bas, yankılı çan arpejleri. */
const MUS = {
  bpm: 64,
  bar: 0,
  arpSeed: 1,
  chords: [
    [45, 57, 60, 64, 71],
    [41, 53, 57, 60, 64],
    [36, 48, 52, 55, 59],
    [43, 50, 55, 59, 64],
  ],
};
const mtof = (m) => 440 * Math.pow(2, (m - 69) / 12);
function padNote(f, t, dur, vol) {
  const ac = AU.ac,
    flt = ac.createBiquadFilter(),
    g = ac.createGain();
  flt.type = "lowpass";
  flt.frequency.setValueAtTime(380, t);
  flt.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(950, t + dur * 0.5);
  flt.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(420, t + dur);
  flt.Q.value = 0.6;
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
  g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(vol, t + 1.6);
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol, t + dur - 0.4);
  g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + dur + 2.2);
  for (const det of [-7, 6]) {
    const o = ac.createOscillator();
    o.type = "sawtooth";
    o.frequency.value = f;
    o.detune.value = det;
    o.connect(flt);
    o.start(t);
    o.stop(t + dur + 2.4);
  }
  flt.connect(g);
  g.connect(AU.musicG);
}
function bellNote(f, t, vol) {
  const ac = AU.ac,
    g = ac.createGain();
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol, t + 0.01);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + 1.6);
  const o = ac.createOscillator();
  o.type = "sine";
  o.frequency.value = f;
  const o2 = ac.createOscillator();
  o2.type = "sine";
  o2.frequency.value = f * 2.76;
  const g2 = ac.createGain();
  g2.gain.setValueAtTime(vol * 0.35, t);
  g2.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + 0.5);
  o.connect(g);
  o2.connect(g2);
  g2.connect(g);
  g.connect(AU.bus);
  o.start(t);
  o2.start(t);
  o.stop(t + 1.7);
  o2.stop(t + 0.6);
}
function bassNote(f, t, dur, vol) {
  const ac = AU.ac,
    o = ac.createOscillator(),
    g = ac.createGain(),
    lp = ac.createBiquadFilter();
  o.type = "triangle";
  o.frequency.value = f;
  lp.type = "lowpass";
  lp.frequency.value = 260;
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
  g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(vol, t + 0.25);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + dur);
  o.connect(lp);
  lp.connect(g);
  g.connect(AU.musicG);
  o.start(t);
  o.stop(t + dur + 0.1);
}
function scheduleMusic() {
  if (!AU.ready) return;
  if (mode === "intro") {
    AU.nextT = AU.ac.currentTime + 0.4;
    return;
  } // açılış sinemasının kendi müziği var
  const ac = AU.ac,
    beat = 60 / MUS.bpm,
    barLen = beat * 4;
  if (!MUS.init) {
    MUS.init = true;
    try {
      AU.delay.delayTime.value = beat * 0.75;
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  while (AU.nextT < ac.currentTime + 1.2) {
    const t = AU.nextT,
      ch = MUS.chords[Math.floor(MUS.bar / 2) % MUS.chords.length],
      first = MUS.bar % 2 === 0;
    if (first) for (let i = 1; i < ch.length - 1; i++) padNote(mtof(ch[i]), t, barLen * 2 - 0.2, 0.026);
    bassNote(mtof(ch[0]), t, barLen * 0.95, 0.14);
    if (!first) bassNote(mtof(ch[0] + 7), t + beat * 2, barLen * 0.45, 0.08);
    // arpej: her ölçüde değişen, seyrek çan notaları
    const pat = [
      [0, 2, 1, 3],
      [1, 3, 2, 4],
      [0, 2, 4, 3],
      [2, 1, 3, 0],
    ][Math.floor(MUS.bar / 4) % 4];
    for (let s = 0; s < 8; s++) {
      MUS.arpSeed = (MUS.arpSeed * 16807) % 2147483647;
      const r = MUS.arpSeed / 2147483647;
      if (r < (s % 2 ? 0.32 : 0.62)) {
        const n = ch[1 + (pat[s % 4] % (ch.length - 1))] + 12;
        bellNote(mtof(n), t + (s * beat) / 2, 0.045 + (s === 0 ? 0.02 : 0));
      }
    }
    if (MUS.bar % 8 === 7) bellNote(mtof(ch[ch.length - 1] + 24), t + beat * 3, 0.03); // yüksek parıltı
    AU.nextT += barLen;
    MUS.bar++;
  }
}

/* ============== REHBER KİTAP ============== */
let bookOpen = false,
  bookPages = [],
  bookSpread = 0,
  bookBusy = false;
function _ic(k, cls) {
  return `<img class="bk-ic ${cls || ""}" src="${itemIconURL(k)}" alt="">`;
}
function bookCalendar() {
  const d0 = gameDayNumber(),
    wt = game.worldTime || 0,
    inDay = wt % DAY_SECONDS;
  let rows = "";
  for (let d = d0; d < d0 + 10; d++) {
    const ev = [];
    if (d >= 3 && d % 3 === 0) ev.push(Tf(`<span class="ev rd">☢ Radyasyon · 00:00–01:30</span>`, []));
    if (isStormDay(d)) ev.push(Tf(`<span class="ev st">🌪 Kum fırtınası · 01:30–04:00</span>`, []));
    rows += Tf(`<tr class="{0}"><td>Gün {1}{2}</td><td>{3}</td></tr>`, [
      d === d0 ? "today" : "",
      d,
      d === d0 ? " ◀" : "",
      ev.join(" ") || T("<span class='ev ok'>Sakin</span>"),
    ]);
  }
  const ns = nextStormIn(),
    nsd = isFinite(ns) ? Math.floor((wt + ns) / DAY_SECONDS) + 1 : "–";
  return { rows, nsd, left: mmss(DAY_SECONDS - inDay) };
}

/* sayfa içeriği taşarsa (uzun dillerde) içeriği orantılı küçült */
function fitPages(root) {
  (root || $("bookPages")).querySelectorAll(".pg-in").forEach((el) => {
    el.style.transform = "";
    el.style.width = "";
    el.style.height = "";
    const H = el.clientHeight;
    if (!H) return;
    const pb = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(el).paddingBottom) || 0;
    const over = () => {
      let b = 0;
      for (const c of el.children) b = Math.max(b, c.offsetTop + c.offsetHeight);
      return b > el.clientHeight - pb - 16;
    };
    let sc = 1;
    for (let k = 0; k < 14 && over(); k++) {
      sc -= 0.035;
      el.style.transformOrigin = "0 0";
      el.style.transform = `scale(${sc})`;
      el.style.width = `${100 / sc}%`;
      el.style.height = `${100 / sc}%`;
    }
  });
}
function pageHTML(i) {
  if (i < 0 || i >= bookPages.length) return `<div class="pg-end">✦</div>`;
  return `<div class="pg-in">${bookPages[i]}</div>${i > 0 ? `<div class="pg-num">${i + 1}</div>` : ""}`;
}
function renderSpread() {
  $("pgL").innerHTML = pageHTML(bookSpread * 2);
  $("pgR").innerHTML = pageHTML(bookSpread * 2 + 1);
  const last = Math.ceil(bookPages.length / 2) - 1;
  $("bkPrev").disabled = bookSpread <= 0;
  $("bkNext").disabled = bookSpread >= last;
  $("bkInd").textContent =
    bookSpread * 2 + 1 + "–" + Math.min(bookPages.length, bookSpread * 2 + 2) + " / " + bookPages.length;
  document
    .querySelectorAll("#bookScreen [data-go]")
    .forEach((a) => (a.onclick = () => bookGoto(+a.dataset.go)));
  fitPages();
}
function flipSound() {
  noiseBurst(0.22, 0.13, 2600);
  setTimeout(() => noiseBurst(0.08, 0.07, 1800), 120);
}
function openBook() {
  if (mode !== "play" || !game) return;
  bookOpen = true;
  bookPages = buildBookPages();
  bookBusy = false;
  for (const k in keys) keys[k] = false;
  renderSpread();
  $("bookScreen").classList.remove("hidden");
  $("ui").classList.add("book-open");
  layoutBook();
  fitPages();
  flipSound();
}
/* kitabı görev kartının altı ile oksijen barının üstü arasındaki boşluğa yerleştir;
   boşluk dar ise kitap açıkken görev kartı gizlenir ve kitap gün kartının altına oturur */
function layoutBook() {
  const S = $("bookScreen"),
    wrap = S.querySelector(".bk-wrap"),
    bk = S.querySelector(".book");
  const q = $("quest"),
    st = $("stats");
  $("ui").classList.remove("book-noquest");
  const statsTop =
    (st && !st.classList.contains("hidden") ? st.getBoundingClientRect().top : innerHeight) - 24;
  const fit = (topEl) => {
    const top = topEl.getBoundingClientRect().bottom + 22,
      h = statsTop - top;
    return { top, h };
  };
  let L = q && !q.classList.contains("hidden") ? fit(q) : fit($("hud"));
  if (L.h < 330 && q && !q.classList.contains("hidden")) {
    $("ui").classList.add("book-noquest");
    L = fit($("hud"));
  }
  if (L.h < 200) {
    S.style.top = "50%";
    S.style.transform = "translateY(-50%)";
    wrap.style.width = "";
    bk.style.height = "";
    return;
  }
  const w = Math.min(640, innerWidth * 0.5, L.h * 1.5),
    h = Math.min(L.h, w / 1.42);
  S.style.top = L.top + "px";
  S.style.transform = "none";
  wrap.style.width = w + "px";
  bk.style.height = h + "px";
}
addEventListener("resize", () => {
  if (bookOpen) {
    layoutBook();
    fitPages();
  }
});
function closeBook() {
  bookOpen = false;
  $("bookScreen").classList.add("hidden");
  $("ui").classList.remove("book-open", "book-noquest");
  $("bookPages")
    .querySelectorAll(".flip")
    .forEach((f) => f.remove());
  bookBusy = false;
  focusGame();
}
function bookFlip(dir, target) {
  const last = Math.ceil(bookPages.length / 2) - 1,
    s = bookSpread,
    t = target == null ? s + dir : target;
  if (bookBusy || t < 0 || t > last || t === s) return;
  bookBusy = true;
  flipSound();
  const fl = document.createElement("div");
  if (t > s) {
    fl.className = "flip r";
    fl.innerHTML = `<div class="face front page right">${pageHTML(2 * s + 1)}</div><div class="face back page left">${pageHTML(2 * t)}</div>`;
    $("pgR").innerHTML = pageHTML(2 * t + 1);
  } else {
    fl.className = "flip l";
    fl.innerHTML = `<div class="face front page left">${pageHTML(2 * s)}</div><div class="face back page right">${pageHTML(2 * t + 1)}</div>`;
    $("pgL").innerHTML = pageHTML(2 * t);
  }
  $("bookPages").appendChild(fl);
  fitPages();
  requestAnimationFrame(() =>
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      fl.classList.add("go");
    }),
  );
  setTimeout(() => {
    bookSpread = t;
    renderSpread();
    fl.remove();
    bookBusy = false;
  }, 760);
}
function bookGoto(page) {
  bookFlip(0, Math.floor(page / 2));
}
$("bkPrev").onclick = () => bookFlip(-1);
$("bkNext").onclick = () => bookFlip(1);
$("bkX").onclick = closeBook;
$("bookPages").addEventListener("click", (e) => {
  if (e.target.closest("a,button")) return;
  const r = $("bookPages").getBoundingClientRect();
  if (e.clientX > r.left + r.width * 0.82) bookFlip(1);
  else if (e.clientX < r.left + r.width * 0.18) bookFlip(-1);
});

let commOpen = false,

function commState() {
  if (!game.comms)
    game.comms = {
      log: [],
      sent: [],
      inbox: [],
      seq: { obs: 1, rpr: 1, msg: 1 },
      sci: 0,
      trk: { st: null, rd: null, crit: {} },
      flags: {},
      lastBull: 0,
      lastRpt: 0,
    };
  const C = game.comms;
  C.trk = C.trk || { st: null, rd: null, crit: {} };
  C.trk.crit = C.trk.crit || {};
  C.flags = C.flags || {};
  return C;
