/* ---------- çizim yardımcıları ---------- */
function oCapsule(x, y, rot, s, shield) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.rotate(rot);
  ctx.scale(s, s);
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(-22, 0, 22, 0);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#9aa3b8");
  g.addColorStop(0.45, "#eef1f7");
  g.addColorStop(1, "#6b7388");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-24, 14);
  ctx.lineTo(-10, -22);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, -27, 10, -22);
  ctx.lineTo(24, 14);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(30,40,60,.6)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff8c42";
  ctx.fillRect(-19, 1, 38, 3);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#1d2b4f";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(-6, -8, 3.4, 2.6, 0, 0, 7);
  ctx.ellipse(6, -8, 3.4, 2.6, 0, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(127,231,255,.7)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(-6.6, -8.6, 1.5, 1, 0, 0, 7);
  ctx.ellipse(5.4, -8.6, 1.5, 1, 0, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  const hs = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 12, 0, 20);
  hs.addColorStop(
    0,
    shield > 0
      ? `rgb(${ilerp(70, 255, shield) | 0},${ilerp(50, 170, shield) | 0},${ilerp(40, 80, shield) | 0})`
      : "#4a3a32",
  );
  hs.addColorStop(1, "#22160f");
  ctx.fillStyle = hs;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-25, 13);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, 23, 25, 13);
  ctx.lineTo(24, 15);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, 26, -24, 15);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}
function oMoon(x, y, r, lit) {
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x - r * 0.35 * lit, y - r * 0.3, r * 0.1, x, y, r);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#f1efe9");
  g.addColorStop(0.55, "#b9b5ab");
  g.addColorStop(1, "#3d3b37");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(60,58,54,.35)";
  for (const [a, b, c] of [
    [-0.3, -0.2, 0.22],
    [0.25, 0.1, 0.16],
    [-0.05, 0.35, 0.12],
    [0.35, -0.35, 0.1],
    [-0.45, 0.25, 0.08],
  ]) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x + a * r, y + b * r, c * r, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  const sh = ctx.createRadialGradient(x + r * 0.6, y + r * 0.2, r * 0.2, x + r * 0.4, y, r * 1.2);
  sh.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,.75)");
  sh.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = sh;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
}
function oChutes(x, y, s, t) {
  const sw = Math.sin(t * 1.3) * 0.06;
  for (const [dx, dy, c] of [
    [-46, -118, 0],
    [0, -132, 1],
    [46, -118, 2],
  ]) {
    const cx = x + (dx + Math.sin(t * 1.1 + c) * 3) * s,
      cy = y + dy * s,
      r = 34 * s;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(230,230,235,.75)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let i = -3; i <= 3; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, y - 20 * s);
      ctx.lineTo(cx + (i * r) / 3.2, cy + 4 * s);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(cx, cy);
    ctx.rotate(sw + (c - 1) * 0.08);
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      const a0 = Math.PI + (i / 8) * Math.PI,
        a1 = Math.PI + ((i + 1) / 8) * Math.PI;
      ctx.fillStyle = i % 2 ? "#ff8c42" : "#f5f6fa";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, 8 * s);
      ctx.arc(0, 8 * s, r, a0, a1);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.18)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 8 * s, r, r * 0.18, 0, 0, Math.PI);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }
}
function oRidges(gy, cols, par) {
  intro.ridge.forEach((R, i) => {
    const amp = [0.07, 0.05, 0.035][i] * H,
      base = gy - [0.06, 0.03, 0.0][i] * H;
    ctx.fillStyle = cols[i];
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, H);
    for (let j = 0; j < R.length; j++) {
      const x = (j / (R.length - 1)) * W * 1.1 - W * 0.05 + par * (i + 1) * 8;
      ctx.lineTo(x, base - R[j] * amp);
    }
    ctx.lineTo(W, H);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  });
}
/* ---------- sahneler ---------- */
function oLift(t, U) {
  // 0–11: Mars gün batımı, kalkış
  const ign = 3.6,
    up = Math.max(0, t - 4.6),
    lift = Math.pow(up, 2.05) * H * 0.045,
    sh = t > ign && t < 9 ? (1 - iclamp((t - 8) / 1)) * 7 * U : 0;
  ctx.save();
  if (sh) ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * sh, (Math.random() - 0.5) * sh);
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#0e0a18");
  g.addColorStop(0.45, "#3d2030");
  g.addColorStop(0.72, "#a4573a");
  g.addColorStop(1, "#d9925f");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(-20, -20, W + 40, H + 40);
  iStars(0.45, 0, 0, true);
  // Mars'ta gün batımı mavidir
  const sx = W * 0.74,
    sy = H * 0.66,
    bl = ctx.createRadialGradient(sx, sy, 0, sx, sy, H * 0.42);
  bl.addColorStop(0, "rgba(200,230,255,.95)");
  bl.addColorStop(0.06, "rgba(150,200,255,.7)");
  bl.addColorStop(0.3, "rgba(110,160,230,.22)");
  bl.addColorStop(1, "rgba(110,160,230,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = bl;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  // Phobos
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2a1d1a";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(W * 0.2, H * 0.18, 6 * U, 4.4 * U, 0.4, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  const gy = H * 0.78;
  oRidges(gy, ["#5a2a20", "#40190f", "#28100a"], -t * 0.2);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#1d0b06";
  ctx.fillRect(0, gy, W, H - gy);
  // yer ışıkları / rampa
  ctx.fillStyle = "#3a2a28";
  ctx.fillRect(W * 0.5 - 70 * U, gy - 4 * U, 140 * U, 6 * U);
  const blink = Math.sin(t * 5) > 0;
  for (const dx of [-64, 64]) {
    ctx.fillStyle = blink ? "#ff5a3c" : "#5a1a10";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W * 0.5 + dx * U, gy - 6 * U, 2.2 * U, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  const s = U * 1.35,
    rx = W * 0.5,
    ry = gy - 44 * s - lift;
  if (t > ign) {
    // alev + duman
    const pw = iclamp((t - ign) / 1.1);
    if (Math.random() < 0.9)
      iSmoke(rx, gy - 2 * U, up < 2 ? 4 : 2, U, {
        sp: up < 1.5 ? 1.4 : 0.6,
        up: 0.5,
        life: 4,
        c: [190, 140, 110],
        a: 0.55,
      });
    const fl = ctx.createRadialGradient(
      rx,
      ry + 60 * s,
      0,
      rx,
      ry + 60 * s,
      (120 + Math.random() * 30) * U * pw,
    );
    fl.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,245,210," + 0.9 * pw + ")");
    fl.addColorStop(0.3, "rgba(255,160,70," + 0.6 * pw + ")");
    fl.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,90,40,0)");
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
    ctx.fillStyle = fl;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
    const gl = ctx.createRadialGradient(rx, gy, 0, rx, gy, W * 0.5);
    gl.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,170,90," + 0.35 * pw * (1 - iclamp(up / 5)) + ")");
    gl.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,170,90,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = gl;
    ctx.fillRect(0, gy - H * 0.3, W, H * 0.6);
  }
  iParts2D();
  iRocket(rx, ry, Math.sin(t * 1.7) * 0.01 * (up > 0 ? 1 : 0), s, t > ign ? 1 + 0.2 * Math.sin(t * 30) : 0);
  ctx.restore();
  const cd = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(ign - t));
  iHud(
    [
      [
        T("EVRE"),
        t < ign ? T("GERİ SAYIM") : up <= 0 ? T("ATEŞLEME") : T("MARS KALKIŞI"),
        t < ign ? "#ffd34d" : "#4ade80",
      ],
      ["T", t < ign ? "− " + cd : "+ " + fmtN(t - ign, 1) + " sn"],
      [T("İRTİFA"), fmtN((lift / (H * 0.045)) * 55, 0) + " m"],
      [T("İTKİ"), "%" + Math.round(t > ign ? Math.min(100, (t - ign) * 90) : 0)],
    ],
    W * 0.04,
    H * 0.14,
    U,
  );
}
function oOrbit(t, U) {
  // 11–21: Mars uzaklaşır, röle uydusu
  const lt = t - 11,
    k = iease(lt / 10),
    r = Math.max(W, H) * ilerp(0.9, 0.32, k),
    mx = W * ilerp(0.38, 0.24, k),
    my = H * ilerp(1.25, 0.72, k);
  if (GLX.ok)
    ctx.drawImage(
      glxSpace({
        time: t,
        milky: 0.85,
        stars: 1,
        off: [lt * 6, 0],
        p1: [mx, my, r, 1],
        rot1: 0.3 + lt * 0.02,
        tilt1: 1.05,
        l1: [0.7, 0.45, 0.55],
        expo: 1,
      }),
      0,
      0,
      W,
      H,
    );
  else {
    iSpace("#010208", "#06030c");
    iMilky(0.8);
    iStars(1, lt * 6, 0, true);
    iMars(mx, my, r, 0.3 + lt * 0.02, true);
  }
  // röle uydusu
  const sa = iclamp((lt - 0.5) / 1) * (1 - iclamp((lt - 6.5) / 1)),
    sx = W * ilerp(0.95, 0.55, iclamp(lt / 7)),
    sy = H * ilerp(0.3, 0.36, iclamp(lt / 7));
  if (sa > 0) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = sa;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(sx, sy);
    ctx.rotate(-0.2);
    const q = U * 1.1;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#1e3a8a";
    ctx.fillRect(-46 * q, -6 * q, 30 * q, 12 * q);
    ctx.fillRect(16 * q, -6 * q, 30 * q, 12 * q);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#93c5fd";
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.6;
    for (let i = 1; i < 5; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo((-46 + i * 6) * q, -6 * q);
      ctx.lineTo((-46 + i * 6) * q, 6 * q);
      ctx.moveTo((16 + i * 6) * q, -6 * q);
      ctx.lineTo((16 + i * 6) * q, 6 * q);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = "#d4a843";
    rrp(-14 * q, -11 * q, 28 * q, 22 * q, 3 * q);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#e8ecf5";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, -16 * q, 9 * q, 3.5 * q, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
    iText("ARES-R1", sx, sy + 30 * U, 10 * U + 3, { al: "center", mono: 1, w: 800, c: "#9fd3ff", ls: 3 });
    if (Math.sin(t * 6) > 0) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(127,231,255,.5)";
      ctx.setLineDash([4, 6]);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(sx, sy);
      ctx.lineTo(W * 0.62, H * 0.52);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
  // roket: ateşleme 5.5–9.5
  const burn = lt > 5.4 && lt < 9.6,
    rx = W * ilerp(0.5, 0.8, k),
    ry = H * ilerp(0.56, 0.34, k);
  if (burn) {
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(rx, ry, 0, rx, ry, 60 * U);
    g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,220,160,.5)");
    g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,160,90,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(rx, ry, 60 * U, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  iRocket(rx, ry, Math.atan2(-0.22, 0.3) + Math.PI / 2, U * 0.75, burn ? 0.9 + 0.15 * Math.sin(t * 28) : 0);
  iHud(
    [
      [
        T("EVRE"),
        lt < 5.4
          ? T("MARS YÖRÜNGESİ")
          : lt < 9.6
            ? T("DÜNYA'YA TRANSFER ATEŞLEMESİ")
            : T("TRANSFER YÖRÜNGESİ"),
        burn ? "#ffd34d" : "#4ade80",
      ],
      [T("İRTİFA"), fmtN(ilerp(410, 52000, k), 0) + " km"],
      [T("HIZ"), fmtN(ilerp(3.4, 5.9, iclamp((lt - 5.4) / 4)), 1) + " km/s"],
    ],
    W * 0.04,
    H * 0.14,
    U,
  );
}
function oCruise(t, U) {
  // 21–35: Mars → Dünya
  const lt = t - 21,
    k = lt / 14,
    O = intro.O;
  const mx = W * 0.15,
    my = H * 0.62,
    mr = H * (0.13 - 0.1 * k),
    ex = W * 0.85,
    ey = H * 0.36,
    er = H * (0.02 + 0.13 * iease(k));
  if (GLX.ok)
    ctx.drawImage(
      glxSpace({
        time: t,
        off: [-lt * 14, 0],
        p1: [ex, ey, er, 0],
        rot1: lt * 0.08,
        l1: [-0.5, 0.35, 0.7],
        p2: [mx, my, mr, 1],
        rot2: lt * 0.04,
        l2: [0.8, 0.3, 0.5],
      }),
      0,
      0,
      W,
      H,
    );
  else {
    iSpace("#010208", "#03061a");
    iMilky(0.9);
    iStars(1, -lt * 14, 0, true);
    iEarth(ex, ey, er, lt * 0.08);
    iMars(mx, my, mr, lt * 0.04);
  }
  const cx = W * 0.5,
    cy = H * 0.08,
    B = (u) => ({
      x: (1 - u) * (1 - u) * mx + 2 * (1 - u) * u * cx + u * u * ex,
      y: (1 - u) * (1 - u) * (my - mr * 1.3) + 2 * (1 - u) * u * cy + u * u * (ey - er * 1.3),
    });
  const u0 = 0.04 + 0.9 * iease(k);
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(127,200,255,.9)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let i = 0; i <= 40; i++) {
    const q = B((i / 40) * u0);
    i ? ctx.lineTo(q.x, q.y) : ctx.moveTo(q.x, q.y);
  }
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([5, 7]);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(127,200,255,.4)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let i = 0; i <= 40; i++) {
    const q = B(u0 + ((1 - u0) * i) / 40);
    i ? ctx.lineTo(q.x, q.y) : ctx.moveTo(q.x, q.y);
  }
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  const q = B(u0),
    q2 = B(Math.min(1, u0 + 0.01)),
    ang = Math.atan2(q2.y - q.y, q2.x - q.x);
  const gl = ctx.createRadialGradient(q.x, q.y, 0, q.x, q.y, 40 * U);
  gl.addColorStop(0, "rgba(160,210,255,.35)");
  gl.addColorStop(1, "rgba(160,210,255,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = gl;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(q.x, q.y, 40 * U, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  iRocket(q.x, q.y, ang + Math.PI / 2, U * 0.55, 0.2 + 0.08 * Math.sin(t * 20));
  const day = Math.max(1, Math.round(1 + (O.TD - 1) * iease(k)));
  iText(T("DÖNÜŞ GÜNÜ"), W / 2, H * 0.15, 11 * U + 4, { al: "center", mono: 1, w: 800, c: "#8d9cc0", ls: 5 });
  iText(String(day).padStart(3, "0") + " / " + O.TD, W / 2, H * 0.15 + 40 * U, 34 * U + 8, {
    al: "center",
    mono: 1,
    w: 300,
    c: "#fff",
    ls: 4,
  });
  const dist = ilerp(225, 0.4, iease(k)),
    dl = ilerp(12.5, 0.03, iease(k));
  iHud(
    [
      [T("DÜNYA'YA UZAKLIK"), fmtN(dist, 1) + T(" milyon km")],
      [T("SİNYAL GECİKMESİ"), fmtN(dl, 1) + T(" dk")],
      [T("KARGO"), O.cargo + T(" numune")],
      [T("YER İSTASYONU"), GS_STATIONS[Math.floor(day / 9) % 3].nm],
    ],
    W * 0.04,
    H * 0.14,
    U,
  );
  iText(T("MARS"), mx, my + mr + 22 * U, 10 * U + 4, { al: "center", mono: 1, w: 800, c: "#ffb38a", ls: 3 });
  iText(T("DÜNYA"), ex, ey + er + 22 * U, 10 * U + 4, { al: "center", mono: 1, w: 800, c: "#9fc9ff", ls: 3 });
}
function oEarth(t, U) {
  // 35–44: Dünya'ya yaklaşma, Ay, kapsül ayrılması
  const lt = t - 35,
    k = iease(lt / 9),
    r = Math.max(W, H) * ilerp(0.28, 0.62, k),
    ex = W * ilerp(0.66, 0.6, k),
    ey = H * ilerp(0.52, 0.78, k);
  // Ay önden geçer
  const mo = W * ilerp(1.1, -0.1, iclamp(lt / 7.5)),
    moy = H * 0.24,
    mr = H * 0.055;
  if (GLX.ok)
    ctx.drawImage(
      glxSpace({
        time: t,
        milky: 0.7,
        stars: 1,
        off: [lt * 8, 0],
        p1: [ex, ey, r, 0],
        rot1: 0.6 + lt * 0.03,
        tilt1: 1.05,
        l1: [-0.55, 0.45, 0.7],
        flare: [W * 0.08, H * 0.15, 0.7],
      }),
      0,
      0,
      W,
      H,
    );
  else {
    iSpace("#010208", "#030a1a");
    iMilky(0.6);
    iStars(1, lt * 8, 0, true);
    iEarth(ex, ey, r, 0.6 + lt * 0.03);
  }
  oMoon(mo, moy, mr, 1);
  // roket gövdesi + kapsül ayrılması (39.6)
  const sep = Math.max(0, lt - 4.6),
    bx = W * ilerp(0.18, 0.34, k),
    by = H * ilerp(0.4, 0.46, k),
    ang = 0.95;
  if (sep <= 0) iRocket(bx, by, ang, U * 0.62, 0.15);
  else {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(bx - sep * 26 * U, by + sep * 10 * U);
    ctx.rotate(ang + sep * 0.25);
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, 1 - sep / 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#c5ccdf";
    rrp(-12 * U, -10 * U, 24 * U, 70 * U, 6 * U);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#8e2f26";
    ctx.fillRect(-12 * U, 40 * U, 24 * U, 6 * U);
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    if (sep < 0.5) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,240,210," + (1 - sep / 0.5) + ")";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(bx, by, (18 + sep * 90) * U, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    oCapsule(bx + sep * 20 * U, by - sep * 6 * U, ang + Math.PI * 0.05, U * 1.05, 0);
  }
  iHud(
    [
      [T("EVRE"), sep > 0 ? T("KAPSÜL AYRILDI") : T("DÜNYA YAKLAŞMASI"), sep > 0 ? "#ffd34d" : "#4ade80"],
      [T("DÜNYA'YA UZAKLIK"), fmtN(ilerp(380000, 6400, k), 0) + " km"],
      [T("HIZ"), fmtN(ilerp(9.8, 11.1, k), 1) + " km/s"],
    ],
    W * 0.04,
    H * 0.14,
    U,
  );
}
function oEntry(t, U) {
  // 44–52: atmosfere giriş
  const lt = t - 44,
    k = lt / 8,
    r = Math.max(W, H) * 1.15,
    cy = H * 0.66 + r - ilerp(0, H * 0.22, iease(k));
  if (GLX.ok)
    ctx.drawImage(
      glxSpace({
        time: t,
        milky: 0.5,
        stars: 1 - iclamp((k - 0.5) * 2),
        p1: [W * 0.5, cy, r, 0],
        rot1: 0.8 + lt * 0.01,
        tilt1: 1.1,
        l1: [0.3, 0.65, 0.7],
      }),
      0,
      0,
      W,
      H,
    );
  else {
    iSpace("#010208", "#040812");
    iStars(1 - iclamp((k - 0.5) * 2), 0, 0, true);
    iEarth(W * 0.5, cy, r, 0.8 + lt * 0.01);
  }
  const atm = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, cy - r - H * 0.1, 0, cy - r + H * 0.06);
  atm.addColorStop(0, "rgba(120,190,255,0)");
  atm.addColorStop(1, "rgba(150,210,255,.4)");
  ctx.fillStyle = atm;
  ctx.fillRect(0, cy - r - H * 0.1, W, H * 0.16);
  const pk = iclamp((lt - 0.8) / 2) * (1 - iclamp((lt - 6.6) / 1.2)),
    sh = pk * 6 * U;
  ctx.save();
  if (sh) ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * sh, (Math.random() - 0.5) * sh);
  const rx = W * ilerp(0.24, 0.56, iease(k)),
    ry = H * ilerp(0.14, 0.44, iease(k)),
    ang = Math.atan2(H * 0.3, W * 0.32),
    s = U * 1.5;
  if (pk > 0) {
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
    for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
      const l = (90 + Math.random() * 220) * U * pk,
        o = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 44 * U;
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255," + ((140 + Math.random() * 90) | 0) + ",70," + 0.35 * pk + ")";
      ctx.lineWidth = (1 + Math.random() * 3.2) * U;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(
        rx + Math.cos(ang) * 22 * s - Math.sin(ang) * o,
        ry + Math.sin(ang) * 22 * s + Math.cos(ang) * o,
      );
      ctx.lineTo(
        rx - Math.cos(ang) * l - Math.sin(ang) * o * 1.8,
        ry - Math.sin(ang) * l + Math.cos(ang) * o * 1.8,
      );
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    const hx = rx + Math.cos(ang) * 26 * s,
      hy = ry + Math.sin(ang) * 26 * s,
      g = ctx.createRadialGradient(hx, hy, 0, hx, hy, 100 * U);
    g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,235," + pk + ")");
    g.addColorStop(0.3, "rgba(255,170,80," + 0.75 * pk + ")");
    g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,90,40,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(hx, hy, 100 * U, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
  }
  oCapsule(rx, ry, ang - Math.PI / 2, s, pk);
  ctx.restore();
  if (pk > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,120,60," + 0.12 * pk + ")";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }
  const lost = lt > 3.4 && lt < 7.6;
  iHud(
    [
      [T("EVRE"), T("ATMOSFERE GİRİŞ")],
      [T("HIZ"), fmtN(ilerp(11.1, 0.3, iclamp(lt / 7.5)), 1) + " km/s"],
      [T("ISI KALKANI"), fmtN(ilerp(200, 2700, iclamp(lt / 4)), 0) + " °C", lt > 2.5 ? "#ff8c42" : "#e8f1ff"],
      [T("SİNYAL"), lost ? (Math.sin(t * 8) > 0 ? T("YOK") : "—") : "▮▮▮▯", lost ? "#ff5a5a" : "#4ade80"],
    ],
    W * 0.04,
    H * 0.14,
    U,
  );
}
function oChute(t, U) {
  // 52–59: mavi gökyüzü, bulutlar, paraşütler
  const lt = t - 52,
    k = lt / 7;
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#2f6fb5");
  g.addColorStop(0.6, "#7fb8e8");
  g.addColorStop(1, "#cfe6f7");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  const sun = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.82, H * 0.18, 0, W * 0.82, H * 0.18, H * 0.35);
  sun.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,250,230,.95)");
  sun.addColorStop(0.1, "rgba(255,240,200,.6)");
  sun.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,240,200,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = sun;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  for (const c of intro.clouds) {
    const y = ((((c.y * H * 1.4 - lt * H * 0.09 * c.z * 3) % (H * 1.4)) + H * 1.4) % (H * 1.4)) - H * 0.2,
      x = c.x * W;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + (0.35 + (0.4 * c.z) / 1.3) + ")";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, c.w * W * 0.5 * c.z, c.h * H * c.z, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.ellipse(x + c.w * W * 0.18, y - c.h * H * 0.5, c.w * W * 0.28 * c.z, c.h * H * 1.1 * c.z, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  // okyanus aşağıdan yükselir
  const sea = H * ilerp(1.25, 0.86, iease(iclamp((lt - 3) / 4)));
  if (sea < H) {
    const sg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, sea, 0, H);
    sg.addColorStop(0, "#5b8fb8");
    sg.addColorStop(1, "#0f3a63");
    ctx.fillStyle = sg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, sea, W, H - sea);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.35)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, sea, W, 1.5);
  }
  const open = iclamp((lt - 0.3) / 0.8),
    s = U * 1.25,
    x = W * 0.5 + Math.sin(lt * 1.2) * 12 * U,
    y = H * 0.58 + Math.sin(lt * 1.7) * 5 * U;
  if (lt < 0.5) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + (1 - lt / 0.5) * 0.7 + ")";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.scale(1, ilerp(0.2, 1, open));
  ctx.translate(-x, -y);
  oChutes(x, y, s, t);
  ctx.restore();
  oCapsule(x, y, Math.sin(lt * 1.3) * 0.05, s, 0);
  iHud(
    [
      [T("EVRE"), T("PARAŞÜTLER AÇIK"), "#4ade80"],
      [T("İRTİFA"), fmtN(ilerp(3000, 40, k), 0) + " m"],
      [T("İNİŞ HIZI"), fmtN(ilerp(32, 7.5, iclamp(lt / 2)), 1) + " m/s"],
      [T("SİNYAL"), "▮▮▮▮", "#4ade80"],
    ],
    W * 0.04,
    H * 0.14,
    U,
  );
}
function oSplash(t, U) {
  // 59–68: gün batımında okyanus
  const lt = t - 59;
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#1c2246");
  g.addColorStop(0.35, "#7b3f63");
  g.addColorStop(0.58, "#f08a4b");
  g.addColorStop(0.62, "#ffc27a");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  const hy = H * 0.6,
    sx = W * 0.3;
  const sun = ctx.createRadialGradient(sx, hy - 6 * U, 0, sx, hy, H * 0.4);
  sun.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,245,210,1)");
  sun.addColorStop(0.07, "rgba(255,215,150,.9)");
  sun.addColorStop(0.3, "rgba(255,150,90,.3)");
  sun.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,150,90,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = sun;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,240,200,.9)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(sx, hy - 2 * U, 22 * U, Math.PI, 0);
  ctx.fill();
  const sg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, hy, 0, H);
  sg.addColorStop(0, "#c76a4f");
  sg.addColorStop(0.25, "#3a3358");
  sg.addColorStop(1, "#0b1022");
  ctx.fillStyle = sg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, hy, W, H - hy);
  // güneş yansıması + dalgalar
  for (let i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
    const yy = hy + Math.pow(i / 70, 1.6) * (H - hy),
      w = (8 + i * 1.6) * U * (0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(t * 2 + i)),
      xx = sx + Math.sin(t * 1.3 + i * 1.7) * i * 0.8 * U;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,200,140," + 0.55 * (1 - i / 70) + ")";
    ctx.fillRect(xx - w / 2, yy, w, 1.3 * U);
  }
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.08)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
    const yy = hy + Math.pow(i / 26, 1.7) * (H - hy);
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += 24) {
      const y2 = yy + Math.sin(x * 0.02 + t * 1.4 + i) * (1 + i * 0.15) * U;
      x ? ctx.lineTo(x, y2) : ctx.moveTo(x, y2);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  // kurtarma gemisi
  const shx = W * ilerp(1.08, 0.78, iease(iclamp((lt - 1) / 7))),
    shy = hy + 4 * U;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#141a2c";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(shx - 70 * U, shy);
  ctx.lineTo(shx + 66 * U, shy);
  ctx.lineTo(shx + 56 * U, shy + 10 * U);
  ctx.lineTo(shx - 62 * U, shy + 10 * U);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillRect(shx - 30 * U, shy - 16 * U, 34 * U, 16 * U);
  ctx.fillRect(shx - 20 * U, shy - 28 * U, 12 * U, 12 * U);
  ctx.fillRect(shx + 12 * U, shy - 8 * U, 30 * U, 8 * U);
  ctx.fillStyle = Math.sin(t * 4) > 0 ? "#ff5a3c" : "#5a1a10";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(shx - 14 * U, shy - 30 * U, 2 * U, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  // kapsül: suya iniş
  const drop = iclamp(lt / 0.6),
    cx = W * 0.55,
    cy = ilerp(H * 0.3, hy + 20 * U, iease(drop)) + Math.sin(t * 1.6) * 3 * U * drop;
  if (lt < 0.6) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(cx, cy);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1 - drop;
    oChutes(0, 0, U * 1.1, t);
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
  if (lt > 0.55 && lt < 2.4) {
    const sp = (lt - 0.55) / 1.85;
    for (let i = 0; i < 22; i++) {
      const a = -Math.PI * (i / 21),
        d = sp * 90 * U * (0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(i * 7));
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(240,248,255," + (1 - sp) * 0.8 + ")";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx + Math.cos(a) * d, hy + 20 * U + Math.sin(a) * d * (1.2 - sp), (3 + 3 * (1 - sp)) * U, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + (1 - sp) * 0.6 + ")";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2 * U;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, hy + 24 * U, sp * 120 * U, sp * 16 * U, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  oCapsule(cx, cy, Math.sin(t * 1.2) * 0.08 * drop, U * 1.15, 0);
  {
    const wy = cy + 9 * U;
    ctx.fillStyle = sg;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx - 44 * U, wy + 16 * U); // su kapsülün alt kısmını örter
    for (let x = -44; x <= 44; x += 4) ctx.lineTo(cx + x * U, wy + Math.sin(x * 0.18 + t * 3) * 1.6 * U);
    ctx.lineTo(cx + 44 * U, wy + 16 * U);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,210,170,.5)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2 * U;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let x = -44; x <= 44; x += 4) {
      const y = wy + Math.sin(x * 0.18 + t * 3) * 1.6 * U;
      x > -44 ? ctx.lineTo(cx + x * U, y) : ctx.moveTo(cx + x * U, y);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  if (Math.sin(t * 5) > 0.3 && lt > 1) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff3b3b";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy - 26 * U, 2.6 * U, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  iHud(
    [
      [T("EVRE"), T("SUYA İNİŞ"), "#4ade80"],
      [T("KONUM"), T("Pasifik Okyanusu")],
      [T("KURTARMA"), lt < 4 ? T("YOLDA") : T("KAPSÜLE YAKLAŞIYOR")],
    ],
    W * 0.04,
    H * 0.14,
    U,
  );
}
function oTitle(t, U) {
  // 68–72
  const lt = t - 68,
    O = intro.O;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#03040a";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  iStars(0.5, 0, 0, true);
  const a = iclamp(lt / 0.8);
  ctx.globalAlpha = a;
  iText("ARES-1", W / 2, H * 0.4, 13 * U + 4, { al: "center", mono: 1, w: 800, c: "#ff8c42", ls: 8 });
  iText(T("GÖREV TAMAMLANDI"), W / 2, H * 0.4 + 46 * U, 34 * U + 8, {
    al: "center",
    w: 300,
    c: "#ffffff",
    ls: 10,
  });
  iText(
    Tf(`Mars'ta {0} sol · {1} numune · bilim hedefi %{2}`, [O.sol, O.cargo, O.sci]),
    W / 2,
    H * 0.4 + 86 * U,
    12 * U + 4,
    { al: "center", mono: 1, w: 600, c: "#9fb0d4", ls: 2 },
  );
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}
const OGRADE = [
  [11, 41],
  [21, 60],
  [35, 66],
  [44, 5],
  [52, 75],
  [59, 22],
  [68, 85],
  [99, 85],
];
function drawOutro() {
  const t = intro.t,
    U = Math.min(W, H) / 700,
    O = intro.O;
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#000";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  if (t < 11) oLift(t, U);
  else if (t < 21) oOrbit(t, U);
  else if (t < 35) oCruise(t, U);
  else if (t < 44) oEarth(t, U);
  else if (t < 52) oEntry(t, U);
  else if (t < 59) oChute(t, U);
  else if (t < 68) oSplash(t, U);
  else oTitle(t, U);
  if (t >= 10.9 && t < 11.1) intro.parts.length = 0;
  if (t < 68) iPost(OGRADE.find((g) => t < g[0])[1]);
  const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(
    W / 2,
    H / 2,
    Math.min(W, H) * 0.35,
    W / 2,
    H / 2,
    Math.max(W, H) * 0.75,
  );
  vg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
  vg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,.5)");
  ctx.fillStyle = vg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  if (intro.grain && settings.grain !== false) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.04;
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "overlay";
    const pt = ctx.createPattern(intro.grain, "repeat");
    ctx.translate(Math.random() * 160, Math.random() * 160);
    ctx.fillStyle = pt;
    ctx.fillRect(-160, -160, W + 320, H + 320);
    ctx.restore();
  }
  let fb = Math.max(1 - iclamp(t / 1.4), iclamp((t - (OUTRO_LEN - 1.2)) / 1.2));
  for (const b of [11, 21, 35, 44, 68]) fb = Math.max(fb, 1 - Math.min(1, Math.abs(t - b) / 0.55));
  if (fb > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0," + fb + ")";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }
  let fw = 0;
  for (const b of [52, 59.5]) fw = Math.max(fw, 1 - Math.min(1, Math.abs(t - b) / 0.4));
  if (fw > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,250,240," + fw * 0.85 + ")";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }
  const bh = H * 0.085 * iclamp(t / 1.5);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#000";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, bh);
  ctx.fillRect(0, H - bh, W, bh);
  const chp = O.chapters.filter((c) => c[0] <= t).pop();
  if (chp && t < 68) {
    const a = iclamp((t - chp[0] - 0.6) / 0.8) * (1 - iclamp((t - chp[0] - 5.5) / 1));
    if (a > 0) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      iText(chp[1], W * 0.04, bh * 0.62, 12 * U + 5, { mono: 1, w: 800, c: "#5ad1ff" });
      iText(chp[2], W * 0.04 + 28 * U + 8, bh * 0.62, 11 * U + 4, { mono: 1, w: 700, c: "#c9d3ea", ls: 4 });
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
  }
  const cap = O.caps.find((c) => t >= c[0] && t < c[1]);
  if (cap) {
    const a = iclamp((t - cap[0]) * 4) * iclamp((cap[1] - t) * 4),
      n = Math.floor((t - cap[0]) * 42);
    const fs = Math.round((15 * U + 6) * (settings.subs || 1));
    ctx.font = "600 " + fs + "px 'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif";
    const L = iWrap(cap[3], Math.min(W * 0.8, 900));
    let shown = n;
    const baseY = H - bh - fs * 0.9 - (L.length - 1) * fs * 1.35;
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    if (cap[2])
      iText(cap[2], W / 2, baseY - fs * 1.25, Math.round(fs * 0.62), {
        al: "center",
        mono: 1,
        w: 800,
        c: "#5ad1ff",
        ls: 3,
      });
    L.forEach((l, i) => {
      const part = l.slice(0, Math.max(0, shown));
      shown -= l.length + 1;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(0,0,0,.9)";
      ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
      iText(part, W / 2, baseY + i * fs * 1.35, fs, {
        al: "center",
        w: cap[2] ? 600 : 500,
        c: cap[2] === T("KOMUTANIN GÜNLÜĞÜ") ? "#ffe3c9" : "#ffffff",
      });
      ctx.restore();
    });
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
}

/* ---------- çizim yardımcıları ---------- */
const iclamp = (x, a = 0, b = 1) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, x));
const iease = (x) => {
  x = iclamp(x);
  return x < 0.5 ? 2 * x * x : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * x + 2, 2) / 2;
};
const ilerp = (a, b, k) => a + (b - a) * k;
function iStars(a, dx, dy, tw) {
  const t = performance.now() / 1000;
  for (const s of intro.stars) {
    const x = (((s.x * W + dx * s.s) % W) + W) % W,
      y = (((s.y * H + dy * s.s) % H) + H) % H;
    ctx.globalAlpha = a * (tw ? 0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(t * 1.7 + s.tw) : 0.9) * (0.4 + s.s * 0.4);
    ctx.fillStyle = s.c;
    ctx.fillRect(x, y, s.s * 1.3, s.s * 1.3);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}
function iSpace(top, bot) {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, top || "#02030a");
  g.addColorStop(1, bot || "#070b1c");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
}
function iMilky(a) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = a;
  ctx.translate(W * 0.5, H * 0.45);
  ctx.rotate(-0.42);
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -H * 0.22, 0, H * 0.22);
  g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(120,110,200,0)");
  g.addColorStop(0.5, "rgba(170,150,230,.12)");
  g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(120,110,200,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(-W, -H * 0.22, W * 2, H * 0.44);
  ctx.restore();
}
function iSphereBlobs(list, cx, cy, r, rot, draw) {
  for (const b of list) {
    const a = b.lon + rot,
      cz = Math.cos(a);
    if (cz < -0.05) continue;
    const x = cx + r * Math.sin(a) * Math.cos(b.lat),
      y = cy - r * Math.sin(b.lat) * 0.98,
      k = Math.max(0.08, cz) * Math.cos(b.lat);
    draw(b, x, y, k);
  }
}
function iEarth(cx, cy, r, rot) {
  ctx.save();
  const ag = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, r * 0.92, cx, cy, r * 1.2);
  ag.addColorStop(0, "rgba(110,180,255,.6)");
  ag.addColorStop(0.35, "rgba(90,160,255,.22)");
  ag.addColorStop(1, "rgba(90,160,255,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = ag;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, r * 1.2, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, 0, 7);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.clip();
  const og = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx + r * 0.35, cy - r * 0.3, r * 0.1, cx, cy, r);
  og.addColorStop(0, "#3a8fe0");
  og.addColorStop(0.6, "#1d5aa8");
  og.addColorStop(1, "#0b2552");
  ctx.fillStyle = og;
  ctx.fillRect(cx - r, cy - r, r * 2, r * 2);
  ctx.filter = "blur(" + Math.max(0.6, r * 0.004) + "px)";
  iSphereBlobs(intro.cont, cx, cy, r, rot, (b, x, y, k) => {
    ctx.fillStyle = b.col;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, b.rx * r * k, b.ry * r * Math.cos(b.lat) * 0.9 + 1, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  });
  if (r < 260) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(240,248,255,.9)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, cy - r * 0.97, r * 0.5, r * 0.09, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, cy + r * 0.98, r * 0.45, r * 0.07, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  iSphereBlobs(intro.cloud, cx, cy, r, rot * 1.25 + 1, (b, x, y, k) => {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.5)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, b.rx * r * k, b.ry * r, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  });
  ctx.filter = "none";
  // gece tarafı + şehir ışıkları
  const ng = ctx.createLinearGradient(cx - r, 0, cx + r * (r > 260 ? -0.05 : 0.35), 0);
  ng.addColorStop(0, "rgba(1,3,12,.94)");
  ng.addColorStop(0.55, "rgba(1,3,12,.7)");
  ng.addColorStop(1, "rgba(1,3,12,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = ng;
  ctx.fillRect(cx - r, cy - r, r * 2, r * 2);
  iSphereBlobs(intro.cont, cx, cy, r, rot, (b, x, y, k) => {
    if (x > cx - r * (r > 260 ? 0.45 : 0.15)) return;
    const n = 4;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const ox = Math.sin(i * 2.3 + b.lon * 9) * b.rx * r * k * 0.8,
        oy = Math.cos(i * 1.7 + b.lat * 7) * b.ry * r * 0.6;
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,205,120," + (0.5 + 0.3 * Math.sin(i + b.lon)) + ")";

  sh.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,.18)");
  sh.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = sh;
  ctx.fillRect(cx - r, cy - r, r * 2, r * 2);
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(150,210,255,.65)";
  ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, r * 0.012);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, -1.9, 0.7);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}
function iMars(cx, cy, r, rot, lit) {

  ag.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,150,100,.38)");
  ag.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,150,100,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = ag;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, r * 1.1, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, 0, 7);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.clip();
  const og = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx + r * 0.3, cy - r * 0.3, r * 0.1, cx, cy, r);
  og.addColorStop(0, "#e58a52");
  og.addColorStop(0.55, "#b9552a");
  og.addColorStop(1, "#5a2010");
  ctx.fillStyle = og;
  ctx.fillRect(cx - r, cy - r, r * 2, r * 2);
  iSphereBlobs(intro.mspot, cx, cy, r, rot, (b, x, y, k) => {
    ctx.fillStyle = b.d ? "rgba(90,35,18,.42)" : "rgba(240,170,110,.25)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, b.rx * r * k, b.ry * r, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  });
  iSphereBlobs(intro.crat, cx, cy, r, rot, (b, x, y, k) => {
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(70,25,10,.35)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, b.r * r * k, b.r * r, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.stroke();
  });

    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,245,235,.85)";
    ctx.beginPath();

    ng.addColorStop(0.6, "rgba(8,2,2,.35)");
    ng.addColorStop(1, "rgba(8,2,2,0)");

}
function iRocket(x, y, rot, s, flame) {
  ctx.save();

  ctx.restore();
}
function iSmoke(x, y, n, U, o) {
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    if (intro.parts.length > 320) return;
    const d = Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
    intro.parts.push({
      x: x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 20 * U,
      y,
      vx: d * (o.sp || 1) * (60 + Math.random() * 240) * U,
      vy: -(o.up || 1) * (10 + Math.random() * 60) * U,
      r: (12 + Math.random() * 16) * U,
      gr: (26 + Math.random() * 30) * U,
      l: 0,
      m: (o.life || 3) + Math.random() * 2,
      dr: o.dr || 0.7,
      c: o.c || [205, 198, 190],
      a: o.a || 0.5,
    });
  }
}
function iParts2D() {
  for (const q of intro.parts) {
    const k = q.l / q.m;
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${q.c[0]},${q.c[1]},${q.c[2]},${q.a * (1 - k) * Math.min(1, q.l * 4)})`;

    ctx.arc(q.x, q.y, q.r, 0, 7);

}
function iText(txt, x, y, size, o) {
  if (intro && game && game.design && game.design.fx.days !== 214)
    txt = String(txt)
      .replace(/\b214\b/g, game.design.fx.days)
      .replace(/\b213\b/g, game.design.fx.days - 1);
  o = o || {};
  ctx.font =
    (o.w || 600) +
    " " +
    size +
    "px " +
    (o.mono ? "ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace" : "'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif");
  ctx.textAlign = o.al || "left";
  ctx.textBaseline = o.bl || "alphabetic";
  if (o.ls && ctx.letterSpacing !== undefined) ctx.letterSpacing = o.ls + "px";
  if (o.glow) {
    ctx.shadowColor = o.glow;
    ctx.shadowBlur = o.gb || 12;
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = o.c || "#e8f1ff";
  ctx.fillText(txt, x, y);
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  if (ctx.letterSpacing !== undefined) ctx.letterSpacing = "0px";
}
function iWrap(txt, maxW) {
  const words = txt.split(" "),
    L = [];
  let cur = "";
  for (const w of words) {
    const tst = cur ? cur + " " + w : w;
    if (ctx.measureText(tst).width > maxW && cur) {
      L.push(cur);
      cur = w;
    } else cur = tst;
  }
  if (cur) L.push(cur);
  return L;
}
function iHud(lines, x, y, U, col) {
  ctx.save();
  const fs = Math.round(12 * U + 3);
  ctx.font = "700 " + fs + "px ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace";
  const w = Math.max(...lines.map((l) => ctx.measureText(l[0] + "  " + l[1]).width)) + 28,
    h = lines.length * fs * 1.65 + 18;
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(4,10,24,.55)";
  rrp(x, y, w, h, 8);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = col || "rgba(90,209,255,.45)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.stroke();
  lines.forEach((l, i) => {
    iText(l[0], x + 14, y + 14 + fs + i * fs * 1.65, fs, { mono: 1, w: 700, c: "#8d9cc0" });
    iText(l[1], x + w - 14, y + 14 + fs + i * fs * 1.65, fs, {
      mono: 1,
      w: 800,
      al: "right",
      c: l[2] || "#e8f1ff",
    });
  });
  ctx.restore();
}

/* ---------- sahneler ---------- */
function sEarth2D(t, U) {
  // 0–16
  iSpace("#010208", "#04071a");
  iMilky(iclamp(t / 4) * 0.9);
  iStars(iclamp(t / 2.5), -t * 6, 0, true);
  // Mars: uzakta kızıl nokta
  const ma = iclamp((t - 8.5) / 2);
  if (ma > 0) {
    const mx = W * 0.78,
      my = H * 0.26,
      pr = 3 * U + 1.5 * Math.sin(t * 3);
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(mx, my, 0, mx, my, 26 * U);
    g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,120,70," + 0.55 * ma + ")");
    g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,120,70,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(mx, my, 26 * U, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,150,100," + ma + ")";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(mx, my, pr, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = ma;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,180,140,.6)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(mx, my, 14 * U, 0, 7);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(mx + 14 * U, my - 6 * U);
    ctx.lineTo(mx + 46 * U, my - 24 * U);
    ctx.lineTo(mx + 120 * U, my - 24 * U);
    ctx.stroke();
    iText(T("MARS"), mx + 50 * U, my - 30 * U, 12 * U + 4, { mono: 1, w: 800, c: "#ffb38a", ls: 3 });
    iText(T("225 milyon km"), mx + 50 * U, my - 12 * U, 9 * U + 3, { mono: 1, c: "#c99b84" });
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
  // Dünya: alttan yükselir
  const k = iease(t / 9),
    r = Math.max(W, H) * 0.62,
    cy = H + r * 0.98 - ilerp(0, r * 0.42, k);
  iEarth(W * 0.5, cy, r, t * 0.02 + 0.6);
  // gün doğumu parlaması
  const fl = iclamp((t - 4.2) / 2) * (1 - iclamp((t - 12) / 4));
  if (fl > 0) {
    const fx = W * 0.5 + r * 0.42,
      fy = cy - r * 0.9;
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(fx, fy, 0, fx, fy, W * 0.35);
    g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,250,235," + 0.9 * fl + ")");
    g.addColorStop(0.08, "rgba(255,220,170," + 0.35 * fl + ")");
    g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,200,150,0)");
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
  }
  // başlık
  const ta = iclamp((t - 1) / 1.5) * (1 - iclamp((t - 5.5) / 1.2));
  if (ta > 0) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = ta;
    iText(T("ARES PROGRAMI"), W / 2, H * 0.36, 13 * U + 4, {
      al: "center",
      w: 800,
      c: "#9fc9ff",
      ls: 6,
      mono: 1,
    });
    iText("2035", W / 2, H * 0.36 + 44 * U, 40 * U + 8, { al: "center", w: 300, c: "#ffffff", ls: 14 });
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
}
function sControl(t, U) {
  // 16–30
  const lt = t - 16,
    k = lt / 14;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(W / 2, H * 0.55);
  ctx.scale(1 + k * 0.07, 1 + k * 0.07);
  ctx.translate(-W / 2, -H * 0.55);
  const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  bg.addColorStop(0, "#03060f");
  bg.addColorStop(0.6, "#081329");
  bg.addColorStop(1, "#02040a");
  ctx.fillStyle = bg;
  ctx.fillRect(-W * 0.1, -H * 0.1, W * 1.2, H * 1.2);
  // ana ekran
  const sx = W * 0.17,
    sy = H * 0.12,
    sw = W * 0.66,
    sh = H * 0.38;
  const sg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, sy + sh / 2, 10, W / 2, sy + sh / 2, sw * 0.7);
  sg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(60,140,255,.25)");
  sg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(60,140,255,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = sg;
  ctx.fillRect(sx - sw * 0.2, sy - sh * 0.3, sw * 1.4, sh * 1.8);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#051028";
  rrp(sx, sy, sw, sh, 6);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#2b5a9a";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.save();
  rrp(sx, sy, sw, sh, 6);
  ctx.clip();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(90,160,255,.08)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let x = sx; x < sx + sw; x += sw / 24) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, sy);
    ctx.lineTo(x, sy + sh);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (let y = sy; y < sy + sh; y += sh / 12) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(sx, y);
    ctx.lineTo(sx + sw, y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  const ex = sx + sw * 0.2,
    ey = sy + sh * 0.68,
    mx = sx + sw * 0.8,
    my = sy + sh * 0.42;
  iEarth(ex, ey, sh * 0.14, lt * 0.1);
  iMars(mx, my, sh * 0.11, lt * 0.05);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,180,90,.85)";
  ctx.setLineDash([6, 6]);
  ctx.lineDashOffset = -lt * 30;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(ex, ey - sh * 0.16);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(sx + sw * 0.5, sy - sh * 0.15, mx, my - sh * 0.13);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  const u = (lt * 0.08) % 1,
    qx = (1 - u) * (1 - u) * ex + 2 * (1 - u) * u * (sx + sw * 0.5) + u * u * mx,
    qy = (1 - u) * (1 - u) * (ey - sh * 0.16) + 2 * (1 - u) * u * (sy - sh * 0.15) + u * u * (my - sh * 0.13);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(qx, qy, 3, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  const fs = Math.round(11 * U + 3);
  iText(T("ARES-1 · GÖREV PROFİLİ"), sx + 14, sy + fs + 10, fs, { mono: 1, w: 800, c: "#9fc9ff", ls: 2 });
  iText(T("TRANSFER YÖRÜNGESİ · 214 GÜN"), sx + 14, sy + fs * 2 + 16, fs * 0.9, { mono: 1, c: "#6f8ab8" });
  iText(T("MÜRETTEBAT: 1"), sx + sw - 14, sy + fs + 10, fs, { mono: 1, w: 800, c: "#ffd34d", al: "right" });
  if (Math.sin(lt * 4) > -0.2)
    iText(T("● GÖREV ONAYLANDI"), sx + sw - 14, sy + fs * 2 + 16, fs * 0.9, {
      mono: 1,
      w: 800,
      c: "#4ade80",
      al: "right",
    });
  ctx.restore();
  // yan ekranlar
  for (const [x0, col] of [
    [W * 0.02, "#4ade80"],
    [W * 0.86, "#ffb347"],
  ]) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#04101f";
    rrp(x0, H * 0.16, W * 0.12, H * 0.24, 5);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(90,160,255,.35)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = col;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    for (let r = 0; r < 3; r++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let i = 0; i <= 40; i++) {
        const x = x0 + 6 + (i * (W * 0.12 - 12)) / 40,
          y = H * 0.2 + r * H * 0.07 + Math.sin(i * 0.5 + lt * (3 + r) + r) * H * 0.012 * (1 + r * 0.4);
        i ? ctx.lineTo(x, y) : ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      }
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
  // konsol sıraları + insan siluetleri
  const rows = [
    [H * 0.6, 0.62],
    [H * 0.73, 0.8],
    [H * 0.9, 1.05],
  ];
  rows.forEach(([ry, sc], ri) => {
    const n = ri === 2 ? 5 : 7,
      sp = W / (n + 0.3);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#0a1428";
    ctx.fillRect(0, ry, W, H * 0.05 * sc);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#132443";
    ctx.fillRect(0, ry, W, 3 * sc);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const cx = sp * (i + 0.65) + (ri % 2 ? sp * 0.3 : 0),
        mw = 44 * U * sc,
        mh = 28 * U * sc;
      const hx = cx + Math.sin(lt * 0.8 + i * 2 + ri) * 3 * sc,
        hy = ry - mh - 16 * U * sc;
      // kişi
      ctx.fillStyle = "#010309";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(hx, hy, 11 * U * sc, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(hx, ry - 4 * sc, 24 * U * sc, 18 * U * sc, 0, Math.PI, 0);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(90,170,255,.45)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.2 * sc;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(hx, hy, 11 * U * sc, -1.2, 0.5);
      ctx.stroke();
      if ((i + ri) % 3 === 0) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#0a0f1c";
        ctx.lineWidth = 2 * sc;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(hx, hy, 13 * U * sc, Math.PI * 1.1, -0.1 * Math.PI);
        ctx.stroke();
      } // kulaklık
      // monitörler
      for (const off of [-1, 1]) {
        const mx = cx + off * (mw * 0.75),
          my = ry - mh - 4 * sc,
          c = ["#1d6fd8", "#14a36b", "#d98a1d", "#1d6fd8"][(i + ri + (off > 0 ? 1 : 0)) % 4];
        ctx.fillStyle = "#020611";
        rrp(mx - mw / 2, my, mw, mh, 3 * sc);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = c;
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.55 + 0.15 * Math.sin(lt * 2 + i + off);
        rrp(mx - mw / 2 + 2 * sc, my + 2 * sc, mw - 4 * sc, mh - 4 * sc, 2 * sc);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.55)";
        for (let l = 0; l < 3; l++)
          ctx.fillRect(
            mx - mw / 2 + 5 * sc,
            my + 6 * sc + l * 6 * sc,
            (mw - 14 * sc) * (0.4 + 0.5 * Math.abs(Math.sin(i * 3 + l + off + Math.floor(lt * 2)))),
            1.5 * sc,
          );
      }
    }
  });
  ctx.restore();
  const v = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, H * 0.5, 0, H);
  v.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
  v.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,.55)");
  ctx.fillStyle = v;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
}
function sDossier(t, U) {

  iText(T("GİZLİLİK: ÜST DÜZEY"), x0 + cw - 20, y0 + hh * 0.62, fs * 0.85, {
    mono: 1,
    w: 800,

  pg.addColorStop(0, "#16264d");

  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(90,209,255,.3)";
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.save();
  rrp(px, py, pw, ph, 10);
  ctx.clip();
  const sc = Math.min(pw / 70, ph / 120);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(px + pw / 2, py + ph * 0.62);
  ctx.scale(sc, sc);
  try {
    p.walk = 0;
    p.dir = 1;
    p.sx = p.sy = 1;
    astronaut(0, 0, false, null, 0);
  } catch (e) {}
  ctx.restore();
  const scan = py + ((lt * 0.35) % 1) * ph;
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(90,209,255,.22)";
  ctx.fillRect(px, scan, pw, 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(90,209,255,.06)";
  for (let y = py; y < py + ph; y += 4) ctx.fillRect(px, y, pw, 1);
  ctx.restore();
  iText(T("KOMUTAN — SEN"), px + pw / 2, py + ph - fs * 1.9, fs * 0.95, {
    al: "center",
    w: 800,
    c: "#fff",
    ls: 1,
  });
  iText(T("KİMLİK ARES-1/CDR"), px + pw / 2, py + ph - fs * 0.7, fs * 0.75, {
    al: "center",
    mono: 1,
    c: "#8d9cc0",
  });
  // bilgiler
  const ix = px + pw + 26,
    iw = x0 + cw - ix - 22;
  let y = py + fs * 1.2;
  const rows = [
    [T("GÖREV"), T("ARES-1 · Mars yüzey keşfi")],
    [T("MÜRETTEBAT"), T("1 kişi — Komutan (sen)")],
    [T("ARAÇ"), T("ARES-1 iniş ve dönüş roketi · 3 güverte")],
    [T("YOLCULUK"), T("≈ 214 gün · 225 milyon km")],
    [T("HEDEF"), T("Mars · ekvator ovası")],
    [T("YER BİRİMİ"), T("Görev Kontrol · 3 yer istasyonu")],
  ];
  const goals = [
    T("Atmosferi, toprağı ve radyasyonu ölç, verileri topla"),
    T("Su, oksijen ve tarımla yaşam koşullarını test et"),
    T("Fırtına, radyasyon ve meteor gibi tehlikeleri raporla"),
    T("Tüm bulguları iletişim terminalinden Dünya'ya aktar"),
  ];
  const show = (i, k) => iclamp((lt - 0.8 - i * 0.55) * k);
  rows.forEach((r, i) => {
    const a = show(i, 3);
    if (a <= 0) return;
    ctx.globalAlpha = ap * a;
    iText(r[0], ix, y, fs * 0.78, { mono: 1, w: 800, c: "#5ad1ff", ls: 1 });
    const full = r[1],
      n = Math.floor(full.length * iclamp((lt - 0.8 - i * 0.55) * 2.2));
    iText(full.slice(0, n), ix + iw * 0.3, y, fs, { w: 600, c: "#fff" });
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(141,156,192,.18)";
    ctx.fillRect(ix, y + fs * 0.6, iw, 1);
    y += fs * 1.85;
  });
  y += fs * 0.5;
  const ga = show(6, 3);
  if (ga > 0) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = ap * ga;
    iText(T("GÖREV AMAÇLARI"), ix, y, fs * 0.78, { mono: 1, w: 800, c: "#ff8c42", ls: 2 });
    y += fs * 1.6;
    goals.forEach((g, i) => {
      const a = show(6.6 + i * 0.75, 2.5);
      if (a <= 0) return;
      ctx.globalAlpha = ap * a;
      iText("▸", ix, y, fs, { c: "#ff8c42", w: 800 });
      ctx.font = "600 " + fs + "px 'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif";
      const L = iWrap(g, iw - fs * 1.6);
      L.forEach((l, j) => iText(l, ix + fs * 1.4, y + j * fs * 1.3, fs, { c: "#dfe7f8" }));
      y += fs * 1.3 * L.length + fs * 0.45;
    });
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = ap;
  // mühür
  const st = lt - 7.5;
  if (st > 0) {
    const s = Math.max(1, 2.4 - st * 9),
      a = iclamp(st * 8);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x0 + cw - cw * 0.17, y0 + ch - ch * 0.2);
    ctx.rotate(-0.2);
    ctx.scale(s, s);
    ctx.globalAlpha = a * ap * 0.92;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#ff4d4d";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3.5;
    rrp(-fs * 6, -fs * 1.5, fs * 12, fs * 3, 6);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    rrp(-fs * 5.6, -fs * 1.15, fs * 11.2, fs * 2.3, 4);
    ctx.stroke();
    iText(T("ONAYLANDI"), 0, fs * 0.55, fs * 1.55, { al: "center", w: 900, c: "#ff4d4d", ls: 4 });

function sLaunch(t, U) {
  // 40–57
  const lt = t - 40,
    G = H * 0.8,
    s = U * 2.25,
    ig = t >= 52,
    lift = t >= 53.5,
    lu = t - 53.5;
  const shake = ig ? Math.min(1, (t - 52) / 1.5) * (lift ? Math.max(0.3, 1 - lu / 4) : 1) * 7 * U : 0;
  ctx.save();
  if (shake) ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake);
  const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, G);
  sky.addColorStop(0, "#060d24");
  sky.addColorStop(0.45, "#1f3466");
  sky.addColorStop(0.8, "#b5694f");
  sky.addColorStop(1, "#f6a466");
  ctx.fillStyle = sky;
  ctx.fillRect(-20, -20, W + 40, G + 20);
  iStars(0.5 * (1 - iclamp(lt / 10)), 0, 0, true);
  const sun = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.82, G, 0, W * 0.82, G, H * 0.5);
  sun.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,230,180,.85)");
  sun.addColorStop(0.15, "rgba(255,170,100,.35)");
  sun.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,140,90,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = sun;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, G);
  // uzak kıyı
  ctx.fillStyle = "#1b1c33";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-20, G);
  for (let x = 0; x <= W + 20; x += W / 16)
    ctx.lineTo(x, G - H * 0.03 - Math.abs(Math.sin(x * 0.013)) * H * 0.025);
  ctx.lineTo(W + 20, G);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  const gr = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, G, 0, H);
  gr.addColorStop(0, "#272a3e");
  gr.addColorStop(1, "#0d0e18");
  ctx.fillStyle = gr;
  ctx.fillRect(-20, G, W + 40, H - G + 20);
  const rx = W * 0.5,
    ry = G - 46 * s - (lift ? lu * lu * H * 0.085 + lu * 12 * U : 0);
  // kule
  const tx = rx - 62 * s,
    tw = 22 * s,
    th = 170 * s;
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#3a3f5c";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.strokeRect(tx - tw / 2, G - th, tw, th);
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let y = G; y > G - th; y -= tw) {
    ctx.moveTo(tx - tw / 2, y);
    ctx.lineTo(tx + tw / 2, y - tw);
    ctx.moveTo(tx + tw / 2, y);
    ctx.lineTo(tx - tw / 2, y - tw);
  }
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff5a5a";
  if (Math.sin(t * 4) > 0) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(tx, G - th - 4, 3, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  const arm = iclamp((t - 50.5) / 1.4);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#4b5070";
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(tx + tw / 2, G - th * 0.68);
  ctx.rotate(-arm * 1.1);
  ctx.fillRect(0, -3 * s, rx - tx - tw / 2 - 24 * s, 6 * s);
  ctx.restore();
  // rampa
  ctx.fillStyle = "#3a3e57";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(rx - 70 * s, G);
  ctx.lineTo(rx - 50 * s, G - 10 * s);
  ctx.lineTo(rx + 50 * s, G - 10 * s);
  ctx.lineTo(rx + 70 * s, G);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#14151f";
  ctx.fillRect(rx - 24 * s, G - 10 * s, 48 * s, 10 * s);
  // duman
  if (ig && Math.random() < 0.95) {
    iSmoke(rx, G - 6 * s, lift ? 3 : 5, U, { sp: lift ? 0.7 : 1.2, up: 0.6, life: 3.5 });
    if (lift && lu < 3) iSmoke(rx, ry + 60 * s, 2, U, { sp: 0.25, up: -0.2, life: 2.5, a: 0.4 });
  }
  // roket + alev
  const fl = ig ? Math.min(1.15, (t - 52) * 0.6 + (lift ? 0.4 : 0)) : 0;
  if (fl > 0) {
    const gx = rx,
      gy = ry + 70 * s,
      R = (70 + fl * 70) * U;
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(gx, gy, 0, gx, gy, R * 2.2);
    g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,240,200," + 0.8 * Math.min(1, fl) + ")");
    g.addColorStop(0.2, "rgba(255,160,80,.45)");
    g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,120,60,0)");
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(gx - R * 2.2, gy - R * 2.2, R * 4.4, R * 4.4);
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";

    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,190,120," + 0.18 * Math.min(1, fl) + ")";
    ctx.fillRect(-20, -20, W + 40, H + 40);
  }
  ctx.restore();
  // geri sayım
  if (t >= 42 && t < 53.5) {
    const n = 10 - Math.floor(t - 42),
      k = (t - 42) % 1;
    ctx.save();
    if (n >= 1) {
      const sz = (76 + Math.max(0, 0.25 - k) * 120) * U;
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1 - Math.max(0, k - 0.75) * 3;
      iText(T("KALKIŞA"), W / 2, H * 0.2, 12 * U + 4, { al: "center", mono: 1, w: 800, c: "#ffb38a", ls: 6 });
      iText("T–" + String(n).padStart(2, "0"), W / 2, H * 0.2 + sz * 0.95, sz, {
        al: "center",
        w: 300,
        c: "#ffffff",
        ls: 6,
        glow: "rgba(255,140,80,.8)",
        gb: 20,
        mono: 1,
      });
    } else {
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, (t - 52) * 4);
      iText(T("ATEŞLEME"), W / 2, H * 0.28, 44 * U + 6, {
        al: "center",
        w: 800,
        c: "#ffd34d",
        ls: 12,
        glow: "#ff8c42",
        gb: 24,
      });
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
  if (lift && lu < 2.6) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, lu * 3) * (1 - iclamp((lu - 2) / 0.6));
    iText(T("KALKIŞ"), W / 2, H * 0.28, 44 * U + 6, {
      al: "center",
      w: 800,
      c: "#fff",
      ls: 14,
      glow: "#5ad1ff",
      gb: 24,
    });
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
  if (t >= 42 && t < 53.5)
    iHud(
      [
        [T("ARAÇ"), "ARES-1"],
        [T("YAKIT"), "%100", "#4ade80"],
        [T("RÜZGÂR"), T("6 km/sa")],
        [T("DURUM"), t < 52 ? T("HAZIR") : T("ATEŞLEME"), t < 52 ? "#4ade80" : "#ffd34d"],
      ],
      W * 0.04,
      H * 0.14,
      U,
    );
}
function sAscent(t, U) {

  const lt = t - 57,

      glxSpace({
        time: t,
        milky: 0.4,
        stars: 0.8,
        p1: [W * 0.5, H * 0.98 + er - ilerp(0, H * 0.42, iease((k - 0.5) * 2)), er, 0],
        rot1: 0.9 + lt * 0.01,

        x = (i * 311) % W;
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + 0.5 * ca + ")";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(x, y, (90 + (i % 4) * 40) * U, (14 + (i % 3) * 6) * U, 0, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();

  }

  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.25)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;

    const x = (i * 97) % W,

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(rx, ry + 60 * s, (30 + d * 120) * U, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
    }

      [T("HIZ"), fmtN(0.4 + k * 7.4, 1) + " km/s"],
      [
        T("EVRE"),
        lt < 1.4 ? "MAX-Q" : lt < 3.1 ? T("YÜKSELİŞ") : lt < 3.9 ? T("KADEME AYRILMASI") : T("YÖRÜNGE"),
        lt >= 3.1 && lt < 3.9 ? "#ffd34d" : "#4ade80",
      ],
    ],
    W * 0.04,
    H * 0.14,
    U,
  );
}
function sCruise(t, U) {

        l1: [0.8, 0.3, 0.5],
        p2: [mx, my, mr, 1],
        rot2: lt * 0.04 + 1.2,
        l2: [-0.6, 0.3, 0.72],
      }),

      0,

    cy = H * 0.06,

      x: (1 - u) * (1 - u) * ex + 2 * (1 - u) * u * cx + u * u * mx,

    });

  ctx.setLineDash([5, 7]);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,180,90,.4)";

    mono: 1,
    w: 300,
    c: "#fff",

      [T("HIZ"), "24,1 km/s"],

    H * 0.14,

  iText(T("MARS"), mx, my + mr + 22 * U, 10 * U + 4, { al: "center", mono: 1, w: 800, c: "#ffb38a", ls: 3 });

function sEntry(t, U) {
  // 72–79
  const lt = t - 72,
    k = lt / 7;
  const r = Math.max(W, H) * 1.15,
    cy = H * 0.62 + r - ilerp(0, H * 0.25, iease(k));
  if (GLX.ok)
    ctx.drawImage(
      glxSpace({
        time: t,
        milky: 0.6,
        stars: 1 - iclamp((k - 0.5) * 2),
        p1: [W * 0.55, cy, r, 1],
        rot1: 0.4 + lt * 0.01,
        tilt1: 1.1,
        l1: [0.35, 0.6, 0.72],
      }),
      0,
      0,
      W,
      H,
    );
  else {
    iSpace("#010208", "#0a0408");
    iStars(1 - iclamp((k - 0.5) * 2), 0, 0, true);
    iMars(W * 0.55, cy, r, 0.4 + lt * 0.01, false);
  }
  if (!GLX.ok) {
    const atm = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, cy - r - H * 0.12, 0, cy - r + H * 0.05);
    atm.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,150,100,0)");
    atm.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,170,120,.35)");
    ctx.fillStyle = atm;
    ctx.fillRect(0, cy - r - H * 0.12, W, H * 0.17);
  }
  const pk = iclamp((lt - 1.4) / 2) * (1 - iclamp((lt - 6) / 1)),
    sh = pk * 5 * U;
  ctx.save();
  if (sh) ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * sh, (Math.random() - 0.5) * sh);
  const rx = W * ilerp(0.18, 0.56, iease(k)),
    ry = H * ilerp(0.1, 0.42, iease(k)),
    ang = Math.atan2(H * 0.32, W * 0.38),
    s = U * 1.15;
  if (pk > 0) {
    // plazma kılıfı
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
    for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
      const l = (80 + Math.random() * 200) * U * pk,
        o = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 36 * U;
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255," + ((130 + Math.random() * 90) | 0) + ",60," + 0.35 * pk + ")";
      ctx.lineWidth = (1 + Math.random() * 3) * U;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(
        rx + Math.cos(ang) * 40 * s - Math.sin(ang) * o,
        ry + Math.sin(ang) * 40 * s + Math.cos(ang) * o,

      ctx.lineTo(
        rx - Math.cos(ang) * l - Math.sin(ang) * o * 1.8,

      );
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(
      rx + Math.cos(ang) * 70 * s,
      ry + Math.sin(ang) * 70 * s,
      0,
      rx + Math.cos(ang) * 70 * s,
      ry + Math.sin(ang) * 70 * s,
      90 * U,
    );
    g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,230," + pk + ")");
    g.addColorStop(0.3, "rgba(255,170,80," + 0.7 * pk + ")");
    g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,90,40,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(rx + Math.cos(ang) * 70 * s, ry + Math.sin(ang) * 70 * s, 90 * U, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();

  }

      [T("HIZ"), fmtN(ilerp(5.8, 1.2, k), 1) + " km/s"],
      [T("ISI KALKANI"), fmtN(ilerp(200, 1600, iclamp(lt / 4.5)), 0) + " °C", lt > 3 ? "#ff8c42" : "#e8f1ff"],
      [T("SİNYAL"), lost ? (Math.sin(t * 8) > 0 ? T("YOK") : "—") : "▮▮▮▯", lost ? "#ff5a5a" : "#4ade80"],
    ],
    W * 0.04,
    H * 0.14,
    U,

}
function sLand2D(t, U) {
  // 79–92
