    G = H * 0.78;
  const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, G);
  sky.addColorStop(0, "#5e3a2c");
  sky.addColorStop(0.6, "#c48a62");
  sky.addColorStop(1, "#e8bf94");
  ctx.fillStyle = sky;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, G);
  const sun = ctx.createRadialGradient(W * 0.2, H * 0.2, 0, W * 0.2, H * 0.2, H * 0.3);
  sun.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,245,230,.9)");
  sun.addColorStop(0.06, "rgba(255,235,210,.5)");
  sun.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,220,190,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = sun;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, G);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#a35a38";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, G);
  for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += W / 20)
    ctx.lineTo(
      x,
      G - H * 0.07 - Math.abs(Math.sin(x * 0.008 + 1)) * H * 0.06 - Math.sin(x * 0.03) * H * 0.01,
    );
  ctx.lineTo(W, G);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#8a4426";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, G);
  for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += W / 24)
    ctx.lineTo(x, G - H * 0.025 - Math.abs(Math.sin(x * 0.017 + 3)) * H * 0.03);
  ctx.lineTo(W, G);
  ctx.fill();
  const gg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, G, 0, H);
  gg.addColorStop(0, "#b8673a");
  gg.addColorStop(1, "#6e3218");
  ctx.fillStyle = gg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, G, W, H - G);
  for (const r of intro.rocks) {
    const x = r.x * W,
      y = G + 8 + r.k * (H - G - 8),
      sz = (3 + r.s * 9) * U * (0.5 + r.k);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#5e2a14";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, sz * 1.4, sz * 0.7, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,200,160,.25)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x - sz * 0.3, y - sz * 0.25, sz * 0.6, sz * 0.25, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  const s = U * 2,
    TD = 3.5,
    u = iclamp(lt / TD),
    rest = G - 34 * s - 8 * U,
    ry = ilerp(-H * 0.25, rest, 1 - Math.pow(1 - u, 2.2)),
    rx = W * 0.52;
  const fl = lt < TD ? 0.95 : Math.max(0, 0.95 - (lt - TD) * 1.2);
  if (lt > 1.8 && lt < TD + 0.6)
    iSmoke(rx, G, lt > TD - 0.4 ? 6 : 2, U, {
      sp: 1.6,
      up: 0.35,
      life: 3,
      c: [200, 130, 90],
      a: 0.45,
      dr: 0.9,
    });
  if (!intro.td && lt >= TD) {
    intro.td = true;
    iSmoke(rx, G, 50, U, { sp: 2.2, up: 0.6, life: 4.5, c: [190, 120, 80], a: 0.55, dr: 1 });
  }
  const sh = lt > TD - 0.3 && lt < TD + 0.8 ? 6 * U : 0;
  ctx.save();
  if (sh) ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * sh, (Math.random() - 0.5) * sh);
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(40,15,5," + 0.35 * u + ")";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(rx, G + 4 * U, (30 + 40 * u) * s * 0.6, 8 * U, 0, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  if (fl > 0) {
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(rx, G, 0, rx, G, 120 * U);
    g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,220,160," + 0.6 * fl + ")");
    g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,160,90,0)");
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(rx - 120 * U, G - 120 * U, 240 * U, 240 * U);
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
  }
  iRocket(rx, ry, 0, s, fl);
  iParts();
  ctx.restore();
  const haze = lt > TD ? Math.max(0, 0.45 - (lt - TD) * 0.07) : 0;
  if (haze > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(200,140,100," + haze + ")";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }
  if (lt < TD + 2.6) {
    const alt = Math.max(0, Math.round(ilerp(140, 0, 1 - Math.pow(1 - u, 2.2))));
    iHud(
      lt < TD
        ? [
            [T("EVRE"), T("GÜÇLÜ İNİŞ")],
            [T("İRTİFA"), alt + " m"],
            [T("DİKEY HIZ"), fmtN(Math.max(0, (1 - u) * 24), 1) + " m/s"],
          ]
        : [
            [T("EVRE"), T("TEMAS")],
            [T("İNİŞ"), T("BAŞARILI"), "#4ade80"],
            [T("KONUM"), T("Mars · ekvator ovası")],
            [T("SİNYAL"), T("İSTASYON A · ALINDI"), "#4ade80"],
          ],
      W * 0.04,
      H * 0.14,
      U,
      lt >= TD ? "rgba(74,222,128,.6)" : null,
    );
  }
  // başlık kartı
  iTitleCard(t, U);
}
/* ---------- ana çizim ---------- */
function drawIntro() {
  if (!intro) return;
  if (intro.outro) {
    drawOutro();
    return;
  }
  const t = intro.t,
    U = Math.min(W, H) / 700;
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#000";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  if (t < 16) sEarth(t, U);
  else if (t < 30) sControl(t, U);
  else if (t < 40) sDossier(t, U);
  else if (t < 57) sLaunch(t, U);
  else if (t < 62) sAscent(t, U);
  else if (t < 72) sCruise(t, U);
  else if (t < 79) sEntry(t, U);
  else sLand(t, U);
  if ((t >= 56.4 && t < 57) || (t >= 62 && t < 62.05)) intro.parts.length = 0;
  iPost(t);
  // vinyet
  const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(
    W / 2,
    H / 2,
    Math.min(W, H) * 0.35,
    W / 2,
    H / 2,
    Math.max(W, H) * 0.75,
  );
  vg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
  vg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,.55)");
  ctx.fillStyle = vg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  // gren
  if (intro.grain && settings.grain !== false) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.045;
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "overlay";
    const pt = ctx.createPattern(intro.grain, "repeat");
    ctx.translate(Math.random() * 160, Math.random() * 160);
    ctx.fillStyle = pt;
    ctx.fillRect(-160, -160, W + 320, H + 320);
    ctx.restore();
  }
  // geçişler
  let fb = Math.max(1 - iclamp(t / 1.6), iclamp((t - (INTRO_LEN - 1.2)) / 1.2));
  for (const b of [16, 30, 40, 62, 72]) fb = Math.max(fb, 1 - Math.min(1, Math.abs(t - b) / 0.55));
  if (fb > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0," + fb + ")";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }
  let fw = 0;
  for (const b of [57, 79]) fw = Math.max(fw, 1 - Math.min(1, Math.abs(t - b) / 0.4));
  if (fw > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,248,236," + fw + ")";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }
  // sinema şeritleri
  const bh = H * 0.085 * iclamp(t / 1.5);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#000";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, bh);
  ctx.fillRect(0, H - bh, W, bh);
  // bölüm etiketi
  const chp = IC.chapters.filter((c) => c[0] <= t).pop();
  if (chp) {
    const a = iclamp((t - chp[0] - 0.6) / 0.8) * (1 - iclamp((t - chp[0] - 5.5) / 1));
    if (a > 0) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      iText(chp[1], W * 0.04, bh * 0.62, 12 * U + 5, { mono: 1, w: 800, c: "#ff8c42" });
      iText(chp[2], W * 0.04 + 28 * U + 8, bh * 0.62, 11 * U + 4, { mono: 1, w: 700, c: "#c9d3ea", ls: 4 });
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
  }
  // altyazı
  const cap = IC.caps.find((c) => t >= c[0] && t < c[1]);
  if (cap) {
    const a = iclamp((t - cap[0]) * 4) * iclamp((cap[1] - t) * 4),
      n = Math.floor((t - cap[0]) * 42),
      txt = cap[3].slice(0, n);
    const fs = Math.round((15 * U + 6) * (settings.subs || 1));
    ctx.font = "600 " + fs + "px 'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif";
    const L = iWrap(cap[3], Math.min(W * 0.8, 900));
    let shown = n;
    const baseY = H - bh - fs * 0.9 - (L.length - 1) * fs * 1.35;
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    if (cap[2])
      iText(cap[2], W / 2, baseY - fs * 1.25, Math.round(fs * 0.62), {
        al: "center",
        mono: 1,
        w: 800,
        c: "#5ad1ff",
        ls: 3,
      });
    L.forEach((l, i) => {
      const part = l.slice(0, Math.max(0, shown));
      shown -= l.length + 1;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(0,0,0,.9)";
      ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
      iText(part, W / 2, baseY + i * fs * 1.35, fs, {
        al: "center",
        w: cap[2] ? 600 : 500,
        c: cap[2] === T("KOMUTANIN GÜNLÜĞÜ") ? "#ffe3c9" : "#ffffff",
      });
      ctx.restore();
    });
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    void txt;
  }
}

/* ============== ANA MENÜ — gerçekçi Mars manzarası ==============
   Arazi bir kez prosedürel olarak (piksel piksel gürültü + ışıklandırma)
   ayrı katmanlara pişirilir; her karede sadece katmanlar paralaksla
   çizilir, üstüne canlı öğeler (güneş halesi, Phobos, toz, toz şeytanı,
   roketin işaret ışığı) eklenir. */
const MB = { baked: null, bakeT: 0, mx: 0, my: 0, tx: 0, ty: 0, motes: [] };
function mbHash(i, j, s) {
  let n = (i * 374761393 + j * 668265263 + s * 982451653) | 0;
  n = Math.imul(n ^ (n >>> 13), 1274126177);
  return ((n ^ (n >>> 16)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
}
function mbNoise(x, y, s, P) {
  const xi = Math.floor(x),
    yi = Math.floor(y),
    u = x - xi,
    v = y - yi,
    fu = u * u * (3 - 2 * u),
    fv = v * v * (3 - 2 * v);
  const w = P ? (a) => ((a % P) + P) % P : (a) => a;
  const a = mbHash(w(xi), w(yi), s),
    b = mbHash(w(xi + 1), w(yi), s),
    c = mbHash(w(xi), w(yi + 1), s),
    d = mbHash(w(xi + 1), w(yi + 1), s);
  return a + (b - a) * fu + (c - a) * fv + (a - b - c + d) * fu * fv;
}
function mbFbm(x, y, o, s, P) {
  let t = 0,
    a = 0.5,
    f = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < o; i++) {
    t += a * mbNoise(x * f, y * f, s + i * 17, P ? P * f : 0);
    a *= 0.5;
    f *= 2;
  }
  return t / (1 - Math.pow(0.5, o));
}
function mbRidge(x, y, o, s) {
  let t = 0,
    a = 0.5,
    f = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < o; i++) {
    t += a * (1 - Math.abs(2 * mbNoise(x * f, y * f, s + i * 31) - 1));
    a *= 0.5;
    f *= 2;
  }
  return t / (1 - Math.pow(0.5, o));
}
const mbMix = (a, b, k) => [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * k, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * k, a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * k];
const mbC = (x) => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, x));
function mbCanvas(w, h) {
  const c = document.createElement("canvas");
  c.width = Math.max(1, w | 0);
  c.height = Math.max(1, h | 0);
  return c;
}

function bakeMenu() {
  const q = Math.min(1, 1000 / Math.max(W, 1)),
    M = 26,
    w = Math.round((W + M * 2) * q),
    h = Math.round((H + M * 2) * q);
  const HY = Math.round(h * 0.6),
    SX = Math.round(w * 0.83),
    SY = HY - Math.round(h * 0.07);
  const sky = [
      [13, 17, 30],
      [42, 34, 40],
      [118, 78, 58],
      [196, 146, 108],
    ],
    HAZE = [198, 150, 112];
  const B = { q, M, w, h, HY, SX, SY };
  /* --- gökyüzü (düşük çözünürlük, yumuşak) --- */
  {
    const sw = Math.ceil(w / 3),
      sh = Math.ceil(HY / 3) + 2,
      c = mbCanvas(sw, sh),
      g = c.getContext("2d"),
      im = g.createImageData(sw, sh),
      D = im.data;
    for (let y = 0; y < sh; y++) {
      const k = y / (sh - 1);
      const base =
        k < 0.45
          ? mbMix(sky[0], sky[1], k / 0.45)
          : k < 0.8
            ? mbMix(sky[1], sky[2], (k - 0.45) / 0.35)
            : mbMix(sky[2], sky[3], (k - 0.8) / 0.2);
      for (let x = 0; x < sw; x++) {
        const dx = (x * 3 - SX) / w,
          dy = (y * 3 - SY) / h,
          dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx * 1.2 + dy * dy * 2.2);
        const blue = Math.exp(-dist * 7.5) * 0.75,
          warm = Math.exp(-dist * 2.6) * 0.35; // Mars gün batımı: güneş çevresi mavi hale
        const band = (mbFbm((x / sw) * 6, (y / sh) * 14, 4, 3) - 0.5) * 0.1 * k; // ince toz katmanları
        let c0 = mbMix(base, [214, 170, 128], warm);
        c0 = mbMix(c0, [150, 190, 228], blue);
        const i = (y * sw + x) * 4;
        D[i] = c0[0] * (1 + band);
        D[i + 1] = c0[1] * (1 + band);
        D[i + 2] = c0[2] * (1 + band);
        D[i + 3] = 255;
      }
    }
    g.putImageData(im, 0, 0);
    B.sky = c;
  }
  /* --- uzak sıradağ (krater kenarı) --- */
  const profFar = new Float32Array(w),
    profMid = new Float32Array(w);
  for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
    const xn = x / w;
    const big =
      Math.exp(-Math.pow((xn - 0.3) / 0.16, 2)) * 0.09 + Math.exp(-Math.pow((xn - 0.93) / 0.1, 2)) * 0.05; // geniş volkan omuzları
    profFar[x] =
      HY -
      h *
        (0.03 +
          big +
          0.07 * Math.pow(mbFbm(xn * 2.1 + 7, 0.5, 5, 11), 1.8) +
          0.03 * mbRidge(xn * 6 + 2, 0.3, 4, 13));
    const pl = mbFbm(xn * 3.3 + 40, 1.5, 5, 21);
    const mesa = mbC((mbFbm(xn * 2.6 + 3, 2.2, 3, 27) - 0.5) * 9) * 0.035;
    profMid[x] =
      HY -
      h * (0.006 + mesa + 0.04 * Math.pow(mbC((pl - 0.32) * 1.6), 1.3) + 0.01 * mbRidge(xn * 11, 0.7, 3, 23));
  }
  const layer = (prof, seed, col, dark, hazeK, bottom) => {
    const c = mbCanvas(w, bottom + 2),
      g = c.getContext("2d"),
      im = g.createImageData(w, bottom + 2),
      D = im.data;
    for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
      const top = Math.floor(prof[x]),
        sl = (prof[Math.min(w - 1, x + 2)] - prof[Math.max(0, x - 2)]) / 4; // eğim: + → sağa iniyor (güneşe bakan)
      for (let y = Math.max(0, top); y <= bottom; y++) {
        const n = mbFbm((x / w) * 38, (y / h) * 30, 4, seed),
          gul = mbRidge((x / w) * 60, (y / h) * 12, 3, seed + 5);
        const depth = (y - top) / Math.max(8, bottom - top);
        let lit = 0.62 + sl * 2.2 + (n - 0.5) * 0.55 - gul * 0.18 + (1 - depth) * 0.08;
        lit = Math.max(0.25, Math.min(1.25, lit));
        let c0 = mbMix(dark, col, mbC(lit - 0.2));
        c0 = [c0[0] * lit, c0[1] * lit, c0[2] * lit];
        const hz =
          hazeK * (1 - mbC((HY - y) / (h * 0.12)) * 0.25) +
          (y > HY - h * 0.012 ? mbC((y - (HY - h * 0.012)) / (h * 0.012)) * 0.5 : 0);
        c0 = mbMix(c0, HAZE, mbC(hz));
        const i = (y * w + x) * 4,
          edge = y === top ? mbC(prof[x] - top === 0 ? 1 : 1 - (prof[x] - top)) : 1;
        D[i] = c0[0];
        D[i + 1] = c0[1];
        D[i + 2] = c0[2];
        D[i + 3] = 255 * edge;
      }
    }
    g.putImageData(im, 0, 0);
    return c;
  };
  B.far = layer(profFar, 31, [176, 112, 82], [96, 56, 44], 0.55, HY);
  B.mid = layer(profMid, 41, [150, 78, 44], [66, 30, 20], 0.22, HY);
  /* --- zemin: perspektifli doku + kum dalgaları + ışıklandırma --- */
  {
    const gh = h - HY,
      c = mbCanvas(w, gh),
      g = c.getContext("2d"),
      im = g.createImageData(w, gh),
      D = im.data;
    const height = (u, v) => {
      const b = mbFbm(u * 0.55, v * 0.55, 5, 51),
        dn = Math.sin((u * 1.3 + v * 0.45) * 5.2 + mbFbm(u * 0.25, v * 0.25, 3, 57) * 7);
      return b * 0.9 + 0.16 * dn * mbC(mbFbm(u * 0.18 + 3, v * 0.18, 3, 59) * 1.8 - 0.55);
    };
    for (let y = 0; y < gh; y++) {
      const d = (y + 0.5) / gh,
        z = 1 / (d + 0.035),
        fog = Math.pow(mbC(1 - d * 3.2), 1.5) * 0.85;
      for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
        const u = (x / w - 0.5) * z * 2.1,
          v = z * 0.9,
          e = 0.035 * Math.max(0.4, z * 0.12);
        const h0 = height(u, v),
          hx = (height(u + e, v) - h0) / e,
          hz = (height(u, v + e) - h0) / e;
        let lit = 0.86 - hx * 0.16 - hz * 0.22;
        lit = Math.max(0.35, Math.min(1.35, lit));
        const n = mbFbm(u * 2.2, v * 2.2, 4, 61),
          bas = mbC((mbFbm(u * 0.35 + 9, v * 0.35, 4, 67) - 0.56) * 5);
        let c0 = mbMix([181, 98, 52], [132, 62, 32], n);
        c0 = mbMix(c0, [78, 46, 36], bas * 0.75);
        const sunSide = 0.9 + 0.25 * mbC((x / w - 0.35) * 1.4) * (1 - d);
        c0 = [c0[0] * lit * sunSide, c0[1] * lit * sunSide, c0[2] * lit * sunSide];
        c0 = mbMix(c0, HAZE, fog);
        c0 = mbMix(c0, [30, 14, 10], Math.pow(d, 2.2) * 0.45); // ön plan kararır
        const i = (y * w + x) * 4;
        D[i] = c0[0];
        D[i + 1] = c0[1];
        D[i + 2] = c0[2];
        D[i + 3] = 255;
      }
    }
    g.putImageData(im, 0, 0);
    // kayalar (uzaktan yakına), uzun gün batımı gölgeleriyle
    const R = rng(77),
      rocks = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 300; i++) {
      const d = Math.pow(R(), 0.7);
      rocks.push({ x: R() * w, d, s: R(), k: R(), id: i });
    }
    rocks.sort((a, b) => a.d - b.d);
    for (const r of rocks) {
      const y = r.d * gh,
        sz = (1 + Math.pow(r.d, 1.5) * h * 0.05) * (0.18 + Math.pow(r.s, 3) * 1.5);
      if (sz < 0.8) continue;
      const rx = sz * (1.1 + r.k * 0.8),
        ry = sz * (0.55 + r.k * 0.35),
        n = 11,
        pts = [];
      for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
        const a = (j / n) * Math.PI * 2,
          jr = 0.62 + 0.5 * mbHash(r.id, j, 5);
        let py = Math.sin(a) * ry * jr;
        if (py > 0) py *= 0.28; // alt kısım gömülü
        pts.push([r.x + Math.cos(a) * rx * jr, y + py]);
      }
      // gün batımı gölgesi (sola uzanır)
      g.fillStyle = "rgba(22,8,6," + (0.3 + 0.22 * r.d) + ")";
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(r.x + rx * 0.2, y + ry * 0.12);
      g.quadraticCurveTo(r.x - rx * 2.2, y + ry * 0.5, r.x - rx * 3.2 * (0.6 + r.k), y + ry * 0.18);
      g.quadraticCurveTo(r.x - rx * 1.5, y - ry * 0.05, r.x - rx * 0.6, y);
      g.closePath();
      g.fill();
      const poly = () => {
        g.beginPath();
        pts.forEach((p, k) => (k ? g.lineTo(p[0], p[1]) : g.moveTo(p[0], p[1])));
        g.closePath();
      };
      const gr = g.createLinearGradient(r.x + rx * 0.8, y - ry, r.x - rx * 0.7, y + ry * 0.2);
      const tone = r.k < 0.3 ? [110, 72, 60] : [170, 94, 58];
      gr.addColorStop(0, `rgb(${tone[0] + 50},${tone[1] + 40},${tone[2] + 30})`);
      gr.addColorStop(0.4, `rgb(${tone[0]},${tone[1]},${tone[2]})`);
      gr.addColorStop(1, "rgb(40,18,12)");
      poly();
      g.fillStyle = gr;
      g.fill();
      if (sz > 4) {
        // yüzey faseti + çatlak
        g.save();
        poly();
        g.clip();
        g.fillStyle = "rgba(30,12,8,.32)";
        g.beginPath();
        g.moveTo(r.x - rx, y - ry);
        g.lineTo(r.x - rx * 0.05 + mbHash(r.id, 1, 9) * rx * 0.3, y - ry * 1.1);
        g.lineTo(r.x - rx * 0.2, y + ry);
        g.lineTo(r.x - rx * 1.2, y + ry);
        g.fill();
        g.strokeStyle = "rgba(25,10,6,.45)";
        g.lineWidth = Math.max(0.5, sz * 0.04);
        g.beginPath();
        g.moveTo(r.x + rx * 0.3, y - ry * 0.6);
        g.lineTo(r.x + rx * 0.1, y - ry * 0.1);
        g.lineTo(r.x + rx * 0.35, y + ry * 0.1);
        g.stroke();
        for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
          g.fillStyle = "rgba(255,210,170," + (0.08 + 0.1 * mbHash(r.id, k, 3)) + ")";
          g.fillRect(
            r.x + (mbHash(r.id, k, 4) - 0.3) * rx,
            y - ry * mbHash(r.id, k, 6) * 0.8,
            sz * 0.08,
            sz * 0.06,
          );
        }
        g.restore();
      }
      // kumun kayayı kısmen örtmesi
      g.fillStyle = "rgba(150,78,44," + (0.5 + 0.2 * r.k) + ")";
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(r.x, y + ry * 0.08, rx * 1.05, ry * 0.2, 0, 0, 7);
      g.fill();
      const fogk = Math.pow(mbC(1 - r.d * 3.2), 1.5) * 0.8;
      if (fogk > 0.02) {
        g.fillStyle = "rgba(198,150,112," + fogk + ")";
        poly();
        g.fill();
      }
    }
    // çakıllar
    for (let i = 0; i < 900; i++) {
      const d = Math.pow(R(), 0.6),
        y = d * gh,
        x = R() * w,
        s = 0.4 + d * d * 2.4;
      g.fillStyle = "rgba(" + (R() < 0.5 ? "60,28,18" : "200,130,90") + "," + (0.25 + d * 0.4) + ")";
      g.fillRect(x, y, s * 1.4, s * 0.7);
    }
    B.ground = c;
  }
  /* --- toz dokusu (döşenebilir) --- */
  {
    const S = 256,
      c = mbCanvas(S * 2, S),
      g = c.getContext("2d"),
      im = g.createImageData(S * 2, S),
      D = im.data;
    for (let y = 0; y < S; y++)
      for (let x = 0; x < S * 2; x++) {
        const n = mbFbm((x / S) * 2, (y / S) * 2, 5, 71, 4),
          a = mbC((n - 0.42) * 2.4);
        const i = (y * S * 2 + x) * 4;
        D[i] = 214;
        D[i + 1] = 150;
        D[i + 2] = 104;
        D[i + 3] = a * 120;
      }
    g.putImageData(im, 0, 0);
    B.dust = c;
  }
  /* --- roket (oyunun kendi modeli) --- */
  {
    const rs = Math.max(0.35, h * 0.00105),
      rw = Math.ceil(90 * rs),
      rh = Math.ceil(150 * rs),
      c = mbCanvas(rw * 2, rh * 2),
      g = c.getContext("2d");
    bakeRocketInto(g, 2, rw / 2, 84 * rs, rs);
    B.rocket = c;
    B.rs = rs;
    B.rw = rw;
    B.rh = rh;
  }
  B.W = W;
  B.H = H;
  return B;
}
function i0(r) {
  return Math.floor(r.x * 7 + r.s * 1000);
}

function drawMenuBg2D() {
  const c = mctx,
    t = performance.now() / 1000;
  if (!MB.baked || MB.baked.W !== W || MB.baked.H !== H) {
    if (!MB.baked || performance.now() - MB.bakeT > 250) {
      MB.baked = bakeMenu();
      MB.bakeT = performance.now();
    }
  }
  const B = MB.baked,
    s = 1 / B.q,
    M = B.M;
  MB.tx += (MB.mx - MB.tx) * 0.04;
  MB.ty += (MB.my - MB.ty) * 0.04;
  const par = (k) => [-M + MB.tx * k - 0, -M + MB.ty * k * 0.5];
  c.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  c.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
  c.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
  // gökyüzü
  let [ox, oy] = par(3);
  c.drawImage(B.sky, ox, oy, B.w * s, (B.HY + 6) * s);
  // yıldızlar (üst bölge)
  for (const st of stars) {
    if (st.y > 0.32) continue;
    const a = (0.15 + st.h * 0.6) * (1 - st.y / 0.32) * (0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(t * 1.3 + st.h * 50));
    c.fillStyle = "rgba(255,240,230," + a + ")";
    const z = 0.6 + st.h * 1.3;
    c.fillRect(st.x * W + ox * 0.3, st.y * H, z, z);
  }
  // güneş + hale
  const sx = B.SX * s + ox,
    sy = B.SY * s + oy;
  c.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
  let g = c.createRadialGradient(sx, sy, 0, sx, sy, H * 0.5);
  g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(200,225,255,.55)");
  g.addColorStop(0.05, "rgba(150,190,235,.28)");
  g.addColorStop(0.35, "rgba(120,150,200,.06)");
  g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
  c.fillStyle = g;
  c.fillRect(sx - H * 0.5, sy - H * 0.5, H, H);
  g = c.createRadialGradient(sx, sy, 0, sx, sy, 8 + H * 0.008);
  g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,1)");
  g.addColorStop(0.6, "rgba(235,245,255,.9)");
  g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(200,225,255,0)");
  c.fillStyle = g;
  c.beginPath();
  c.arc(sx, sy, 8 + H * 0.008, 0, 7);
  c.fill();
  c.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
  // Phobos: yavaşça geçer
  {
    const k = (t % 120) / 120,
      px = W * (1.08 - 1.2 * k),
      py = H * 0.13 + Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * -H * 0.03,
      pr = Math.max(5, H * 0.011);
    c.save();
    c.translate(px, py);
    c.rotate(0.4);
    const pg = c.createRadialGradient(pr * 0.5, -pr * 0.3, pr * 0.1, 0, 0, pr * 1.4);
    pg.addColorStop(0, "#d9c3b0");
    pg.addColorStop(1, "#3a2c27");
    c.fillStyle = pg;
    c.beginPath();
    c.ellipse(0, 0, pr * 1.35, pr, 0, 0, 7);
    c.fill();
    c.fillStyle = "rgba(40,28,24,.5)";
    c.beginPath();
    c.arc(-pr * 0.4, pr * 0.2, pr * 0.3, 0, 7);
    c.fill();
    c.restore();
  }
  // uzak dağlar
  [ox, oy] = par(6);
  c.drawImage(B.far, ox, oy, B.w * s, B.far.height * s);
  // uzak toz perdesi
  const dw = B.dust.width;
  c.save();
  c.globalAlpha = 0.35;
  const pat = c.createPattern(B.dust, "repeat");
  c.translate(-(t * 6) % dw, 0);
  c.fillStyle = pat;
  c.fillRect(0, B.HY * s - H * 0.16 + oy, W + dw, H * 0.18);
  c.restore();
  // toz şeytanı (uzakta dönen kum hortumu)
  {
    const k = (t * 0.006) % 1.4,
      dx = W * (0.15 + k * 0.75),
      base = B.HY * s + oy + H * 0.012,
      hh = H * 0.15;
    if (k < 1.2) {
      c.save();
      for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
        const f = i / 25,
          y = base - f * hh,
          r = ((3 + f * f * 26) * H) / 900,
          sw = Math.sin(t * 3 + f * 6) * 6 * f;
        c.fillStyle = "rgba(206,150,108," + 0.1 * (1 - f * 0.6) + ")";
        c.beginPath();
        c.ellipse(dx + sw + f * f * 14, y, r * 1.6, r * 0.55, 0, 0, 7);
        c.fill();
      }
      const top = c.createRadialGradient(dx + 16, base - hh, 0, dx + 16, base - hh, hh * 0.4);
      top.addColorStop(0, "rgba(206,150,108,.12)");
      top.addColorStop(1, "rgba(206,150,108,0)");
      c.fillStyle = top;
      c.fillRect(dx - hh * 0.4, base - hh * 1.4, hh * 0.9, hh * 0.8);
      c.restore();
    }
  }
  // orta tepeler
  [ox, oy] = par(10);
  c.drawImage(B.mid, ox, oy, B.w * s, B.mid.height * s);
  // zemin
  const gx = ox * 1.6,
    gy = oy * 1.2;
  c.drawImage(B.ground, gx - M * 0.6, B.HY * s + gy, B.w * s, (B.h - B.HY) * s);
  // roket — iniş alanında, sağ tarafta
  {
    const rx = W * 0.64 + gx * 0.6,
      ry = B.HY * s + gy + (B.h - B.HY) * s * 0.16,
      rw = B.rw * s,
      rh = B.rh * s;
    c.fillStyle = "rgba(20,8,6,.45)";
    c.beginPath();
    c.ellipse(rx - rw * 0.9, ry + 2, rw * 1.3, rh * 0.04, 0, 0, 7);
    c.fill();
    c.drawImage(B.rocket, rx - rw / 2, ry - rh * 0.79, rw, rh);
    // işaret ışığı + pencere parlaması
    const bl = Math.max(0, Math.sin(t * 2.2)) ** 8;
    if (bl > 0.02) {
      const by = ry - rh * 0.79 + rh * 0.03;
      g = c.createRadialGradient(rx, by, 0, rx, by, 12);
      g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,90,80," + bl + ")");
      g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,90,80,0)");
      c.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
      c.fillStyle = g;
      c.fillRect(rx - 30, by - 30, 60, 60);
      c.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
    }
    const wy = ry - rh * 0.79 + rh * 0.42;
    g = c.createRadialGradient(rx, wy, 0, rx, wy, rw * 0.6);
    g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(140,210,255,.28)");
    g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(140,210,255,0)");
    c.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
    c.fillStyle = g;
    c.fillRect(rx - rw, wy - rw, rw * 2, rw * 2);
    c.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
  }
  // yakın toz perdesi
  c.save();
  c.globalAlpha = 0.16;
  c.translate(-(t * 22) % dw, 0);
  c.fillStyle = pat;
  c.fillRect(0, H * 0.62, W + dw, H * 0.4);
  c.restore();
  // uçuşan toz zerreleri
  if (!MB.motes.length) {
    const R = rng(31);
    for (let i = 0; i < 110; i++) MB.motes.push({ x: R(), y: R(), z: R() });
  }
  for (const m of MB.motes) {
    const sp = 0.006 + m.z * 0.03;
    m.x += sp / 60;
    m.y += Math.sin(t * 0.7 + m.z * 30) * 0.00012;
    if (m.x > 1.02) {
      m.x = -0.02;
      m.y = Math.random();
    }
    const x = m.x * W,
      y = (0.25 + m.y * 0.75) * H,
      r = 0.5 + m.z * m.z * 2.6;
    c.fillStyle = "rgba(240,200,160," + (0.12 + m.z * 0.35) + ")";
    c.beginPath();
    c.arc(x, y, r, 0, 7);
    c.fill();
  }
  // sinematik renk + okunurluk
  g = c.createLinearGradient(0, 0, W * 0.55, 0);
  g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(10,5,5,.82)");
  g.addColorStop(0.6, "rgba(10,5,5,.38)");
  g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(10,5,5,0)");
  c.fillStyle = g;
  c.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  g = c.createRadialGradient(W * 0.6, H * 0.5, Math.min(W, H) * 0.3, W * 0.6, H * 0.5, Math.max(W, H) * 0.8);
  g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
  g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,.6)");
  c.fillStyle = g;
  c.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  g = c.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,.35)");
  g.addColorStop(0.18, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
  g.addColorStop(0.85, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
  g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,.45)");
  c.fillStyle = g;
  c.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
}
addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => {

/* canlı telemetri satırı */
function menuTele() {
  const el = $("mnTele");
  if (!el || mode !== "menu") return;
  const d = new Date(),
    mh = (d.getHours() * 60 + d.getMinutes() + d.getSeconds() / 60) * 1.0275,
    hh = Math.floor(mh / 60) % 24,
    mm = Math.floor(mh % 60);
  const temp = -63 + Math.round(Math.sin(d.getTime() / 9e5) * 6),
    wind = 14 + Math.round(Math.abs(Math.sin(d.getTime() / 4e4)) * 9),
    dl = (12.6 + Math.sin(d.getTime() / 8e6) * 0.4).toFixed(1).replace(".", ",");
  el.innerHTML = Tf(
    `<span><i class="dot"></i>CANLI</span><span>MARS YEREL <b>{0}:{1}</b></span><span>SICAKLIK <b>{2} °C</b></span><span>RÜZGÂR <b>{3} km/sa</b></span><span>BASINÇ <b>6,1 mbar</b></span><span>IŞIK GECİKMESİ <b>{4} dk</b></span>`,
    [String(hh).padStart(2, "0"), String(mm).padStart(2, "0"), temp, wind, dl],
  );
}
setInterval(menuTele, 1000);

/* ============== GLX — WebGL "ultra" grafik motoru ==============
   • space   : yıldız alanı + Samanyolu + 2 gezegen (Dünya/Mars) + mercek parlaması
   • terrain : ışın yürütmeli (raymarch) Mars arazisi, yumuşak gölge, sis, gün batımı göğü
   Arazi pahalıdır: FBO'ya satır satır (kare başına birkaç şerit) işlenir, bitince
   2D tuvale kopyalanır. WebGL yoksa oyun eski 2D çizimlere döner. */
const GLX = { ok: false, c: null, gl: null, P: {} };
const GLSL_COMMON = `
precision highp float;
float h21(vec2 p){vec3 p3=fract(vec3(p.xyx)*.1031);p3+=dot(p3,p3.yzx+33.33);return fract((p3.x+p3.y)*p3.z);}
float h31(vec3 p3){p3=fract(p3*.1031);p3+=dot(p3,p3.zyx+31.32);return fract((p3.x+p3.y)*p3.z);}
float n2(vec2 p){vec2 i=floor(p),f=fract(p),u=f*f*(3.-2.*f);
  return mix(mix(h21(i),h21(i+vec2(1.,0.)),u.x),mix(h21(i+vec2(0.,1.)),h21(i+vec2(1.,1.)),u.x),u.y);}
float n3(vec3 x){vec3 i=floor(x),f=fract(x);f=f*f*(3.-2.*f);
  return mix(mix(mix(h31(i),h31(i+vec3(1.,0.,0.)),f.x),mix(h31(i+vec3(0.,1.,0.)),h31(i+vec3(1.,1.,0.)),f.x),f.y),
             mix(mix(h31(i+vec3(0.,0.,1.)),h31(i+vec3(1.,0.,1.)),f.x),mix(h31(i+vec3(0.,1.,1.)),h31(i+vec3(1.,1.,1.)),f.x),f.y),f.z);}
float fbm3(vec3 p,int o){float a=.5,s=0.,t=0.;for(int i=0;i<7;i++){if(i>=o)break;s+=a*n3(p);t+=a;p=p*2.03+vec3(1.7,9.2,3.1);a*=.5;}return s/t;}
vec3 aces(vec3 x){return clamp((x*(2.51*x+.03))/(x*(2.43*x+.59)+.14),0.,1.);}

const FS_SPACE =
  GLSL_COMMON +
  `
uniform vec2 uRes;uniform float uTime,uMilky,uStars,uExpo;
uniform vec4 uP1,uP2;uniform vec2 uRot,uTilt;uniform vec3 uL1,uL2,uFlare;uniform vec2 uOff;
vec3 rotY(vec3 p,float a){float c=cos(a),s=sin(a);return vec3(c*p.x+s*p.z,p.y,-s*p.x+c*p.z);}
vec3 stars(vec2 fc){
  vec3 c=vec3(0.);
  for(int l=0;l<3;l++){
    float cs=6.+float(l)*5.,thr=.93-float(l)*.025;
    vec2 g=(fc+uOff*(.4+float(l)*.5))/cs,id=floor(g);
    float h=h21(id+float(l)*17.31);
    if(h>thr){
      vec2 o=vec2(h21(id+3.7),h21(id+9.1));
      float d=length((fract(g)-o)*cs);
      float b=pow((h-thr)/(1.-thr),2.2)*(1.4+float(l));
      float tw=.7+.3*sin(uTime*(1.+h*4.)+h*40.);
      vec3 tint=mix(vec3(1.,.82,.66),vec3(.72,.82,1.),h21(id+5.3));
      c+=tint*b*tw*exp(-d*d*(1.6-float(l)*.35));

}
vec3 milky(vec2 fc){
  vec2 uv=fc/uRes.y;vec2 dir=normalize(vec2(1.,.55));vec2 nrm=vec2(-dir.y,dir.x);
  float b=dot(uv-vec2(.9*uRes.x/uRes.y,.45),nrm);

  float cl=fbm3(vec3(uv*2.6,1.3),6),lane=smoothstep(.45,.7,fbm3(vec3(uv*5.,7.1),5));
  vec3 col=mix(vec3(.10,.08,.16),vec3(.26,.19,.14),smoothstep(.4,.8,cl))*band*(.35+cl)*(1.-lane*.75*band);
  float neb=smoothstep(.55,.85,fbm3(vec3(uv*1.4,4.4),5));

}
vec4 planet(vec2 fc,vec4 P,float rot,vec3 L,float tilt){

    vec3 lc=mix(mix(vec3(.05,.10,.035),vec3(.025,.06,.02),smoothstep(.5,.7,fbm3(p*8.,3))),vec3(.34,.24,.12),desert);
    lc=mix(lc,vec3(.16,.13,.10),smoothstep(.62,.74,h));

    vec3 surf=mix(mix(oc,lc,land),vec3(.86,.9,.95),ice);

    col=surf*day*1.05+spec*vec3(1.,.86,.66)*day;

    col+=city*vec3(1.,.6,.26)*2.2*smoothstep(.06,-.25,ndl);

    float a=fbm3(q+w*.5,6);
    float dk=smoothstep(.47,.62,fbm3(p*1.1+vec3(9.,2.,4.),5));
    vec3 c=mix(vec3(.52,.18,.065),vec3(.30,.10,.04),a);c=mix(c,vec3(.11,.045,.028),dk*.78);

    c*=1.-can*.6;

  n2(x, y) {

      uy = fy * fy * (3 - 2 * fy);

      b = tj.h21(ix + 1, iy),

      y = ny;

  rdg(x, y, o) {

    for (let i = 0; i < o; i++) {

      t += a;

function glxProject(P, U, W_, H_) {

const _puff = {};
function puffSprite(rgb) {
  const k = rgb.join(",");
  if (_puff[k]) return _puff[k];

    c = document.createElement("canvas");
  c.width = c.height = S;
  const g = c.getContext("2d"),
    im = g.createImageData(S, S),
    D = im.data;
  for (let y = 0; y < S; y++)
    for (let x = 0; x < S; x++) {
      const dx = (x - S / 2) / (S / 2),
        dy = (y - S / 2) / (S / 2),
        r = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

      D[i + 1] = Math.min(255, rgb[1] * lit);
      D[i + 2] = Math.min(255, rgb[2] * lit);
      D[i + 3] = Math.min(255, a * 255);

/* roket modelini doğrudan verilen bağlama çizer (ana tuvalin boyutuna/durumuna bağlı değil) */
function bakeRocketInto(g, k, ox, oy, rs) {
  const old = ctx;
  let ok = true;
  try {
    ctx = g;
    g.save();
    g.setTransform(k, 0, 0, k, 0, 0);
    g.translate(ox, oy);
    g.scale(rs, rs);
    rocketBody({ flame: 0, broken: false, t: 0 });
    g.restore();
  } catch (e) {
    ok = false;
    try {
      g.restore();
    } catch (_) {}
  } finally {
    ctx = old;
  }
  return ok;
}

function mkRocketSprite(rs, filter) {
  // oyunun roket modelini (vektör) bir sprite'a pişirir; zemin = sprite tepesinden 128*rs
  const rw = Math.ceil(110 * rs),
    rh = Math.ceil(150 * rs),
    c = document.createElement("canvas");
  c.width = rw;
  c.height = rh;
  const g = c.getContext("2d");
  const tmp = document.createElement("canvas");
  tmp.width = rw;
  tmp.height = rh;
  const ok = bakeRocketInto(tmp.getContext("2d"), 1, rw / 2, 84 * rs, rs);
  if (filter) g.filter = filter;
  g.drawImage(tmp, 0, 0);
  g.filter = "none";
  return { c, rs, rw, rh, ok };
}

      for (let i = 1; i <= 10; i++) {
        const d = i * i * 7,
          h = tj.h(cx + d * o.dx, cz + d, cam0);
        ahead += h;
        if (h > eye - d * o.slope) block = true;
      }
      ahead /= 10;
      const score = (g - ahead) * o.over - (block ? 1e5 : 0) - Math.abs(g - ahead - o.want) * 0.3;
      if (!best || score > best.score) best = { score, cx, cz, g };
    }
  const cam = [best.cx, best.g + o.eye, best.cz];
  // rampa: görüş hattı açık, düzlüğe yakın
  let pad = null;
  for (const d of o.padD)
    for (const a of o.padA) {
      const px = cam[0] + Math.sin(a) * d,
        pz = cam[2] + Math.cos(a) * d,
        py = tj.h(px, pz, cam);
      const s1 =
        Math.abs(tj.h(px + 8, pz, cam) - tj.h(px - 8, pz, cam)) +
        Math.abs(tj.h(px, pz + 8, cam) - tj.h(px, pz - 8, cam));
      let vis = true;
      for (let i = 1; i < 20; i++) {
        const k = i / 20,
          x = cam[0] + (px - cam[0]) * k,
          z = cam[2] + (pz - cam[2]) * k,
          y = cam[1] + (py + o.padTop - cam[1]) * k;
        if (tj.h(x, z, cam) > y - 0.5) {
          vis = false;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (vis && s1 < o.flat && (!pad || s1 < pad.s1)) {
        pad = { x: px, y: py, z: pz, s1 };
        if (s1 < o.flat * 0.4) break;
      }
    }
  if (!pad) {
    const px = cam[0] + Math.sin(o.padA[0]) * o.padD[0],
      pz = cam[2] + Math.cos(o.padA[0]) * o.padD[0];
    pad = { x: px, y: tj.h(px, pz, cam), z: pz };
  }
  return { cam, pad };
}
function glxSun(az, el) {
  return [Math.sin(az) * Math.cos(el), Math.sin(el), Math.cos(az) * Math.cos(el)];
}

/* ---------------- ANA MENÜ ---------------- */
const MG = { job: null, key: "", doneT: 0, U: null, rocket: null, far: null, motes: [], shoot: 0 };
function menuGLSetup() {
  const v = glxFindView({
    ox: 0,
    eye: 9,
    dx: 0.12,
    slope: 0.012,
    over: 1,
    want: 40,
    padD: [150, 190, 230, 120, 270],
    padA: [0.2, 0.24, 0.16, 0.28, 0.12],
    padTop: 12,
    flat: 6,
  });
  const cam = v.cam,
    yaw = 0.12;
  const U = {
    uCam: cam,
    uTgt: [cam[0] + Math.sin(yaw) * 100, cam[1] - 5.5, cam[2] + Math.cos(yaw) * 100],
    uSun: glxSun(yaw + 0.34, 0.028),
    uPad: [v.pad.x, v.pad.y, v.pad.z, 13],
    uFl: 1.55,
    uMood: 0.9,
    uExpo: 1.15,
  };
  // uzak, gizemli ışık: sol tarafta uzak bir sırtta
  const fa = yaw - 0.42,
    fd = 1350,
    fx = cam[0] + Math.sin(fa) * fd,
    fz = cam[2] + Math.cos(fa) * fd;
  MG.far = [fx, tj.h(fx, fz, cam) + 3, fz];
  return U;
}
function drawMenuBg() {
  const haveImg = !!((MG.job && MG.job.done && MG.job.canvas) || MG.prev);
  const glOk = settings.ultra !== false && glxInit();
  if (settings.ultra === false || (!glOk && !haveImg)) return drawMenuBg2D();
  const c = mctx,
    t = performance.now() / 1000;
  // küçük boyut değişimlerinde (kaydırma çubuğu, tarayıcı çubukları) yeniden işleme yok: mevcut görüntü ölçeklenir
  const key = W + "x" + H,
    [kw, kh] = (MG.key || "0x0").split("x").map(Number);
  const bigChange =
    !MG.key || Math.abs(W - kw) / Math.max(1, kw) > 0.12 || Math.abs(H - kh) / Math.max(1, kh) > 0.12;
  if (MG.key !== key && !bigChange && haveImg) MG.key = key;
  if (MG.key !== key && glOk) {
    if (!MG.pendT) MG.pendT = performance.now();
    if (!MG.job || performance.now() - MG.pendT > 300) {
      MG.pendT = 0;
      MG.key = key;
      MG.U = MG.U || menuGLSetup();
      const sc = Math.min(1.25, 1700 / Math.max(1, W)) * Math.min(dpr, 1.5),
        w = Math.round(W * Math.min(sc, dpr)),
        h = Math.round(H * Math.min(sc, dpr));
      const old = MG.job && MG.job.done ? MG.job.canvas : MG.prev;
      MG.prev = old;
      MG.job = glxTerrainJob(w, h, MG.U);
      MG.doneT = 0;
    }
  }
  if (glOk && MG.job && !MG.job.done) {
    glxTerrainStep(MG.job, Math.max(8, Math.round(MG.job.h / 36)));
    if (MG.job.done) MG.doneT = t;
  }
  if (!MG.rocket || !MG.rocket.ok)
    MG.rocket = mkRocketSprite(1.6, "brightness(.34) saturate(.55) contrast(1.15)");
  c.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  c.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
  c.globalAlpha = 1;
  c.fillStyle = "#050304";
  c.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  const img = MG.job && MG.job.done ? MG.job.canvas : MG.prev;
  if (!img) {
    // ilk işleme sürerken: zarif bekleme
    const g = c.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#07050a");
    g.addColorStop(0.62, "#1d0f0b");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#070404");
    c.fillStyle = g;
    c.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    const p = MG.job ? MG.job.y / MG.job.h : 0;
    c.fillStyle = "rgba(255,140,80,.5)";
    c.fillRect(W * 0.5 - 60, H - 28, 120 * p, 1.5);
    menuOverlay(c, t, null);
    return;
  }
  // yeni görüntü hazır olunca eskisinin ÜSTÜNE yumuşakça geçer (siyaha düşmez)
  const fadeIn = MG.job && MG.job.done && MG.prev && MG.prev !== img ? Math.min(1, (t - MG.doneT) / 1.6) : 1;
  const fade = 1;
  // yavaş sinematik itme (Ken Burns)
  const z = 1.035 + 0.025 * Math.sin(t * 0.045),
    cx = W * 0.62,
    cy = H * 0.55;
  c.save();
  c.translate(cx, cy);
  c.scale(z, z);
  c.translate(-cx, -cy);
  if (fadeIn < 1 && MG.prev) c.drawImage(MG.prev, 0, 0, W, H);
  c.globalAlpha = fadeIn;
  c.drawImage(img, 0, 0, W, H);
  c.globalAlpha = 1;
  if (fadeIn >= 1 && MG.prev && MG.prev !== img) MG.prev = null;
  const U = MG.U;
  // roket (gün batımında siluet) + ışıkları
  {
    const b = glxProject([U.uPad[0], U.uPad[1], U.uPad[2]], U, W, H);
    if (b.s > 0) {
      const ppu = (b.s * 17) / 124,
        R = MG.rocket,
        sw = (R.rw * ppu) / R.rs,
        sh = (R.rh * ppu) / R.rs,
        top = b.y - 128 * ppu;
      c.globalAlpha = fade;
      c.fillStyle = "rgba(8,3,2,.55)";
      c.beginPath();
      c.ellipse(b.x - sw * 0.1, b.y, sw * 0.9, sh * 0.03, 0, 0, 7);
      c.fill();
      c.drawImage(R.c, b.x - sw / 2, top, sw, sh);
      // gün batımı kenar ışığı (sağdan)
      c.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
      const rim = c.createLinearGradient(b.x + sw * 0.25, 0, b.x, 0);
      rim.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,130,70,.0)");
      rim.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,130,70,0)");
      // pencere ışığı
      const wy = top + sh * 0.36,
        wl = c.createRadialGradient(b.x, wy, 0, b.x, wy, sw * 0.55);
      wl.addColorStop(0, "rgba(120,200,255,.55)");
      wl.addColorStop(0.25, "rgba(90,170,255,.18)");
      wl.addColorStop(1, "rgba(90,170,255,0)");
      c.fillStyle = wl;
      c.fillRect(b.x - sw, wy - sw, sw * 2, sw * 2);
      const bl = Math.pow(Math.max(0, Math.sin(t * 2.1)), 10),
        by = top + sh * 0.03;
      if (bl > 0.02) {
        const g = c.createRadialGradient(b.x, by, 0, b.x, by, 5 + sw * 0.1);
        g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,70,60," + bl + ")");
        g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,70,60,0)");
        c.fillStyle = g;
        c.fillRect(b.x - 40, by - 40, 80, 80);
      }
      // zemindeki çalışma lambası halesi
      const gl = c.createRadialGradient(b.x, b.y, 0, b.x, b.y, sw * 1.6);
      gl.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,190,130,.16)");
      gl.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,190,130,0)");
      c.fillStyle = gl;
      c.fillRect(b.x - sw * 2, b.y - sw, sw * 4, sw * 2);
      c.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
      c.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
  }
  // uzakta gizemli ışık (yavaş nabız)
  {
    const f = glxProject(MG.far, U, W, H);
    if (f.s > 0 && f.x > 0 && f.x < W) {
      const pu = 0.35 + 0.65 * Math.pow(0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * 0.9), 3);
      c.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
      const g = c.createRadialGradient(f.x, f.y, 0, f.x, f.y, 22);
      g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(150,210,255," + 0.85 * pu * fade + ")");
      g.addColorStop(0.15, "rgba(110,180,255," + 0.25 * pu * fade + ")");
      g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(110,180,255,0)");
      c.fillStyle = g;
      c.fillRect(f.x - 24, f.y - 24, 48, 48);
      c.fillStyle = "rgba(200,235,255," + 0.18 * pu * fade + ")";
      c.fillRect(f.x - 26, f.y - 0.5, 52, 1);
      c.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
    }
  }
  c.restore();
  menuOverlay(c, t, U);
}
function menuOverlay(c, t, U) {
  // Phobos (yüksekte yavaş geçer)
  {
    const k = (t % 150) / 150,
      px = W * (1.1 - 1.25 * k),
      py = H * 0.1 + Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * -H * 0.03,
      pr = Math.max(4, H * 0.008);
    c.save();
    c.translate(px, py);
    c.rotate(0.4);
    const pg = c.createRadialGradient(pr * 0.6, -pr * 0.2, pr * 0.1, 0, 0, pr * 1.3);
    pg.addColorStop(0, "#bfa48f");
    pg.addColorStop(1, "#1d1512");
    c.fillStyle = pg;
    c.beginPath();
    c.ellipse(0, 0, pr * 1.35, pr, 0, 0, 7);
    c.fill();
    c.restore();
  }
  // kayan yıldız (ara sıra)
  {
    const p = (t % 13) / 13;
    if (p < 0.05) {
      const q = p / 0.05,
        x0 = W * 0.35,
        y0 = H * 0.04,
        x1 = W * 0.62,
        y1 = H * 0.2,
        x = x0 + (x1 - x0) * q,
        y = y0 + (y1 - y0) * q;
      const g = c.createLinearGradient(x - (x1 - x0) * 0.25, y - (y1 - y0) * 0.25, x, y);
      g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,240,220,0)");
      g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,240,220," + 0.8 * (1 - q) + ")");
      c.strokeStyle = g;
      c.lineWidth = 1.4;
      c.beginPath();
      c.moveTo(x - (x1 - x0) * 0.25, y - (y1 - y0) * 0.25);
      c.lineTo(x, y);
      c.stroke();
    }
  }
  // yerden süzülen toz sisi
  const sp = puffSprite([150, 92, 64]);
  if (!MG.motes.length) {
    const R = rng(41);
    for (let i = 0; i < 34; i++) MG.motes.push({ x: R(), y: R(), s: R(), v: R() });
  }
  for (const m of MG.motes) {
    const x = (((m.x + t * (0.004 + m.v * 0.006)) % 1.2) - 0.1) * W,
      y = H * (0.62 + m.y * 0.4),
      s = ((120 + m.s * 260) * H) / 900;
    c.globalAlpha = 0.05 + m.s * 0.06;
    c.drawImage(sp, x - s, y - s * 0.35, s * 2, s * 0.7);
  }
  c.globalAlpha = 1;
  // zerreler
  for (let i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
    const h = (i * 0.618) % 1,
      x = (h * W + t * (14 + h * 30) * (1 + (i % 3))) % W,
      y = H * (0.3 + ((i * 0.371) % 1) * 0.7) + Math.sin(t * 0.6 + i) * 6,
      r = 0.5 + h * h * 2;
    c.fillStyle = "rgba(235,200,170," + (0.08 + h * 0.22) + ")";
    c.fillRect(x, y, r, r);
  }
  // okunurluk + sinematik ton
  let g = c.createLinearGradient(0, 0, W * 0.58, 0);
  g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(6,3,3,.86)");
  g.addColorStop(0.55, "rgba(6,3,3,.42)");
  g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(6,3,3,0)");
  c.fillStyle = g;
  c.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  g = c.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,.45)");
  g.addColorStop(0.16, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
  g.addColorStop(0.82, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
  g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,.6)");
  c.fillStyle = g;
  c.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  // gren
  if (!MG.grain) {
    const gc = document.createElement("canvas");
    gc.width = gc.height = 160;
    const x = gc.getContext("2d"),
      im = x.createImageData(160, 160);
    for (let i = 0; i < im.data.length; i += 4) {
      const v = Math.random() * 255;
      im.data[i] = im.data[i + 1] = im.data[i + 2] = v;
      im.data[i + 3] = 255;
    }
    x.putImageData(im, 0, 0);
    MG.grain = gc;
  }
  if (settings.grain !== false) {
    c.save();
    c.globalAlpha = 0.04;
    c.globalCompositeOperation = "overlay";
    c.translate(Math.random() * 160, Math.random() * 160);
    c.fillStyle = c.createPattern(MG.grain, "repeat");
    c.fillRect(-160, -160, W + 320, H + 320);
    c.restore();
  }
}

/* ---------------- HİKÂYE SAHNELERİ ---------------- */
function introGLSetup() {
  if (settings.ultra === false || !glxInit()) return;
  const v = glxFindView({
    ox: 1800,
    eye: 2.2,
    dx: 0,
    slope: 0.0,
    over: 0.15,
    want: 5,
    padD: [90, 80, 105, 70],
    padA: [0.06, 0.02, 0.1, -0.04],
    padTop: 20,
    flat: 5,
  });
  const cam = v.cam,
    p = v.pad;
  const U = {
    uCam: cam,
    uTgt: [p.x * 0.7 + cam[0] * 0.3, p.y + 16, p.z],
    uSun: glxSun(-0.9, 0.42),
    uPad: [p.x, p.y, p.z, 13],
    uFl: 1.42,
    uMood: 0.1,
    uExpo: 1.0,
  };
  const sc = Math.min(1, 1400 / Math.max(1, W)) * Math.min(dpr, 1.25);
  intro.landJob = glxTerrainJob(Math.round(W * sc), Math.round(H * sc), U);
}
function iParts() {
  for (const q of intro.parts) {
    const k = q.l / q.m,
      a = q.a * (1 - k) * Math.min(1, q.l * 4);
    if (a <= 0.003) continue;
    const sp = puffSprite(q.c);
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, a * 1.25);
    const r = q.r * 1.5;
    ctx.drawImage(sp, q.x - r, q.y - r, r * 2, r * 2);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}
function sEarth(t, U) {
  if (!GLX.ok) return sEarth2D(t, U);
  const k = iease(t / 9),
    r = Math.max(W, H) * 0.62,
    cy = H + r * 0.98 - ilerp(0, r * 0.42, k),
    ma = iclamp((t - 8.5) / 2);
  const sw = iclamp((t - 3) / 10),
    L = [ilerp(0.42, 0.6, sw), ilerp(0.5, 0.45, sw), ilerp(-0.82, 0.28, iease(sw))];
  const ll = Math.hypot(L[0], L[1]) || 1,
    fl = iclamp(-L[2] * 1.5) * iclamp((t - 1.5) / 2.5);
  ctx.drawImage(
    glxSpace({
      time: t,
      milky: iclamp(t / 4),
      stars: iclamp(t / 2.5),
      off: [t * 5, 0],
      p1: [W * 0.5, cy, r, 0],
      rot1: t * 0.018 + 0.6,
      tilt1: 1.05,
      l1: L,
      p2: ma > 0 ? [W * 0.78, H * 0.26, Math.max(2.5, 3.4 * U), 1] : null,
      l2: [-0.4, 0.3, 0.85],
      flare: fl > 0 ? [W * 0.5 + (r * L[0]) / ll, cy - (r * L[1]) / ll, fl * 1.3] : null,
      expo: iclamp(t / 1.2),
    }),
    0,
    0,
    W,
    H,
  );
  if (ma > 0) {
    const mx = W * 0.78,
      my = H * 0.26;
    ctx.globalAlpha = ma;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,180,140,.6)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(mx, my, 14 * U, 0, 7);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(mx + 14 * U, my - 6 * U);
    ctx.lineTo(mx + 46 * U, my - 24 * U);
    ctx.lineTo(mx + 120 * U, my - 24 * U);
    ctx.stroke();
    iText(T("MARS"), mx + 50 * U, my - 30 * U, 12 * U + 4, { mono: 1, w: 800, c: "#ffb38a", ls: 3 });
    iText(T("225 milyon km"), mx + 50 * U, my - 12 * U, 9 * U + 3, { mono: 1, c: "#c99b84" });
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
  const ta = iclamp((t - 1) / 1.5) * (1 - iclamp((t - 5.5) / 1.2));
  if (ta > 0) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = ta;
    iText(T("ARES PROGRAMI"), W / 2, H * 0.36, 13 * U + 4, {
      al: "center",
      w: 800,
      c: "#9fc9ff",
      ls: 6,
      mono: 1,
    });
    iText("2035", W / 2, H * 0.36 + 44 * U, 40 * U + 8, { al: "center", w: 300, c: "#ffffff", ls: 14 });
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
}
function sLand(t, U) {
  const J = intro.landJob;
  if (!GLX.ok || !J || !J.done) return sLand2D(t, U);
  const lt = t - 79,
    TD = 3.5,
    u = iclamp(lt / TD),
    LU = J.U,
    P = LU.uPad;
  const shk = lt > TD - 0.3 && lt < TD + 0.8 ? 5 * U : 0;
  ctx.save();
  if (shk) ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shk, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shk);
  const z = 1.02 + lt * 0.004,
    cx = W / 2,
    cy = H * 0.6;
  ctx.translate(cx, cy);
  ctx.scale(z, z);
  ctx.translate(-cx, -cy);
  ctx.drawImage(J.canvas, 0, 0, W, H);
  const alt = ilerp(150, 0, 1 - Math.pow(1 - u, 2.2)),
    b = glxProject([P[0], P[1], P[2]], LU, W, H),
    r = glxProject([P[0], P[1] + alt, P[2]], LU, W, H);
  const s = (b.s * 16) / 124,
    fl = lt < TD ? 0.95 : Math.max(0, 0.95 - (lt - TD) * 1.2);
  // gölge
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(10,4,2," + 0.55 * u + ")";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(b.x + s * 20, b.y + 2, (26 + 30 * u) * s, 6 * s, 0, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  // alevin zemine vurduğu ışık
  if (fl > 0) {
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(b.x, b.y, 0, b.x, b.y, 90 * s * (1.3 - u * 0.5));
    g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,200,140," + 0.45 * fl * u + ")");
    g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,140,80,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(b.x - 120 * s, b.y - 120 * s, 240 * s, 240 * s);
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
  }
  if (lt > 1.6 && lt < TD + 0.6)
    iSmoke(b.x, b.y, lt > TD - 0.5 ? 5 : 2, s * 0.9, {
      sp: 1.5,
      up: 0.35,
      life: 3.2,
      c: [176, 104, 66],
      a: 0.5,
      dr: 0.9,
    });
  if (!intro.td && lt >= TD) {
    intro.td = true;
    iSmoke(b.x, b.y, 46, s * 0.9, { sp: 2.1, up: 0.55, life: 4.6, c: [170, 100, 62], a: 0.55, dr: 1 });
  }
  iRocket(r.x, r.y - 40 * s, 0, s, fl);
  iParts();
  ctx.restore();
  const haze = lt > TD ? Math.max(0, 0.4 - (lt - TD) * 0.065) : 0;
  if (haze > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(170,110,75," + haze + ")";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }
  if (lt < TD + 2.6) {
    const a = Math.max(0, Math.round(alt));
    iHud(
      lt < TD
        ? [
            [T("EVRE"), T("GÜÇLÜ İNİŞ")],
            [T("İRTİFA"), a + " m"],
            [T("DİKEY HIZ"), fmtN(Math.max(0, (1 - u) * 24), 1) + " m/s"],
          ]
        : [
            [T("EVRE"), T("TEMAS")],

            [T("KONUM"), T("Mars · ekvator ovası")],

function iTitleCard(t, U) {

    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.globalAlpha = ta;
    iText("ARES-1 · SOL 1", W / 2, H * 0.38, 12 * U + 4, {
      al: "center",
      mono: 1,
      w: 800,
      c: "#ffb38a",
      ls: 8,
    });
    iText("SOL ZERO", W / 2, H * 0.38 + 56 * U, Math.min(W * 0.06, 54 * U + 10), {
      al: "center",
      w: 800,
      c: "#ffffff",
      ls: Math.round(8 * U),
      glow: "rgba(255,140,80,.55)",
      gb: 26,
    });
    const lw = W * 0.24 * iease((t - 87.4) / 1.4);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff8c42";
    ctx.fillRect(W / 2 - lw / 2, H * 0.38 + 76 * U, lw, 2);
    iText(
      T("Görev başlıyor: Mars'ı incele, hayatta kal ve her şeyi Dünya'ya aktar."),
      W / 2,
      H * 0.38 + 108 * U,
      14 * U + 5,

    );
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
}

const BASE_STORM_BREAK = 0.6;
let SUITX = { deco: 0, visor: SUITS[0].pal.visor, trim: SUITS[0].pal.trim };
let RSK = ROCKET_SKINS[0],
  RKV = { armor: 0 };
function curSuit() {
  return SUITS.find((s) => s.id === (game && game.suit)) || SUITS[0];
}
function suitSt() {
  return curSuit().st;
}
function rkArmor() {
  return game && game.rk ? game.rk.armor || 0 : 0;
}
function ensureUpg() {
  if (!game) return;
  ensureRare();
  if (!game.suit) game.suit = "std";
  if (!Array.isArray(game.suitsOwned)) game.suitsOwned = ["std"];
  if (game.gold == null) game.gold = 0;
  if (!game.rk) game.rk = { armor: 0, skin: "classic", owned: ["classic"] };
}
function applySuit(s) {
  s = s || curSuit();
  Object.assign(SUIT, s.pal);
  SUITX = { deco: s.deco, visor: s.pal.visor, trim: s.pal.trim };
}
function applyRocketSkin() {
  RSK = ROCKET_SKINS.find((s) => s.id === (game && game.rk && game.rk.skin)) || ROCKET_SKINS[0];
  RKV = { armor: rkArmor() };
}
function syncLooks() {
  if (game) ensureUpg();
  const k = game ? game.suit + "|" + game.rk.skin + "|" + game.rk.armor : "std|classic|0";
  if (syncLooks.k !== k) {
    syncLooks.k = k;
    applySuit();
    applyRocketSkin();
  }
}
/* --- önizleme sprite'ları (önbellekli) --- */
const _suitPrev = {},
  _rkPrev = {};
function suitSprite(s, scale) {
  const key = s.id + "@" + scale;
  if (_suitPrev[key]) return _suitPrev[key];
  const c = document.createElement("canvas"),
    w = Math.ceil(80 * scale),
    h = Math.ceil(120 * scale);
  c.width = w;
  c.height = h;
  const g = c.getContext("2d");
  const save = { walk: p.walk, t: p.t, dir: p.dir, sx: p.sx, sy: p.sy },
    sv = { ...SUIT },
    sx = SUITX,
    kc = game && game.kitCarried,
    sI = stormFx.I,
    ra = game && game.radiationActive,
    ir = insideRocket;
  try {
    p.walk = 0;
    p.t = 0;
    p.dir = 1;
    p.sx = 1;
    p.sy = 1;
    stormFx.I = 0;
    insideRocket = true;
    if (game) {
      game.kitCarried = false;
    }
    applySuit(s);
    withCtx(g, () => {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(w / 2 - 2 * scale, h * 0.66);
      ctx.scale(scale, scale);
      astronaut(0, 0, false, null, 0);
      ctx.restore();
    });
  } catch (e) {
  } finally {
    Object.assign(p, save);
    Object.assign(SUIT, sv);
    SUITX = sx;
    stormFx.I = sI;
    insideRocket = ir;
    if (game) game.kitCarried = kc;
  }
  return (_suitPrev[key] = c);
}
function rocketSprite(sk, armor, scale) {
  const key = sk.id + "@" + armor + "@" + scale;
  if (_rkPrev[key]) return _rkPrev[key];
  const c = document.createElement("canvas"),
    w = Math.ceil(110 * scale),
    h = Math.ceil(150 * scale);
  c.width = w;
  c.height = h;
  const g = c.getContext("2d");
  const o1 = RSK,
    o2 = RKV;
  try {
    RSK = sk;
    RKV = { armor };
    withCtx(g, () => {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(w / 2, 84 * scale);
      ctx.scale(scale, scale);
      rocketBody({ flame: 0, broken: false, t: 1.2 });
      ctx.restore();
    });
  } catch (e) {
  } finally {
    RSK = o1;
    RKV = o2;
  }
  return (_rkPrev[key] = c);
}
/* --- astronot süslemeleri (set seviyesine göre) --- */
function suitDecoTorso(t) {
  const d = SUITX.deco;
  if (!d) return;
  if (d === 1) {
    // Kaşif: camgöbeği biyeler + göğüs yaması
    ctx.strokeStyle = SUIT.orange;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-15, -20);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-8, -2, -14, 10);
    ctx.moveTo(15, -20);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(8, -2, 14, 10);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = SUIT.orange;
    rrp(8, 4, 8, 5, 1.5);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.fillRect(9, 6, 6, 1);
  } else if (d === 2) {
    // Öncü: ışık şeritleri
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = SUIT.orange;
    ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
    ctx.strokeStyle = SUIT.orange;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.75 + 0.25 * Math.sin(t * 3);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-14, -18);
    ctx.lineTo(-14, 8);
    ctx.moveTo(14, -18);
    ctx.lineTo(14, 8);
    ctx.moveTo(-16, 14);
    ctx.lineTo(16, 14);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  } else if (d === 3) {
    // Kalkan: göğüs zırhı + tehlike bandı + radyasyon simgesi
    const cg = ctx.createLinearGradient(-14, -22, 14, 8);
    cg.addColorStop(0, SUIT.light);
    cg.addColorStop(1, SUIT.dark);
    ctx.fillStyle = cg;
    rrp(-15, -22, 30, 10, 4);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = SUIT.line;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.save();
    rrp(-18, 15, 36, 4, 1);
    ctx.clip();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#1f2416";
    ctx.fillRect(-18, 15, 36, 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = SUIT.orange;
    for (let x = -18; x < 18; x += 6) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, 19);
      ctx.lineTo(x + 3, 19);
      ctx.lineTo(x + 6, 15);
      ctx.lineTo(x + 3, 15);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.fillStyle = SUIT.orange;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-9, 4, 4, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#1f2416";
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const a = (i * Math.PI * 2) / 3 - Math.PI / 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-9, 4);
      ctx.arc(-9, 4, 3.4, a - 0.45, a + 0.45);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = SUIT.orange;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-9, 4, 0.9, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  } else if (d === 4) {
    // Elite: plazma çekirdeği + altın hatlar
    ctx.strokeStyle = SUIT.orange;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-16, -16);
    ctx.lineTo(-6, -6);
    ctx.lineTo(-6, 10);
    ctx.moveTo(16, -16);
    ctx.lineTo(6, -6);
    ctx.lineTo(6, 10);
    ctx.stroke();
    const pu = 0.7 + 0.3 * Math.sin(t * 4);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = "#ffb02e";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 12 * pu;
    const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 2, 0, 0, 2, 5.5);
    rg.addColorStop(0, "#fffbe6");
    rg.addColorStop(0.4, "#ffd34d");
    rg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,140,30,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = rg;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 2, 5.5, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.strokeStyle = SUIT.orange;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 2, 4, 0, 7);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}
function suitDecoShoulders() {
  const d = SUITX.deco;
  if (d < 3) return;
  for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(s * 8, -26, s * 20, -12);
    g.addColorStop(0, d === 4 ? "#f8d77a" : SUIT.light);
    g.addColorStop(1, d === 4 ? "#8a6410" : SUIT.dark);
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(s * 14, -18, 9, 6.5, s * 0.25, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = SUIT.line;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.1;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.35)";

function suitDecoHelmet(t) {
  const d = SUITX.deco;
  if (!d) return;
  if (d === 1) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = SUIT.orange;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, 17.5, Math.PI * 1.12, Math.PI * 1.62);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  if (d === 2) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = SUIT.orange;
    ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
    ctx.strokeStyle = SUIT.orange;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.3;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8 + 0.2 * Math.sin(t * 3);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, 18.5, Math.PI * 0.95, Math.PI * 1.55);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }
  if (d === 3) {
    ctx.fillStyle = SUIT.dark;
    rrp(-21, -6, 6, 12, 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = SUIT.orange;
    ctx.fillRect(-20, -4, 4, 1.6);
    ctx.fillRect(-20, 0, 4, 1.6);
  }
  if (d === 4) {
    // tepe yüzgeci
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(-10, -30, 8, -16);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#ffe9a0");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#8a6410");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-10, -16);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-8, -27, 6, -25);
    ctx.lineTo(4, -18);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#4a3405";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

    const R = rng(9);
    for (let i = 0; i < 22; i++) {
      ctx.fillStyle = ["rgba(91,102,49,.55)", "rgba(107,69,38,.55)", "rgba(226,192,147,.5)"][i % 3];
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(-24 + R() * 48, -60 + R() * 92, 4 + R() * 7, 3 + R() * 5, R() * 3, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  if (d === "raven") {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = "#ff2a3a";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,60,70,.9)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(s * 6, -50);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(s * 20, -10, s * 19, 30);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
  if (d === "gold") {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(20,20,24,.85)";
    for (const y of [-44, 24]) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-26, y);
      ctx.lineTo(0, y + 5);
      ctx.lineTo(26, y);
      ctx.lineTo(26, y + 3);
      ctx.lineTo(0, y + 8);
      ctx.lineTo(-26, y + 3);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    }
    const sx = Math.sin(t * 1.3) * 18;
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(sx - 10, 0, sx + 10, 0);
    g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
    g.addColorStop(0.5, "rgba(255,255,255,.55)");
    g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(-26, -80, 52, 116);
  }
  const a = RKV.armor || 0;
  if (a >= 1) {
    // perçinli plakalar
    for (const [x0, x1] of [
      [-24, -2],
      [2, 24],
    ]) {
      const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 4, 0, 22);
      g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(120,128,150,.85)");
      g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(60,66,88,.9)");
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      rrp(x0, 4, x1 - x0, 17, 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(20,24,36,.8)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(230,235,245,.8)";
      for (let x = x0 + 3; x < x1 - 1; x += 5) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(x, 7, 0.8, 0, 7);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(x, 18, 0.8, 0, 7);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }
  }
}
function rocketDecoOutside(t) {
  const a = RKV.armor || 0;
  if (a >= 2) {
    // kanat kenar koruyucuları + burun başlığı
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#c3c9dc";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.6;
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    for (const sx of [-1, 1]) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(sx * 23, 6);
      ctx.lineTo(sx * 44, 42);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(30,34,50,.8)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (const sx of [-1, 1]) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(sx * 23, 6);
      ctx.lineTo(sx * 44, 42);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(-6, -82, 6, -70);
    g.addColorStop(0, "#eef1fb");
    g.addColorStop(1, "#5b6178");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -82);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(6, -76, 6.5, -70);
    ctx.lineTo(-6.5, -70);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-6, -76, 0, -82);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  if (a >= 3) {
    // deflektör kalkanı
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
    for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
      const y = -14 + i * 30,
        ph = t * 2 + i;
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(90,200,255," + (0.35 + 0.25 * Math.sin(ph)) + ")";
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, y, 34, 6, 0, 0, 7);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, -20, 10, 0, -20, 70);
    g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(90,200,255,0)");
    g.addColorStop(0.8, "rgba(90,200,255," + (0.08 + 0.04 * Math.sin(t * 3)) + ")");
    g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(90,200,255,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, -20, 52, 78, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }
}
/* --- altın parçası (zeminde) --- */
function drawGoldNugget(x, y, t, seed) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  const pu = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(t * 3 + seed);
  const gl = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 26);
  gl.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,210,90," + 0.35 * pu + ")");
  gl.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,210,90,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = gl;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, 26, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.3)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(2, 9, 11, 3.5, 0, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  const R = rng(Math.floor(seed * 1000) + 3);
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
    const a = (i / 9) * 6.283,
      r = 7 + R() * 4;
    ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(a) * r * 1.25, Math.sin(a) * r * 0.85);
  }
  ctx.closePath();
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(-9, -8, 9, 8);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#fff4c2");
  g.addColorStop(0.35, "#f5c542");
  g.addColorStop(0.75, "#b9861a");
  g.addColorStop(1, "#6b4a08");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#5a3d06";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.75)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(-3, -3, 3, 1.4, -0.5, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  const sp = (t * 1.4 + seed) % 1;
  if (sp < 0.3) {
    const a = 1 - sp / 0.3;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + a + ")";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(5, -9);
    ctx.lineTo(5, -3);
    ctx.moveTo(2, -6);
    ctx.lineTo(8, -6);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}
/* --- roket içi: geliştirme istasyonu (cam kapsül + manken) --- */
let upgOpen = false,
  upgTab = "suit",
  upgSel = null,
  upgAnim = 0;
function drawSuitPod(x, F, C, t) {
  upgAnim += ((upgOpen ? 1 : 0) - upgAnim) * 0.12;
  const top = C + 18,
    w = 40;
  // gövde: mühendislik ünitesi
  const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(x - w / 2, 0, x + w / 2, 0);
  bg.addColorStop(0, "#3b4160");
  bg.addColorStop(0.5, "#59617f");
  bg.addColorStop(1, "#2d3246");
  ctx.fillStyle = bg;
  rrp(x - w / 2, top, w, F - top, 6);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#1b1e2e";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.stroke();
  // üst: holografik projeksiyon (kıyafet ↔ roket dönüşümlü)
  const cyc = (t * 0.22) % 2,
    isS = cyc < 1,
    k = cyc % 1,
    fade = Math.min(1, Math.min(k, 1 - k) * 6);
  const hx = x,
    hy = top + 36,
    gc = isS ? curSuit().glow : "#5ad1ff";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0a0f22";
  rrp(x - w / 2 + 3, top + 3, w - 6, 62, 5);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.save();
  rrp(x - w / 2 + 3, top + 3, w - 6, 62, 5);
  ctx.clip();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(90,209,255,.08)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let yy = top + 5; yy < top + 66; yy += 3) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x - w / 2, yy);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w / 2, yy);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.85 * fade;
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
  const img = isS ? suitSprite(curSuit(), 0.42) : rocketSprite(RSK, RKV.armor, 0.36);
  const sx = Math.cos(t * 1.4);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(hx, hy);
  ctx.scale(Math.max(0.25, Math.abs(sx)) * (sx < 0 ? -1 : 1), 1);
  ctx.drawImage(img, -img.width / 2, -img.height / 2 + (isS ? -2 : 6));
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  const hl = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, top + 3, 0, top + 65);
  hl.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
  hl.addColorStop(1, gc + "33");
  ctx.fillStyle = hl;
  ctx.fillRect(x - w / 2, top + 3, w, 62);
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.fillStyle = gc;
  ctx.fillRect(x - 12, top + 64, 24, 1.6);
  // orta: üretim haznesi + robot kol
  const cy = top + 72,
    ch = F - cy - 24;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#141a2e";
  rrp(x - w / 2 + 3, cy, w - 6, ch, 4);
  ctx.fill();
  const cg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, cy, 0, cy + ch);
  cg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,170,90,.18)");
  cg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,120,60,.05)");
  ctx.fillStyle = cg;
  rrp(x - w / 2 + 3, cy, w - 6, ch, 4);
  ctx.fill();
  const ax = x + Math.sin(t * 1.7) * 9,
    ay = cy + ch - 12 + Math.sin(t * 3.1) * 2;
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#c9d0e2";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.4;
  ctx.lineCap = "round";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x - w / 2 + 6, cy + 5);
  ctx.lineTo(x - 4, cy + ch * 0.45);
  ctx.lineTo(ax, ay);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff8c42";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x - 4, cy + ch * 0.45, 2.2, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#6b7390";
  rrp(x - 12, cy + ch - 6, 24, 5, 2);
  ctx.fill(); // üretim tablası
  if (Math.sin(t * 9) > 0.2) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
    const sg = ctx.createRadialGradient(ax, ay, 0, ax, ay, 9);
    sg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,240,200,.95)");
    sg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,160,80,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = sg;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ax, ay, 9, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * 3.14 + 3.14,
        l = 3 + Math.random() * 7;
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,210,140,.9)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(ax, ay);
      ctx.lineTo(ax + Math.cos(a) * l, ay + Math.sin(a) * l);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
  // cam
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(180,220,255,.07)";
  rrp(x - w / 2 + 3, cy, w - 6, ch, 4);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.25)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x - w / 2 + 6, cy + 4);
  ctx.lineTo(x - w / 2 + 6, cy + ch - 4);
  ctx.stroke();
  // alt: malzeme yuvaları (metal / altın / nadir)
  const by = F - 20;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#1d2234";
  rrp(x - w / 2 + 2, by, w - 4, 16, 3);
  ctx.fill();
  const slots = [
    ["#c9d2e0", (game.inventory.stone || 0) > 0],
    ["#f5c542", (game.gold || 0) > 0],
    ["#b6f04a", game.rare && (game.rare.olivin || 0) > 0],
    ["#9fd3ff", game.rare && (game.rare.titan || 0) > 0],
  ];
  slots.forEach(([c, on], i) => {
    const sx2 = x - 14 + i * 9.3;
    ctx.fillStyle = on ? c : "#2a3048";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sx2, by + 8, 2.6, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    if (on) {
      ctx.fillStyle = c + "55";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(sx2, by + 8, 5, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  });
  // etiket
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0a1024";
  rrp(x - 20, top - 13, 40, 10, 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = gc;
  ctx.font = "700 6.5px monospace";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillText(T("ATÖLYE"), x, top - 5.5);
}
/* --- arayüz --- */
function upgRes() {
  ensureRare();
  const R = { stone: game.inventory.stone || 0, star: game.inventory.star || 0, gold: game.gold || 0 };
  for (const k of RARE_ALL) R[k] = game.rare[k] || 0;
  return R;
}
function rareShort(k) {
  return game.rareKnown && game.rareKnown[k]
    ? RARE_DEF[k].name.split(" ")[0]
    : T("Bilinmeyen") + " #" + (RARE_ALL.indexOf(k) + 1);
}
function openUpg(tab) {
  ensureUpg();
  upgOpen = true;
  if (tab) upgTab = tab;
  upgSel = null;
  $("upgScreen").classList.remove("hidden");
  sfx("click");
  tone(440, 0.08, "triangle", 0.05);
  tone(660, 0.1, "triangle", 0.05, 0, 0.08);
  renderUpg();
}
function closeUpg() {
  upgOpen = false;
  $("upgScreen").classList.add("hidden");
  focusGame();
}
const pct = (v) => Math.round(v * 100);
function statRows(st, cmp) {
  const rows = [
    [T("Oksijen tüketimi"), 1 / st.o2, 1 / (cmp || st).o2, "o2", "%" + pct(1 - st.o2) + T(" daha az")],
    [T("Yürüme hızı"), st.spd, (cmp || st).spd, "spd", "+%" + pct(st.spd - 1)],
    [
      T("Radyasyon koruması"),
      1 - st.rad,
      1 - (cmp || st).rad,
      "rad",
      "%" + pct(1 - st.rad) + T(" daha az hasar"),
    ],
    [
      T("Fırtına direnci"),
      1 - st.storm,
      1 - (cmp || st).storm,
      "storm",
      "%" + pct(1 - st.storm) + T(" daha az etki"),
    ],
    [
      T("Yerçekimi dengesi"),
      st.grav || 0,
      (cmp || st).grav || 0,
      "grav",
      "%" + pct((st.grav || 0) * 0.85) + T(" daha az sekme"),
    ],
  ];
  const norm = {
    o2: (v) => (v - 1) / 1.7,
    spd: (v) => (v - 1) / 0.3,
    rad: (v) => v / 0.8,
    storm: (v) => v / 0.8,
    grav: (v) => v / 0.9,
  };
  return rows
    .map(([n, v, c, k, txt]) => {
      const a = Math.max(0.04, Math.min(1, norm[k](v))),
        b = Math.max(0.04, Math.min(1, norm[k](c)));
      const up = a > b + 0.001,
        dn = a < b - 0.001;
      return `<div class="ug-st"><div class="ug-stn"><span>${n}</span><b class="${up ? "up" : dn ? "dn" : ""}">${txt === "+%0" || txt.startsWith("%0 ") ? T("standart") : txt}</b></div>
      <div class="ug-bar"><i class="cur" style="width:${b * 100}%"></i><i class="new ${up ? "up" : dn ? "dn" : ""}" style="width:${a * 100}%"></i></div></div>`;
    })
    .join("");
}
function costChips(c) {
  const R = upgRes(),
    out = [];
  if (c.stone)
    out.push(
      `<span class="ug-cost ${R.stone >= c.stone ? "ok" : "no"}"><img src="${itemIconURL("stone")}">${R.stone}/${c.stone}</span>`,
    );
  if (c.star)
    out.push(
      `<span class="ug-cost ${R.star >= c.star ? "ok" : "no"}"><img src="${itemIconURL("star")}">${R.star}/${c.star}</span>`,
    );
  if (c.gold)
    out.push(
      `<span class="ug-cost gold ${R.gold >= c.gold ? "ok" : "no"}"><i class="ug-au"></i>${R.gold}/${c.gold}</span>`,
    );
  for (const k of RARE_KEYS)
    if (c[k])
      out.push(
        `<span class="ug-cost ${R[k] >= c[k] ? "ok" : "no"}" title="${rareLabel(k)}"><img src="${rareIconURL(k)}">${rareShort(k)} ${R[k]}/${c[k]}</span>`,
      );
  return out.join("") || T('<span class="ug-cost ok">Ücretsiz</span>');
}
function canPay(c) {
  const R = upgRes();
  return ["stone", "star", "gold", ...RARE_KEYS].every((k) => R[k] >= (c[k] || 0));
}
function pay(c) {
  game.inventory.stone -= c.stone || 0;
  game.inventory.star -= c.star || 0;
  game.gold -= c.gold || 0;
  for (const k of RARE_KEYS) game.rare[k] -= c[k] || 0;
  updateInv();
}
function upgFanfare(col) {
  tone(523, 0.12, "triangle", 0.07);
  tone(659, 0.12, "triangle", 0.07, 0, 0.1);
  tone(784, 0.16, "triangle", 0.07, 0, 0.2);
  tone(1047, 0.35, "sine", 0.06, 0, 0.32);
  const el = $("ugFlash");
  if (el) {
    el.style.background = `radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%,${col}55,transparent 60%)`;
    el.classList.remove("go");
    void el.offsetWidth;
    el.classList.add("go");
  }
}
function renderUpg() {
  const R = upgRes();
  $("ugRes").innerHTML =
    Tf(
      `<span><img src="{0}">Metal <b>{1}</b></span><span><img src="{2}">Kristal <b>{3}</b></span><span><i class="ug-au"></i>Altın <b>{4}</b></span>`,
      [itemIconURL("stone"), R.stone, itemIconURL("star"), R.star, R.gold],
    ) +
    RARE_ALL.filter((k) => RARE_KEYS.includes(k) || R[k] > 0)
      .map(
        (k) =>
          `<span title="${rareLabel(k)}${RARE_KEYS.includes(k) ? "" : T(" (yalnız bilim)")}"${RARE_KEYS.includes(k) ? "" : ' style="opacity:.6"'}><img src="${rareIconURL(k)}">${rareShort(k)} <b>${R[k]}</b></span>`,
      )
      .join("");
  document
    .querySelectorAll("#upgScreen .ug-tabs button")
    .forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle("on", b.dataset.t === upgTab));
  const B = $("ugBody");
  if (upgTab === "suit") {
    const cur = curSuit();
    const sel = SUITS.find((s) => s.id === upgSel) || cur;
    upgSel = sel.id;
    const owned = game.suitsOwned.includes(sel.id),
      worn = game.suit === sel.id,
      idx = SUITS.indexOf(sel),
      prevOwned = idx === 0 || game.suitsOwned.includes(SUITS[idx - 1].id);
    B.innerHTML = `<div class="ug-grid">
      <div class="ug-list">${SUITS.map((s) => {
        const o = game.suitsOwned.includes(s.id),
          wn = game.suit === s.id;
        return `<button class="ug-card ${s.id === sel.id ? "sel" : ""} ${o ? "own" : ""}" data-id="${s.id}" style="--g:${s.glow}">
          <div class="ug-thumb"><img src="${suitSprite(s, 0.7).toDataURL()}"></div>
          <div class="ug-ct"><small>${s.tier}</small><b>${s.name}</b><em>${s.tag}</em></div>
          <span class="ug-badge ${wn ? "on" : o ? "own" : ""}">${wn ? T("GİYİLİ") : o ? T("SAHİP") : T("KİLİTLİ")}</span></button>`;
      }).join("")}</div>
      <div class="ug-detail" style="--g:${sel.glow}">
        <div class="ug-stage"><div class="ug-ring"></div><img class="ug-hero" src="${suitSprite(sel, 2.1).toDataURL()}"><div class="ug-floor"></div></div>
        <div class="ug-info"><small>${sel.tier}</small><h3>${sel.name}</h3><p>${sel.desc}</p>
          ${sel.gf ? Tf(`<div class="ug-feat">⚙ {0} · dışarıda yerçekiminden daha az etkilenirsin</div>`, [sel.gf]) : ""}<div class="ug-stats">${statRows(sel.st, cur.st)}</div>
          <div class="ug-buy">${owned ? "" : `<div class="ug-costs">${costChips(sel.cost)}</div>`}
            <button class="cbtn pri wide" id="ugAct" ${worn ? "disabled" : ""}>${worn ? T("✓ Şu an giyili") : owned ? T("Giy") : !prevOwned ? T("Önce ") + SUITS[idx - 1].name : T("Üret ve giy")}</button></div></div>
      </div></div>`;
    B.querySelectorAll(".ug-card").forEach(
      (c) =>
        (c.onclick = () => {
          upgSel = c.dataset.id;
          sfx("click");
          renderUpg();
        }),
    );
    $("ugAct").onclick = () => {
      if (worn) return;
      if (!owned) {
        if (!prevOwned) {
          sfx("error");
          toast(T("Önce bir önceki seti üretmelisin"));
          return;
        }
        if (!canPay(sel.cost)) {
          sfx("error");
          toast(T("Malzeme yetersiz — metal, yıldız kristali ve uzak bölgelerdeki nadir taşları topla"));
          return;
        }
        pay(sel.cost);
        game.suitsOwned.push(sel.id);
        setTimeout(() => {
          bumpQuest("suit");
          if (sel.st.rad <= 0.6) bumpQuest("radSuit");
        }, 900);
      }
      game.suit = sel.id;
      syncLooks();
      upgFanfare(sel.glow);
      toast("🧑‍🚀 <b>" + sel.name + T("</b> giyildi — ") + sel.tag);
      renderUpg();
    };
  } else {
    const A = rkArmor(),
      sk = ROCKET_SKINS.find((s) => s.id === upgSel) || ROCKET_SKINS.find((s) => s.id === game.rk.skin);
    upgSel = sk.id;
    const ownedSk = game.rk.owned.includes(sk.id),
      appl = game.rk.skin === sk.id;
    const chanceNow = A ? ARMOR[A - 1].chance : BASE_STORM_BREAK;
    B.innerHTML = Tf(
      `<div class="ug-rk">
      <div class="ug-rkstage" style="--g:#5ad1ff"><div class="ug-ring"></div><img class="ug-hero rk" src="{0}"><div class="ug-floor"></div>
        <div class="ug-rkcap"><small>BOYA</small><b>{1}</b><p>{2}</p></div></div>
      <div class="ug-rkside">
        <div class="ug-sec">🛡️ FIRTINA KALKANI <span>Arıza olasılığı: <b>%{3}</b></span></div>
        <div class="ug-armor">{4}</div>
        <div class="ug-sec">🎨 GÖRÜNÜM <span>Altın parçalarıyla boya</span></div>
        <div class="ug-skins">{5}</div>
        <div class="ug-buy">{6}
          <button class="cbtn pri wide" id="ugSk" {7}>{8}</button></div>
      </div></div>`,
      [
        rocketSprite(sk, A, 2.2).toDataURL(),
        sk.name,
        sk.desc,
        Math.round(chanceNow * 100),
        ARMOR.map((a) => {
          const done = A >= a.lv,
            next = A === a.lv - 1;
          return `<div class="ug-al ${done ? "done" : next ? "next" : "lock"}"><div class="ug-alv">${done ? "✓" : a.lv}</div><div class="ug-alt"><b>${a.name}</b><p>${a.desc}</p>${next ? `<div class="ug-costs">${costChips(a.c)}</div>` : ""}</div>
            ${next ? Tf(`<button class="cbtn pri" data-armor="{0}">Kur</button>`, [a.lv]) : done ? T('<span class="ug-badge on">KURULU</span>') : T('<span class="ug-badge">KİLİTLİ</span>')}</div>`;
        }).join(""),
        ROCKET_SKINS.map((s) => {
          const o = game.rk.owned.includes(s.id),
            on = game.rk.skin === s.id;
          return `<button class="ug-sk ${s.id === sk.id ? "sel" : ""}" data-id="${s.id}"><img src="${rocketSprite(s, A, 0.62).toDataURL()}"><b>${s.name}</b>
            <span class="ug-badge ${on ? "on" : o ? "own" : ""}">${on ? T("AKTİF") : o ? T("SAHİP") : `<i class="ug-au"></i>${s.cost}`}</span></button>`;
        }).join(""),
        ownedSk ? "" : `<div class="ug-costs">${costChips({ gold: sk.cost })}</div>`,
        appl ? "disabled" : "",
        appl ? T("✓ Uygulandı") : ownedSk ? T("Boyayı uygula") : T("Satın al ve uygula"),
      ],
    );
    B.querySelectorAll(".ug-sk").forEach(
      (c) =>
        (c.onclick = () => {
          upgSel = c.dataset.id;
          sfx("click");
          renderUpg();
        }),
    );
    B.querySelectorAll("[data-armor]").forEach(
      (b) =>
        (b.onclick = () => {
          const a = ARMOR[+b.dataset.armor - 1];
          if (!canPay(a.c)) {
            sfx("error");
            toast(
              T("Malzeme yetersiz — altın (meteor kraterleri) ve titanyum cevheri (uzak bölgeler) topla"),
            );
            return;
          }
          pay(a.c);
          game.rk.armor = a.lv;
          syncLooks();
          setTimeout(() => bumpQuest("armor"), 900);
          upgFanfare("#5ad1ff");
          noiseBurst(0.6, 0.12, 1800);
          toast(
            "🛡️ <b>" + a.name + T("</b> kuruldu — fırtınada arıza olasılığı %") + Math.round(a.chance * 100),
          );
          renderUpg();
        }),
    );
    $("ugSk").onclick = () => {
      if (appl) return;
      if (!ownedSk) {
        if (!canPay({ gold: sk.cost })) {
          sfx("error");
          toast(T("Yeterli altın yok — meteor kraterlerinden altın parçası topla"));
          return;
        }
        pay({ gold: sk.cost });
        game.rk.owned.push(sk.id);
      }
      game.rk.skin = sk.id;
      syncLooks();
      upgFanfare("#f5c042");
      toast(T("🎨 Roket boyandı: <b>") + sk.name + "</b>");
      renderUpg();
    };
  }
}
