let rareNodes = [];
function ensureRare() {
  if (!game) return;
  if (!game.rare) game.rare = { titan: 0, olivin: 0, ares: 0 };
  for (const k of RARE_ALL) if (game.rare[k] == null) game.rare[k] = 0;
  if (!game.rareKnown) game.rareKnown = {};
  if (!Array.isArray(game.rareTaken)) game.rareTaken = [];
}
function genRare() {
  const R = rng(4242),
    out = [],
    spec = [
      ["titan", 28, 1300, 6400],
      ["olivin", 23, 1700, 7200],
      ["ares", 10, 2700, 7800],
      ["hematit", 22, 800, 6200],
      ["jips", 20, 1000, 6800],
      ["perklorat", 16, 1200, 7400],
      ["meteorit", 11, 2000, 7800],
    ];
  for (const [k, n, d0, d1] of spec) {
    let made = 0,
      guard = 0;
    while (made < n && guard++ < 4000) {
      const a = R() * 6.283,
        d = d0 + R() * (d1 - d0),
        x = ROCKET.x + Math.cos(a) * d,
        y = ROCKET.y + Math.sin(a) * d;
      if (Math.abs(x) > CFG.worldHalf - 160 || Math.abs(y) > CFG.worldHalf - 160) continue;
      if (out.some((o) => Math.hypot(o.x - x, o.y - y) < 320)) continue;
      out.push({
        id: k + made,
        kind: k,
        x,
        y,
        n: k === "titan" && R() < 0.4 ? 2 : 1,
        seed: R() * 100,
        taken: false,
      });
      made++;
    }
  }
  return out;
}
function spawnRare(sc) {
  ensureRare();
  rareNodes = sc === "mars" ? genRare().filter((n) => !game.rareTaken.includes(n.id)) : [];
}
function rareLabel(k) {
  return game && game.rareKnown && game.rareKnown[k] ? RARE_DEF[k].name : T("Bilinmeyen taş");
}
/* --- çizim: büyük, ayrıntılı nadir taş (kaya gövdesi + jeot kristalleri + çatlaklar + kırılma) --- */
const RARE_SCALE = 1.45;
function hslHex(h, s, l) {
  h = ((h % 360) + 360) % 360;
  s /= 100;
  l /= 100;
  const k = (n) => (n + h / 30) % 12,
    a = s * Math.min(l, 1 - l),
    f = (n) => l - a * Math.max(-1, Math.min(k(n) - 3, Math.min(9 - k(n), 1)));
  return (
    "#" +
    [f(0), f(8), f(4)]
      .map((x) =>
        Math.round(x * 255)
          .toString(16)
          .padStart(2, "0"),
      )
      .join("")
  );
}
function rarePal(n, t) {
  const known = game && game.rareKnown && game.rareKnown[n.kind],
    D = RARE_DEF[n.kind];
  if (known) return { col: D.col, gl: D.glow, unk: false };
  const h = 200 + (((t || 0) * 24 + (n.seed || 0) * 90) % 160); // gizemli, renk değiştiren (yanardöner) kristal
  return {
    col: [hslHex(h, 90, 93), hslHex(h + 35, 72, 64), hslHex(h + 70, 62, 24)],
    gl: hslHex(h + 20, 95, 72),
    unk: true,
  };
}
function rareShape(n) {
  // kaya silüeti (sabit, tohumdan)
  if (n._sh) return n._sh;
  const R = rng(Math.floor(n.seed * 1000) + 7),
    pts = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
    const a = Math.PI + (i / 13) * Math.PI,
      r = 30 + R() * 9;
    pts.push([Math.cos(a) * r * 1.25, Math.sin(a) * r * 0.95 - 2]);
  }
  pts.push([34, 6], [22, 12], [0, 14], [-22, 12], [-35, 6]);
  const cr = [];
  const nC = 6 + Math.floor(R() * 3);
  for (let i = 0; i < nC; i++)
    cr.push({
      x: (R() - 0.5) * 30,
      y: -6 + (R() - 0.5) * 6,
      h: 18 + R() * 24,
      w: 4 + R() * 4.5,
      a: (R() - 0.5) * 0.95,
    });
  cr.sort((a, b) => b.h - a.h);
  const sh = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const a = R() * 6.283;
    sh.push({
      x: Math.cos(a) * (44 + R() * 16),
      y: 8 + Math.sin(a) * 10,
      h: 5 + R() * 7,
      a: (R() - 0.5) * 1.2,
    });
  }
  const sp = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) sp.push([(R() - 0.5) * 66, -30 + R() * 36, R()]);
  return (n._sh = { pts, cr, sh, sp });
}
function rareCrystal(c, x, y, h, w, a, col, gl, pu) {
  c.save();
  c.translate(x, y);
  c.rotate(a);
  c.shadowColor = gl;
  c.shadowBlur = 12 * pu;
  const cg = c.createLinearGradient(-w, 0, w, 0);
  cg.addColorStop(0, col[2]);
  cg.addColorStop(0.35, col[1]);
  cg.addColorStop(0.55, col[0]);
  cg.addColorStop(1, col[2]);
  c.fillStyle = cg;
  c.beginPath();
  c.moveTo(-w, 0);
  c.lineTo(-w * 0.85, -h * 0.72);
  c.lineTo(0, -h);
  c.lineTo(w * 0.85, -h * 0.72);
  c.lineTo(w, 0);
  c.closePath();
  c.fill();
  c.shadowBlur = 0;
  const ig = c.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, -h);
  ig.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
  ig.addColorStop(0.6, gl + "66");
  ig.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,.9)");
  c.fillStyle = ig;
  c.beginPath();
  c.moveTo(-w * 0.25, -h * 0.1);
  c.lineTo(-w * 0.3, -h * 0.7);
  c.lineTo(0, -h * 0.96);
  c.lineTo(w * 0.1, -h * 0.7);
  c.lineTo(w * 0.05, -h * 0.1);
  c.closePath();
  c.fill();
  c.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.55)";
  c.lineWidth = 0.8;
  c.beginPath();
  c.moveTo(-w * 0.85, -h * 0.72);
  c.lineTo(0, -h);
  c.lineTo(w * 0.85, -h * 0.72);
  c.stroke();
  c.restore();
}
function drawRareBody(c, n, t, o) {
  o = o || {};
  const P = rarePal(n, t),
    col = P.col,
    gl = P.gl,
    S = rareShape(n),
    pu = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(t * 2.2 + n.seed);
  const now = performance.now() / 1000,
    wob = n.hitT ? Math.max(0, 1 - (now - n.hitT) / 0.35) : 0;
  const hits = n.hits || 0,
    split = n.split ? Math.min(1, (now - n.split) / 0.55) : 0;
  // zemin: koyu iz + nabız gibi atan ışık + yere düşen kristal ışığı
  if (!o.icon) {
    c.fillStyle = "rgba(10,4,2,.35)";
    c.beginPath();
    c.ellipse(0, 10, 62, 17, 0, 0, 7);
    c.fill();
    const g0 = c.createRadialGradient(0, 2, 4, 0, 2, 92);
    g0.addColorStop(0, gl + "66");
    g0.addColorStop(0.5, gl + "22");
    g0.addColorStop(1, gl + "00");
    c.globalAlpha = 0.55 + 0.45 * pu;
    c.fillStyle = g0;
    c.beginPath();
    c.ellipse(0, 4, 92, 46, 0, 0, 7);
    c.fill();
    c.globalAlpha = 1;
    // yörüngedeki toz zerreleri
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      const a = t * 0.6 + i * 0.9 + n.seed,
        r = 46 + 12 * Math.sin(t + i);
      c.fillStyle = gl;
      c.globalAlpha = 0.35 + 0.35 * Math.sin(t * 3 + i);
      c.beginPath();
      c.arc(Math.cos(a) * r, -14 + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.32, 1.3, 0, 7);
      c.fill();
    }
    c.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
  // etraftaki küçük kristal kırıntıları
  for (const s of S.sh) rareCrystal(c, s.x, s.y, s.h, 2.2, s.a, col, gl, pu * 0.7);
  const half = (side) => {
    // ana kaya: üç tonlu yüzeyler + kenar ışığı
    c.beginPath();
    S.pts.forEach((q, i) => (i ? c.lineTo(q[0], q[1]) : c.moveTo(q[0], q[1])));
    c.closePath();
    const rg = c.createLinearGradient(-30, -34, 24, 16);
    rg.addColorStop(0, "#8a6253");
    rg.addColorStop(0.35, "#5a382c");
    rg.addColorStop(0.75, "#2e1a13");
    rg.addColorStop(1, "#170c08");
    c.fillStyle = rg;
    c.fill();
    c.save();
    c.clip();
    c.fillStyle = "rgba(255,210,180,.10)";
    c.beginPath();
    c.moveTo(-40, -40);
    c.lineTo(10, -40);
    c.lineTo(-6, -10);
    c.lineTo(-40, -4);
    c.closePath();
    c.fill(); // üst yüzey
    c.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.22)";
    c.beginPath();
    c.moveTo(12, -36);
    c.lineTo(44, -20);
    c.lineTo(44, 20);
    c.lineTo(6, 20);
    c.closePath();
    c.fill(); // gölgeli yan
    for (const q of S.sp) {
      c.fillStyle = q[2] < 0.5 ? "rgba(255,220,200,.10)" : "rgba(0,0,0,.18)";
      c.fillRect(q[0], q[1], 1.4, 1.4);
    }
    // jeot ağzı: kayanın içinden ışık sızar
    const gg = c.createRadialGradient(0, -8, 2, 0, -8, 26);
    gg.addColorStop(0, gl + "cc");
    gg.addColorStop(0.5, gl + "44");
    gg.addColorStop(1, gl + "00");
    c.globalAlpha = 0.55 + 0.35 * pu;
    c.fillStyle = gg;
    c.beginPath();
    c.ellipse(0, -8, 26, 14, 0, 0, 7);
    c.fill();
    c.globalAlpha = 1;
    c.restore();
    c.strokeStyle = "rgba(15,6,3,.75)";
    c.lineWidth = 1.6;
    c.beginPath();
    S.pts.forEach((q, i) => (i ? c.lineTo(q[0], q[1]) : c.moveTo(q[0], q[1])));
    c.closePath();
    c.stroke();
    c.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,190,150,.35)";
    c.lineWidth = 1.2;
    c.beginPath();
    for (let i = 1; i < 9; i++) {
      const q = S.pts[i];
      i === 1 ? c.moveTo(q[0], q[1]) : c.lineTo(q[0], q[1]);
    }
    c.stroke(); // kenar ışığı
    // kristal kümesi
    for (const k of S.cr) rareCrystal(c, k.x, k.y, k.h, k.w, k.a, col, gl, pu);
    // bilinmeyen taş: yüzeyde nabız gibi atan ışık damarları
    if (P.unk && !hits) {
      c.save();
      c.shadowColor = gl;
      c.shadowBlur = 6;
      c.strokeStyle = gl;
      c.globalAlpha = 0.25 + 0.45 * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * 2.6 + n.seed * 3));
      c.lineWidth = 1.1;
      c.lineCap = "round";
      for (const V of [
        [
          [-34, -6],
          [-22, -12],
          [-14, -6],
          [-6, -14],
        ],
        [
          [30, -4],
          [20, -10],
          [12, -6],
        ],
        [
          [-26, 6],
          [-12, 4],
          [-2, 8],
        ],
      ]) {
        c.beginPath();
        V.forEach((q, j) => (j ? c.lineTo(q[0], q[1]) : c.moveTo(q[0], q[1])));
        c.stroke();
      }
      c.restore();
    }
    // vuruş çatlakları: içinden ışık sızar
    if (hits > 0) {
      c.save();
      c.shadowColor = gl;
      c.shadowBlur = 8;
      c.strokeStyle = gl;
      c.lineWidth = 1.6;
      c.lineCap = "round";
      const cracks = [
        [
          [-4, -30],
          [2, -18],
          [-3, -8],
          [4, 4],
          [0, 12],
        ],
        [
          [2, -18],
          [14, -14],
          [22, -4],
        ],
        [
          [-3, -8],
          [-16, -4],
          [-26, 4],
        ],
        [
          [4, 4],
          [16, 8],
        ],
      ];
      for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(cracks.length, hits + 1); i++) {
        const L = cracks[i];
        c.beginPath();
        L.forEach((q, j) => (j ? c.lineTo(q[0], q[1]) : c.moveTo(q[0], q[1])));
        c.stroke();
      }
      c.restore();
    }
  };
  c.save();
  if (wob > 0) {
    c.translate(Math.sin(now * 70) * 2.2 * wob, 0);
    c.rotate(Math.sin(now * 55) * 0.03 * wob);
  }
  if (split <= 0) half(0);
  else {
    // kırıldı: iki yarı ayrılır, ortada çekirdek kalır
    const e = 1 - Math.pow(1 - split, 3),
      fade = n.fadeEnd ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (n.fadeEnd - now) / 1.2)) : 1;
    c.globalAlpha = fade;
    for (const sd of [-1, 1]) {
      c.save();
      c.translate(sd * e * 20, e * 5);
      c.rotate(sd * e * 0.32);
      c.beginPath();
      if (sd < 0) {
        c.moveTo(-80, -80);
        c.lineTo(-4, -80);
        c.lineTo(2, -18);
        c.lineTo(-3, -8);
        c.lineTo(4, 4);
        c.lineTo(0, 30);
        c.lineTo(-80, 30);
      } else {
        c.moveTo(80, -80);
        c.lineTo(-4, -80);
        c.lineTo(2, -18);
        c.lineTo(-3, -8);
        c.lineTo(4, 4);
        c.lineTo(0, 30);
        c.lineTo(80, 30);
      }
      c.closePath();
      c.clip();
      half(sd);
      c.restore();
    }
    c.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
  c.restore();
  // parıltı
  const sp = (t * 0.9 + n.seed) % 1;
  if (sp < 0.25 && !split) {
    const a = 1 - sp / 0.25,
      sx = Math.sin(n.seed * 7) * 14,
      sy = -40;
    c.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + a + ")";
    c.lineWidth = 1.4;
    c.beginPath();
    c.moveTo(sx, sy - 8);
    c.lineTo(sx, sy + 8);
    c.moveTo(sx - 8, sy);
    c.lineTo(sx + 8, sy);
    c.stroke();

}
function drawRareCore(n, now) {
  // kırılınca açığa çıkan parlayan çekirdek
  if (!n.split) return;
  const k = Math.min(1, (now - n.split) / 0.8),
    P = rarePal(n),
    fly = n.flyT ? Math.min(1, (now - n.flyT) / 0.35) : 0;
  if (fly >= 1) return;
  let x = n.x,
    y = n.y - 14 * RARE_SCALE - 34 * (1 - Math.pow(1 - k, 3)) + Math.sin(now * 4) * 2;
  if (fly > 0) {
    const tx = p.x + p.dir * 14,
      ty = p.y - 6,
      e = fly * fly;
    x += (tx - x) * e;
    y += (ty - y) * e - 26 * Math.sin(Math.PI * fly);
  }
  const s = (0.6 + 0.4 * k) * (1 - fly * 0.5);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.scale(s, s);
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 2, 0, 0, 46);
  g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,.9)");
  g.addColorStop(0.25, P.gl + "aa");
  g.addColorStop(1, P.gl + "00");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, 46, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = P.gl + "88";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    const a = (i / 8) * 6.283 + now * 0.8,
      r1 = 14,
      r2 = 28 + 8 * Math.sin(now * 6 + i);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(Math.cos(a) * r1, Math.sin(a) * r1);
    ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(a) * r2, Math.sin(a) * r2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
  ctx.rotate(Math.sin(now * 2) * 0.2);
  rareCrystal(ctx, 0, 9, 22, 7, 0, P.col, P.gl, 1);
  rareCrystal(ctx, -6, 9, 14, 4, -0.45, P.col, P.gl, 1);
  rareCrystal(ctx, 6, 9, 15, 4, 0.45, P.col, P.gl, 1);
  ctx.restore();
}
function drawRare(n, t) {
  const known = game.rareKnown[n.kind],
    D = RARE_DEF[n.kind],
    P = rarePal(n, t),
    gl = P.gl;
  const d = Math.hypot(p.x - n.x, p.y - n.y);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(n.x, n.y);
  ctx.scale(RARE_SCALE, RARE_SCALE);
  drawRareBody(ctx, n, t);
  ctx.restore();
  if (n.split || n.taken) return;
  // tarayıcı işareti: dönen holografik halka + etiket
  if (d < 340) {
    const a = Math.min(1, (340 - d) / 120);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(n.x, n.y);
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    ctx.strokeStyle = gl;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
    ctx.setLineDash([6, 6]);
    ctx.lineDashOffset = -t * 22;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 8, 82, 30, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    const ly = -112 + Math.sin(t * 2) * 3;
    if (!known) {
      // holografik tarayıcı: ışık hüzmesi + iki katlı dönen halka + titreşen "?"
      const hy = ly - 30;
      const bm = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, hy, 0, -30);
      bm.addColorStop(0, gl + "55");
      bm.addColorStop(1, gl + "00");
      ctx.fillStyle = bm;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-6, hy + 8);
      ctx.lineTo(6, hy + 8);
      ctx.lineTo(46, -26);
      ctx.lineTo(-46, -26);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        const yy = hy + 10 + ((t * 40 + i * 24) % 70);
        ctx.strokeStyle = gl;
        ctx.globalAlpha = a * (1 - ((t * 40 + i * 24) % 70) / 70) * 0.7;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, yy, 8 + (yy - hy) * 0.55, 2 + (yy - hy) * 0.12, 0, 0, 7);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(0, hy);
      ctx.shadowColor = gl;
      ctx.shadowBlur = 16;
      ctx.strokeStyle = gl;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        const an = (i / 6) * 6.283 + t * 0.9;
        ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(an) * 17, Math.sin(an) * 17);
      }
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.setLineDash([3, 4]);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, 23, -t * 1.4, -t * 1.4 + 5.2);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        const an = (i * Math.PI) / 2 - t * 1.4;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(Math.cos(an) * 26, Math.sin(an) * 26);
        ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(an) * 30, Math.sin(an) * 30);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      const gx = Math.random() < 0.06 ? (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4 : 0;
      ctx.fillStyle = gl;
      ctx.globalAlpha = a * 0.6;
      ctx.font = "900 21px Inter,system-ui,sans-serif";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
      ctx.fillText("?", gx + 1.5, 1);
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
      ctx.fillText("?", gx, 0);
      ctx.restore();
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(8,10,24,.8)";
    const tx = known ? D.name : T("BİLİNMEYEN TAŞ") + ".".repeat(1 + (Math.floor(t * 2.5) % 3));
    ctx.font = "800 11px ui-monospace,monospace";
    const tw = ctx.measureText(tx).width + 18;
    rrp(-tw / 2, ly - 13, tw, 20, 10);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = gl;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = known ? "#fff" : gl;
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    ctx.fillText(tx, 0, ly + 1);
    ctx.strokeStyle = gl;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, ly + 7);
    ctx.lineTo(0, -62);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }
}
const _rareIc = {};
function rareIconURL(k) {
  if (_rareIc[k]) return _rareIc[k];
  const c = document.createElement("canvas");
  c.width = c.height = 64;
  const g = c.getContext("2d"),
    D = RARE_DEF[k];
  g.translate(32, 40);
  g.fillStyle = "#3a241c";
  g.beginPath();
  g.ellipse(0, 6, 22, 9, 0, 0, 7);
  g.fill();
  for (const [bx, h, w, a] of [
    [-10, 26, 6, -0.35],
    [0, 34, 7, 0],
    [10, 24, 6, 0.35],
    [-4, 18, 5, -0.15],
    [6, 20, 5, 0.2],
  ]) {
    g.save();
    g.translate(bx, 4);
    g.rotate(a);
    g.shadowColor = D.glow;
    g.shadowBlur = 8;
    const cg = g.createLinearGradient(-w, 0, w, 0);
    cg.addColorStop(0, D.col[1]);
    cg.addColorStop(0.45, D.col[0]);
    cg.addColorStop(1, D.col[2]);
    g.fillStyle = cg;
    g.beginPath();
    g.moveTo(-w, 0);
    g.lineTo(-w * 0.8, -h * 0.75);
    g.lineTo(0, -h);
    g.lineTo(w * 0.8, -h * 0.75);
    g.lineTo(w, 0);
    g.closePath();
    g.fill();
    g.restore();
  }
  return (_rareIc[k] = c.toDataURL());
}
/* --- tarayıcı: yakındaki bilinmeyen sinyal --- */
let _scanT = 0;
function rareScan(dt) {
  if (scene !== "mars" || insideRocket || !rareNodes.length) return;
  let best = null,
    bd = 700 * desFx().scanMul;
  for (const n of rareNodes) {
    if (n.taken) continue;
    const d = Math.hypot(p.x - n.x, p.y - n.y);
    if (d < bd) {
      bd = d;
      best = n;
    }
  }
  if (!best) return;
  _scanT -= dt;
  if (_scanT <= 0) {
    _scanT = 0.5 + (bd / 700) * 2.2;
    tone(900 + (700 - bd) * 1.4, 0.05, "sine", 0.025);
    if (!best.pinged) {
      best.pinged = true;
      toast(
        T("📡 Tarayıcı: yakında ") +
          (game.rareKnown[best.kind]
            ? "<b>" + RARE_DEF[best.kind].name + "</b>"
            : T("<b>bilinmeyen bir mineral</b>")) +
          T(" sinyali — haritadaki işarete git"),
      );
    }
  }
}
function pickRare(n) {
  ensureRare();
  n.taken = true;
  game.rareTaken.push(n.id);
  if (n.kind === "ares") {
    if (!storySeen("firstRock")) setTimeout(() => storyTrigger("ares"), 700);
  } else if (!storySeen("firstRock") && !storySeen("ares")) {
    storyState().rk = n.kind;
    setTimeout(() => storyTrigger("firstRock"), 700);
  }
  game.rare[n.kind] = (game.rare[n.kind] || 0) + n.n;
  setTimeout(() => bumpQuest("rare"), 1200);
  const D = RARE_DEF[n.kind];
  sfx("star");
  tone(1320, 0.18, "sine", 0.06);
  tone(1760, 0.25, "sine", 0.05, 0, 0.12);
  updateInv();
  addFloat(n.x, n.y - 50, "+" + n.n + " " + (game.rareKnown[n.kind] ? D.name : T("Bilinmeyen taş")), D.glow);
  if (!game.rareKnown[n.kind]) {
    toast(
      T(
        "<b>Bilinmeyen taş</b> çantana alındı. Ne olduğunu ve tehlikeli olup olmadığını öğrenmek için roketteki <b>kargo terminalinden</b> analize gönder.",
      ),
    );
    commsObs("rare", { [n.kind]: n.n });
  } else {
    toast("💎 +" + n.n + " <b>" + D.name + T("</b> (toplam ") + game.rare[n.kind] + ")");
    commsObs("rare", { [n.kind]: n.n });
  }
}

/* ---------- taş analizi: kargoyla Dünya'ya gönder → laboratuvar raporu ---------- */
function sendRockSample(k) {

    sfx("error");
    return;
  }
  if (C.flags.rock[k]) {
    sfx("error");
    toast(T("Bu taş zaten analizde"));
    return;
  }
  game.rare[k]--;
  C.flags.rock[k] = game.worldTime + DAY_SECONDS * 0.05;
  bumpQuest("rockSent");
  tone(523, 0.1, "triangle", 0.07);
  tone(659, 0.1, "triangle", 0.07, 0, 0.09);
  tone(880, 0.16, "triangle", 0.07, 0, 0.18);
  noiseBurst(0.35, 0.08, 1400, 0.12);
  toast(T("Taş numunesi <b>analiz için</b> Dünya'ya gönderildi. Laboratuvar sonucu birazdan gelen kutunda."));
  updateInv();
  if (marketOpen) openMarket();
}

    <div class="mn-leg">${M.comp.map((c) => `<span><i style="background:${c[2]}"></i>${c[0]} %${fmtN(c[1], 1)}</span>`).join("")}</div>`;

  <b style="font-size:12px">Bileşim (ağırlıkça)</b>{7}
  <div class="an">Yöntem: X-ışını kırınımı (XRD) · X-ışını floresansı (XRF) · gama spektrometrisi</div></div>
  <div class="mn-hz {8}"><b>{9}</b><span>{10}</span></div>
