/* --- yer şekilleri: kum tepesi alanları, bazalt düzlükleri, kırağı, kuru dere yatakları --- */
let landmarks = null;
function genLandmarks() {
  const R = rng(9001),
    L = [],
    B = CFG.worldHalf - 300;
  const add = (type, n, r0, r1) => {
    let m = 0,
      g = 0;
    while (m < n && g++ < 2000) {
      const x = (R() * 2 - 1) * B,
        y = (R() * 2 - 1) * B,
        r = r0 + R() * (r1 - r0);
      if (Math.hypot(x - ROCKET.x, y - ROCKET.y) < r + 380) continue;
      if (L.some((o) => Math.hypot(o.x - x, o.y - y) < o.r + r)) continue;
      L.push({ type, x, y, r, seed: R() * 1000, ang: R() * 3.14 });
      m++;
    }
  };
  add("dunes", 42, 280, 560);
  add("basalt", 30, 220, 440);
  add("frost", 21, 140, 280);
  add("river", 18, 380, 680);
  add("layers", 24, 200, 380);
  return L;
}
function lmCanvas(l) {
  if (l.c) return l.c;
  const S = Math.ceil(l.r * 2 + 40),
    c = document.createElement("canvas");
  c.width = c.height = S;
  const g = c.getContext("2d"),
    R = rng(Math.floor(l.seed) + 1),
    cx = S / 2,
    cy = S / 2;
  g.save();
  g.translate(cx, cy);
  g.rotate(l.ang);
  const mask = (a) => {
    const gr = g.createRadialGradient(0, 0, l.r * 0.2, 0, 0, l.r);
    gr.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0," + a + ")");
    gr.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    return gr;
  };
  if (l.type === "dunes") {
    for (let i = -l.r; i < l.r; i += 14 + R() * 6) {
      const ph = R() * 6;
      g.beginPath();
      for (let x = -l.r; x <= l.r; x += 10) {
        const y = i + Math.sin(x * 0.012 + ph) * 18 + Math.sin(x * 0.035) * 5;
        x === -l.r ? g.moveTo(x, y) : g.lineTo(x, y);
      }
      g.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,214,170,.20)";
      g.lineWidth = 3;
      g.stroke();
      g.translate(0, 4);
      g.strokeStyle = "rgba(70,20,6,.20)";
      g.lineWidth = 3;
      g.stroke();
      g.translate(0, -4);
    }
  } else if (l.type === "basalt") {
    const s1 = R() * 6,
      s2 = R() * 6;
    g.filter = "blur(5px)";
    g.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
      const a = (i / 64) * 6.283,
        r = l.r * (0.74 + 0.13 * Math.sin(3 * a + s1) + 0.08 * Math.sin(5 * a + s2));
      g.lineTo(Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r * 0.75);
    }
    g.closePath();
    g.fillStyle = "rgba(40,14,8,.32)";
    g.fill();
    g.filter = "none";
    g.strokeStyle = "rgba(20,6,2,.4)";
    g.lineWidth = 1.5;
    for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
      let x = (R() - 0.5) * l.r * 1.2,
        y = (R() - 0.5) * l.r * 0.9;
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(x, y);
      for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
        x += (R() - 0.5) * 40;
        y += (R() - 0.5) * 30;
        g.lineTo(x, y);
      }
      g.stroke();
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
      g.fillStyle = "rgba(15,5,2,.5)";
      g.beginPath();
      g.arc((R() - 0.5) * l.r * 1.3, (R() - 0.5) * l.r * 0.9, 1 + R() * 3, 0, 7);
      g.fill();
    }
  } else if (l.type === "frost") {
    const s1 = R() * 6,
      s2 = R() * 6;
    g.filter = "blur(6px)";
    g.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
      const a = (i / 64) * 6.283,
        r = l.r * (0.72 + 0.15 * Math.sin(3 * a + s1) + 0.08 * Math.sin(7 * a + s2));
      g.lineTo(Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r * 0.7);
    }
    g.closePath();
    const fg = g.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, l.r);
    fg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(230,240,255,.42)");
    fg.addColorStop(0.7, "rgba(190,210,240,.22)");
    fg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(190,210,240,0)");
    g.fillStyle = fg;
    g.fill();
    g.filter = "none";
    g.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.3)";
    g.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
      const x = (R() - 0.5) * l.r,
        y = (R() - 0.5) * l.r * 0.6,
        s = 4 + R() * 8;
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(x - s, y);
      g.lineTo(x + s, y);
      g.moveTo(x, y - s * 0.6);
      g.lineTo(x, y + s * 0.6);
      g.stroke();
    }
  } else if (l.type === "river") {
    const pts = [];
    let x = -l.r,
      y = (R() - 0.5) * l.r * 0.4;
    for (let i = 0; i <= 20; i++) {
      pts.push([x, y]);
      x += (l.r * 2) / 20;
      y += (R() - 0.5) * 50;
    }
    const path = () => {
      g.beginPath();
      pts.forEach(([a, b], i) => (i ? g.lineTo(a, b) : g.moveTo(a, b)));
    };
    g.lineCap = "round";
    g.lineJoin = "round";
    path();
    g.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,206,160,.16)";
    g.lineWidth = 90;
    g.stroke();
    path();
    g.strokeStyle = "rgba(60,18,6,.28)";
    g.lineWidth = 58;
    g.stroke();
    path();
    g.strokeStyle = "rgba(30,8,2,.25)";
    g.lineWidth = 26;
    g.stroke();
    for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
      const [a, b] = pts[Math.floor(R() * pts.length)];
      g.fillStyle = "rgba(200,150,110,.35)";
      g.beginPath();
      g.arc(a + (R() - 0.5) * 40, b + (R() - 0.5) * 20, 1.5 + R() * 3, 0, 7);
      g.fill();
    }
  } else if (l.type === "layers") {
    for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
      const rr = l.r * (1 - i * 0.1);
      g.beginPath();
      for (let k = 0; k <= 40; k++) {
        const a = (k / 40) * 6.283,
          w = rr * (1 + 0.08 * Math.sin(a * 3 + i));
        g.lineTo(Math.cos(a) * w, Math.sin(a) * w * 0.6);
      }
      g.closePath();
      g.fillStyle = i % 2 ? "rgba(255,200,150,.07)" : "rgba(70,20,6,.09)";
      g.fill();
    }
  }
  g.restore();
  g.globalCompositeOperation = "destination-in";
  g.fillStyle = mask(1);
  g.translate(cx, cy);
  g.fillRect(-cx, -cy, S, S);
  return (l.c = c);
}
function drawLandmarks(vis) {
  if (scene !== "mars") return;
  if (!landmarks) landmarks = genLandmarks();
  for (const l of landmarks) {
    if (Math.abs(l.x - p.x) > l.r + 1400 || Math.abs(l.y - p.y) > l.r + 1100) continue;
    const c = lmCanvas(l);
    ctx.drawImage(c, l.x - c.width / 2, l.y - c.height / 2);
  }
}
/* --- toz şeytanları (dolaşan kum hortumları) --- */
const devils = [];
function updateAmbient(dt) {
  if (scene !== "mars" || !game) {
    devils.length = 0;
    return;
  }
  while (devils.length < 4) {
    const a = Math.random() * 6.283,
      d = 900 + Math.random() * 900;
    devils.push({
      x: p.x + Math.cos(a) * d,
      y: p.y + Math.sin(a) * d,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 60,
      vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40,
      ph: Math.random() * 6,
      life: 40 + Math.random() * 60,
    });
  }
  for (let i = devils.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const v = devils[i];
    v.life -= dt;
    v.ph += dt * 6;
    v.vx += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30 * dt;
    v.vy += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30 * dt;
    v.vx = Math.max(-90, Math.min(90, v.vx));
    v.vy = Math.max(-70, Math.min(70, v.vy));
    v.x += v.vx * dt;
    v.y += v.vy * dt;
    const d = Math.hypot(p.x - v.x, p.y - v.y);
    if (d > 2400 || v.life <= 0) {
      devils.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }
    if (!insideRocket && d < 90) {
      const k = (1 - d / 90) * SUIT_STORM() * dt;
      p.x += ((p.y - v.y) / (d || 1)) * 160 * k + ((p.x - v.x) / (d || 1)) * 90 * k;
      p.y += (-(p.x - v.x) / (d || 1)) * 160 * k + ((p.y - v.y) / (d || 1)) * 90 * k;
      game.o2 = Math.max(0, game.o2 - 1.2 * k);
      shake = Math.max(shake, 3);
      if (!v.hit) {
        v.hit = true;
        toast(T("🌀 Toz şeytanına yakalandın — uzaklaş!"));
        sfx("hurt");
      }
    }
  }
}
function SUIT_STORM() {
  return typeof suitSt === "function" ? suitSt().storm : 1;
}
function drawDevils(t) {
  if (scene !== "mars") return;
  const sp = puffSprite([196, 132, 92]);
  for (const v of devils) {
    if (Math.abs(v.x - p.x) > 1400 || Math.abs(v.y - p.y) > 1000) continue;
    const fade = Math.min(1, v.life / 4);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(v.x, v.y);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.32 * fade;
    ctx.drawImage(sp, -70, -22, 140, 44);
    for (let i = 0; i < 22; i++) {
      const f = i / 21,
        y = -f * 190,
        r = 12 + f * f * 55,
        sw = Math.sin(v.ph + f * 5) * 10 * f;
      ctx.globalAlpha = (0.16 - f * 0.08) * fade;
      ctx.drawImage(sp, sw - r, y - r * 0.35, r * 2, r * 0.7);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.restore();
  }
}
/* --- ekran atmosferi (sakin havada da canlı Mars) --- */
const AMB = { wisps: null, motes: null };
function drawAtmosphere() {
  if (scene !== "mars" || settings.atmos === false) return;
  const t = performance.now() / 1000,
    calm = 1 - Math.min(1, stormFx.I * 1.5);
  if (calm <= 0) return;
  // ufuk pusu (üst kenar)
  let g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H * 0.45);
  g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,170,120," + 0.16 * calm + ")");
  g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,170,120,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H * 0.45);
  // bulut/toz gölgeleri yerde kayar
  const sp = puffSprite([40, 12, 6]);
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    const s = Math.max(W, H) * (0.55 + i * 0.12),
      x = (((i * 0.37 + t * 0.006) % 1.6) - 0.3) * W - ((p.x * 0.02) % W),
      y = ((i * 0.29) % 1) * H * 0.9 - ((p.y * 0.02) % H) + Math.sin(t * 0.05 + i) * 40;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.1 * calm;
    ctx.drawImage(sp, x - s / 2, y - s / 3, s, s * 0.66);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  // süzülen toz perdeleri
  const dw = puffSprite([222, 160, 118]);
  if (!AMB.wisps) {
    AMB.wisps = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++)
      AMB.wisps.push({
        x: Math.random(),
        y: Math.random(),
        s: Math.random(),
        v: 0.008 + Math.random() * 0.014,
      });
  }
  for (const w of AMB.wisps) {
    const x = (((w.x + t * w.v) % 1.3) - 0.15) * W - ((((p.x * 0.15) % W) + W) % W) * 0,
      y = w.y * H + Math.sin(t * 0.4 + w.s * 9) * 14,
      sx = 280 + w.s * 420,
      sy = sx * 0.18;
    ctx.globalAlpha = (0.045 + w.s * 0.05) * calm;
    ctx.drawImage(dw, x - sx / 2, y - sy / 2, sx, sy);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  // zerreler
  for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
    const h = (i * 0.618) % 1,
      x = (((h * W + t * (10 + h * 26) - p.x * 0.3 * (0.3 + h)) % W) + W) % W,
      y = (((i * 0.377) % 1) * H + Math.sin(t * 0.7 + i) * 8 - ((p.y * 0.3 * (0.3 + h)) % H) + H) % H,
      r = 0.6 + h * h * 2.2;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,225,190," + (0.1 + h * 0.25) * calm + ")";
    ctx.fillRect(x, y, r, r);
  }
  // sıcak hava titreşimi hissi: hafif sıcak ton nabzı
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,140,80," + 0.025 * calm * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * 0.3)) + ")";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
}

/* ============== SAHNE GİRİŞİ / HUD ============== */
function enterPlanet(k, fromLoad, silent) {
  scene = k;
  mode = "play";
  paused = false;
  rocketOpen = false;
  marketOpen = false;
  ev.meteors = [];
  if (scene === "earth" || scene === START_PLANET) {
    ev.type = null;
  }
  warp = silent ? 0 : 1;
  if (!fromLoad) {
    p.x = 170;
    p.y = 120;
  }
  game.planet = k;
  if (!game.visited.includes(k)) game.visited.push(k);
  stones = spawnStones(k);
  farmArr();
  spawnRare(k);
  showPlayUI();
  if (!fromLoad && !silent) {
    sfx("travel");
    toast(PLANETS[k].name + T("'e varıldı"));
  }
  if (!fromLoad && !silent) bumpQuest("traveled");
}
function showPlayUI() {
  $("menuScreen").classList.add("hidden");
  $("hud").classList.remove("hidden");
  $("inv").classList.remove("hidden");
  $("stats").classList.remove("hidden");
  updateHud(true);
  updateInv();
  updateStats();
  updateQuest();
  focusGame();
}
let hudSec = -1;
function updateHud(force) {
  const sec = Math.floor((game.worldTime || 0) * 2);
  if (!force && sec === hudSec) return;
  hudSec = sec;
  const wt = Math.max(0, Number(game.worldTime) || 0),
    day = Math.floor(wt / DAY_SECONDS) + 1,
    inDay = wt % DAY_SECONDS,
    frac = inDay / DAY_SECONDS;
  const mh = (6 + frac * 24) % 24,
    hh = Math.floor(mh),
    mm = Math.floor((mh - hh) * 60),
    isDay = hh >= 6 && hh < 18;
  const clock = String(hh).padStart(2, "0") + ":" + String(mm).padStart(2, "0");
  // olay çipleri
  const S = scene === "earth" ? { phase: "none" } : stormInfo();
  let ev = "";
  if (scene !== "earth") {
    if (S.phase === "active") ev += T('<span class="st on">🌪 FIRTINA</span>');
    else if (S.phase === "warn") ev += '<span class="st on">🌪 ' + mmss(S.tTo) + "</span>";
    else {
      const ns = nextStormIn();
      if (isFinite(ns)) {
        const d2 = Math.floor((wt + ns) / DAY_SECONDS) + 1;
        ev += T('<span class="st" title="Sonraki kum fırtınası">🌪 Gün ') + d2 + "</span>";
      }
    }
    if (game.radiationActive) ev += T('<span class="rd on">☢ AKTİF</span>');
    else {
      const rd = Math.ceil(day / 3) * 3 === day ? day + 3 : Math.ceil(day / 3) * 3;
      ev += T('<span class="rd" title="Sonraki radyasyon dalgası">☢ Gün ') + rd + "</span>";
    }
  }
  // gün çubuğunda olay işaretleri
  let marks = "";
  if (scene !== "earth" && isStormDay(day))
    marks += '<i style="left:' + (STORM_START / DAY_SECONDS) * 100 + '%"></i>';
  if (scene !== "earth" && day % 3 === 0) marks += '<i class="rad" style="left:0%"></i>';
  $("hud").innerHTML = Tf(
    `<div class="hd-top"><span class="hd-planet" style="{0}"></span>
      <div class="hd-tt"><b>{1}</b><span>GÜN {2}</span></div>
      <div class="hd-clock">{3} {4}</div></div>
    <div class="hd-bar">{5}<em style="left:{6}%"></em></div>
    <div class="hd-foot"><span>⏳ {7}</span><span class="hd-ev">{8}</span></div>`,
    [
      scene === "earth"
        ? "background:radial-gradient(circle at 34% 30%,#d6f0ff 0,#3b82f6 30%,#1e3a8a 70%,#0b1638 100%)"
        : "",
      PLANETS[scene].name.toLocaleUpperCase("tr-TR"),
      day,
      isDay ? "☀" : "☾",
      clock,
      marks,
      (frac * 100).toFixed(2),
      mmss(DAY_SECONDS - inDay),
      ev,
    ],
  );
}
function setStat(id, val) {
  $(id + "Fill").style.width = Math.max(0, val) + "%";
  $(id + "Val").textContent = Math.max(0, Math.round(val));
  $(id + "Stat").classList.toggle("low", val < 25);
}
/* kendi bilgilerimiz: vücut ısısı, nabız, ortam sıcaklığı, ortam radyasyonu (hafif simülasyon) */
const BIO = { temp: 36.8, pulse: 72, env: -58, rad: 0.45, ex: 0, acc: 0 };
function updateBio(dt) {
  if (!game || scene === "earth") return;
  const out = !insideRocket,
    ra = !!game.radiationActive && out,
    lowO2 = (game.o2 == null ? 100 : game.o2) < 25,
    lowHp = game.hp < 30;
  const k = 1 - Math.exp(-dt * 0.6);
  const inDay = ((game.worldTime % DAY_SECONDS) + DAY_SECONDS) % DAY_SECONDS,
    hr = (6 + (inDay / DAY_SECONDS) * 24) % 24;
  const sun = Math.max(0, Math.sin((Math.PI * (hr - 6)) / 12));
  const envT = out ? -78 + 56 * sun + (stormFx.I > 0.25 ? 6 : 0) : 21;
  const radT = out ? (ra ? 8.6 : 0.42 + 0.08 * Math.sin(game.worldTime * 0.05)) : 0.08;
  const tempT =
    36.6 + BIO.ex * 0.7 + (lowHp ? 0.5 : 0) + (out && sun < 0.1 ? -0.15 : 0) + (game.sleeping ? -0.3 : 0);
  const pulseT =
    (game.sleeping ? 56 : 66) +
    BIO.ex * 48 +
    (lowO2 ? 28 : 0) +
    (lowHp ? 16 : 0) +
    (ra ? 12 : 0) +
    (stormFx.I > 0.25 && out ? 8 : 0);
  BIO.temp += (tempT - BIO.temp) * k * 0.6;
  BIO.pulse += (pulseT - BIO.pulse) * k * 1.6;
  BIO.env += (envT - BIO.env) * k * 1.4;
  BIO.rad += (radT - BIO.rad) * Math.min(1, dt * 2);
  BIO.acc += dt;
  if (BIO.acc < 0.25) return;
  BIO.acc = 0;
  const set = (id, v, cls) => {
    const e = $(id);
    e.querySelector("b").innerHTML = v;
    e.classList.toggle("warn", cls === "warn");
    e.classList.toggle("crit", cls === "crit");
  };
  set("bioTemp", fmtN(BIO.temp, 1) + "<em>°C</em>", BIO.temp > 37.6 ? "warn" : BIO.temp < 36 ? "warn" : "");
  const bpm = Math.round(BIO.pulse + Math.sin(performance.now() / 700) * 1.5);
  set("bioPulse", bpm + "<em>bpm</em>", bpm > 120 ? "crit" : bpm > 100 ? "warn" : "");
  $("bioPulse").style.setProperty("--beat", (60 / Math.max(40, bpm)).toFixed(2) + "s");
  $("bioEnvL").textContent = out ? T("DIŞARI") : T("KABİN");
  set("bioEnv", Math.round(BIO.env) + "<em>°C</em>", "");
  set("bioRad", fmtN(BIO.rad, 2) + "<em>µSv/h</em>", BIO.rad > 4 ? "crit" : BIO.rad > 1 ? "warn" : "");
}
function updateStats() {
  setStat("oxy", game.o2 == null ? 100 : game.o2);
  setStat("hp", game.hp);
  setStat("hunger", game.hunger);
  setStat("thirst", game.thirst);
  setStat("energy", game.energy == null ? 100 : game.energy);
}
/* --- hotbar: alttaki 1-6 slot seçimi --- */
const SLOT_KEYS = [
  "kit",
  "pick",
  "radmeter",
  "water",
  "potato",
  "medkit",
  "seed",
  "tuber",
  "ceramic",
  "stone",
  "star",
  "rotten",
  "rare",
];
const SLOT_NAMES = [
  T("Çapa"),
  T("Jeolog kazması"),
  T("DZ-7 radyasyon ölçer"),
  T("💧 Su"),
  T("🥔 Patates"),
  T("💊 Medikit"),
  T("🌱 Tohum"),
  T("🥔 Tohumluk patates"),
  T("🛡️ Seramik kalkan"),
  T("🔩 Metal numune"),
  T("⭐ Yıldız kırıntısı (2 numune)"),
  T("Çürük patates (numune)"),
  T("💎 Nadir taşlar — roketteki kargo terminalinden analize gönder"),
];
const SLOT_GROUP = {
  kit: 0,
  pick: 0,
  radmeter: 0,
  water: 1,
  potato: 1,
  medkit: 1,
  seed: 1,
  tuber: 1,
  ceramic: 1,
  stone: 2,
  star: 2,
  rotten: 2,
  rare: 2,
};
let selSlot = 0;
function useSelected() {
  if (
    mode !== "play" ||
    paused ||
    rocketOpen ||
    marketOpen ||
    repairOpen ||
    capOpen ||
    commOpen ||
    upgOpen ||
    o2Fill ||
    bookOpen ||
    !game
  )
    return;
  const order = game.slotOrder || [];
  const k = order[selSlot];
  if (!k) {
    sfx("error");
    toast(T("Bu numarada henüz eşya yok — önce topla"));
    return;
  }
  if (k === "kit") {
    sfx("click");
    toast(T("Çapa elinde — yakındaki yere <b>sol tıkla</b>, toprağı kaz"));
    return;
  }
  const n = game.inventory[k] || 0;
  const nm = SLOT_NAMES[SLOT_KEYS.indexOf(k)] || k;
  if (n <= 0) {
    sfx("error");
    toast(T("Bu slot boş — (") + (selSlot + 1) + ") " + nm);
    return;
  }
  if (k === "water") {
    if (game.thirst >= 100) {
      sfx("full");
      toast(T("Susuzluğun zaten dolu"));
      return;
    }
    game.inventory.water--;
    game.thirst = Math.min(100, game.thirst + CFG.drinkThirst);
    startAct("drink", 1.8);
    burst(p.x, p.y - 30, 10, "#38bdf8", { sp: 70, life: 0.5, size: 3 });
    sfx("drink");
    toast(T("Su içildi (+") + CFG.drinkThirst + T(" susuzluk)"));
    updateInv();
    updateStats();
    bumpQuest("drunk");
    return;
  }
  if (k === "potato") {
    if (game.hunger >= 100) {
      sfx("full");
      toast(T("Açlığın zaten dolu"));
      return;
    }
    game.inventory.potato--;
    game.hunger = Math.min(100, game.hunger + CFG.eatHunger);
    startAct("eat", 2.0);
    sfx("eat");
    toast(T("Patates yendi (+") + CFG.eatHunger + T(" açlık)"));
    updateInv();
    updateStats();
    return;
  }
  if (k === "medkit") {
    pressG();
    return;
  }
  if (k === "radmeter") {
    if (insideRocket) {
      sfx("click");
      toast(T("Radyasyon ölçer dışarıda, toprak üzerinde kullanılır"));
      return;
    }
    startMeasure(p.x + p.dir * 80, p.y + 26);
    return;
  }
  if (k === "rotten") {
    sfx("error");
    toast(T("Çürük patates yenmez — roketteki kargo terminalinden Dünya'ya gönder"));
    return;
  }
  if (isSeedKey(k)) {
    const pl = nearestPlot();
    if (!pl) {
      sfx("error");
      toast(T("Tarla parselinin yakınına git"));
      return;
    }
    const fa = farmArr(),
      g = fa[pl.i];
    if (g && g.g > 0) {
      sfx("error");
      toast(T("Parsel dolu — önce hasat et (F)"));
      return;
    }
    if (g && g.cov && g.shut) {
      sfx("error");
      toast(T("🔒 Kalkan kapalı — tohum ekmek için önce <b>Q</b> ile aç"));
      return;
    }
    game.inventory[k]--;
    Object.assign(fa[pl.i], { g: 0.1, wet: 0, idle: 0, fill: 0 });
    updateInv();
    burst(pl.pl.x, pl.pl.y, 14, "#8a6a3c", { sp: 90, life: 0.6, size: 4 });
    addFloat(pl.pl.x, pl.pl.y - 30, T("🌱 Ekildi"), "#7fe0ff");
    sfx("plant");
    bumpQuest("planted");
    return;
  }
  if (k === "ceramic") {
    if (insideRocket) {
      sfx("click");
      toast(T("Seramik kalkan dışarıda, ekili parselin üstüne takılır"));
      return;
    }
    const pl = nearestPlot();
    if (!pl) {
      sfx("error");
      toast(T("Bir parselin yakınına git"));
      return;
    }
    coverPlot(farmArr()[pl.i]);
    return;
  }
  if (k === "stone" || k === "star") {
    if (nearRocket() || (insideRocket && nearStation() && nearStation().key === "trade")) {
      depositSamples();
      return;
    }
    sfx("click");
    toast(T("Numuneler roketin kargo bölmesine yüklenir — rokete götür (F)"));
    return;
  }
}
function rareTotal() {
  if (!game || !game.rare) return 0;
  let n = 0;
  for (const k in game.rare) n += Math.max(0, game.rare[k] || 0);
  return n;
}
function rareSlotIcon() {
  const k = game && game.rare && RARE_ALL.find((k) => (game.rare[k] || 0) > 0);
  return rareIconURL(k || "titan");
}
function rareBreakdown() {
  ensureRare();
  return RARE_ALL.filter((k) => (game.rare[k] || 0) > 0)
    .map(
      (k) =>
        "<b>" +
        rareLabel(k) +
        (game.rareKnown[k] ? "" : " #" + (RARE_ALL.indexOf(k) + 1)) +
        "</b> ×" +
        game.rare[k] +
        (RARE_KEYS.includes(k) ? "" : T(" (yalnız bilim)")),
    )
    .join(" · ");
}
function isRareSlot(k) {
  return typeof k === "string" && k.startsWith("r_");
}
function slotName(k) {
  if (isRareSlot(k)) {
    const r = k.slice(2);
    return (
      "💎 " + rareLabel(r) + (game.rareKnown && game.rareKnown[r] ? "" : " #" + (RARE_ALL.indexOf(r) + 1))
    );
  }
  return SLOT_NAMES[SLOT_KEYS.indexOf(k)] || k;
}
function slotGroup(k) {
  return isRareSlot(k) ? 2 : SLOT_GROUP[k];
}
function slotIcon(k) {
  return isRareSlot(k) ? rareIconURL(k.slice(2)) : itemIconURL(k);
}
function slotCount(k) {
  if (isRareSlot(k)) {
    ensureRare();
    return Math.max(0, game.rare[k.slice(2)] || 0);
  }
  return k === "kit" ? (game.kitCarried ? 1 : 0) : game.inventory[k] || 0;
}
let _invSig = "";
function invSig() {
  if (!game) return "";
  ensureRare();
  return SLOT_KEYS.map(slotCount).join(",") + "|" + RARE_ALL.map((k) => game.rare[k] || 0).join(",");
}
function updateInv() {
  if (!game) return;
  _invSig = invSig();
  if (!Array.isArray(game.slotOrder)) game.slotOrder = [];
  const prevKey = game.slotOrder[selSlot];
  // düzenli yerleşim: aletler | tüketim | numuneler (her eşyanın sabit yeri var)
  ensureRare();
  game.slotOrder = SLOT_KEYS.filter((k) => k !== "rare" && slotCount(k) > 0).concat(
    RARE_ALL.map((k) => "r_" + k).filter((k) => slotCount(k) > 0),
  );
  if (prevKey && game.slotOrder.includes(prevKey)) selSlot = game.slotOrder.indexOf(prevKey);
  else if (prevKey) selSlot = -1; // elindeki bitti → eller boş
  if (selSlot >= game.slotOrder.length) selSlot = -1;
  const nameOf = slotName;
  let h = `<div class="slot bookslot" data-book="1" title="Rehber kitap (R)"><span class="num">R</span><img class="ic" src="${itemIconURL("book")}" alt=""></div><div class="slot-sep"></div>`;
  game.slotOrder.forEach((key, i) => {
    const n = slotCount(key);
    if (i > 0 && slotGroup(key) !== slotGroup(game.slotOrder[i - 1])) h += `<div class="slot-sep"></div>`;
    h += `<div class="slot on${i === selSlot ? " sel" : ""}" data-i="${i}" title="${i + 1} · ${nameOf(key)}">
      <span class="num">${i + 1}</span><img class="ic" src="${slotIcon(key)}" alt="">${key !== "kit" && n > 0 ? `<b>${n}</b>` : ""}</div>`;
  });
  $("inv").innerHTML = h;
}
function slotAgain(i) {
  // aynı slota tekrar: yiyecek/su/medikit kullanılır, diğer eşyalar bırakılır (el boş)
  const k = (game.slotOrder || [])[i];
  if (k === "water" || k === "potato" || k === "medkit") {
    useSelected();
    return;
  }
  selSlot = -1;
  updateInv();
  sfx("click");
  toast(T("Elin boş"));
}
function equip(k) {
  const i = (game.slotOrder || []).indexOf(k);
  if (i < 0) return false;
  selSlot = i;
  updateInv();
  sfx("click");
  return true;
}
$("inv").addEventListener("click", (e) => {
  const s = e.target.closest(".slot");
  if (!s || !game) return;
  if (s.dataset.book) {
    openBook();
    return;
  }
  const i = +s.dataset.i;
  if (i === selSlot) slotAgain(i);
  else {
    selSlot = i;
    updateInv();
    const k = (game.slotOrder || [])[i];
    if (k) {
      sfx("click");
      toast(T("Slot ") + (i + 1) + ": " + slotName(k));
    } else sfx("error");
  }
});

/* ============== GÖREV / HEDEF UI ============== */
const QUEST_REWARD = (QUESTS_NOOP = null); // görevler artık ödül vermez
function bumpQuest(key, amount) {
  if (!game || !game.qstats) return;
  game.qstats[key] = (game.qstats[key] || 0) + (amount == null ? 1 : amount);
  if (key === "planted") commsObs("agri", { p: 1 });
  else if (key === "harvested") commsObs("agri", { h: 1 });
  else if (key === "repaired") commsObs("engine_fix", {});
  else if (key === "loaded") commsObs("cargo", { pts: amount || 1, tot: game.cargo || 0 });
  const q0 = game.quest;
  checkQuest();
  if (game.quest === q0) updateQuest(); // kısmi ilerleme (1/5, 2/5…) kartta hemen görünsün
}
function checkQuest() {
  if (!game) return;
  if (game.story && game.story.goal) return; // hikâye görevi sürerken normal görev bekler
  let guard = 0;
  while (game.quest < QUESTS.length && guard++ < 25) {
    const qi = game.quest,
      q = QUESTS[qi];
    if ((game.qstats[q.k] || 0) < q.n) break;
    game.quest++;
    /* Dünya: görevlerin sonuna gelince açılır
       (son "Kaşif" görevi roket yolculuğu sırasında tamamlanır) */
    const earthOpen = game.quest >= QUESTS.length - 1;
    game.progIdx = earthOpen ? PROG_ORDER.length - 1 : 0;
    updateInv();
    updateQuest(true);
    showQuestDone(q, QUESTS[game.quest]);
    if (earthOpen) setTimeout(() => storyTrigger("home"), 3800);
    if (earthOpen)
      setTimeout(() => {
        sfx("star");
        toast(T("🔓 Dünya rotası açıldı! Komuta güvertesindeki navigasyondan eve dön"));
      }, 1800);
  }
}
/* görev bitti: ekranın ortasında kutlama kartı + fanfar + konfeti */
function showQuestDone(q, next) {
  const el = $("qDone");
  clearTimeout(showQuestDone._t);
  clearTimeout(showQuestDone._t2);
  el.className = "";
  el.innerHTML = Tf(
    `<div class="qd-ck">✓</div><div class="qd-k">GÖREV TAMAMLANDI</div><div class="qd-t">{0} {1}</div>
{2}`,
    [
      q.ic || "",
      q.t,
      next
        ? Tf(`<div class="qd-n">Sıradaki görev: <b>{0} {1}</b></div>`, [next.ic || "", next.t])
        : Tf(`<div class="qd-n"><b>Tüm görevler bitti!</b></div>`, []),
    ],
  );
  void el.offsetWidth;
  [523, 659, 784, 1047].forEach((f, i) => tone(f, 0.16, "triangle", 0.2, null, i * 0.11));
  const cx = insideRocket ? null : p.x,
    cy = insideRocket ? null : p.y;
  if (cx != null) {
    burst(cx, cy - 40, 26, "#4ade80", { sp: 220, life: 1, size: 5, up: 120 });
    burst(cx, cy - 40, 18, "#ffd34d", { sp: 200, life: 1.1, size: 4, up: 140 });
  }
  showQuestDone._t = setTimeout(() => {
    el.classList.add("out");
  }, 3000);
  showQuestDone._t2 = setTimeout(() => {
    el.className = "hidden";
  }, 3500);
}
/* ---------- görev kartı görseli: gidilecek/toplanacak cismin oyundaki gerçek görüntüsü ---------- */
const _qIcon = {};
function bakeIcon(key, fn) {
  if (_qIcon[key]) return _qIcon[key];
  const cv = document.createElement("canvas");
  cv.width = cv.height = 96;
  const g = cv.getContext("2d");
  const old = ctx;
  ctx = g;
  try {
    g.translate(48, 52);
    fn(g);
  } finally {
    ctx = old;
  }
  return (_qIcon[key] = cv.toDataURL());
}
const QUEST_ART = {
  covered: "ceramic",
  domeCycle: "ceramic",
  shieldSaved: "ceramic",
  kit: "kit",
  mined: "stone",
  planted: "seed",
  drunk: "water",
  harvested: "potato",
  cleanHarvest: "potato",
  rotSample: "rotten",
  measured: "radmeter",
  loaded: "star",
};
function questIconURL(q) {
  if (QUEST_ART[q.k]) return itemIconURL(QUEST_ART[q.k]);
  if (q.k === "gold")
    return bakeIcon("gold", () => {
      ctx.scale(1.6, 1.6);
      drawGoldNugget(0, 0, 0, 3);
    });
  if (q.k === "rare" || q.k === "rockSent")
    return bakeIcon("rare", (g) => {
      g.translate(0, 8);
      g.scale(0.95, 0.95);
      drawRareBody(g, { kind: "titan", seed: 3.7 }, 1.2, { icon: true });
    });
  if (q.k === "suit" || q.k === "radSuit")
    return bakeIcon("suit", () => {
      const pd = p.dir,
        ps = p.sx,
        py = p.sy,
        pw = p.walk;
      p.dir = 1;
      p.sx = p.sy = 1;
      p.walk = 0;
      ctx.translate(0, -2);
      ctx.scale(0.7, 0.7);
      astronaut(0, -10, false, null, 0);
      p.dir = pd;
      p.sx = ps;
      p.sy = py;
      p.walk = pw;
    });
  return null;
}
function setQuestIcon(el, q) {
  const u = questIconURL(q);
  if (u) el.innerHTML = '<img src="' + u + '" alt="">';
  else el.textContent = q.ic || "📋";
}
function updateQuest(pop) {
  const el = $("quest");
  if (!game || mode !== "play" || game.quest >= QUESTS.length) {
    el.classList.add("hidden");
    return;
  }
  el.classList.remove("hidden");
  const q = QUESTS[game.quest],
    cur = Math.min(q.n, game.qstats[q.k] || 0);
  $("qTitle").textContent = q.t;
  setQuestIcon($("qIc"), q);
  $("qStep").textContent = T("GÖREV ") + (game.quest + 1) + "/" + QUESTS.length;
  $("qDesc").innerHTML = q.d + " <b style='color:#5ad1ff'>(" + cur + "/" + q.n + ")</b>";
  $("qFill").style.width = (cur / q.n) * 100 + "%";
  $("qReward").textContent = "";
  let how = q.how || "";
  if (q.k === "repaired" && game.repair.state === "ok" && !game.stormBroke)
    how = Tf(
      `⏳ Fırtına bekleniyor: <b>Gün 2</b>, saat {0} civarı. O zamana kadar numune topla, tarım yap.`,
      [marsClock(STORM_START)],
    );
  $("qHow").innerHTML = "💡 " + how;
  _qsLast = "";
  refreshQuestSteps(true);
  if (pop) {
    el.classList.remove("done");
    void el.offsetWidth;
    el.classList.add("done");
  }
}
/* ============== ETKİLEŞİM ============== */
const nearRocket = () => Math.hypot(p.x - ROCKET.x, p.y - ROCKET.y) <= CFG.interactRange;
function nearestPickup() {
  let b = null,
    bd = CFG.pickupRange;
  for (const s of stones) {
    if (s.taken) continue;
    const d = Math.hypot(p.x - s.x, p.y - s.y);
    if (d < bd) {
      bd = d;
      b = { kind: "stone", o: s };
    }
  }
  for (const d of drops) {
    if (d.taken) continue;
    const dd = Math.hypot(p.x - d.x, p.y - d.y);
    if (dd < bd) {
      bd = dd;
      b = { kind: d.type, o: d };
    }
  }
  for (const n of rareNodes) {
    if (n.taken || n.split) continue;
    const dd = Math.hypot(p.x - n.x, p.y - n.y);
    if (dd < 125 && (!b || dd - 60 < bd)) {
      bd = dd - 60;
      b = { kind: "rare", o: n };
    }
  }
  return b;
}
function nearestPlot() {
  let b = null,
    bd = CFG.plotRange;
  farmArr().forEach((pl, i) => {
    const d = Math.hypot(p.x - pl.x, p.y - pl.y);
    if (d < bd) {
      bd = d;
      b = { i, pl };
    }
  });
  return b;
}

function openRocket(kind) {
  rocketOpen = true;
  const d = $("dest"),
    top = $("navTop");
  d.innerHTML = "";
  top.innerHTML = "";
  $("rocketSub").textContent = PLANETS[scene].name + T(" yüzeyi · sol ") + gameDayNumber();
  const cargo = Math.min(game.cargo || 0, CFG.cargoGoal);
  top.innerHTML = `<div class="con-meters">${conMeter(T("KARGO"), (cargo / CFG.cargoGoal) * 100, "linear-gradient(90deg,#c2410c,#ffb347)")}
    ${conMeter(T("GÖREV"), (Math.min(game.quest, QUESTS.length) / QUESTS.length) * 100, "linear-gradient(90deg,#1f7fb8,#7fe0ff)")}</div>`;
  if (game.repair.state !== "ok") {
    const a = document.createElement("div");
    a.className = "con-alert";
    a.innerHTML = Tf(
      `<div class="ai">⚠️</div><div><b>Ana motor hasarlı — kalkış kilitli.</b><br>Makine dairesindeki ana motoru onar · aşama {0}/4</div>`,
      [(game.repair.stage || 0) + 1],
    );
    top.appendChild(a);
  }
  const idxNow = progIdxOf(scene),
    locked0 = game.repair.state !== "ok";
  PROG_ORDER.forEach((k, idx) => {
    const P = PLANETS[k],
      isEarth = k === "earth",
      locked = idx > game.progIdx;
    const earthFinal = isEarth && game.progIdx >= PROG_ORDER.length - 1 && !game.won;
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.className = "con-row" + (idx === idxNow ? " cur" : "");
    let desc, right;
    if (idx === idxNow) {
      desc = T("Şu an buradasın");
      right = T('<span class="badge ok">BURADASIN</span>');
    } else if (locked) {
      desc =
        T("Görevleri tamamla (") + Math.min(game.quest, QUESTS.length - 1) + "/" + (QUESTS.length - 1) + ")";
      right = T('<span class="badge mute">🔒 KİLİTLİ</span>');
    } else if (earthFinal) {
      desc = T("Eve dönüş rotası hazır");
      right = "";
    } else {
      desc = game.visited.includes(k) ? T("Daha önce ziyaret edildi") : T("Yeni rota");
      right = "";
    }
    row.innerHTML = `<div class="ri"><span class="planet" style="background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#ffffff88,${P.ground} 45%,${P.dot})"></span></div>
      <div><div class="rn">${P.name}</div><div class="rd">${desc}</div></div><div class="rp"></div>`;
    const act = document.createElement("div");
    if (right) act.innerHTML = right;
    else {
      const b = document.createElement("button");
      b.className = "cbtn pri";
      b.textContent = earthFinal ? T("🌍 EVE DÖN") : T("🚀 KALKIŞ");
      b.disabled = locked0;
      if (locked0) b.title = T("Ana motor hasarlı");
      b.onclick = () => {
        if (earthFinal) {
          game.won = true;
          startOutro();
          return;
        }
        startTravel(k);
      };
      act.appendChild(b);
    }
    row.appendChild(act);
    d.appendChild(row);
  });
  $("rocketScreen").classList.remove("hidden");
}
function conMeter(label, val, bg) {
  const v = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, val));
  return `<div class="con-meter"><span>${label}</span><div class="bar"><i style="width:${v}%;background:${bg}"></i></div><span>${Math.round(v)}%</span></div>`;
}
function closeRocket() {
  rocketOpen = false;
  clearInterval(openRocket._t);
  $("rocketScreen").classList.add("hidden");
  focusGame();
}
$("rocketClose").onclick = closeRocket;

/* --- Roket yolculuk animasyonu --- */
let fly = null,
  pendingWin = false,
  winOpen = false;
function startTravel(k) {
  if (fly) return;
  if (game.repair && game.repair.state !== "ok") {
    sfx("error");
    toast(T("Ana motor arızalı — makine dairesinde motoru onar"));
    return;
  }
  closeRocket();
  insideRocket = false;
  game.sleeping = false;
  fly = { t: 0, from: scene, to: k, switched: false };
  sfx("travel");
}
function updateFly(dt) {
  const f = fly;
  if (!f) return;
  f.t += dt;
  updateParticles(dt);
  shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 36);
  warp = Math.max(0, warp - dt * 1.3);
  $("hint").classList.add("hidden");
  $("eBtn").style.display = "none";
  $("fBtn").style.display = "none";
  $("gBtn").style.display = "none";
  $("qBtn").style.display = "none";
  if (!f.switched && f.t >= 0.45) {
    f.switched = true;
    enterPlanet(f.to, false, true);
  }
  if (f.t >= CFG.flyDur) {
    const to = f.to;
    fly = null;
    bumpQuest("traveled"); // seyahat tamamlandı (son görev: Kaşif)
    toast(PLANETS[to].name + T("'e varıldı"));
    sfx("click");
    if (pendingWin) {
      pendingWin = false;
      showWin();
    }
  }
}
function drawFlyOverlay() {
  const f = fly;
  if (!f) return;
  const t = f.t,
    d = CFG.flyDur;
  const a = t < 0.4 ? t / 0.4 : t > d - 0.45 ? Math.max(0, (d - t) / 0.45) : 1;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(4,5,16," + a + ")";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  if (a > 0.08) {
    const prog = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (t - 0.4) / (d - 0.85)));
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
      const sx = (i * 149.3) % W,
        sy = (i * 97.7) % H;
      const len = 16 + ((i * 53) % 70) * prog;
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + (0.1 + ((i * 17) % 70) / 160) + ")";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(sx, sy);
      ctx.lineTo(sx - len, sy + len * 0.3);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    const ease = prog < 0.5 ? 2 * prog * prog : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * prog + 2, 2) / 2;
    const rx = -150 + (W + 300) * ease,
      ry = H * 0.72 - H * 0.36 * ease;
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    storyRocket(rx, ry, Math.PI / 2 + Math.sin(ease * 7) * 0.05, Math.min(W, H) / 560, 1, true);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#eef0ff";
    ctx.font = "800 " + Math.round(Math.min(W, H) * 0.05) + "px 'Segoe UI',sans-serif";
    ctx.shadowColor = "#5ad1ff";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 18;
    ctx.fillText("🚀 " + PLANETS[f.from].name + "  →  " + PLANETS[f.to].name, W / 2, H * 0.2);
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    ctx.font = "500 15px 'Segoe UI',sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#9aa0cf";
    ctx.fillText(T("Roket yolculuğu sürüyor…"), W / 2, H * 0.2 + 36);
    const bw = Math.min(380, W * 0.5),
      bx = W / 2 - bw / 2,
      by = H * 0.2 + 58;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.14)";
    if (ctx.roundRect) ctx.roundRect(bx, by, bw, 8, 4);
    else ctx.rect(bx, by, bw, 8);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#5ad1ff";
    if (ctx.roundRect) ctx.roundRect(bx, by, Math.max(4, bw * ease), 8, 4);
    else ctx.rect(bx, by, Math.max(4, bw * ease), 8);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function openMarket() {
  marketOpen = true;
  const S = game.stock;
  $("mktTitle").textContent = T("Kargo Terminali");
  $("marketSub").textContent = T("Numuneleri kargo bölmesine yükle · erzak kapsüllerde");
  $("mktCoins").textContent = "📦 " + Math.min(game.cargo, CFG.cargoGoal) + "/" + CFG.cargoGoal;
  $("mktRate").textContent = "💧 +1 / " + Math.round((recycleInt() / 60) * 10) / 10 + T(" dk");
  const sh = $("shop");
  sh.innerHTML = "";
  const items = [
    ["water", "💧", T("Su"), T("Susuzluğu giderir · geri dönüştürülür")],
    ["potato", "🥔", T("Patates"), T("Açlığı giderir · tarladan yetişir")],
    ["seed", "🌱", T("Patates tohumu"), T("Dışarıdaki parsele ek")],
    ["medkit", "💊", T("Medikit"), T("Canı yeniler")],
  ];
  items.forEach(([key, ic, name, desc]) => {
    const inv = game.inventory[key] || 0,
      st = S[key] || 0;
    const el = document.createElement("div");
    el.className = "con-row";
    el.innerHTML = Tf(
      `<div class="ri">{0}</div><div><div class="rn">{1}</div><div class="rd">{2}</div></div>
      <div class="rp"><span>DEPO {3}</span><span class="rp-sub">ÇANTA {4}</span></div>`,
      [ic, name, desc, st, inv],
    );
    const act = document.createElement("div");
    act.className = "con-2b";
    const take = document.createElement("button");
    take.className = "cbtn pri";
    take.textContent = T("Al");
    take.disabled = st <= 0;
    take.onclick = () => {
      if (S[key] <= 0) return;
      S[key]--;
      game.inventory[key] = (game.inventory[key] || 0) + 1;
      sfx("pickup");
      updateInv();
      openMarket();
    };
    const put = document.createElement("button");
    put.className = "cbtn";
    put.textContent = T("Bırak");
    put.disabled = inv <= 0;
    put.onclick = () => {
      if ((game.inventory[key] || 0) <= 0) return;
      game.inventory[key]--;
      S[key] = (S[key] || 0) + 1;
      sfx("click");
      updateInv();
      openMarket();
    };
    act.append(take, put);
    el.appendChild(act);
    sh.appendChild(el);
  });
  // kargo bölmesi
  const cargo = Math.min(game.cargo || 0, CFG.cargoGoal);
  $("sellSum").textContent = cargo + " / " + CFG.cargoGoal;
  const list = $("sellList");
  list.innerHTML = "";
  list.insertAdjacentHTML(
    "beforeend",
    `<div class="con-meters" style="width:100%">${conMeter(T("KARGO"), (cargo / CFG.cargoGoal) * 100, "linear-gradient(90deg,#c2410c,#ffb347)")}</div>`,
  );
  const st = game.inventory.stone || 0,
    sr = game.inventory.star || 0;
  if (st)
    list.insertAdjacentHTML(
      "beforeend",
      Tf(`<span class="chip">🔩 Metal <b>×{0}</b> <i>+{1}</i></span>`, [st, st]),
    );
  if (sr)
    list.insertAdjacentHTML(
      "beforeend",
      Tf(`<span class="chip">⭐ Yıldız <b>×{0}</b> <i>+{1}</i></span>`, [sr, sr * 2]),
    );
  if (!st && !sr)
    list.insertAdjacentHTML(
      "beforeend",
      Tf(
        `<div class="con-note">Çantanda numune yok — dışarıda metal ve ⭐ topla, burada kargoya yükle.</div>`,
        [],
      ),
    );
  {
    ensureRare();
    const C = commState();
    C.flags.rock = C.flags.rock || {};
    const hdr = document.createElement("div");
    let any = false;
    for (const k of RARE_ALL) {
      const n = game.rare[k] || 0,
        st = C.flags.rock[k],
        known = !!game.rareKnown[k];
      if (known || (!n && !(st > 0))) continue;
      any = true;
      const wait = st > 0;
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.className = "con-row ana-row";
      row.innerHTML = Tf(
        `<div class="ri"><img src="{0}" alt="" style="width:32px;height:32px;filter:{1}"></div><div><div class="rn">Bilinmeyen taş · {2}. tür<span class="ana-tag">ANALİZ İÇİN</span></div><div class="rd">{3}</div></div><div class="rp"><span>ÇANTA {4}</span></div>`,
        [
          rareIconURL(k),
          known ? "none" : "grayscale(.6) hue-rotate(200deg)",
          RARE_ALL.indexOf(k) + 1,
          wait
            ? T("Dünya'ya gönderildi · laboratuvar inceliyor")
            : T("Ne olduğunu ve tehlikeli olup olmadığını öğrenmek için gönder"),
          n,
        ],
      );
      const b = document.createElement("button");
      b.className = "cbtn pri";
      b.textContent = wait ? T("Analizde…") : T("Analize gönder");
      b.disabled = wait || n < 1;
      b.onclick = () => sendRockSample(k);
      const a = document.createElement("div");
      a.className = "con-2b";
      a.appendChild(b);
      row.appendChild(a);
      list.appendChild(row);
    }
  }
  {
    const rt = game.inventory.rotten || 0,
      C = commState(),
      wait = C.flags.capsAt && !C.flags.ana;
    if (rt > 0 || wait) {
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.className = "con-row rot-row ana-row";
      row.innerHTML = Tf(
        `<div class="ri"><img src="{0}" alt="" style="width:30px;height:30px"></div><div><div class="rn">Çürük patates<span class="ana-tag">ANALİZ İÇİN</span></div><div class="rd">{1}</div></div><div class="rp"><span>ÇANTA {2}</span></div>`,
        [
          itemIconURL("rotten"),
          wait
            ? T("Dünya'ya gönderildi · analiz bekleniyor")
            : T("Kargoyla Dünya'ya gönder · neden çürüdüğünü incelesinler"),
          rt,
        ],
      );
      const b = document.createElement("button");
      b.className = "cbtn pri";
      b.textContent = T("Dünya'ya gönder");
      b.disabled = wait || rt < 1;
      b.onclick = sendRotCargo;
      const a = document.createElement("div");
      a.className = "con-2b";
      a.appendChild(b);
      row.appendChild(a);
      list.appendChild(row);
    }
  }
  $("marketTrade").textContent =
    st + sr > 0 ? T("📦 Numuneleri kargoya yükle · +") + (st + sr * 2) : T("Yüklenecek numune yok");
  $("marketTrade").disabled = st + sr <= 0;
  $("marketScreen").classList.remove("hidden");
}
function closeMarket() {
  marketOpen = false;
  $("marketScreen").classList.add("hidden");
  focusGame();
}
$("marketClose").onclick = closeMarket;
$("marketTrade").onclick = () => depositSamples();

function pressE() {
  if (mode !== "play" || paused) return;
  if (upgOpen) {
    closeUpg();
    return;
  }
  if (commOpen) {
    closeComm();
    return;
  }
  if (capOpen) {
    closeCapsule();
    return;
  }
  if (o2Fill) {
    stopO2Fill(false);
    return;
  }
  if (repairOpen) {
    closeRepair();
    return;
  }
  if (rocketOpen) {
    closeRocket();
    return;
  }
  if (marketOpen) {
    closeMarket();
    return;
  }
  if (bedOpen) {
    if (game.sleeping) wakeUp(T("Uyandın"));
    else closeBed();
    return;
  }
  if (insideRocket) {
    stationAction();
    return;
  }
  sfx("click");
  if (nearRocket()) enterRocket();
}
function pressF() {
  if (radM) return;
  if (
    mode !== "play" ||
    paused ||
    rocketOpen ||
    marketOpen ||
    repairOpen ||
    capOpen ||
    commOpen ||
    upgOpen ||
    o2Fill ||
    bookOpen ||
    bedOpen
  )
    return;
  if (insideRocket) {
    insideF();
    return;
  }
  const pk = nearestPickup();
  if (pk) {
    if (pk.kind === "rare") {
      startBreak(pk.o);
      return;
    }
    if (pk.kind === "gold") {
      pk.o.taken = true;
      ensureUpg();
      game.gold += pk.o.n || 1;
      bumpQuest("gold", pk.o.n || 1);
      burst(pk.o.x, pk.o.y, 24, "#ffd34d", { sp: 150, life: 0.7, size: 5 });
      addFloat(pk.o.x, pk.o.y - 24, "+" + (pk.o.n || 1) + T(" altın"), "#ffd34d");
      sfx("star");
      tone(1568, 0.12, "sine", 0.05, 0, 0.05);
      if (!game._goldTip) {
        game._goldTip = 1;
        toast(
          T("🪙 <b>Altın parçası</b> — roketteki geliştirme istasyonunda roketini güçlendirmek için kullan"),
        );
      }
      return;
    }
    if (pk.kind === "stone" && (game.inventory.stone || 0) >= stoneCap()) {
      sfx("full");
      toast(T("Envanter dolu! (") + game.inventory.stone + "/" + stoneCap() + ")");
      return;
    }
    pk.o.taken = true;
    game.inventory[pk.kind] = (game.inventory[pk.kind] || 0) + 1;
    burst(pk.o.x, pk.o.y, pk.kind === "star" ? 20 : 12, pk.kind === "star" ? "#ffd34d" : "#c9d2e0", {
      sp: 130,
      life: 0.6,
      size: 5,
    });
    addFloat(
      pk.o.x,
      pk.o.y - 24,
      pk.kind === "star" ? "+1 ⭐" : "+1 🔩",
      pk.kind === "star" ? "#ffd34d" : "#dfe7f5",
    );
    sfx(pk.kind === "star" ? "star" : "pickup");
    updateInv();
    commsObs("geo", pk.kind === "star" ? { star: 1 } : { metal: 1 });
    bumpQuest("mined");
    return;
  }
  if (nearRocket() && sampleCount() > 0) {
    depositSamples();
    return;
  }
  {
    const nm = nearestMark(),
      pl0 = nearestPlot();
    if (nm && (!pl0 || nm.d < Math.hypot(p.x - pl0.pl.x, p.y - pl0.pl.y))) {
      removeMark(nm);
      return;
    }
  }
  if (heldItemKey() === "radmeter" && !nearestPlot()) {
    startMeasure(p.x + p.dir * 80, p.y + 26);
    return;
  }
  const pl = nearestPlot(),
    held = heldItemKey();
  if (pl) {
    const fa = farmArr(),
      g = fa[pl.i];
    if (!g || g.g <= 0) {
      if (held === "ceramic") {
        coverPlot(g);
        return;
      }
      if (g && g.cov && g.shut) {
        sfx("error");
        toast(T("🔒 Kalkan kapalı — tohum ekmek için önce <b>Q</b> ile aç"));
        return;
      }
      if (!isSeedKey(held)) {
        const sk = nextSeedKey();
        if (sk) {
          equip(sk);
          toast(
            sk === "tuber"
              ? T("🥔 Tohumluk patatesi eline aldın — ekmek için tekrar <b>F</b>")
              : T("🌱 Tohumu eline aldın — ekmek için tekrar <b>F</b>"),
          );
        } else {
          sfx("error");
          toast(T("Tohum yok — roketteki alet sandığından al ya da sağlıklı hasat yap"));
        }
        return;
      }
      game.inventory[held]--;
      Object.assign(fa[pl.i], { g: 0.1, wet: 0, idle: 0, fill: 0 });
      updateInv();
      burst(pl.pl.x, pl.pl.y, 14, "#8a6a3c", { sp: 90, life: 0.6, size: 4 });
      addFloat(pl.pl.x, pl.pl.y - 30, T("🌱 Ekildi"), "#7fe0ff");
      sfx("plant");
      bumpQuest("planted");
      if (fa[pl.i].cov && !fa[pl.i].shut) toast(T("🌱 Ekildi — şimdi <b>Q</b> ile kalkanı kapat"));
      else storyTrigger("seedTip");
      return;
    }
    if (held === "ceramic") {
      coverPlot(g);
      return;
    }
    if (g.cov && (g.shut || domeMoving(g))) {
      sfx("error");
      toast(
        g.g >= CFG.farmGrow
          ? T("🔒 Kalkan kapalı — patatese ulaşmak için <b>Q</b> ile aç")
          : T("🔒 Kalkan kapalı — sulamak için <b>Q</b> ile aç"),
      );
      return;
    }
    if (g.g >= CFG.farmGrow) {
      const rot = plotRots(fa[pl.i]);
      fa[pl.i].g = 0;
      fa[pl.i].wet = 0;
      if (rot) {
        harvestRot(fa[pl.i]);
        return;
      }
      if (game.radLearned) bumpQuest("cleanHarvest");
      const n = 1 + (Math.random() < 0.45 ? 1 : 0);
      game.inventory.potato = (game.inventory.potato || 0) + n;
      game.inventory.tuber = (game.inventory.tuber || 0) + 1;
      burst(pl.pl.x, pl.pl.y, 22, "#4ade80", { sp: 140, life: 0.7, size: 5 });
      addFloat(pl.pl.x, pl.pl.y - 34, "+" + n + " 🥔  +1 " + T("tohumluk"), "#4ade80");
      if (!game._tuberTip) {
        game._tuberTip = 1;
        setTimeout(
          () =>
            toast(T("🥔 Hasattan <b>1 tohumluk patates</b> çıktı — filizli gözleriyle yeniden ekilebilir")),
          900,
        );
      }
      sfx("harvest");
      updateInv();
      bumpQuest("harvested");
      return;
    }
    if (held === "water") {
      game.inventory.water--;
      g.wet = Math.max(g.wet, 16);
      g.g = Math.min(CFG.farmGrow, g.g + 6);
      burst(pl.pl.x, pl.pl.y, 16, "#38bdf8", { sp: 110, life: 0.6, size: 4, up: 60 });
      game.qstats.watered = (game.qstats.watered || 0) + 1;
      addFloat(pl.pl.x, pl.pl.y - 30, T("💧 Sulandı"), "#38bdf8");
      sfx("water");
      updateInv();
      return;
    }
    if ((game.inventory.water || 0) > 0) {
      equip("water");
      toast(T("💧 Su şişesini eline aldın — sulamak için tekrar <b>F</b>"));
      return;
    }
    sfx("error");
    toast(T("Sulamak için su yok · büyüyor %") + Math.round(plotStage(g.g) * 100));
    return;
  }
  if (held === "water") {
    if (game.thirst >= 100) {
      sfx("full");
      toast(T("Susuzluğun zaten dolu"));
      return;
    }
    game.inventory.water--;
    game.thirst = Math.min(100, game.thirst + CFG.drinkThirst);
    startAct("drink", 1.8);
    burst(p.x, p.y - 30, 10, "#38bdf8", { sp: 70, life: 0.5, size: 3 });
    sfx("drink");
    toast(T("Su içildi (+") + CFG.drinkThirst + T(" su)"));
    updateInv();
    updateStats();
    bumpQuest("drunk");
    return;
  }
  if (held === "potato") {
    if (game.hunger >= 100) {
      sfx("full");
      toast(T("Tok durumdasın"));
      return;
    }
    game.inventory.potato--;
    game.hunger = Math.min(100, game.hunger + CFG.eatHunger);
    startAct("eat", 2.0);
    sfx("eat");
    toast(T("Patates yendi (+") + CFG.eatHunger + T(" tokluk)"));
    updateInv();
    updateStats();
    return;
  }
  sfx("error");
  toast(
    held === "pickaxe"
      ? T("Çapa elinde — su içmek için önce suyu eline al (numara tuşu)")
      : T("Yapılacak bir şey yok (F)"),
  );
}
function pressG() {
  if (
    mode !== "play" ||
    paused ||
    rocketOpen ||
    marketOpen ||
    repairOpen ||
    capOpen ||
    commOpen ||
    upgOpen ||
    o2Fill ||
    bookOpen ||
    bedOpen
  )
    return;
  const fromStock = insideRocket && (game.inventory.medkit || 0) <= 0 && game.stock.medkit > 0;
  if ((game.inventory.medkit || 0) <= 0 && !fromStock) {
    sfx("error");
    toast("Medikit yok — roketin revirinden al");
    return;
  }
  if (game.hp >= 100) {
    sfx("full");
    toast(T("Canın zaten dolu"));
    return;
  }
  if (fromStock) game.stock.medkit--;
  else game.inventory.medkit--;
  game.hp = Math.min(100, game.hp + CFG.healAmount);
  startAct("use", 1.2);
  burst(p.x, p.y - 20, 26, "#4ade80", { sp: 120, life: 0.8, size: 5, up: 80 });
  addFloat(p.x, p.y - 50, "+" + CFG.healAmount + " ❤️", "#4ade80");
  sfx("heal");
  updateInv();
  updateStats();
}

/* ============== OLAY SİSTEMİ (Meteor) ============== */
function damage(n, quiet) {
  if (game.hp <= 0) return;
  game.hp = Math.max(0, game.hp - n);
  if (!quiet) {
    flash = 0.7;
    shake = Math.max(shake, 14);
    sfx("hurt");
  }
  updateStats();
}
function gameDayNumber() {
  return Math.floor(Math.max(0, Number(game && game.worldTime) || 0) / DAY_SECONDS) + 1;
}
function radiationActiveNow() {
  if (!game) return false;
  const worldTime = Math.max(0, Number(game.worldTime) || 0),
    day = Math.floor(worldTime / DAY_SECONDS) + 1;
  return day >= 3 && day % 3 === 0 && worldTime % DAY_SECONDS < RADIATION_DURATION;
}
function updateRadiation(simDt) {
  const active = radiationActiveNow(),
    was = !!game.radiationActive;
  if (active && !was) {
    sfx("warn");
    if (!insideRocket) toast(T("☢️ Radyasyon dalgası başladı — canın azalıyor, rokete gir!"));
    if (scene !== "earth") {
      const open = farmArr().filter((g) => g && g.g > 0 && !domeSafe(g)).length;
      if (open > 0)
        setTimeout(
          () =>
            toast(
              Tf("🌱 {0} parsel açıkta — seramik kalkanı olmayan bitkiler radyasyondan zarar görüyor", [
                open,
              ]),
            ),
          2600,
        );
    }
  }
  if (!active && was) {
    toast(T("☢️ Radyasyon dalgası geçti"));
    if (suitSt().rad > 0.6) storyTrigger("radLesson");
    if (scene !== "earth") {
      const fa = farmArr();
      const saved = fa.filter((g) => g && g.g > 0 && g.radOK && !g.radHit).length,
        hit = fa.filter((g) => g && g.g > 0 && g.radHit).length;
      fa.forEach((g) => {
        if (g) {
          g.radOK = 0;
          g.radHit = 0;
        }
      });
      if (saved > 0) {
        bumpQuest("shieldSaved");
        storyTrigger("domeSaved");
      }
      if (hit > 0) storyTrigger("domeBurn");
    }
  }
  game.radiationActive = active;
  const wt = Math.max(0, Number(game.worldTime) || 0),
    inDay = wt % DAY_SECONDS,
    day = Math.floor(wt / DAY_SECONDS) + 1;
  if (active) {
    const left = RADIATION_DURATION - inDay;
    if (insideRocket)
      setAlert(
        "radiationBanner",
        "rad safe",
        "safe",
        T("Roket içi güvenli"),
        T("Radyasyon dalgası · gövde zırhı koruyor"),
        left / RADIATION_DURATION,
        mmss(left),
      );
    else
      setAlert(
        "radiationBanner",
        "rad",
        "rad",
        T("Radyasyon dalgası"),
        T("Dışarıda can azalıyor — rokete sığın!"),
        left / RADIATION_DURATION,
        mmss(left),
      );
    if (!insideRocket) {
      const rd = RADIATION_DAMAGE_PER_SECOND * suitSt().rad * dif().rad;
      damage(rd * simDt, true);
      game._radT = (game._radT || 0) + simDt;
      if (game._radT >= 1.2) {
        game._radT = 0;
        addFloat(
          p.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30,
          p.y - 62,
          "-" + Math.max(1, Math.round(rd * 1.2)) + " ☢",
          "#a3e635",
        );
        sfx("hurt");
        shake = Math.max(shake, 3);
      }
    }
  } else if (scene !== "earth" && (day + 1) % 3 === 0 && inDay > DAY_SECONDS - RAD_WARN - desFx().radWarn) {
    if (farmArr().some((g) => g && g.g > 0 && !domeSafe(g))) {
      const SS = storyState();
      if (!SS.done.radRadio) {
        SS.rrDay = day;
        storyTrigger("radRadio");
      } else if (SS.rrDay !== day) storyTrigger("radRadio2_" + day);
    }
    const tt = DAY_SECONDS - inDay;
    setAlert(
      "radiationBanner",
      "rad warn",
      "rad",
      T("Radyasyon dalgası yaklaşıyor"),
      insideRocket ? T("Roketin içindesin — güvendesin") : T("Güneş patlaması · rokete yaklaş"),
      1 - tt / RAD_WARN,
      mmss(tt),
    );
  } else setAlert("radiationBanner");
}
function updateEvent(dt) {
  const E = ev;
  if (scene === "earth") {
    E.type = null;
    E.meteors = [];
    return;
  }
  if (E.type === null) {
    if (stormFx.phase !== "none") {
      E.next = Math.max(E.next, 20);
      return;
    } // fırtınada meteor yok
    E.next -= dt;
    if (E.next <= 0) {
      // uyarısız meteor yağmuru: 1-3 meteor
      E.type = "meteor";
      E.t = 9;
      E.spawnT = 0.8;
      E.meteors = [];
      E.goal = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
      E.spawned = 0;
    }
    return;
  }
  E.t -= dt;
  E.spawnT -= dt;
  if (E.spawnT <= 0 && E.spawned < E.goal && E.t > 2) {
    E.spawnT = 1.3 + Math.random() * 1.2;
    spawnMeteor();
    E.spawned++;
  }
  for (let i = E.meteors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const m = E.meteors[i];
    m.t -= dt;
    if (m.t <= 0) {
      impact(m);
      E.meteors.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }
  if (E.t <= 0) {
    E.type = null;
    E.next = CFG.eventMin + Math.random() * (CFG.eventMax - CFG.eventMin);
    E.meteors = [];
  }
}
/* ============== İPUCU / DOKUNMATİK ============== */
function computeHint() {
  if (
    rocketOpen ||
    marketOpen ||
    repairOpen ||
    capOpen ||
    commOpen ||
    upgOpen ||
    o2Fill ||
    bookOpen ||
    bedOpen ||
    paused ||
    mode !== "play"
  )
    return "";
  if (insideRocket) return insideHint();
  const pk = nearestPickup(),
    nr = nearRocket(),
    pl = nearestPlot();
  const stone = game.inventory.stone || 0;
  if (pk) {
    if (pk.kind === "gold") return T("<b>F</b>: Altın parçası topla · roket geliştirme");
    if (pk.kind === "rare") {
      const kn = game.rareKnown[pk.o.kind];
      return (
        "<b>F</b>: " +
        (kn ? RARE_DEF[pk.o.kind].name + T(" — kazmayla kır") : T("Bilinmeyen taşı kazmayla kır")) +
        ((game.inventory.pick || 0) > 0 ? "" : T(" · <b style='color:#ff8a8a'>jeolog kazması gerekli</b>"))
      );
    }
    if (pk.kind === "stone")
      return stone >= stoneCap()
        ? T("Çanta dolu (") + stone + "/" + stoneCap() + T(") — rokete yükle")
        : T("<b>F</b>: Metal numune topla");
    return T("<b>F</b>: Yıldız kırıntısı topla (⭐ = 2 numune)");
  }
  if (brk) return T("Taş kırılıyor…");
  if (radM) return radM.done ? T("Sol tık: ölçümü kapat") : T("Ölçülüyor… hareket etme");
  {
    const nm = nearestMark();
    if (nm && !nr && (!pl || nm.d < Math.hypot(p.x - pl.pl.x, p.y - pl.pl.y)))
      return T("<b>F</b>: Ölçüm bayrağını kaldır (") + fmtN(nm.mk.u, 2) + " µSv/h)";
  }
  if (nr)
    return (
      T("<b>E</b>: Rokete gir") +
      (sampleCount() > 0 ? T("  ·  <b>F</b>: Numuneleri kargoya yükle") : "") +
      ((game.inventory.rotten || 0) > 0 ? T("  ·  çürük patatesi kargo terminalinden gönder") : "")
    );
  if (heldItemKey() === "radmeter")
    return T("<b>Sol tık</b>: toprağın radyasyonunu ölç  ·  <b>F</b>: önündeki toprağı ölç");
  if (farmArr().length === 0 && game.quest >= 2)
    return game.kitCarried
      ? heldItemKey() === "pickaxe"
        ? T("<b>Sol tık</b>: yakındaki yere kaz — ilk parseli aç")
        : T("Çapayı eline al (numara tuşu) ya da yere tıkla")
      : T("Çapa roketteki alet sandığında (makine dairesi) — rokete gir: <b>E</b>");
  if (pl) {
    const fa = farmArr(),
      g = fa[pl.i];
    const hk = heldItemKey();
    if (g && g.cov && domeMoving(g)) return g.shut ? T("🛡️ Kalkan kapanıyor…") : T("🛡️ Kalkan açılıyor…");
    if (hk === "ceramic" && !(g && g.cov))
      return T("<b>F</b>: Seramik kalkanı kur · <b>Q</b> ile açılıp kapanır");
    if (!g || g.g <= 0) {
      if (g && g.cov && g.shut) return T("🔒 Kalkan kapalı · <b>Q</b>: aç ve tohum ek");
      const sx = g && g.cov ? T("  ·  <b>Q</b>: kalkanı kapat  ·  <b>Shift+Q</b>: sök") : "";
      return (
        (isSeedKey(hk)
          ? T("<b>F</b>: Tohum ek")
          : hasSeeds()
            ? T("<b>F</b>: Tohumu eline al")
            : T("Tohum yok — roketteki alet sandığından al")) + sx
      );
    }
    if (g.cov && g.shut)
      return g.g >= CFG.farmGrow
        ? T("🔒 Patatesler hazır ama kalkan kapalı · <b>Q</b>: aç")
        : T("🛡️ Kalkan kapalı · korunuyor · büyüyor %") +
            Math.round(plotStage(g.g) * 100) +
            T(" · <b>Q</b>: aç");
    const qx = g.cov ? T("  ·  <b>Q</b>: kalkanı kapat") : "";
    if (g.g >= CFG.farmGrow)
      return (
        (plotRots(g)
          ? T("<b>F</b>: Hasat et — yapraklar solmuş, bir terslik var")
          : T("<b>F</b>: Hasat et 🥔")) + qx
      );
    if (game.radiationActive && scene !== "earth")
      return g.cov
        ? T("☢️ Radyasyon! Bitki zarar görüyor — <b>Q</b> ile kalkanı kapat")
        : T("☢️ Bitki radyasyondan zarar görüyor — seramik kalkanı eline al ve <b>F</b>");
    return (
      (heldItemKey() === "water"
        ? T("<b>F</b>: Sula (hızlandırır)")
        : (game.inventory.water || 0) > 0
          ? T("<b>F</b>: Suyu eline al (sulamak için)")
          : T("Büyüyor %") + Math.round(plotStage(g.g) * 100) + "…") + qx
    );
  }
  if ((game.inventory.medkit || 0) > 0 && game.hp < 100)
    return T("<b>G</b>: Medikit kullan (") + Math.round(game.hp) + "❤️)";
  if (game.hp < 60) return T("Dikkat: canın düşük! Roketin revirinde iyileş");
  return "";
}
function updateTouch(hint) {
  const touch = matchMedia("(pointer:coarse)").matches;
  if (!touch) return;
  if (bedOpen) {
    $("eBtn").style.display = game.sleeping ? "block" : "none";
    $("fBtn").style.display = "none";
    $("gBtn").style.display = "none";
    return;
  }
  $("qBtn").style.display = "none";
  if (insideRocket) {
    const st = nearStation();
    $("eBtn").style.display = st ? "block" : "none";
    $("fBtn").style.display = st && st.key === "trade" && sampleCount() > 0 ? "block" : "none";
    $("gBtn").style.display = "none";
    return;
  }
  const nr = nearRocket(),
    pk = nearestPickup(),
    pl = nearestPlot();
  $("eBtn").style.display = nr ? "block" : "none";
  const stone = game.inventory.stone || 0;
  const hk = heldItemKey(),
    canF =
      (pk && (pk.kind !== "stone" || stone < stoneCap())) ||
      (nr && sampleCount() > 0) ||
      pl ||
      (hk === "water" && game.thirst < 100) ||
      (hk === "potato" && game.hunger < 100);
  $("fBtn").style.display = canF ? "block" : "none";
  $("gBtn").style.display = (game.inventory.medkit || 0) > 0 && game.hp < 100 ? "block" : "none";
  $("qBtn").style.display = nearestDome() ? "block" : "none";
}

/* ============== GİRDİ ============== */
addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (game && game.wake && mode === "play") {
    if (["Space", "Enter", "Escape"].includes(e.code)) {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (!e.repeat && game.wake.t > 1.2) endWake();
    }
    return;
  } // açılışı geçmek için basılı tutulan tuş uyanışı atlamasın
  if (story && !story.end && mode === "play") {
    if (["Space", "Enter", "KeyE", "KeyF"].includes(e.code)) {
      e.preventDefault();
      storyAdvance();
    } else if (e.code === "Escape") {
      e.preventDefault();
      storyEnd();
    }
    return;
  }
  if (mode === "intro") {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (e.code === "Escape") endIntro();
    else if ((e.code === "Space" || e.code === "Enter") && intro) intro.hold = true;
    return;
  }
  if (commOpen) {
    // terminal açıkken: yazı alanında oyun tuşları çalışmaz
    const typing = /^(TEXTAREA|INPUT|SELECT)$/.test((e.target && e.target.tagName) || "");
    if (e.code === "Escape" || (!typing && e.code === "KeyE")) {
      e.preventDefault();
      closeComm();
    }
    return;
  }
  if (bookOpen) {
    // kitap açıkken sadece kitap tuşları
    e.preventDefault();
    if (e.code === "ArrowRight" || e.code === "KeyD") bookFlip(1);
    else if (e.code === "ArrowLeft" || e.code === "KeyA") bookFlip(-1);
    else if (e.code === "Escape" || e.code === "KeyR" || e.code === "KeyE") closeBook();
    return;
  }
  if (
    e.code === "KeyR" &&
    mode === "play" &&
    game &&
    !paused &&
    !rocketOpen &&
    !marketOpen &&
    !repairOpen &&
    !capOpen &&
    !commOpen &&
    !upgOpen &&
    !bedOpen &&
    !winOpen &&
    !fly
  ) {
    openBook();
    return;
  }
  if (["Space", "ArrowUp", "ArrowDown", "ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight"].includes(e.code)) e.preventDefault();
  if (e.code === "Space") {
    if (
      !e.repeat &&
      mode === "play" &&
      game &&
      !paused &&
      !rocketOpen &&
      !marketOpen &&
      !repairOpen &&
      !capOpen &&
      !commOpen &&
      !upgOpen &&
      !bedOpen &&
      !o2Fill &&
      !winOpen &&
      !fly
    )
      keys.Space = true;
    return;
  }
  // 1-6: hotbar slotu seç (aynı tuşa tekrar bas = bırak (su, yiyecek, medikit: kullan))
  if (/^(Digit|Numpad)[1-9]$/.test(e.code)) {
    if (
      mode === "play" &&
      game &&
      !paused &&
      !rocketOpen &&
      !marketOpen &&
      !repairOpen &&
      !capOpen &&
      !commOpen &&
      !upgOpen
    ) {
      const i = +e.code.slice(-1) - 1;
      if (i === selSlot) slotAgain(i);
      else {
        const k = (game.slotOrder || [])[i];
        if (k) {
          selSlot = i;
          updateInv();
          sfx("click");
          toast(
            T("Elinde: ") +
              slotName(k) +
              (isRareSlot(k)
                ? " ×" + slotCount(k) + (RARE_KEYS.includes(k.slice(2)) ? "" : T(" (yalnız bilim)"))
                : ""),
          );
        } else sfx("error");
      }
    }
    return;
  }
  keys[e.code] = true;
  if (e.code === "KeyQ" && !e.repeat) pressQ(e.shiftKey);
  if (e.code === "Escape") toggleEsc();
  if (e.code === "KeyE") pressE();
  if (e.code === "KeyF") pressF();
  if (e.code === "KeyG") pressG();
});
addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
  keys[e.code] = false;
  if (mode === "intro" && intro && (e.code === "Space" || e.code === "Enter")) intro.hold = false;
});
addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
  if (!(e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest("#commScreen"))) focusGame();
});

/* --- sol tık / dokunuş: kazmayla parsel aç --- */
function digAt(wx, wy) {
  const d = Math.hypot(wx - p.x, wy - p.y);
  if (d > CFG.digRange) {
    sfx("error");
    toast(T("Çok uzak — tıkladığın yere daha yaklaş"));
    return;
  }
  const plots = farmArr();
  if (plots.length >= CFG.maxPlots) {
    sfx("full");
    toast(T("Azami parsel sayısına ulaştın (") + CFG.maxPlots + ")");
    return;
  }
  if (plots.some((pl) => Math.hypot(wx - pl.x, wy - pl.y) < 120)) {
    sfx("error");
    toast(T("Buraya çok yakın — biraz aralık bırak"));
    return;
  }
  if (Math.hypot(wx - ROCKET.x, wy - ROCKET.y) < 170) {
    sfx("error");
    toast(T("İniş platformunu kazamazsın"));
    return;
  }
  if (Math.abs(wx) > CFG.worldHalf - 80 || Math.abs(wy) > CFG.worldHalf - 80) {
    sfx("error");
    toast(T("Dünyanın kenarını kazamazsın"));
    return;
  }
  p.dir = wx < p.x ? -1 : 1;
  if (p.action === "dig" && p.actionT > 0) return; // önceki vuruş bitmeden yeni vuruş yok
  p.action = "dig";
  p.actionT = 1.0;
  p.actionDur = 1.0;
  p.digAt = { x: wx, y: wy, t: 0 };
  tone(220, 0.25, "sine", 0.04, 320, 0.05); // kaldırırken hışırtı
}
/* ekilebilir tohumlar: paket tohum (alet sandığı) + tohumluk patates (hasattan) */
function isSeedKey(k) {
  return k === "seed" || k === "tuber";
}
function hasSeeds() {
  return (game.inventory.seed || 0) + (game.inventory.tuber || 0) > 0;
}
function nextSeedKey() {
  return (game.inventory.tuber || 0) > 0 ? "tuber" : (game.inventory.seed || 0) > 0 ? "seed" : null;
}
/* tohum/su elindeyken parsele tıkla: ek ya da sula */
function plotClickUse(wx, wy, held) {
  const fa = farmArr();
  let i = -1,
    bd = 80;
  fa.forEach((q, j) => {
    const d = Math.hypot(q.x - wx, q.y - wy);
    if (d < bd) {
      bd = d;
      i = j;
    }
  });
  if (i < 0) {
    sfx("error");
    toast(
      isSeedKey(held)
        ? T("Tohumu ekmek için açtığın bir parsele tıkla")
        : held === "ceramic"
          ? T("Kalkanı takmak için ekili bir parsele tıkla")
          : T("Sulamak için ekili bir parsele tıkla"),
    );
    return;
  }
  const g = fa[i];
  p.dir = g.x < p.x ? -1 : 1;
  if (held === "ceramic") {
    coverPlot(g);
    return;
  }
  if (g.cov && (g.shut || domeMoving(g))) {
    sfx("error");
    toast(T("🔒 Kalkan kapalı — önce <b>Q</b> ile aç"));
    return;
  }
  if (isSeedKey(held)) {
    if (g.g > 0) {
      sfx("error");
      toast(T("Parsel dolu — önce hasat et (F)"));
      return;
    }
    game.inventory[held]--;
    g.g = 0.1;
    g.wet = 0;
    updateInv();
    burst(g.x, g.y, 14, "#8a6a3c", { sp: 90, life: 0.6, size: 4 });
    addFloat(g.x, g.y - 30, "Ekildi", "#7fe0ff");
    sfx("plant");
    bumpQuest("planted");
    return;
  }
  if (g.g <= 0) {
    sfx("error");
    toast(T("Bu parsel boş — önce tohum ek"));
    return;
  }
  if (g.g >= CFG.farmGrow) {
    sfx("click");
    toast(T("Mahsul hazır — hasat için yanına git ve <b>F</b>"));
    return;
  }
  game.inventory.water--;
  g.wet = Math.max(g.wet, 16);
  g.g = Math.min(CFG.farmGrow, g.g + 6);
  burst(g.x, g.y, 16, "#38bdf8", { sp: 110, life: 0.6, size: 4, up: 60 });
  game.qstats.watered = (game.qstats.watered || 0) + 1;
  addFloat(g.x, g.y - 30, T("Sulandı"), "#38bdf8");
  sfx("water");
  updateInv();
}
const EMPTY_HOLE_T = 45;
const PLANT_RAD_DMG = 0.45; // korumasız bitkinin radyasyon dalgasında kaybettiği büyüme (sn başına)
function digImpact(wx, wy) {
  const plots = farmArr();
  const pr = { x: wx, y: wy, g: 0, wet: 0, rad: soilRad01(wx, wy) };
  plots.push(pr);
  burst(wx, wy + 6, 22, "#c98a5a", { sp: 150, life: 0.7, size: 5, up: 90 });
  burst(wx, wy + 6, 12, "#8f6a4a", { sp: 80, life: 1, size: 4 });
  burst(wx, wy + 2, 8, "#e8c4a0", { sp: 40, life: 1.3, size: 7, up: 20, drag: 2 });
  addFloat(wx, wy - 34, T("Yeni parsel: boş"), "#ffd8a8");
  shake = Math.max(shake, 5);
  sfx("dig");
  noiseBurst(0.12, 0.18, 700);
  toast(T("Yeni parsel hazır: <b>boş</b> — tohum ek (F)"));
}
cv.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
  if (
    mode !== "play" ||
    paused ||
    rocketOpen ||
    marketOpen ||
    repairOpen ||
    capOpen ||
    commOpen ||
    upgOpen ||
    o2Fill ||
    bookOpen ||
    bedOpen ||
    winOpen ||
    fly ||
    !game ||
    insideRocket
  )
    return;
  if (e.button !== 0) return;
  if (radM) {
    if (radM.done) radM.t = Math.max(radM.t, radM.T - 0.5);
    return;
  }
  if (brk) return;
  const z = ((CFG.zoom * Math.min(W, H)) / 700) * cam.z;
  const wx = (e.clientX - W / 2) / z + p.x + cam.ox,
    wy = (e.clientY - H / 2) / z + p.y + cam.oy;
  const held = heldItemKey();
  if (held === "radmeter") {
    startMeasure(wx, wy);
    return;
  }
  if (held === "pick") {
    const n = nearRareNode(150);
    if (n) {
      startBreak(n);
      return;
    }
  }
  if (Math.hypot(wx - p.x, wy - p.y) > CFG.digRange) return; // menzil dışı: sıradan tıklama
  if (isSeedKey(held) || held === "water" || held === "ceramic") {
    plotClickUse(wx, wy, held);
    return;
  }
  if (held === "pick") {
    const n = nearRareNode(150);
    if (n) startBreak(n);
    else {
      sfx("error");
      toast(T("Jeolog kazması yalnızca <b>bilinmeyen (?) taşları</b> kırar — kazmak için çapayı eline al"));
    }
    return;
  }
  if (held === "pickaxe") {
    digAt(wx, wy);
    return;
  }
  if (held) {
    sfx("click");
    toast(T("Elinde başka bir eşya var — kazmak için çapayı eline al (numara tuşu)"));
    return;
  }
  if (!game.kitCarried) {
    sfx("error");
    toast(T("Çapa rokette — makine dairesindeki alet sandığından al"));
    return;
  }
  equip("kit");
  toast(T("Çapayı eline aldın — kazmak için tekrar tıkla"));
});
addEventListener("load", focusGame);

function toggleEsc() {
  if (mode !== "play") return;
  if (!$("settingsScreen").classList.contains("hidden")) {
    $("settingsClose").click();
    return;
  }
  if (winOpen || fly) return;
  if (upgOpen) {
    closeUpg();
    return;
  }
  if (commOpen) {
    closeComm();
    return;
  }
  if (capOpen) {
    closeCapsule();
    return;
  }
  if (o2Fill) {
    stopO2Fill(false);
    return;
  }
  if (repairOpen) {
    closeRepair();
    return;
  }
  if (rocketOpen) {
    closeRocket();
    return;
  }
  if (marketOpen) {
    closeMarket();
    return;
  }
  if (bedOpen) {
    if (game.sleeping) wakeUp(T("Uyandın"));
    else closeBed();
    return;
  }
  paused = !paused;
  $("pauseScreen").classList.toggle("hidden", !paused);
  if (paused) renderPause();
  if (!paused) focusGame();
}
$("pResume").onclick = () => {
  paused = false;
  $("pauseScreen").classList.add("hidden");
  focusGame();
};
$("pSave").onclick = () => {

$("pSettings").onclick = () => openSettings();
$("pMenu").onclick = () => {
  paused = false;
  $("pauseScreen").classList.add("hidden");
  clearTimeout(toast._h);
  $("toast").style.opacity = 0;
  mode = "menu";
  insideRocket = false;
  storyReset();
  if (bookOpen) closeBook();
  if (commOpen) closeComm();
  $("commBadge").classList.add("hidden");
  resetStormFx();
  setAlert("stormBanner");
  setAlert("radiationBanner");
  ["hud", "inv", "stats", "hint", "quest", "stormBanner", "radiationBanner"].forEach((id) =>
    $(id).classList.add("hidden"),
  );
  $("menuScreen").classList.remove("hidden");
  refreshContinueButton();
};

  LB_KEY = "uzay_oyunu_leaderboard_v1";
function mdDefault() {
  return {
    obj: "hab",
    diff: "normal",
    life: 25,

  };
}
let MD = null,
  PENDING_DESIGN = null,
  PENDING_NAME = "";
