const mdFind = (arr, id) => arr.find((x) => x.id === id) || arr[0];
function mdSubOpt(k, D) {
  return mdFind(MD_SUB[k].o, D[k === "life" ? "life_s" : k]);
}
/* kaynak hesabı */
function mdCalc(D) {
  const lv = mdFind(MD_LV, D.lv),
    trj = mdFind(MD_TRJ, D.trj),
    dif = mdFind(MD_DIFF, D.diff),
    life = mdFind(MD_LIFE, D.life);
  const subs = Object.keys(MD_SUB).map((k) => mdSubOpt(k, D)),
    ins = MD_INS.filter((i) => D.ins.includes(i.id));
  const mass =
    MD_BASE.m + trj.m + subs.reduce((a, o) => a + (o.m || 0), 0) + ins.reduce((a, o) => a + o.m, 0);
  const cost =
    MD_BASE.c +
    lv.cost +
    trj.c +
    life.c +
    subs.reduce((a, o) => a + (o.c || 0), 0) +
    ins.reduce((a, o) => a + o.c, 0);
  const pgen = subs.reduce((a, o) => a + (o.g || 0), 0),
    puse = MD_BASE.p + subs.reduce((a, o) => a + (o.p || 0), 0) + ins.reduce((a, o) => a + o.p, 0);
  const data = MD_BASE.data + ins.reduce((a, o) => a + o.data, 0),
    cm = mdSubOpt("comms", D),
    cap = cm.cap;
  const issues = [];
  if (mass > lv.cap)
    issues.push({
      k: "mass",
      t: Tf(
        `Kütle {0} t, fırlatma aracının kapasitesi {1} t. Daha güçlü bir roket seç ya da kütleyi azalt.`,
        [fmtN(mass), lv.cap],
      ),
    });
  if (puse > pgen)
    issues.push({
      k: "power",
      t: Tf(`Güç tüketimi {0} kW, üretim {1} kW. Güç sistemini büyüt ya da alet çıkar.`, [
        fmtN(puse),
        fmtN(pgen),
      ]),
    });
  if (cost > dif.budget)
    issues.push({
      k: "budget",
      t: Tf(`Maliyet {0} M$, bütçe {1} M$. Daha ucuz bileşenler seç.`, [Math.round(cost), dif.budget]),
    });
  const warns = [];
  if (data > cap)
    warns.push({
      k: "data",
      t: Tf(
        `Aletler günde {0} MB veri üretiyor, anten {1} MB gönderebiliyor. Bilimin yaklaşık %{2}'i kaybolacak.`,
        [data, cap, Math.round((1 - cap / data) * 100)],
      ),
    });
  if (!ins.length) warns.push({ k: "ins", t: T("Hiç bilim aleti yok: görev bilim değeri düşük olur.") });
  if (pgen - puse < 1 && mdSubOpt("power", D).id !== "rtg")
    warns.push({ k: "pmargin", t: T("Güç payı çok az: fırtınada güneş panelleri yetersiz kalabilir.") });
  return {
    lv,
    trj,
    dif,
    life,
    ins,
    mass,
    cost,
    pgen,
    puse,
    data,
    cap,
    issues,
    warns,
    valid: D.diff === "sandbox" ? true : !issues.length,
  };
}
/* tasarımın oyuna etkileri */
function mdFx(D) {
  const c = mdCalc(D),
    ls = mdSubOpt("life", D),
    st = mdSubOpt("struct", D),
    cm = mdSubOpt("comms", D),
    av = mdSubOpt("avionics", D),
    pw = mdSubOpt("power", D),
    bt = mdSubOpt("battery", D);
  const has = (id) => D.ins.includes(id);
  const sci = {};
  const add = (o) => {
    for (const k in o) sci[k] = (sci[k] || 1) * o[k];
  };
  add(mdFind(MD_OBJ, D.obj).sci);
  c.ins.forEach((i) => i.sci && add(i.sci));
  return {
    tankMax: ls.tank,
    regen: ls.regen,
    solar: pw.id !== "rtg",
    stormRegen: pw.id === "rtg" ? 1 : bt.id === "b2" ? 0.6 : 0.2,
    armor0: st.armor,
    replyMul: cm.reply,
    relay: cm.relay,
    commsCap: cm.cap,
    dataGen: c.data,
    dataFactor: Math.min(1, cm.cap / c.data),
    sci,
    sciAll: has("cam") ? 1.15 : 1,
    scanMul: av.scan * (has("gpr") ? 1.8 : 1),
    growMul: has("green") ? 1.5 : 1,
    stormWarn: has("met") ? 30 : 0,
    radWarn: has("rad") ? 30 : 0,
    lifetime: +D.life,
    days: mdFind(MD_TRJ, D.trj).days,
    eco: D.trj === "eco",
  };
}
const FX0 = {
  tankMax: 400,
  regen: 1,
  solar: false,
  stormRegen: 1,
  armor0: 0,
  replyMul: 1,
  relay: false,
  commsCap: 120,
  dataGen: 80,
  dataFactor: 1,
  sci: {},
  sciAll: 1,
  scanMul: 1,
  growMul: 1,
  stormWarn: 0,
  radWarn: 0,
  lifetime: 0,
  days: 214,
  eco: false,
};
function desFx() {
  return (game && game.design && game.design.fx) || FX0;
}
function applyDesign(g) {
  if (!PENDING_DESIGN) return;
  const D = PENDING_DESIGN,
    fx = mdFx(D),
    c = mdCalc(D);
  g.design = {
    D: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(D)),
    fx,
    calc: {
      mass: c.mass,
      cap: c.lv.cap,
      cost: c.cost,
      budget: c.dif.budget,
      pgen: c.pgen,
      puse: c.puse,
      data: c.data,
    },
    sim: D.sims.length ? D.sims[D.sims.length - 1] : null,
  };
  g.o2Tank = fx.tankMax;
  if (PENDING_NAME) g.name = PENDING_NAME;
  if (g.rk) g.rk.armor = Math.max(g.rk.armor || 0, fx.armor0);
  const lifeExtra = { 15: 0, 25: 1, 40: 2 }[fx.lifetime] || 0;
  g.stock.water += lifeExtra * 4;
  g.stock.potato += lifeExtra * 3;
  g.stock.medkit += lifeExtra;
  if (fx.eco) {
    g.stock.water = Math.max(2, g.stock.water - 3);
    g.stock.potato = Math.max(2, g.stock.potato - 2);
    g.o2Tank = Math.round(fx.tankMax * 0.7);
  }
}
/* bilim çarpanı (rapor yanıtında) */
function desSciMul(types) {
  const fx = desFx();
  let m = 0,
    n = 0;
  for (const t in types) {
    const k = types[t].length;
    m += (fx.sci[t] || 1) * k;
    n += k;
  }
  return (n ? m / n : 1) * fx.sciAll * fx.dataFactor;
}
/* ---------- simülasyon: 200 görev ---------- */
function mdSimulate(D) {
  const c = mdCalc(D),
    fx = mdFx(D),
    N = 200;
  let ok = 0,
    sciSum = 0;
  const fails = { launch: 0, engine: 0, o2: 0, supply: 0 };
  const R = rng(Date.now() % 100000);
  const brk = [0.6, 0.35, 0.15, 0][fx.armor0];
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    if (R() > c.lv.rel) {
      fails.launch++;
      continue;
    }
    let alive = true,
      engineOk = true;
    const storms = Math.floor((fx.lifetime - 2) / 5) + 1;
    for (let s = 0; s < storms; s++) {
      if (R() < brk * (s === 0 ? 1 : 0.6)) {
        if (R() < 0.05 + (fx.armor0 ? 0 : 0.04)) {
          engineOk = false;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    if (!engineOk) {
      fails.engine++;
      alive = false;
    }
    const o2Risk = Math.max(
      0,
      0.09 -
        (fx.tankMax - 400) / 2000 -
        (fx.regen - 1) * 0.06 +
        (fx.eco ? 0.05 : 0) +
        (fx.solar ? (1 - fx.stormRegen) * 0.05 : 0),
    );
    if (alive && R() < o2Risk) {
      fails.o2++;
      alive = false;
    }
    const supRisk = Math.max(
      0,
      0.07 -
        ({ 15: 0, 25: 0.04, 40: 0.07 }[fx.lifetime] || 0) +
        (fx.eco ? 0.05 : 0) -
        (fx.growMul > 1 ? 0.04 : 0),
    );
    if (alive && R() < supRisk) {
      fails.supply++;
      alive = false;
    }
    if (alive) ok++;
    const sci = (60 + c.ins.length * 18) * fx.sciAll * fx.dataFactor * (alive ? 1 : 0.35) * (0.8 + R() * 0.4);
    sciSum += sci;
  }
  return {
    t: Date.now(),
    p: Math.round((ok / N) * 100),
    sci: Math.round(sciSum / N),
    fails,
    cost: Math.round(c.cost),
    mass: +c.mass.toFixed(1),
  };
}
function mdSimExplain(s) {
  const L = [];
  if (s.fails.launch)
    L.push(
      Tf(`{0} simülasyonda fırlatma başarısız oldu: fırlatma aracının güvenilirliği bunu belirler.`, [
        s.fails.launch,
      ]),
    );
  if (s.fails.engine)
    L.push(
      Tf(`{0} simülasyonda fırtına motoru onarılamaz şekilde bozdu: gövde zırhı bu riski düşürür.`, [
        s.fails.engine,
      ]),
    );
  if (s.fails.o2)
    L.push(Tf(`{0} simülasyonda oksijen yetmedi: yaşam desteği ve güç sistemi bunu etkiler.`, [s.fails.o2]));
  if (s.fails.supply)
    L.push(
      Tf(`{0} simülasyonda erzak bitti: görev süresi, transfer yörüngesi ve sera modülü bunu etkiler.`, [
        s.fails.supply,
      ]),
    );
  if (!L.length) L.push(T("Simülasyonların hiçbirinde ciddi bir arıza görülmedi."));
  return L;
}
/* ---------- tasarım kodu ve kayıt ---------- */
function mdCode(D) {
  const o = {
    o: D.obj,
    d: D.diff,
    l: D.life,
    v: D.lv,
    t: D.trj,
    p: D.power,
    b: D.battery,
    s: D.life_s,
    x: D.struct,
    c: D.comms,
    a: D.avionics,
    i: D.ins,
  };
  try {
    return "ARES-" + btoa(JSON.stringify(o)).replace(/=+$/, "");
  } catch (e) {
    return "";
  }
}
function mdFromCode(code) {
  try {
    const s = code.trim().replace(/^ARES-/, "");
    const o = JSON.parse(atob(s + "===".slice((s.length + 3) % 4)));
    const D = mdDefault();
    Object.assign(D, {
      obj: o.o,
      diff: o.d,
      life: +o.l,
      lv: o.v,
      trj: o.t,
      power: o.p,
      battery: o.b,
      life_s: o.s,
      struct: o.x,
      comms: o.c,
      avionics: o.a,
      ins: Array.isArray(o.i) ? o.i : [],
    });
    return D;
  } catch (e) {
    return null;
  }
}
function mdSaved() {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(MD_KEY)) || [];
  } catch (e) {
    return [];
  }
}
function mdSave(D) {
  const L = mdSaved();
  L.unshift({ t: Date.now(), code: mdCode(D), p: D.sims.length ? D.sims[D.sims.length - 1].p : null });
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(MD_KEY, JSON.stringify(L.slice(0, 8)));
  } catch (e) {}
}
function lbLoad() {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LB_KEY)) || [];
  } catch (e) {
    return [];
  }
}
function lbAdd(e) {
  const L = lbLoad();
  L.push(e);
  L.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(LB_KEY, JSON.stringify(L.slice(0, 15)));
  } catch (e2) {}
}
/* ---------- arayüz: yeni görev ekranı (standart / özel) ---------- */
const NG = { name: "", diff: "normal", intro: true };
function ngOpen() {
  NG.intro = settings.intro !== false;
  NG.diff = ["easy", "normal", "hard"].includes(settings.diff) ? settings.diff : "normal";
  $("menuScreen").classList.add("hidden");
  const S = $("ngScreen");
  S.classList.remove("hidden", "ng-out");
  ngRender();
  S.classList.remove("ng-in");
  void S.offsetWidth;
  S.classList.add("ng-in");
  clearTimeout(S._t);
  S._t = setTimeout(() => S.classList.remove("ng-in"), 1200);
  setTimeout(() => {
    const n = $("ngName");
    if (n) n.focus();
  }, 60);
}
function ngClose() {
  const S = $("ngScreen");
  if (S.classList.contains("ng-out")) return;
  S.classList.add("ng-out");
  setTimeout(() => {
    S.classList.add("hidden");
    S.classList.remove("ng-out");
    $("menuScreen").classList.remove("hidden");
  }, 260);
}

};
function ngRows(id) {
  const D = DIFF[id] || DIFF.normal;
  const R = [
    [T("Açlık hızı"), "food", 0],
    [T("Susuzluk hızı"), "water", 0],
    [T("Oksijen tüketimi"), "o2", 0],
    [T("Radyasyon hasarı"), "rad", 1],
    [T("Fırtına etkisi"), "storm", 2],
    [T("Meteor hasarı"), "met", 1],
    [T("İyileşme hızı"), "regen", 3],
  ];
  return R.map(([nm, k, t]) => {
    const v = D[k],
      n = Math.round(Math.abs(v - 1) * 100),
      good = t === 3 ? v > 1 : v < 1,
      bad = t === 3 ? v < 1 : v > 1;
    const txt =
      n === 0
        ? T("Standart")
        : t === 0 || t === 3
          ? v > 1
            ? Tf(`%{0} daha hızlı`, [n])
            : Tf(`%{0} daha yavaş`, [n])
          : t === 1
            ? v > 1
              ? Tf(`%{0} daha fazla`, [n])
              : Tf(`%{0} daha az`, [n])
            : v > 1
              ? Tf(`%{0} daha güçlü`, [n])
              : Tf(`%{0} daha zayıf`, [n]);
    return { nm, k, w: Math.round(Math.min(1, v / 1.6) * 100), cls: good ? "good" : bad ? "bad" : "", txt };
  });
}

      <label class="ng-lbl">Zorluk</label>
      <div class="ng-diffs">{1}</div>
      <div class="ng-dbox" data-lv="{2}"><p id="ngDesc">{3}</p>
        <div class="ng-rows">{4}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="ng-tg"><span><b>Açılış hikâyesi</b><small>Görev başlamadan önce ARES-1 sinemasını oynat.</small></span><div class="m2-tg {5}" id="ngIntro" role="switch"></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="ng-right">{6}{7}</div>`,
    [
      escH(NG.name),
      diffs
        .map(
          (d) =>
            `<button class="ng-df ${NG.diff === d.id ? "on" : ""}" data-d="${d.id}" data-lv="${lvl[d.id]}"><span class="ng-pips"><i></i><i></i><i></i></span><b>${d.nm}</b><small>${NG_DIFF_INFO[d.id].tag}</small></button>`,
        )
        .join(""),
      lvl[NG.diff],
      NG_DIFF_INFO[NG.diff].d,
      ngRows(NG.diff)
        .map(
          (r) =>
            `<div class="ng-row" data-k="${r.k}"><span>${r.nm}</span><div class="ng-bar"><i class="${r.cls}" style="width:${r.w}%"></i><u></u></div><em class="${r.cls}">${r.txt}</em></div>`,
        )
        .join(""),
      NG.intro ? "on" : "",
      prev,
      best
        ? `<div class="ng-best"><span>En iyi puan</span><b>${best.score}</b><em>${best.grade}</em></div>`
        : "",
    ],
  );
  const B = $("ngBody");
  $("ngName").oninput = (e) => {
    NG.name = e.target.value;
  };
  B.querySelectorAll("[data-d]").forEach(
    (b) =>
      (b.onclick = () => {
        if (NG.diff === b.dataset.d) return;
        NG.diff = b.dataset.d;
        sfx("click");
        ngDiffUpdate();
      }),
  );
  $("ngIntro").onclick = () => {
    NG.intro = !NG.intro;
    sfx("click");
    $("ngIntro").classList.toggle("on", NG.intro);
  };
}
function ngDiffUpdate() {
  const B = $("ngBody"),
    lvl = { easy: 1, normal: 2, hard: 3 }[NG.diff];
  B.querySelectorAll("[data-d]").forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle("on", b.dataset.d === NG.diff));
  const box = B.querySelector(".ng-dbox");
  box.dataset.lv = lvl;
  const ds = $("ngDesc");
  ds.classList.remove("ng-fade");
  void ds.offsetWidth;
  ds.textContent = NG_DIFF_INFO[NG.diff].d;
  ds.classList.add("ng-fade");
  ngRows(NG.diff).forEach((r) => {
    const row = B.querySelector(`.ng-row[data-k="${r.k}"]`);
    const bar = row.querySelector("i"),
      em = row.querySelector("em");
    bar.style.width = r.w + "%";
    bar.className = r.cls;
    em.className = r.cls;
    em.textContent = r.txt;
    em.classList.remove("ng-pop");
    void em.offsetWidth;
    em.classList.add("ng-pop");
  });
}
function ngGo() {
  settings.intro = NG.intro;
  if (NG.diff !== "sandbox") settings.diff = NG.diff;
  saveSettings();
  PENDING_NAME = NG.name.trim();
  const S = $("ngScreen");
  if (S.classList.contains("ng-out")) return;
  S.classList.add("ng-out", "ng-launch");
  setTimeout(() => {
    S.classList.remove("ng-out", "ng-launch");
    MD = mdDefault();
    MD.diff = "normal";
    MD.sims.push(mdSimulate(MD));
    S.classList.add("hidden");
    mdLaunch();
  }, 420);
}
function mdLaunch() {
  const c = mdCalc(MD);
  if (!c.valid) return;
  mdSave(MD);
  PENDING_DESIGN = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(MD));
  $("ngScreen").classList.add("hidden");
  sfx("click");
  ensureAudio();
  if (settings.intro === false) startNewGame();
  else startIntro();
}
/* ---------- görev sonu: puan, rapor ve analiz ---------- */
function missionScore() {
  const g = game,
    C = commState(),
    des = g.design,
    fx = desFx();
  const sol = gameDayNumber(),
    log = C.log || [];
  const breaks = log.filter((o) => o.type === "engine_fail").length,
    crit = log.filter((o) => o.type === "life").length;
  const success = 300 + Math.round((Math.min(g.quest, QUESTS.length) / QUESTS.length) * 120);
  const science = Math.min(300, Math.round((C.sci || 0) * 1.2));
  let eff = 0,
    time = 0;
  const why = [];
  if (des) {
    const bm = isFinite(des.calc.budget) ? Math.max(0, 1 - des.calc.cost / des.calc.budget) : 0,
      mm = Math.max(0, 1 - des.calc.mass / des.calc.cap);
    eff = Math.round(bm * 120 + mm * 80);
    time = fx.lifetime ? (sol <= fx.lifetime ? 100 : Math.max(0, 100 - (sol - fx.lifetime) * 10)) : 50;
    if (fx.dataFactor < 1)
      why.push(
        Tf(`Aletlerin ürettiği veri anten kapasitesini aştı; bilimin %{0}'i Dünya'ya ulaşamadı.`, [
          Math.round((1 - fx.dataFactor) * 100),
        ]),
      );
    if (fx.lifetime && sol > fx.lifetime)
      why.push(
        Tf(`Görev planlanan {0} solu {1} sol aştı: erzak ve bütçe zorlandı.`, [
          fx.lifetime,
          sol - fx.lifetime,
        ]),
      );
  }
  if (crit > 0)
    why.push(
      Tf(`{0} kez kritik yaşam değeri kaydedildi: oksijen, su veya yiyecek tükenmeye yaklaştı.`, [crit]),
    );
  if ((C.sci || 0) < SCI_GOAL * 0.5)
    why.push(
      T(
        "Bilim hedefinin yarısına ulaşılmadı: daha çok rapor göndermek ve hedefe uygun gözlem yapmak puanı artırır.",
      ),
    );
  const total = success + science + eff + time;
  const grade = total >= 800 ? "S" : total >= 660 ? "A" : total >= 520 ? "B" : total >= 380 ? "C" : "D";
  return {
    parts: [
      [T("Görev başarısı"), success],
      [T("Bilim değeri"), science],
      [T("Kaynak verimliliği"), eff],
      [T("Zaman yönetimi"), time],
    ],
    total,
    grade,
    why,
  };
}

function startNewGame() {
  game = newGameState();
  currentSaveId = null;
  storyReset();
  p.x = game.px;
  p.y = game.py;
  enterPlanet(START_PLANET, true);
  resetStormFx();
  startWake();
  $("wkSkip").innerHTML = T("Atla") + " <kbd>Space</kbd>";
}

function fmtSet(r, v) {

function renderSettings() {
  $("setTabs").innerHTML = SET_TABS.map(
    ([k, ic, n]) =>
      `<button class="${k === setTab ? "on" : ""}" data-k="${k}"><i>${ic}</i><span>${n}</span></button>`,
  ).join("");
  $("setTabs")
    .querySelectorAll("button")
    .forEach(
      (b) =>
        (b.onclick = () => {
          setTab = b.dataset.k;
          sfx("click");
          renderSettings();
        }),
    );
  const B = $("setBody");
  let h = "";
  for (const r of setRows(setTab)) {
    if (r.sec) {
      h += `<div class="m2-sec">${r.sec}</div>`;
      continue;
    }
    if (r.lang) {
      h += `<div class="m2-langs">${LANGS.map(([c, f, n, sub]) => `<button class="m2-lang ${settings.lang === c ? "on" : ""}" data-lang="${c}"><span class="fl">${f}</span><span><b>${n}</b><small>${c === settings.lang ? T("Etkin") : sub}</small></span></button>`).join("")}</div>`;
      continue;
    }
    if (r.keys) {
      h +=
        Tf(`<div class="m2-sec">Klavye</div><div class="m2-keys">`, []) +
        [
          [T("Hareket"), "W A S D"],
          [T("Koş"), "Shift"],
          [T("Etkileşim / rokete gir"), "E"],
          [T("Topla · ek · sula · hasat"), "F"],
          [T("Medikit kullan"), "G"],
          [T("Seramik kalkanı aç / kapat"), "Q"],
          [T("Boş parseldeki kalkanı sök"), "Shift + Q"],
          [T("Rehber kitap"), "R"],
          [T("Çapayla kaz"), T("Sol tık")],
          [T("Eşyayı eline al"), "1 – 7"],
          [T("Merdiven"), "W / S"],
          [T("Duraklat"), "Esc"],
          [T("Hikâyeyi geç"), T("Space (basılı)")],
          [T("Harita"), T("sağ üst")],
        ]
          .map(([a, k]) => `<div><span>${a}</span><kbd>${k}</kbd></div>`)
          .join("") +
        Tf(
          `</div>
      <div class="m2-sec">Dokunmatik</div><div class="m2-keys"><div><span>Hareket</span><kbd>sol joystick</kbd></div><div><span>Eylemler</span><kbd>sağ düğmeler</kbd></div></div>`,
          [],
        );
      continue;
    }
    const v = settings[r.k];
    let ctl = "";
    if (r.t === "rg")
      ctl = `<input type="range" class="m2-range" data-k="${r.k}" min="${r.min}" max="${r.max}" value="${v}" style="--v:${((v - r.min) / (r.max - r.min)) * 100}%"><output>${fmtSet(r, v)}</output>`;
    if (r.t === "tg") ctl = `<div class="m2-tg ${v ? "on" : ""}" data-k="${r.k}" role="switch"></div>`;
    if (r.t === "seg")
      ctl = `<div class="m2-seg">${r.o.map(([ov, ol]) => `<button class="${String(v) === String(ov) ? "on" : ""}" data-k="${r.k}" data-v="${ov}">${ol}</button>`).join("")}</div>`;
    h += `<div class="m2-it"><div><b>${r.l}</b>${r.d ? `<small>${r.d}</small>` : ""}</div><div class="m2-ctl">${ctl}</div></div>`;
  }
  B.innerHTML = h;
  B.querySelectorAll(".m2-range").forEach(
    (el) =>
      (el.oninput = () => {
        const k = el.dataset.k,
          v = +el.value,
          r = setRows(setTab).find((x) => x.k === k);
        settings[k] = v;
        el.style.setProperty("--v", ((v - r.min) / (r.max - r.min)) * 100 + "%");
        el.nextElementSibling.textContent = fmtSet(r, v);
        applySettings(k);
      }),
  );
  B.querySelectorAll(".m2-tg").forEach(
    (el) =>
      (el.onclick = () => {
        const k = el.dataset.k;
        settings[k] = !settings[k];
        el.classList.toggle("on", settings[k]);
        sfx("click");
        applySettings(k);
      }),
  );
  B.querySelectorAll(".m2-seg button").forEach(
    (el) =>
      (el.onclick = () => {
        const k = el.dataset.k,
          raw = el.dataset.v,
          v = isNaN(+raw) ? raw : +raw;
        settings[k] = v;
        el.parentNode.querySelectorAll("button").forEach((x) => x.classList.toggle("on", x === el));
        sfx("click");
        applySettings(k);
      }),
  );
  B.querySelectorAll(".m2-lang").forEach(
    (el) =>
      (el.onclick = () => {
        const c = el.dataset.lang;
        if (c === settings.lang) return;
        sfx("click");
        askLang(c);
      }),
  );
}

      sessionStorage.setItem("uzay_resume", currentSaveId);

  location.reload();
};

let _autoT = 0;
function autoSaveTick(dt) {
  if (!game || mode !== "play" || !settings.autosave) return;
  _autoT += dt;

/* Dokunmatik joystick */
const pad = $("pad"),
  knob = $("knob");
function joyMove(e) {
  const r = pad.getBoundingClientRect(),
    t = e.touches[0];
  let dx = (t.clientX - r.left - 65) / 45,
    dy = (t.clientY - r.top - 65) / 45;
  const l = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  if (l > 1) {
    dx /= l;
    dy /= l;
  }
  joy = { x: dx, y: dy };
  knob.style.left = 45 + dx * 45 + "px";
  knob.style.top = 45 + dy * 45 + "px";
  e.preventDefault();
}
function joyEnd() {
  joy = { x: 0, y: 0 };
  knob.style.left = "45px";
  knob.style.top = "45px";
}
pad.addEventListener("touchstart", joyMove, { passive: false });
pad.addEventListener("touchmove", joyMove, { passive: false });
pad.addEventListener("touchend", joyEnd);

$("fBtn").onclick = pressF;
$("gBtn").onclick = pressG;
$("qBtn").onclick = () => pressQ(false);

}

/* ============== ANA MENÜ ARKA PLANI ============== */
/* --- Mars menü arka planı: kızıl yüzey, ince atmosfer, Phobos --- */
let _mars = null;
function _mkMars() {
  const per = 6,
    w = 384,
    h = 192,
    H1 = (x, y) => {
      const n = Math.sin(x * 127.1 + y * 311.7) * 43758.5453;
      return n - Math.floor(n);
    };
  const vn = (x, y, p) => {
    const xi = Math.floor(x),
      yi = Math.floor(y),
      u = x - xi,
      v = y - yi,
      s = (a) => a * a * (3 - 2 * a),
      m = (a) => ((a % p) + p) % p;
    const a = H1(m(xi), yi),
      b = H1(m(xi + 1), yi),
      c = H1(m(xi), yi + 1),
      d = H1(m(xi + 1), yi + 1),
      su = s(u),
      sv = s(v);
    return (a + (b - a) * su) * (1 - sv) + (c + (d - c) * su) * sv;
  };
  const fbm = (x, y, p) => {
    let s = 0,
      a = 0.5,
      f = 1;
    for (let o = 0; o < 5; o++) {
      s += a * vn(x * f, y * f, p * f);
      a *= 0.5;
      f *= 2;
    }
    return s;
  };
  const mk = () => {
    const c = document.createElement("canvas");
    c.width = w * 2;
    c.height = h;
    return c;
  };
  const land = mk(),
    cl = mk(),
    L = land.getContext("2d"),
    C = cl.getContext("2d"),
    li = L.createImageData(w, h),
    ci = C.createImageData(w, h);
  for (let y = 0; y < h; y++)
    for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
      const nx = (x / w) * per,
        ny = (y / h) * 3,
        i = (y * w + x) * 4,
        lat = Math.abs(y / h - 0.5) * 2;
      const n = fbm(nx, ny, per),
        m = fbm(nx + 7, ny + 3, per),
        d = fbm(nx * 2 + 3, ny * 2, 12),
        t = Math.min(1, n * 0.7 + d * 0.45);
      let r = 150 + t * 74,
        g = 66 + t * 86,
        b = 40 + t * 58;
      const k = Math.max(0, Math.min(0.85, (m - 0.56) * 4));
      r += (74 - r) * k;
      g += (34 - g) * k;
      b += (28 - b) * k;
      if (lat > 0.9) {
        r = g = b = 236;
      }
      li.data[i] = r;
      li.data[i + 1] = g;
      li.data[i + 2] = b;
      li.data[i + 3] = 255;
      const cv = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (fbm((nx * 4) / 3 + 20, ny * 1.4, 8) - 0.52) * 2.6));
      ci.data[i] = 255;
      ci.data[i + 1] = 228;
      ci.data[i + 2] = 205;
      ci.data[i + 3] = cv * 85;
    }
  L.putImageData(li, 0, 0);
  L.putImageData(li, w, 0);
  C.putImageData(ci, 0, 0);
  C.putImageData(ci, w, 0);
  return { land, cl, w, h };
}
function drawMenuBgOld() {
  const c = mctx,
    PI = Math.PI;
  c.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  c.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
  c.fillStyle = "#05030a";
  c.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  const t = performance.now() / 1000;
  c.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
  for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
    const f = i / 17,
      x = W * f,
      y = H * (0.78 - 0.68 * f) + Math.sin(i * 1.7) * H * 0.04,
      r = H * (0.17 + 0.06 * Math.sin(i * 2.3));
    const g = c.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r);
    g.addColorStop(0, i % 3 ? "rgba(235,185,160,.07)" : "rgba(255,170,120,.055)");
    g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    c.fillStyle = g;
    c.fillRect(x - r, y - r, r * 2, r * 2);
  }
  c.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
  for (const s of stars) {
    const x = (s.x * W + t * (1.5 + s.h * 4)) % W,
      y = s.y * H,
      tw = 0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(t * 1.6 + s.h * 40),
      sz = 0.6 + s.h * s.h * 2.2,
      a = (0.3 + s.h * 0.7) * tw;
    c.fillStyle =
      s.h > 0.86
        ? "rgba(190,210,255," + a + ")"
        : s.h < 0.14
          ? "rgba(255,200,150," + a + ")"
          : "rgba(255,255,255," + a + ")";
    c.fillRect(x, y, sz, sz);
    if (s.h > 0.95) {
      c.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,225,200," + a * 0.4 + ")";
      c.lineWidth = 0.8;
      c.beginPath();
      c.moveTo(x - 6, y);
      c.lineTo(x + 7, y);
      c.moveTo(x, y - 6);
      c.lineTo(x, y + 7);
      c.stroke();
    }
  }
  /* Mars */
  if (!_mars) _mars = _mkMars();
  const R = Math.max(W, H) * 0.5,
    cx = W * 0.76,
    cy = H + R * 0.3,
    E = _mars,
    N = 130,
    cw = (2 * R) / N,
    off = (t * 2.5) % E.w,
    off2 = (t * 4) % E.w;
  c.save();
  c.beginPath();
  c.arc(cx, cy, R, 0, 7);
  c.clip();
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    const l0 = Math.asin(-1 + (2 * i) / N),
      l1 = Math.asin(Math.min(1, -1 + (2 * (i + 1)) / N)),
      dx = cx - R + i * cw;
    c.drawImage(
      E.land,
      off + (l0 / (2 * PI) + 0.5) * E.w,
      E.h * 0.18,
      Math.max(0.4, ((l1 - l0) / (2 * PI)) * E.w),
      E.h * 0.64,
      dx,
      cy - R,
      cw + 0.6,
      R * 2,
    );
    c.drawImage(
      E.cl,
      off2 + (l0 / (2 * PI) + 0.5) * E.w,
      E.h * 0.18,
      Math.max(0.4, ((l1 - l0) / (2 * PI)) * E.w),
      E.h * 0.64,
      dx,
      cy - R,
      cw + 0.6,
      R * 2,
    );
  }
  let g = c.createRadialGradient(cx - R * 0.55, cy - R * 0.75, R * 0.2, cx, cy, R * 1.25);
  g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(10,2,2,0)");
  g.addColorStop(0.55, "rgba(10,2,2,.3)");
  g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(6,1,2,.95)");
  c.fillStyle = g;
  c.fillRect(cx - R, cy - R, R * 2, R * 2);
  g = c.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, R * 0.88, cx, cy, R);
  g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,150,100,0)");
  g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,170,120,.5)");
  c.fillStyle = g;
  c.fillRect(cx - R, cy - R, R * 2, R * 2);
  c.restore();
  g = c.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, R * 0.99, cx, cy, R * 1.06);
  g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,175,125,.6)");
  g.addColorStop(0.45, "rgba(200,160,200,.25)");
  g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(120,160,255,0)");
  c.fillStyle = g;
  c.beginPath();
  c.arc(cx, cy, R * 1.06, 0, 7);
  c.fill();
  c.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
  const fx = cx - R * 0.62,
    fy = cy - R * 0.78,
    fr = R * (0.28 + 0.02 * Math.sin(t * 0.7));
  g = c.createRadialGradient(fx, fy, 0, fx, fy, fr);
  g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,235,200,.75)");
  g.addColorStop(0.3, "rgba(255,170,100,.28)");
  g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,120,60,0)");
  c.fillStyle = g;
  c.fillRect(fx - fr, fy - fr, fr * 2, fr * 2);
  c.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
  /* toz sisi */
  g = c.createLinearGradient(0, H * 0.65, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(150,60,30,0)");
  g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(150,60,30,.22)");
  c.fillStyle = g;
  c.fillRect(0, H * 0.65, W, H * 0.35);
  /* Phobos */
  const k = (t % 70) / 70,
    mx = W * (1.05 - 1.1 * k),
    my = H * 0.22 - Math.sin(k * PI) * H * 0.06,
    mr = Math.min(W, H) * 0.024;
  c.save();
  c.translate(mx, my);
  c.rotate(t * 0.05);
  g = c.createRadialGradient(-mr * 0.4, -mr * 0.4, mr * 0.2, 0, 0, mr * 1.3);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#b8a89a");
  g.addColorStop(1, "#3e342f");
  c.fillStyle = g;
  c.beginPath();
  c.ellipse(0, 0, mr * 1.3, mr, 0, 0, 7);
  c.fill();
  c.fillStyle = "rgba(50,40,36,.55)";
  for (const [qx, qy, qr] of [
    [0.3, -0.2, 0.3],
    [-0.5, 0.25, 0.22],
    [0.6, 0.35, 0.16],
  ]) {
    c.beginPath();
    c.arc(qx * mr, qy * mr, qr * mr, 0, 7);
    c.fill();
  }
  c.restore();
  const st = (t + 3) % 9;
  if (st < 0.6) {
    const q = st / 0.6,
      x0 = W * 0.08,
      y0 = H * 0.05,
      x1 = W * 0.55,
      y1 = H * 0.34,
      px = x0 + (x1 - x0) * q,
      py = y0 + (y1 - y0) * q,
      g2 = c.createLinearGradient(px - (x1 - x0) * 0.28, py - (y1 - y0) * 0.28, px, py);
    g2.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
    g2.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255," + (1 - q) + ")");
    c.strokeStyle = g2;
    c.lineWidth = 2;
    c.lineCap = "round";
    c.beginPath();
    c.moveTo(px - (x1 - x0) * 0.28, py - (y1 - y0) * 0.28);
    c.lineTo(px, py);
    c.stroke();
  }
}

  ],
};
function questStepsHTML(q) {
  const L = QSTEPS[q.k];
  if (!L) return "";
  let cur = 0;
  for (let j = L.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
    let ok = false;
    try {
      ok = !!L[j][1]();
    } catch (e) {}
    if (ok) {
      cur = j + 1;
      break;
    }
  }
  return (
    '<div class="qs-l">' +
    L.map((s, j) => {
      const t = typeof s[0] === "function" ? s[0]() : s[0];
      return (
        '<div class="qs ' +
        (j < cur ? "ok" : j === cur ? "cur" : "") +
        '"><i>' +
        (j < cur ? "✓" : j + 1) +
        "</i><span>" +
        t +
        "</span></div>"
      );
    }).join("") +
    "</div>"
  );
}
let _qsLast = "";
function refreshQuestSteps(force) {
  if (!game || game.quest >= QUESTS.length) return;
  const h = questStepsHTML(QUESTS[game.quest]);
  if (!h || (!force && h === _qsLast)) return;
  _qsLast = h;
  $("qHow").innerHTML = h;
}

/* ---------- UYKU KAPSÜLÜ (yaşam güvertesi) ----------
   Yatay kapsül: kaide + beyaz kabuk + dolgulu iç yatak + menteşeli cam kapak.
   Kapak uyurken kapanır, uyanınca açılır; cam, içindeki astronotun üstüne çizilir. */
const POD = { x0: -168, x1: -92, o: 1 };
function podOpenTarget() {
  if (game.wake) {
    const T = game.wake.t;
    return T < 2.0 ? 0 : Math.min(1, (T - 2.0) / 0.6);
  }
  return game.sleeping ? 0 : 1;
}
function drawPodBase(t) {
  const F = DECKS[1].floor,
    C = DECKS[1].ceil,
    x0 = POD.x0,
    x1 = POD.x1,
    cx = (x0 + x1) / 2,
    L = x1 - x0;
  const tgt = podOpenTarget();
  if (game.wake) POD.o = tgt;
  else POD.o += (tgt - POD.o) * 0.08;
  // nişin arka duvarı + dolap + fotoğraf + lamba (eski ranzanın yerine)
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2a2f47";
  rrp(x0 - 2, C + 22, L + 4, F - C - 24, 4);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#4e5578";
  rrp(x0 + 2, C + 26, 22, 32, 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#20243a";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd34d";
  ctx.fillRect(x0 + 19, C + 40, 2, 5);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
  rrp(x0 + 30, C + 28, 18, 14, 1);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#5ab0f0";
  ctx.fillRect(x0 + 32, C + 30, 14, 10);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2f7d4f";
  ctx.fillRect(x0 + 32, C + 36, 14, 4);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#9aa3bf";
  rrp(x1 - 16, C + 30, 12, 5, 2);
  ctx.fill();
  const lamp = ctx.createRadialGradient(x1 - 10, C + 36, 1, x1 - 10, C + 36, 26);
  lamp.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,230,170,.4)");
  lamp.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,230,170,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = lamp;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x1 - 10, C + 36, 26, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  // kaide: ayaklar + LED şerit
  ctx.fillStyle = "#3b4160";
  rrp(x0 + 6, F - 14, L - 12, 12, 3);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#262b40";
  for (const lx of [x0 + 10, x1 - 18]) (rrp(lx, F - 4, 8, 4, 1), ctx.fill());
  const led = game.sleeping ? "rgba(90,160,255," : "rgba(90,220,255,",
    pl = 0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(t * (game.sleeping ? 1.4 : 3));
  ctx.fillStyle = led + (0.5 + 0.5 * pl) + ")";
  ctx.shadowColor = "#5ad1ff";
  ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
  rrp(x0 + 12, F - 9, L - 24, 2, 1);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  // alt kabuk (küvet)
  const sg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, F - 34, 0, F - 14);
  sg.addColorStop(0, "#f4f6fb");
  sg.addColorStop(0.6, "#c9cfe0");
  sg.addColorStop(1, "#8f97b2");
  ctx.fillStyle = sg;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x0 + 4, F - 30);
  ctx.lineTo(x1 - 4, F - 30);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x1 + 2, F - 30, x1, F - 22);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x1 - 2, F - 14, x1 - 12, F - 14);
  ctx.lineTo(x0 + 12, F - 14);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x0 + 2, F - 14, x0, F - 22);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x0 - 2, F - 30, x0 + 4, F - 30);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#5f6886";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.7)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x0 + 6, F - 29);
  ctx.lineTo(x1 - 6, F - 29);
  ctx.stroke();
  // turuncu şerit + yan ekran (nabız/uyku dalgası)
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff8c42";
  ctx.fillRect(x0 + 8, F - 21, L - 16, 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1424";
  rrp(cx - 9, F - 27, 18, 9, 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#5ad1ff";
  ctx.lineWidth = 0.9;
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let i = 0; i <= 16; i++) {
    const xx = cx - 8 + i,
      ph = (i / 16) * 6.283 + t * (game.sleeping ? 1.5 : 4);
    const v = game.sleeping ? Math.sin(ph) * 1.6 : (i % 8 === 4 ? -2.6 : 0) * Math.max(0, Math.sin(t * 6));
    i ? ctx.lineTo(xx, F - 22.5 + v) : ctx.moveTo(xx, F - 22.5 + v);
  }
  ctx.stroke();
  // iç yatak: dolgulu minder + yastık (kapak açıkken görünür)
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2b3f73";
  rrp(x0 + 5, F - 34, L - 10, 7, 3);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.12)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let i = 1; i < 6; i++) {
    const xx = x0 + 5 + ((L - 10) * i) / 6;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(xx, F - 33);
    ctx.lineTo(xx, F - 28);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = "#e9edf7";
  rrp(x0 + 5, F - 37, 16, 7, 3);
  ctx.fill();
  // iç ışık: uyurken yumuşak mavi
  if (POD.o < 0.98 || game.sleeping) {
    const a = (1 - POD.o) * 0.35 + (game.sleeping ? 0.15 : 0);
    const ig = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, F - 36, 3, cx, F - 36, 44);
    ig.addColorStop(0, "rgba(110,170,255," + a + ")");
    ig.addColorStop(1, "rgba(110,170,255,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = ig;
    ctx.fillRect(x0, F - 60, L, 40);
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = "#d9dcea";
  ctx.font = "700 7px monospace";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillText(T("UYKU KAPSÜLÜ"), cx, C + 16);
  if (game.sleeping && !game.wake) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.8)";
    ctx.font = "700 10px sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("z  z  Z", cx + 10 + Math.sin(t * 2) * 3, F - 62 - ((t * 8) % 12));
  }
}
/* cam kapak: arka uçtan menteşeli, açılınca yukarı kalkar (astronotun üstüne çizilir) */
function drawPodCanopy(t) {
  const F = DECKS[1].floor,
    x0 = POD.x0,
    x1 = POD.x1,
    L = x1 - x0,
    o = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, POD.o));
  const hx = x0 + 3,
    hy = F - 30;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(hx, hy);
  ctx.rotate(-o * 1.05);
  const path = () => {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(1, 0);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(2, -22, L - 12, -24, L - 6, 0);
    ctx.closePath();
  };
  const gg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -22, 0, 0);
  gg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(190,235,255,.30)");
  gg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(120,190,240,.12)");
  ctx.fillStyle = gg;
  path();
  ctx.fill();
  if (game.sleeping || o < 0.3) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(220,240,255," + 0.1 * (1 - o) + ")";
    for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
      const fx = 8 + ((i * 23) % (L - 20)),
        fy = -4 - ((i * 7) % 14);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(fx, fy, 1.4 + (i % 3), 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  } // buğu
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(230,245,255,.85)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
  path();
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.75)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(10, -12);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(L * 0.35, -20, L * 0.55, -17);
  ctx.stroke(); // yansıma
  ctx.fillStyle = "#c9cfe0";
  rrp(-2, -3, L - 2, 4, 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#5f6886";
  ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
  ctx.stroke(); // kapak çerçevesi
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#7f879f";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(hx, hy, 2.2, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill(); // menteşe
}

/* ============== UYANIŞ SAHNESİ ==============
   Yeni oyun roketin uyku kabininde başlar: alarm çalar, kapak açılır, astronot doğrulup
   yataktan zıplar; tam o an "MARS'A ULAŞILDI" kartı belirir. ~7 sn, Space/Esc ile atlanır. */
const WAKE_LEN = 8.2;
let WK_CARD0 = null;
function startWake(kind) {
  const faint = kind === "faint";
  enterRocket();
  clearTimeout(toast._h);
  $("toast").style.opacity = 0;
  ip.deck = 1;
  ip.x = -62;
  ip.y = DECKS[1].floor;
  ip.dir = 1;
  game.wake = { t: 0, cues: {}, faint };
  const card = $("wkCard");
  if (WK_CARD0 == null) WK_CARD0 = card.innerHTML;
  card.innerHTML = faint
    ? '<div class="wk-k">SOL ' +
      gameDayNumber() +
      ' · ARES-1</div><div class="wk-t">' +
      T("KENDİNE GELDİN") +
      '</div><div class="wk-ln"></div>' +
      '<div class="wk-s">' +
      T("UYKU KAPSÜLÜ · YAŞAM GÜVERTESİ") +
      "</div>" +
      '<div class="wk-r"><b>' +
      T("GÖREV KONTROL · TELSİZ") +
      "</b>" +
      T(
        "ARES-1, yaşam değerlerin kritik seviyeye düştü. Kapsülde kendine geldin. Önce yemek, su ve oksijeni toparla.",
      ) +
      "</div>"
    : WK_CARD0;
  document.body.classList.add("story");
  const el = $("wake");
  el.className = "";
  void el.offsetWidth;
  el.classList.add("on");
}
function wakeCue(k, at, fn) {
  const W = game.wake;
  if (!W.cues[k] && W.t >= at) {
    W.cues[k] = 1;
    fn();
  }
}
function updateWake(dt) {
  const W = game.wake;
  if (!W) return;
  W.t += dt;
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++)
    wakeCue("b" + i, 0.35 + i * 0.62, () => {
      tone(880, 0.11, "square", 0.045);
      tone(660, 0.11, "square", 0.04, null, 0.14);
    });
  wakeCue("hiss", 2.05, () => {
    noiseBurst(0.55, 0.07, 2200);
    tone(320, 0.4, "sine", 0.03, 520);
  });
  wakeCue("blank", 2.35, () => {
    noiseBurst(0.35, 0.06, 1200);
  });
  wakeCue("step", 3.6, () => {
    tone(140, 0.08, "sine", 0.05, 110);
  });
  wakeCue("jump", 4.05, () => {
    noiseBurst(0.25, 0.05, 900);
    $("wake").classList.add("card");
  });
  wakeCue("land", 4.52, () => {
    tone(85, 0.22, "sine", 0.13, 60);
    noiseBurst(0.18, 0.12, 500);
    shake = Math.max(shake, 5);
  });
  wakeCue("sting", 4.65, () => {
    [392, 523, 784].forEach((f, i) => tone(f, 0.9, "sine", 0.035, null, i * 0.12));
  });
  wakeCue("radio", 5.5, () => {
    noiseBurst(0.2, 0.05, 2600);
    tone(1046, 0.07, "square", 0.02, null, 0.05);
  });
  if (W.t >= WAKE_LEN) endWake();
}
function endWake() {
  if (!game || !game.wake) return;
  const faint = !!game.wake.faint;
  game.wake = null;
  ip.x = -62;
  ip.dir = 1;
  const el = $("wake");
  el.classList.remove("on", "card");
  setTimeout(() => (el.className = "hidden"), 600);
  document.body.classList.remove("story");
  if (faint) {
    toast(T("😵 Bilincini kaybettin, uyku kapsülünde kendine geldin. Kendine dikkat et!"));
    return;
  }
  storyTrigger("start");
}
/* can sıfırlanınca: açık panelleri kapat, uyku kapsülünde uyandır (roketin içinde) */
function faintToPod() {
  game.sleeping = false;
  sleepT = 0;
  stopO2Fill(false);
  try {
    if (upgOpen) closeUpg();
    if (commOpen) closeComm();
    if (capOpen) closeCapsule();
    if (repairOpen) closeRepair();
    if (rocketOpen) closeRocket();
    if (marketOpen) closeMarket();
    if (bedOpen) closeBed();
    if (bookOpen) closeBook();
  } catch (e) {}
  if (radM) {
    radM = null;
    radUIClose();
  }
  brk = null;
  p.action = null;
  p.actionT = 0;
  p.digAt = null;
  p.vx = p.vy = 0;
  p.z = 0;
  p.vz = 0;
  game.hp = 50;
  game.hunger = Math.max(game.hunger, 60);
  game.thirst = Math.max(game.thirst, 60);
  game.o2 = 100;
  p.x = ROCKET.x;
  p.y = ROCKET.y + 118;
  startWake("faint");
  $("wkSkip").innerHTML = T("Atla") + " <kbd>Space</kbd>";
  updateStats();
}
/* yataktan kalkan astronot (drawInterior içinde, roket koordinatlarında)
   evreler: uyku (battaniye altında) → battaniyeyi atıp doğrulma → bacakları kenardan sarkıtma
            → adım atıp zıplama → dizleri kırarak iniş → etrafa bakınma */
function wakePose(T, F) {
  const yM = F - 26,
    ST = F - 45,
    E = (x) => x * x * (3 - 2 * x),
    cl = (x) => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, x)),
    L = (a, b, k) => a + (b - a) * k;
  const H = Math.PI / 2;
  let hx,
    hy,
    r,
    s,
    b,
    f,
    dir = 1,
    air = 0;
  if (T < 2.3) {
    // uyku: sırt üstü, baş yastıkta
    hx = -120;
    hy = yM - 11;
    r = -H;
    s = 0.52;
    b = [0, 0];
    f = [0, 0];
  } else if (T < 3.15) {
    // doğrulma: gövde kalkar, bacaklar yatakta düz kalır
    const k = E(cl((T - 2.3) / 0.85));
    hx = -120;
    hy = L(yM - 11, yM - 5, k);
    r = -H * (1 - k) + 0.06 * Math.sin(k * Math.PI);
    s = L(0.52, 0.62, k);
    b = [H * k, H * k];
    f = [H * k, H * k];
  } else if (T < 3.85) {
    // bacakları kenardan sarkıt, kenara kay
    const k = E(cl((T - 3.15) / 0.7)),
      k2 = E(cl((T - 3.3) / 0.55));
    hx = L(-120, -101, k);
    hy = yM - 5;
    r = -0.05 * k;
    s = L(0.62, 0.78, k);
    b = [L(H, H * 0.92, k), L(H, 0.05, k2)];
    f = [L(H, H * 0.86, k), L(H, -0.08, cl(k2 * 1.15))];
  } else if (T < 4.05) {
    // öne eğil, ön ayağı uzat — adım
    const k = E(cl((T - 3.85) / 0.2));
    hx = L(-101, -96, k);
    hy = L(yM - 5, yM - 9, k);
    r = L(-0.05, 0.32, k);
    s = L(0.78, 0.84, k);
    b = [H * 0.92, L(0.05, -0.2, k)];
    f = [L(H * 0.86, 0.55, k), L(-0.08, 0.25, k)];
  } else if (T < 4.52) {
    // zıplama yayı
    const k = cl((T - 4.05) / 0.47),
      ke = E(k);
    air = Math.sin(Math.PI * k);
    hx = L(-96, -62, ke);
    hy = L(yM - 9, ST + 16, ke) - 30 * air;
    r = L(0.32, 0, ke) + 0.12 * air;
    s = L(0.84, 1, ke);
    b = [L(H * 0.92, -0.25, ke) - 0.2 * air, L(-0.2, -0.9, ke) + 0.5 * (1 - air)];
    f = [L(0.55, 0.35, ke), L(0.25, 0.15, ke)];
  } else if (T < 5.05) {
    // iniş: dizler kırılır, toparlanır
    const k = cl((T - 4.52) / 0.53),
      sq = Math.sin(Math.PI * Math.min(1, k * 1.4)) * (1 - k * 0.4);
    hx = -62;
    hy = ST + 16 + 7 * sq;
    r = 0.14 * sq;
    s = 1;
    b = [L(-0.25, 0, E(k)) + 0.45 * sq, L(-0.9, 0, E(k)) - 0.5 * sq];
    f = [0.5 * sq, -0.45 * sq];
  } else {
    // ayakta: sola sağa bakınır
    hx = -62;
    hy = ST + 16;
    r = 0;
    s = 1;
    b = [0, 0];
    f = [0, 0];
    dir = T > 5.5 && T < 6.3 ? -1 : 1;
  }
  return { hx, hy, r, s, b, f, dir, air, yM };
}
const WAKE_CAM = [
  [0, -130, 298, 4.7],
  [2.25, -128, 296, 4.4],
  [3.9, -110, 290, 3.4],
  [4.6, -84, 288, 2.75],
  [5.8, -74, 288, 2.5],
  [99, -74, 288, 2.5],
];
function wakeCam(T) {
  let i = 0;
  while (i < WAKE_CAM.length - 2 && T >= WAKE_CAM[i + 1][0]) i++;
  const a = WAKE_CAM[i],
    b = WAKE_CAM[i + 1],
    k0 = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (T - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0]))),
    k = k0 * k0 * (3 - 2 * k0);
  return { x: a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * k, y: a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * k, z: a[3] + (b[3] - a[3]) * k };
}
function drawWakeAstro(t) {
  const W = game.wake,
    T = W.t,
    F = DECKS[1].floor,
    P = wakePose(T, F),
    yM = P.yM;
  // okuma lambası: uyanınca titreyerek yanar, ışık konisinde toz zerreleri
  if (T > 1.95) {
    const on = Math.min(1, (T - 1.95) / 0.35) * (T < 2.15 ? (Math.random() < 0.5 ? 0.3 : 1) : 1),
      lx = -101,
      ly = DECKS[1].ceil + 38;
    const cg = ctx.createLinearGradient(lx, ly, lx, yM);
    cg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,226,170," + 0.34 * on + ")");
    cg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,226,170,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = cg;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(lx - 5, ly);
    ctx.lineTo(lx + 5, ly);
    ctx.lineTo(lx + 34, yM + 4);
    ctx.lineTo(lx - 62, yM + 4);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,240,210," + 0.55 * on + ")";
    for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
      const ph = (t * 0.07 + i * 0.137) % 1,
        mx = lx - 50 + ((i * 37) % 80) + Math.sin(t * 0.6 + i) * 4,
        my = ly + ph * (yM - ly);
      ctx.fillRect(mx, my, 1.1, 1.1);
    }
  }
  // gece lambası: uyurken ranzaya soğuk mavi ışık
  if (T < 2.6) {
    const a = T < 2 ? 1 : 1 - (T - 2) / 0.6,
      ng = ctx.createRadialGradient(-128, yM - 12, 3, -128, yM - 12, 58);
    ng.addColorStop(0, "rgba(120,170,255," + 0.32 * a + ")");
    ng.addColorStop(1, "rgba(120,170,255,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = ng;
    ctx.fillRect(-190, yM - 70, 130, 90);
  }
  // uyku baloncukları
  if (T < 1.9) {
    ctx.font = "700 9px Inter,sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const ph = (t * 0.45 + i / 3) % 1;
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(220,235,255," + 0.75 * (1 - ph) * (1 - T / 1.9) + ")";
      ctx.fillText(i % 2 ? "z" : "Z", -150 + ph * 10 + Math.sin(ph * 6) * 2, yM - 24 - ph * 26);
    }
  }
  // astronot
  const pd = p.dir,
    psx = p.sx,
    psy = p.sy,
    pw = p.walk;
  p.dir = P.dir;
  p.sx = p.sy = 1;
  p.walk = 0;
  ASTRO_POSE = { b: P.b, f: P.f, ns: true };
  if (P.air > 0 || T >= 4.05) {
    const sh = Math.max(0.25, 1 - P.air * 0.7);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0," + 0.3 * sh + ")";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(P.hx, F - 2, 22 * P.s * sh, 5 * sh, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(P.hx, P.hy);
  ctx.rotate(P.r);
  ctx.scale(P.s, P.s);
  astronaut(0, -16, false, null, 0);
  // vizör HUD'ı uyanınca yanar
  if (T > 2.1 && T < 4.2) {
    const a = Math.min(1, (T - 2.1) / 0.3) * (1 - Math.max(0, (T - 3.6) / 0.6));
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(120,220,255," + 0.35 * a + ")";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(8 * P.dir, -58, 9, 6, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
  ASTRO_POSE = null;
  p.dir = pd;
  p.sx = psx;
  p.sy = psy;
  p.walk = pw;
  // iniş tozu
  if (T > 4.52 && T < 5.3) {
    const k = (T - 4.52) / 0.78;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(205,210,225," + 0.5 * (1 - k) + ")";
    for (const sd of [-1, 1])
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(
          -62 + sd * (14 + k * (26 + i * 9)),
          F - 3 - i * 2 * k,
          (5 + k * 9) * (1 - i * 0.2),
          2.5 + k * 2.5,
          0,
          0,
          7,
        );
        ctx.fill();
      }
  }
}
/* ekran üstü: karanlık + kırmızı alarm darbesi, yavaşça aydınlanır */
function drawWakeOverlay() {
  const W = game && game.wake;
  if (!W) return;
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  const dark = W.t < 2.2 ? 0.72 - W.t * 0.1 : Math.max(0, 0.5 - (W.t - 2.2) * 0.45);
  if (dark > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(2,3,8," + dark + ")";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W.t >= 0 ? innerWidth : 0, innerHeight);
  }
  if (W.t < 2.6) {
    const pulse = Math.max(0, Math.sin((W.t * Math.PI) / 0.62)) * 0.32 * (1 - W.t / 2.6);
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(
      innerWidth / 2,
      innerHeight / 2,
      innerHeight * 0.15,
      innerWidth / 2,
      innerHeight / 2,
      innerHeight * 0.9,
    );
    g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,40,30," + pulse * 0.4 + ")");
    g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,30,20," + pulse + ")");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, innerWidth, innerHeight);
  }
}

/* ---------- görev hedefi vurgusu: roket içinde gidilecek istasyon kırmızı parlar ---------- */
function questTargetKey() {
  if (!game || game.wake) return null;
  const S = game.story;
  if (S && S.goal && STORY_DEF[S.goal]) {
    const g = S.goal,
      G = STORY_DEF[g].goal,
      st = goalStep(G);
    if (g === "rot" || g === "ares" || g === "firstRock") return st >= 2 || insideRocket ? "trade" : null;
    if (g === "rotReply" || g === "aresReply" || g === "rockReply") return "comm";
    if (g === "engine") return "engine";
    if (g === "home") return "nav";
  }
  if (game.quest >= QUESTS.length) return null;
  const k = QUESTS[game.quest].k,
    I = game.inventory;
  switch (k) {
    case "kit":
      return game.kitCarried ? null : "kit";
    case "rare":
      return (I.pick || 0) > 0 ? "exit" : "kit";
    case "mined":
    case "harvested":
    case "cleanHarvest":
    case "gold":
    case "loaded":
      return "exit";
    case "planted":
      return hasSeeds() ? "exit" : "kit";
    case "covered":
      return (I.ceramic || 0) > 0 ? "exit" : "kit";
    case "domeCycle":
      return "exit";
    case "shieldSaved":
      return game.radiationActive ? "bed" : null;
    case "drunk":
      return (I.water || 0) > 0 ? null : "kitchen";
    case "reported":
    case "replyRead":
    case "rotAnalysis":
      return "comm";
    case "repaired":
      return game.stormBroke && game.repair.state !== "ok" ? "engine" : null;
    case "radSafe":
      return game.radiationActive ? "bed" : null;
    case "rotSample":
      return (I.rotten || 0) > 0 ? "trade" : "exit";
    case "measured":
      return (I.radmeter || 0) > 0 ? "exit" : "kit";
    case "rockSent":
      return "trade";
    case "suit":
    case "radSuit":
    case "armor":
      return "upg";
    case "traveled":
      return "nav";
  }
  return null;
}
function drawQuestTarget(t) {
  const key = questTargetKey();
  if (!key || ip.climb) return;
  const s = STATIONS.find((q) => q.key === key);
  if (!s) return;
  const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * 4.2);
  ctx.save();
  if (s.deck === ip.deck) {
    const d = DECKS[s.deck],
      x0 = s.x - s.w - 6,
      w = (s.w + 6) * 2,
      y0 = d.ceil + 6,
      h = d.floor - d.ceil - 6;
    // iç parıltı + parlayan kırmızı çerçeve
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(s.x, d.floor - 30, 4, s.x, d.floor - 30, Math.max(w, h) * 0.8);
    g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,70,50," + (0.16 + 0.12 * pulse) + ")");
    g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,70,50,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    rrp(x0, y0, w, h, 8);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(255,60,40,.95)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 16 + 18 * pulse;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255," + Math.round(80 + 60 * pulse) + ",60," + (0.75 + 0.25 * pulse) + ")";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3.6;
    ctx.setLineDash([10, 6]);
    ctx.lineDashOffset = -t * 18;
    rrp(x0, y0, w, h, 8);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    // köşe parantezleri
    ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
    ctx.lineWidth = 4.5;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#ff6a4a";
    const c = 13;
    for (const [cx, cy, sx, sy] of [
      [x0, y0, 1, 1],
      [x0 + w, y0, -1, 1],
      [x0, y0 + h, 1, -1],
      [x0 + w, y0 + h, -1, -1],
    ]) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx, cy + sy * c);
      ctx.lineTo(cx, cy);
      ctx.lineTo(cx + sx * c, cy);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    // zıplayan ok + etiket
    const ay = y0 + 14 + Math.sin(t * 5) * 4;
    ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff5a3c";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(s.x, ay + 14);
    ctx.lineTo(s.x - 12, ay - 3);
    ctx.lineTo(s.x + 12, ay - 3);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  } else {
    // başka güvertede: oraya çıkan/inen merdiveni vurgula
    const up = s.deck > ip.deck,
      l = LADDERS.find((q) => (up ? q.from === ip.deck : q.to === ip.deck));
    if (!l) {
      ctx.restore();
      return;
    }
    const d = DECKS[ip.deck],
      x0 = l.x - 22,
      w = 44,
      y0 = d.ceil + 6,
      h = d.floor - d.ceil - 6;
    ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(255,60,40,.95)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 16 + 18 * pulse;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255," + Math.round(80 + 60 * pulse) + ",60," + (0.75 + 0.25 * pulse) + ")";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3.6;
    ctx.setLineDash([8, 5]);
    ctx.lineDashOffset = -t * 18;
    rrp(x0, y0, w, h, 6);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff5a3c";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
    for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
      const yy = up ? y0 + h * 0.55 - ((t * 40 + i * 22) % 44) : y0 + h * 0.25 + ((t * 40 + i * 22) % 44),
        a = 0.4 + 0.6 * (1 - ((t * 40 + i * 22) % 44) / 44);
      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
      ctx.beginPath();
      if (up) {
        ctx.moveTo(l.x, yy - 7);
        ctx.lineTo(l.x - 8, yy + 3);
        ctx.lineTo(l.x + 8, yy + 3);
      } else {
        ctx.moveTo(l.x, yy + 7);
        ctx.lineTo(l.x - 8, yy - 3);
        ctx.lineTo(l.x + 8, yy - 3);
      }
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    ctx.font = "800 14px ui-monospace,monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.fillText(up ? "W ▲" : "S ▼", l.x, y0 + 12);
  }
  ctx.restore();
}
/* dışarıdayken: hedef roketin içindeyse roketin üstünde kırmızı işaret */
function drawQuestRocketMark(z) {
  if (!game || insideRocket || story) return;

  if (game.story && game.story.goal) return; // acil hedef oku zaten gösteriliyor
  const t = performance.now() / 1000,

  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(30,8,6,.8)";
  rrp(sx - tw / 2 - 7, y - 24, tw + 14, 17, 6);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,90,60,.7)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd9cf";
  ctx.fillText(lb, sx, y - 12);
  ctx.restore();
}

/* ---------- jeolog kazması: yalnızca bilinmeyen/nadir taşları kırar ---------- */
function rrc(c, x, y, w, h, r) {
  c.beginPath();
  c.moveTo(x + r, y);
  c.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  c.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  c.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  c.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  c.closePath();
}

  c.moveTo(4, -40.3);
  c.quadraticCurveTo(17, -38.4, 27.4, -27.4);
  c.stroke(); // parlak sırt
  c.strokeStyle = "rgba(30,36,50,.45)";
  c.lineWidth = 0.8;
  c.beginPath();
  c.moveTo(-15, -35);
  c.quadraticCurveTo(4, -37.5, 20, -31);
  c.stroke(); // bilenmiş kenar çizgisi
  c.fillStyle = "#2c3242";
  c.beginPath();
  c.arc(0, -37, 1.4, 0, 7);
  c.fill();
  c.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.6)";
  c.beginPath();
  c.arc(-0.4, -37.4, 0.5, 0, 7);
  c.fill(); // perçin
  c.restore();
}
function drawPickArt(c) {
  c.save();
  c.rotate(0.7);
  drawGeoPick(c, -3, 9, 0, 0.76);
  c.restore();
}

let brk = null; // kırma sahnesi: {n,t,hits}
function nearRareNode(r) {
  let b = null,
    bd = r || 125;
  for (const n of rareNodes) {
    if (n.taken || n.split) continue;
    const d = Math.hypot(p.x - n.x, p.y - n.y);
    if (d < bd) {
      bd = d;
      b = n;
    }
  }
  return b;
}
function startBreak(n) {
  if (brk) return;
  if (!((game.inventory.pick || 0) > 0)) {
    sfx("error");
    toast(
      T("Bu taşı kırmak için <b>jeolog kazması</b> gerekli — makine dairesindeki <b>alet sandığından</b> al"),
    );
    return;
  }
  if (radM) return;
  const dir = n.x < p.x ? -1 : 1;
  p.dir = dir;
  brk = { n, t: 0, hits: 0, dir, x0: p.x, y0: p.y, tx: n.x - dir * 88, ty: n.y - 22, next: 0.32 };
  sfx("click");
}
function strikeFx(n, i) {
  const now = performance.now() / 1000,
    P = rarePal(n);
  n.hits = i;
  n.hitT = now;
  const hx = n.x - brk.dir * 26,
    hy = n.y - 16;
  burst(hx, hy, 16, "#ffffff", { sp: 260, life: 0.35, size: 2.5, up: 60 });
  burst(hx, hy, 14, P.gl, { sp: 180, life: 0.7, size: 4, up: 90 });
  burst(hx, hy + 10, 10, "#5a3a2e", { sp: 120, life: 0.8, size: 5, up: 50 });
  shake = Math.max(shake, 3 + i * 1.5);
  tone(2600 - i * 200, 0.09, "triangle", 0.07, 1900);
  tone(1750, 0.14, "sine", 0.05, null, 0.01);
  noiseBurst(0.12, 0.2, 3400);
  tone(120, 0.14, "sine", 0.14, 70);
}
function splitFx(n) {
  const now = performance.now() / 1000,
    P = rarePal(n);
  n.split = now;
  n.hits = 3;
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++)
    burst(n.x, n.y - 18, 18, i ? P.gl : "#ffffff", { sp: 240 + i * 60, life: 0.9, size: i ? 5 : 3, up: 120 });
  burst(n.x, n.y, 20, "#4a2e25", { sp: 200, life: 1, size: 6, up: 70 });
  shake = Math.max(shake, 9);
  noiseBurst(0.55, 0.22, 4200);
  tone(80, 0.45, "sine", 0.16, 40);
  [1568, 2093, 2637, 3136].forEach((f, i) => tone(f, 0.5, "sine", 0.04, null, 0.08 + i * 0.07));
}
function updateBreak(dt) {
  if (!brk) return;
  const b = brk,
    n = b.n;
  b.t += dt;
  // taşın yanına konumlan
  const k = Math.min(1, b.t / 0.3);
  p.x = b.x0 + (b.tx - b.x0) * k;
  p.y = b.y0 + (b.ty - b.y0) * k;
  p.dir = b.dir;
  p.walk = 0;
  // 3 vuruş: her biri ayrı bir savurma
  if (b.hits < 3 && b.t >= b.next) {
    p.action = "mine";
    p.actionT = 0.62;
    p.actionDur = 0.62;
    b.strikeAt = b.t + 0.35;
    b.next = b.t + 0.72;
    b.hits++;
  }
  if (b.strikeAt && b.t >= b.strikeAt) {
    const i = b.hits;
    b.strikeAt = 0;
    if (i < 3) strikeFx(n, i);
    else splitFx(n);
  }
  if (n.split && !n.flyT && b.t >= b.next + 0.55) {
    n.flyT = performance.now() / 1000;
    tone(880, 0.2, "sine", 0.06, 1760);
  }
  if (n.flyT && performance.now() / 1000 - n.flyT > 0.36) {
    n.fadeEnd = performance.now() / 1000 + 1.6;
    brk = null;
    pickRare(n);
  }
}
/* ============== YERÇEKİMİ ==============
   Mars: 3,72 m/s² = 0,38 g (gerçek değer). Dışarıda adımlar seker, ataletle kayılır, havadayken
   yön değiştirmek zordur; Space ile alçak yerçekimi zıplaması. Roketin içinde yapay yerçekimi (1 g);
   motor arızalanınca jeneratör de durur ve içerisi de Mars yerçekimine düşer.
   Kıyafet dengeleyicileri (st.grav) bu etkiyi azaltır. */
const G_MARS = 3.72 / 9.81,
  G_PX = 900; // 1 g = 900 px/s² (oyun ölçeği)
function cabinGravFail() {
  return !!(game && game.repair && game.repair.state !== "ok");
}
function gravNow() {
  if (!game) return 1;
  if (insideRocket) return cabinGravFail() ? G_MARS : 1;
  return scene === "mars" ? G_MARS : 1;
}
function gravStab() {
  const g = suitSt().grav || 0;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(0.95, g));
}
function gravLow() {
  return (1 - gravNow()) * (1 - gravStab() * 0.85);
} // 0 = Dünya hissi, ~0,62 = standart kıyafetle Mars
function gravAcc() {
  const G = gravNow();
  return G_PX * (G + (1 - G) * gravStab() * 0.85);
} // dengeleyici "ağırlaştırır"
/* hareket: hedef hıza ataletle yaklaş; havada kontrol zayıf */
function gravMove(o, tvx, tvy, dt) {
  const L = gravLow(),
    air = o.z > 0.5;
  const K = air ? 0.9 + 2.4 * (1 - L) : 3.2 + 11 * (1 - L * 1.05);
  const k = Math.min(1, dt * K);
  o.vx += (tvx - o.vx) * k;
  if (tvy != null) o.vy += (tvy - o.vy) * k;
}
/* sekme ve zıplama (o.z: yerden yükseklik, o.vz: dikey hız) */
function gravHop(o, moving, running, dt, ceil) {
  const L = gravLow(),
    g = gravAcc();
  if (o.z > 0 || o.vz > 0) {
    o.vz -= g * dt;
    o.z += o.vz * dt;
    if (ceil && o.z > ceil) {
      o.z = ceil;
      if (o.vz > 0) {
        o.vz = -o.vz * 0.25;
        tone(140, 0.08, "sine", 0.1, 90);
        shake = Math.max(shake, 2);
      }
    } // tavana kafa çarpması
    if (o.z <= 0) {
      const imp = -o.vz;
      o.z = 0;
      o.vz = 0;
      o.landed = imp;
    }
  } else if (moving && L > 0.05) {
    // yürürken her adım küçük bir sıçrayış
    const h = (running ? 34 : 24) * L;
    o.vz = Math.sqrt(2 * g * h);
    o.z = 0.01;
  }
}
function gravJump(o) {
  if (o.z > 0.5) return false;
  const L = gravLow(),
    g = gravAcc(),
    h = 18 + 72 * L;
  o.vz = Math.sqrt(2 * g * h);
  o.z = 0.01;
  o.jumped = true;
  noiseBurst(0.18, 0.08, 700);
  tone(220, 0.12, "sine", 0.05, 330);
  return true;
}
function gravLand(o, x, y) {
  const imp = o.landed;
  o.landed = 0;
  if (!imp) return;
  const big = imp > 260;
  burst(x, y + 38, big ? 10 : 3, PLANETS[scene] ? PLANETS[scene].dot : "#c98", {
    sp: big ? 90 : 40,
    life: big ? 0.8 : 0.45,
    size: big ? 4 : 3,
    g: 40,
    drag: 2.5,
  });
  p.sx = 1 + (big ? 0.14 : 0.06);
  p.sy = 1 - (big ? 0.14 : 0.06);
  if (big || o.jumped) {
    tone(90, 0.16, "sine", 0.12, 60);
    noiseBurst(0.14, 0.1, 500);
    if (big) shake = Math.max(shake, 2.5);
  }
  o.jumped = false;
}
/* zıplarken bacaklar toplanır; gölge yerde kalır ve yükseldikçe küçülür */
function drawGravShadow(x, y, z) {
  const k = Math.max(0.3, 1 - z / 140);
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0," + 0.32 * k + ")";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(x, y + 44, 24 * k, 7 * k, 0, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
}
function drawAstroGrav(x, y, z, running, held, act) {
  if (z > 0.5) {
    drawGravShadow(x, y, z);
    const tuck = Math.min(1, z / 40);
    ASTRO_POSE =
      z > 14
        ? {
            ns: true,
            b: [0.15 + 0.5 * tuck, -0.15 - 0.45 * tuck],
            f: [0.35 + 0.55 * tuck, 0.1 + 0.25 * tuck],
          }
        : { ns: true };
    astronaut(x, y - z, running, held, act);
    ASTRO_POSE = null;
  } else astronaut(x, y, running, held, act);
}
let _gravWas = null;
function updateGravHud() {
  if (!game) return;
  const G = gravNow(),
    el = $("bioGrav");
  if (!el) return;
  const fail = insideRocket && cabinGravFail(),
    stab = gravStab();
  const lbl = insideRocket
    ? fail
      ? T("JENERATÖR ARIZALI")
      : T("YAPAY YERÇEKİMİ")
    : scene === "mars"
      ? T("MARS")
      : T("DÜNYA");
  $("bgVal").textContent = fmtN(G, 2) + " g";
  $("bgLbl").textContent = lbl;
  $("bgFill").style.width = Math.round(G * 100) + "%";
  $("bgStab").textContent =
    stab > 0 && G < 1 ? "⚙ " + (curSuit().gf || "") + " · −%" + Math.round(stab * 85) : "";
  el.classList.toggle("warn", fail);
  el.classList.toggle("low", G < 1 && !fail);
  const key = (insideRocket ? "in" : "out") + (fail ? "F" : "") + (G < 1 ? "L" : "");
  if (_gravWas !== null && key !== _gravWas) {
    if (insideRocket && fail && !_gravWas.includes("F"))
      toast(
        T(
          "⚠️ <b>Yapay yerçekimi jeneratörü durdu</b> — roketin içi de Mars yerçekiminde (0,38 g). Motoru onarınca geri gelir.",
        ),
      );
    else if (insideRocket && !fail && _gravWas === "inFL") toast(T("✅ Yapay yerçekimi yeniden aktif (1 g)"));
  }
  _gravWas = key;
  if (!insideRocket && scene === "mars" && !game._gravTip) {
    game._gravTip = 1;
    setTimeout(
      () =>
        toast(
          T("🪐 <b>Mars yerçekimi: 0,38 g</b> — adımların seker, durması zordur. <b>Space</b> ile zıpla."),
        ),
      900,
    );
  }
}

let story = null;
const ST_AV_ME =

const ST_AV_RADIO =
  '<svg viewBox="0 0 44 44"><circle cx="22" cy="26" r="3.5" fill="#5ad1ff"/><g fill="none" stroke="#5ad1ff" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="22" cy="26" r="9" stroke-dasharray="14 100" transform="rotate(-135 22 26)"/><circle cx="22" cy="26" r="15" stroke-dasharray="23 100" transform="rotate(-135 22 26)" opacity=".7"/></g><rect x="20.6" y="29" width="2.8" height="10" fill="#5ad1ff"/></svg>';
function rockMsgRead(k) {

}
function storyState() {
  if (!game.story || typeof game.story !== "object") game.story = { done: {}, goal: null };
  if (!game.story.done) game.story.done = {};

}
function storySeen(k) {
  return !!(game && storyState().done[k]);
}
function storyTrigger(k) {
  if (k && k.startsWith("radRadio2_")) {
    if (!game || storySeen(k)) return false;

    commOpen ||

function storyStart(k) {

function storyShowLine() {

    L = D.lines[story.i];

  story.t = 0;

  box.classList.add("talk");

  $("stWho").textContent = L[0] === ST_RADIO ? T("GÖREV KONTROL · TELSİZ") : T("KOMUTAN · İÇ SES");

function storyAdvance() {
  if (!story || story.end) return;
  if (story.c < story.txt.length) {
    story.c = story.txt.length;

function storyEnd() {

  }, 450);

  updateQuest(true);
}
function goalDone(G) {
  return G.steps ? !!G.steps[G.steps.length - 1][1]() : G.done();
}
function goalStep(G) {
  if (!G.steps) return -1;
  for (let j = G.steps.length - 1; j >= 0; j--)
    if (G.steps[j][1]()) return Math.min(G.steps.length - 1, j + 1);

}
function goalText(G) {
  const i = goalStep(G);

}
function storySetGoal(k) {

  storyState().goal = k;
  $("stGoal").className = "";
  $("stGoalK").textContent = T("ACİL HEDEF");
  $("stGoalT").textContent = goalText(G);
  $("stGoalD").textContent = "";
  tone(659, 0.12, "triangle", 0.05);
  tone(988, 0.16, "triangle", 0.045, null, 0.1);
}
function storyGoalDone(k) {

    G = STORY_DEF[k].goal;
  S.goal = null;
  const el = $("stGoal");
  el.className = "ok";
  $("stGoalK").textContent = "HEDEF TAMAM";
  $("stGoalT").textContent = G.steps ? G.steps[G.steps.length - 1][0] : G.t;
  $("stGoalD").textContent = "";
