/* gerçek zamanla çalışır (oyun yavaşlatılmış olsa bile) */
function updateStory(dt) {
  if (!game || mode !== "play") return;
  const S = storyState();
  // tetikleyiciler
  if (stormFx.phase === "active" && stormFx.I > 0.4 && !S.done.storm && !S.done.stormIn2) {
    if (insideRocket) {
      S.done.storm = 1;
      storyTrigger("stormIn2");
    } else storyTrigger("storm");
  }
  if (game.radiationActive && !S.done.rad && !S.done.radIn2) {
    if (insideRocket) {
      S.done.rad = 1;
      storyTrigger("radIn2");
    } else {
      S._radT = (S._radT || 0) + dt;
      if (S._radT > 1.6) storyTrigger("rad");
    }
  }
  // aktif hedef
  if (S.goal && STORY_DEF[S.goal]) {
    const G = STORY_DEF[S.goal].goal;
    if (goalDone(G)) storyGoalDone(S.goal);
    else {
      const gl = $("stGoal"),
        ab = $("alerts").getBoundingClientRect();
      gl.style.setProperty("--sgTop", Math.max(14, ab.bottom + 10) + "px");
      if (gl.classList.contains("ok")) gl.className = "";
      gl.classList.toggle("hidden", !!story);
      const gt = goalText(G),
        gi = goalStep(G),
        gk = gi < 0 ? T("ACİL HEDEF") : T("ACİL HEDEF · ") + (gi + 1) + "/" + G.steps.length;
      if ($("stGoalT").textContent !== gt || $("stGoalK").textContent !== gk) {
        $("stGoalT").textContent = gt;
        $("stGoalK").textContent = gk;
        gl.querySelector(".sg-ic").textContent = "!";
        if (gi > 0) {
          gl.classList.remove("bump");
          void gl.offsetWidth;
          gl.classList.add("bump");
          tone(880, 0.08, "triangle", 0.04);
        }
      }
      if (G.to === "rocket" && !insideRocket && goalStep(G) <= 0) {
        const d = Math.hypot(ROCKET.x - p.x, ROCKET.y - p.y);
        $("stGoalD").textContent = " · " + Math.round(d / 10) + " m";
      } else $("stGoalD").textContent = "";
    }
  }
  S._qt = (S._qt || 0) + dt;
  if (S._qt > 0.3) {
    S._qt = 0;
    refreshQuestSteps();
    if (S.done.rockReply && !S.done.rockLearn && rockMsgRead(S.rk)) storyTrigger("rockLearn");
    const qe = $("quest");
    qe.classList.toggle("hold", !!S.goal);
    if (S.goal) qe.dataset.hold = T("⏸ GÖREV BEKLEMEDE · ÖNCE ACİL HEDEF");
  }
  // sıradaki sahne
  if (!story && S.q && S.q.length && !storyBusy()) storyStart(S.q.shift());
  if (story && !story.end) {
    story.t += dt;
    if (story.c < story.txt.length) {
      const n = Math.min(story.txt.length, Math.floor(story.t * 42));
      if (n > story.c) {
        if (n % 3 === 0) tone(1500 + Math.random() * 300, 0.012, "square", 0.006);
        story.c = n;
        $("stLine").textContent = story.txt.slice(0, n);
      }
      if (story.c >= story.txt.length) $("stBox").classList.remove("talk");
    } else if (story.t > story.txt.length / 42 + 3.2) storyAdvance(); // okuma süresi dolunca kendiliğinden ilerler
  }
  // kamera: sahne sırasında oyuncuya yaklaşır
  if (!radM) {
    const on = story && !story.end && !insideRocket,
      want = on ? { z: 1.5, ox: 0, oy: -8 } : { z: 1, ox: 0, oy: 0 },
      k = 1 - Math.exp(-dt * (on ? 2.2 : 3.5));
    cam.z += (want.z - cam.z) * k;
    cam.ox += (want.ox - cam.ox) * k;
    cam.oy += (want.oy - cam.oy) * k;
  }
}
function storyReset() {
  story = null;
  markFx = [];
  $("wake").className = "hidden";
  if (game && game.wake) game.wake = null;
  $("story").className = "hidden";
  $("stGoal").className = "hidden";
  document.body.classList.remove("story");
}
$("story").addEventListener("click", (e) => {
  e.stopPropagation();
  storyAdvance();
});
function storySlow() {
  return story && !story.end ? 0.1 : 1;
}
/* hedef oku: roket ekran dışındaysa kenarda yön oku, içindeyse üstünde zıplayan işaret */
function drawStoryArrow(z) {
  if (!game || insideRocket || story) return;
  const S = game.story;
  if (!S || !S.goal) return;
  const G = STORY_DEF[S.goal] && STORY_DEF[S.goal].goal;
  if (!G || G.to !== "rocket" || goalStep(G) > 0) return;
  const t = performance.now() / 1000,
    sx = W / 2 + (ROCKET.x - p.x - cam.ox) * z,
    sy = H / 2 + (ROCKET.y - 140 - p.y - cam.oy) * z,
    m = 60;
  ctx.save();
  if (sx > m && sx < W - m && sy > m && sy < H - m) {
    const y = sy - 8 + Math.sin(t * 5) * 6;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff6a3d";
    ctx.shadowColor = "#ff6a3d";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(sx, y + 12);
    ctx.lineTo(sx - 11, y - 4);
    ctx.lineTo(sx + 11, y - 4);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  } else {
    const a = Math.atan2(sy - H / 2, sx - W / 2),
      R = Math.min(W, H) / 2 - 70,
      ax = W / 2 + Math.cos(a) * R,
      ay = H / 2 + Math.sin(a) * R,
      pl = 1 + 0.12 * Math.sin(t * 6);
    ctx.translate(ax, ay);
    ctx.rotate(a);
    ctx.scale(pl, pl);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,106,61,.95)";
    ctx.shadowColor = "#ff6a3d";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 16;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(18, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(-10, -13);
    ctx.lineTo(-4, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(-10, 13);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

/* ---------- ölçüm bayrağını kaldır ---------- */
let markFx = [];
function nearestMark() {
  const M = game.radMarks;
  if (!Array.isArray(M) || !M.length) return null;
  let b = null,
    bd = 62;
  M.forEach((mk, i) => {
    const d = Math.hypot(mk.x - p.x, mk.y - (p.y + 26));
    if (d < bd) {
      bd = d;
      b = { i, mk, d };
    }
  });
  return b;
}
function removeMark(nm) {
  game.radMarks.splice(nm.i, 1);
  markFx.push({ x: nm.mk.x, y: nm.mk.y, u: nm.mk.u, t: 0 });
  p.dir = nm.mk.x < p.x ? -1 : 1;
  startAct("use", 0.6);
  burst(nm.mk.x, nm.mk.y, 12, "#8a6a3c", { sp: 80, life: 0.6, size: 4, up: 40 });
  sfx("pickup");
  tone(880, 0.06, "triangle", 0.04, 660);
  if (!game._markTip) {
    game._markTip = 1;
    toast(T("Bayrak kaldırıldı. Ölçtüğün yerleri istediğin zaman temizleyebilirsin."));
  }
}
function drawMarkFx(dt) {
  for (const f of markFx) {
    f.t += dt;
    const k = Math.min(1, f.t / 0.7),
      x = f.x,
      y = f.y - k * 30,
      L = RAD_LV[radLevel(f.u)];
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1 - k;
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    ctx.rotate(-k * 0.6);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#d7dce8";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(0, -42);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = L[1];
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(1, -42);
    ctx.lineTo(19, -36);
    ctx.lineTo(1, -30);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }
  markFx = markFx.filter((f) => f.t < 0.7);
}

/* ---------- enerji: koşmak tüketir, yürürken/dururken dolar; eldeki eşya ağırlığı yavaşlatır ---------- */
const ENERGY = { drain: 9, regenWalk: 4, regenRest: 7, recover: 40 };
const HELD_W = {
  pickaxe: 0.12,
  pick: 0.1,
  ceramic: 0.14,
  radmeter: 0.04,
  rare: 0.08,
  stone: 0.06,
  star: 0.04,
  water: 0.03,
  potato: 0.02,
  seed: 0.02,
  tuber: 0.03,
  medkit: 0.03,
  rotten: 0.03,
};
function heldWeight() {
  const k = heldItemKey();
  return isRareSlot(k) ? 0.08 : (k && HELD_W[k]) || 0;
}
function energyTick(dt, moving, wantRun) {
  if (game.energy == null) game.energy = 100;
  if (game._exh && game.energy >= ENERGY.recover) game._exh = false;
  const run = wantRun && moving && !game._exh && game.energy > 0;
  if (run) {
    game.energy = Math.max(0, game.energy - ENERGY.drain * (1 + heldWeight() * 2) * dt);
    if (game.energy <= 0) {
      game._exh = true;
      sfx("error");
      toast(T("⚡ Enerjin bitti — koşamazsın, biraz yürü ya da dinlen"));
    }
  } else
    game.energy = Math.min(
      100,
      game.energy + (moving ? ENERGY.regenWalk : ENERGY.regenRest) * (insideRocket ? 1.5 : 1) * dt,
    );
  return run;
}
function moveMul() {
  return (1 - heldWeight()) * (game._exh ? 0.85 : 1);
}
function update(dt) {
  game._invT = (game._invT || 0) + dt;
  if (game._invT > 0.4) {
    game._invT = 0;
    if (invSig() !== _invSig) updateInv();
  } // envanter her zaman gerçek sayıları gösterir
  if (game.wake) {
    updateWake(dt);
    updateStats();
    return;
  }
  const simDt = dt * (game.sleeping && insideRocket ? SLEEP_MULTIPLIER : 1);
  updateBio(dt);
  let ix = (keys.KeyD || keys.ArrowRight ? 1 : 0) - (keys.KeyA || keys.ArrowLeft ? 1 : 0) + joy.x;
  let iy = (keys.KeyS || keys.ArrowDown ? 1 : 0) - (keys.KeyW || keys.ArrowUp ? 1 : 0) + joy.y;
  let l = Math.hypot(ix, iy);
  if (l > 1) {
    ix /= l;
    iy /= l;
  }
  if (radM || story || brk) {
    ix = 0;
    iy = 0;
    l = 0;
  }
  updateMeasure(dt);
  updateBreak(dt);
  const running = energyTick(dt, l > 0.1, !!keys.ShiftLeft || !!keys.ShiftRight);
  BIO.ex = l > 0.1 ? (running ? 1 : 0.4) : 0;
  if (insideRocket) {
    if (
      bedOpen ||
      rocketOpen ||
      marketOpen ||
      repairOpen ||
      capOpen ||
      commOpen ||
      upgOpen ||
      o2Fill ||
      bookOpen
    ) {
      ix = 0;
      iy = 0;
    }
    updateInside(dt, ix, iy, running);
    updateSleep(simDt);
  } else {
    const totalItems = Object.values(game.inventory).reduce((a, b) => a + (b || 0), 0);
    const weightPenalty = Math.min(CFG.maxWeightPenalty, totalItems * CFG.weightPerItem);
    const spMul =
      PLANETS[scene].speedMul *
      (running ? CFG.runMultiplier : 1) *
      (1 - weightPenalty) *
      suitSt().spd *
      moveMul();
    const B = CFG.worldHalf;
    // fırtına: rüzgâra karşı yürümek zor, rüzgâr oyuncuyu savurur
    const SI = Math.min(1, stormFx.I),
      wx = Math.cos(stormFx.ang),
      wy = Math.sin(stormFx.ang);
    const against = Math.max(0, -(ix * wx + iy * wy));
    const SS = suitSt().storm * dif().storm;
    const stormMul = 1 - SI * (0.18 + 0.35 * against) * SS;
    const push = SI * (38 + stormFx.gust * 70) * SS;
    if (SI > 0.35) {
      damage(0.45 * SI * SS * dt, true);
      game._stT = (game._stT || 0) + dt;
      if (game._stT > 2.2) {
        game._stT = 0;
        addFloat(
          p.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30,
          p.y - 62,
          "-" + Math.max(1, Math.round(0.45 * SI * SS * 2.2)) + " 🌪",
          "#ffcf8a",
        );
      }
    }
    if (p.vx == null) {
      p.vx = 0;
      p.vy = 0;
      p.z = 0;
      p.vz = 0;
    }
    if (brk) {
      p.vx = p.vy = 0;
    }
    gravMove(p, ix * CFG.walkSpeed * spMul * stormMul, iy * CFG.walkSpeed * spMul * stormMul, dt);
    gravHop(p, l > 0.05 && !brk, running, dt);
    gravLand(p, p.x, p.y);
    if (keys.Space && !radM && !brk && !story) {
      keys.Space = false;
      gravJump(p);
    }
    const nx = Math.max(-B, Math.min(B, p.x + p.vx * dt + wx * push * dt));
    const ny = Math.max(-B, Math.min(B, p.y + p.vy * dt + wy * push * dt));
    if (nx === B || nx === -B) p.vx = 0;
    if (ny === B || ny === -B) p.vy = 0;
    p.x = nx;
    p.y = ny;
    if (ix > 0.1) p.dir = 1;
    if (ix < -0.1) p.dir = -1;
    if (l > 0.05) p.hd = Math.atan2(iy, ix);
    if (l > 0.05 || Math.hypot(p.vx, p.vy) > 40) {
      p.t += dt * CFG.springSpeed * (running ? 1.4 : 1) * (p.z > 0.5 ? 0.35 : 1);
      p.walk = Math.min(1, p.walk + dt * 8);
      const s = Math.sin(p.t * 2) * CFG.springAmount;
      p.sx = 1 + s;
      p.sy = 1 - s;
      stepDust -= dt;
      if (stepDust <= 0) {
        stepDust = running ? 0.16 : 0.26;
        burst(p.x, p.y + 38, 2, PLANETS[scene].dot, { sp: 34, life: 0.45, size: 3, g: 60, drag: 3 });
      }
    } else {
      p.walk = Math.max(0, p.walk - dt * 8);
      const k = Math.min(1, dt * 10);
      p.sx += (1 - p.sx) * k;
      p.sy += (1 - p.sy) * k;
    }
    p._running = running;
    p.actionT = Math.max(0, (p.actionT || 0) - dt);
    if (p.digAt) {
      p.digAt.t += dt;
      if (p.digAt.t >= 0.53) {
        const d = p.digAt;
        p.digAt = null;
        digImpact(d.x, d.y);
      }
    }
    if (p.actionT <= 0) p.action = null; // animasyon bitince el durumu serbest kalır
  }

  updateO2(simDt, dt, running);
  {
    const df = dif();
    game.hunger = Math.max(0, game.hunger - CFG.hungerDrain * (df.food || 1) * simDt);
    game.thirst = Math.max(0, game.thirst - CFG.thirstDrain * (df.water || 1) * simDt);
    if (game.hunger <= 0 || game.thirst <= 0) {
      game.hp = Math.max(0, game.hp - CFG.hpDrainEmpty * simDt);
    } else if (game.hp < 100) {
      game.hp = Math.min(100, game.hp + CFG.hpRegen * (df.regen || 1) * simDt * 0.25);
    }
  }
  const previousDay = gameDayNumber();
  game.worldTime = (Number(game.worldTime) || 0) + simDt;
  const currentDay = gameDayNumber();
  if (currentDay > previousDay) toast(T("🌅 Gün ") + currentDay + T(" başladı"));
  updateRadiation(simDt);
  updateStorm(simDt, dt);
  updateAmbient(dt);
  rareScan(dt);
  autoSaveTick(dt);
  updateDistress(dt);
  updateGravHud();
  commsTick(simDt, dt);
  if (game.hp <= 0) {
    faintToPod();
    return;
  }
  game.playTime = (game.playTime || 0) + simDt;
  game.recyT = (game.recyT || 0) + simDt;
  if (game.recyT >= recycleInt()) {
    game.recyT = 0;
    if (game.stock.water < 12) game.stock.water++;
  }

  // tarım büyümesi
  const fa = farmArr();
  for (let i = fa.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    // boş bırakılan çukur bir süre sonra kendiliğinden kapanır
    const g = fa[i];
    if (!g || g.g > 0 || g.cov) {
      if (g) g.idle = 0;
      continue;
    } // kalkanlı parsel kapanmaz
    g.idle = (g.idle || 0) + simDt;
    if (g.idle > EMPTY_HOLE_T) {
      g.fill = Math.min(1, (g.fill || 0) + simDt / 3.5);
      if (Math.random() < simDt * 6)
        burst(g.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 50, g.y + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 20, 2, "#b98058", {
          sp: 30,
          life: 0.6,
          size: 3,
          up: 10,
        });
      if (g.fill >= 1) {
        burst(g.x, g.y, 14, "#b98058", { sp: 70, life: 0.8, size: 4, up: 20 });
        fa.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }
  }
  const radNow = game.radiationActive && scene !== "earth";
  updateDomes(dt);
  for (const g of fa) {
    if (!g || g.g <= 0) continue;
    if (radNow) {
      if (domeSafe(g)) g.radOK = 1;
      else g.radHit = 1;
    }
    if (radNow && !domeSafe(g)) {
      // korumasız bitki: radyasyon dalgası büyümeyi geri alır
      g.g = Math.max(0.1, g.g - simDt * PLANT_RAD_DMG);
      g._rz = (g._rz || 0) + simDt;
      if (g._rz > 1.6) {
        g._rz = 0;
        addFloat(g.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30, g.y - 50, "☢ -", "#a3e635");
      }
      if (g.g < CFG.farmGrow) g._ready = false;
      continue;
    }
    if (g.wet > 0) g.wet = Math.max(0, g.wet - simDt);
    g.g = Math.min(
      CFG.farmGrow,
      g.g + simDt * PLANETS[scene].grow * desFx().growMul * (1 + (g.wet > 0 ? 1.4 : 0)),
    );
    if (g.g >= CFG.farmGrow && !g._ready) {
      g._ready = true;
      sfx("harvest2");
      if (g.cov && g.shut) {
        toast(T("🌲 Mahsul hazır! Kalkan kapalı — <b>Q</b> ile aç, <b>F</b> ile hasat"));
        storyTrigger("readyShut");
      } else toast(T("🌲 Mahsul hazır! (F ile hasat)"));
    }
    if (g.g < CFG.farmGrow) g._ready = false;
  }

  updateEvent(simDt);
  updateMeteorFx(dt);
  updateParticles(dt);
  shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 36);
  flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt * 1.7);
  warp = Math.max(0, warp - dt * 1.3);

  updateStats();
  updateHud();
  if (!rocketOpen && !marketOpen && !repairOpen && !capOpen && !commOpen && !upgOpen && !paused) {
    const h = computeHint();
    $("hint").innerHTML = h;
    $("hint").classList.toggle("hidden", !h);
    $("hint").classList.toggle("inside", insideRocket);
    updateTouch(h);
  }
  $("ui").classList.toggle(
    "con-open",
    [
      "rocketScreen",
      "marketScreen",
      "bedScreen",
      "repairScreen",
      "capScreen",
      "commScreen",
      "upgScreen",
    ].some((id) => !$(id).classList.contains("hidden")),
  );
  $("ui").classList.toggle("comm-open", commOpen);
  $("ui").classList.toggle("wide-open", commOpen || upgOpen);
}

/* ============== HAVA DURUMU (ekran uzayı) ============== */
function drawWeather() {
  const w = PLANETS[scene].weather,
    t = performance.now() / 1000;
  ctx.save();
  if (stormFx.I > 0.003) {
    drawSandstorm();
    ctx.restore();
    return;
  }
  if (false) {
    const fl = 0.22 + 0.1 * Math.sin(t * 1.7);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(214,138,74," + fl.toFixed(3) + ")";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,204,150,.5)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.6;
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) {
      const sp = 380 + (i % 6) * 70;
      const x = ((i * 167 + t * sp) % (W + 360)) - 180,
        y = ((i * 89 + Math.sin(t * 3 + i) * 30) % (H + 40)) - 20;
      ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      ctx.lineTo(x - 120 - Math.sin(t * 2 + i) * 26, y + 8);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,225,180,.30)";
    for (let i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
      const x = ((i * 131 + t * (520 + (i % 5) * 80)) % (W + 60)) - 30,
        y = ((i * 97 + Math.sin(t * 4 + i) * 40) % (H + 30)) - 15;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x, y, 1.4 + (i % 3), 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  } else if (w === "rain") {
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(170,225,255,.34)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.8;
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
      const x = ((i * 149 + t * 90) % (W + 180)) - 90,
        y = ((i * 97 + t * 1500) % (H + 100)) - 50;
      ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      ctx.lineTo(x - 7, y + 20);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  } else if (w === "dust") {
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,205,150,.20)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.4;
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < 46; i++) {
      const x = ((i * 233 + t * (140 + (i % 5) * 40)) % (W + 300)) - 150,
        y = (i * 71) % (H + 40);
      ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      ctx.lineTo(x - 70 - Math.sin(t + i) * 20, y + 6);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  } else if (w === "ash") {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(120,90,60,.35)";
    for (let i = 0; i < 54; i++) {
      const x = ((i * 167 + Math.sin(t * 0.7 + i) * 40) % (W + 40)) - 20,
        y = (((i * 83 - t * 46) % (H + 40)) + H + 40) % (H + 40);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x, y, 1.6 + (i % 3), 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  } else if (w === "snow") {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.7)";
    for (let i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
      const x = ((i * 137 + Math.sin(t * 0.9 + i) * 36) % (W + 40)) - 20,
        y = (i * 89 + t * 70) % (H + 40);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x, y, 1.4 + (i % 3) * 0.8, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  } else if (w === "spark") {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,240,190,.55)";
    for (let i = 0; i < 34; i++) {
      const x = ((i * 211 + Math.sin(t * 1.3 + i) * 60) % (W + 40)) - 20,
        y = (((i * 97 - t * 30) % (H + 40)) + H + 40) % (H + 40);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x, y, 1.5 + (i % 2), 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    const fl = (Math.sin(t * 0.8) + Math.sin(t * 2.9) + Math.sin(t * 5.3)) / 3;
    if (fl > 0.72) {
      const a = Math.min(0.34, (fl - 0.72) * 2.4);
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + a + ")";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    }
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

/* ============== HARİTA (radar yerine) ============== */
let mapTex = null;
function buildMapTex() {
  const N = 1024,
    B = CFG.worldHalf,
    c = document.createElement("canvas");
  c.width = c.height = N;
  const g = c.getContext("2d");
  const S = PLANETS[scene],
    sc = N / (2 * B),
    r = rng(91);
  g.fillStyle = S.ground;
  g.fillRect(0, 0, N, N);
  // arazi tonları
  for (let i = 0; i < 2000; i++) {
    const x = r() * N,
      y = r() * N,
      rad = 6 + r() * 34;
    const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, rad);
    const light = r() < 0.5;
    gr.addColorStop(0, light ? "rgba(255,206,160,.09)" : "rgba(50,8,0,.12)");
    gr.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    g.fillStyle = gr;
    g.fillRect(x - rad, y - rad, rad * 2, rad * 2);
  }
  // eş yükselti çizgileri
  g.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,220,190,.07)";
  g.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let k = 0; k < 26; k++) {
    const cx = r() * N,
      cy = r() * N,
      base = 20 + r() * 60;
    for (let ring = 0; ring < 3; ring++) {
      g.beginPath();
      for (let a = 0; a <= 6.3; a += 0.25) {
        const rr = base + ring * 12 + Math.sin(a * 3 + k) * 8;
        const x = cx + Math.cos(a) * rr,
          y = cy + Math.sin(a) * rr * 0.8;
        a ? g.lineTo(x, y) : g.moveTo(x, y);
      }
      g.closePath();
      g.stroke();
    }
  }
  // dekor: krater, kaya, çatlak
  for (const d of decor[scene]) {
    const x = (d.x + B) * sc,
      y = (d.y + B) * sc,
      rad = Math.max(1.2, d.r * sc * 1.1);
    if (d.type === "crater") {
      g.fillStyle = "rgba(40,8,4,.35)";
      g.beginPath();
      g.arc(x, y, rad * 1.4, 0, 7);
      g.fill();
      g.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,200,160,.22)";
      g.lineWidth = 1;
      g.beginPath();
      g.arc(x - rad * 0.2, y - rad * 0.2, rad * 1.4, 3.6, 5.6);
      g.stroke();
    } else if (d.type === "rock") {
      g.fillStyle = "rgba(30,6,2,.45)";
      g.beginPath();
      g.arc(x, y, Math.max(1, rad * 0.6), 0, 7);
      g.fill();
    } else if (d.type === "crack") {
      g.strokeStyle = "rgba(30,6,2,.35)";
      g.lineWidth = 1;
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(x - rad, y);
      g.lineTo(x, y + rad * 0.4);
      g.lineTo(x + rad, y - rad * 0.2);
      g.stroke();
    }
  }
  // yer şekilleri
  if (scene === "mars") {
    if (!landmarks) landmarks = genLandmarks();
    for (const l of landmarks) {
      const x = (l.x + B) * sc,
        y = (l.y + B) * sc,
        rr = l.r * sc;
      g.fillStyle = {
        dunes: "rgba(255,200,150,.10)",
        basalt: "rgba(30,8,4,.30)",
        frost: "rgba(220,235,255,.32)",
        river: "rgba(40,10,4,.25)",
        layers: "rgba(255,190,140,.10)",
      }[l.type];
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(x, y, rr, rr * (l.type === "river" ? 0.25 : 0.7), l.ang, 0, 7);
      g.fill();
    }
  }
  // iniş platformu çevresi
  const rx = (ROCKET.x + B) * sc,
    ry = (ROCKET.y + B) * sc;
  g.fillStyle = "rgba(170,179,214,.18)";
  g.beginPath();
  g.arc(rx, ry + 58 * sc, 11, 0, 7);
  g.fill();
  mapTex = { c, scene, N };
}
function mapRocketIcon(x, y, s, broken, t) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.scale(s, s);
  const gl = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 14);
  gl.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,180,120,.55)");
  gl.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,140,66,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = gl;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, 14, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#d43d2d";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-3.5, 3);
  ctx.lineTo(-7, 9);
  ctx.lineTo(-3, 8);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(3.5, 3);
  ctx.lineTo(7, 9);
  ctx.lineTo(3, 8);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#f4f6fc";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, -11);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(5, -5, 4, 8);
  ctx.lineTo(-4, 8);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-5, -5, 0, -11);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#1b2140";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.1;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff8c42";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, -11);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(3, -8, 3.4, -6);
  ctx.lineTo(-3.4, -6);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-3, -8, 0, -11);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#3f8fd8";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, -1.5, 1.9, 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  if (!broken) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,190,90," + (0.7 + 0.3 * Math.sin(t * 14)) + ")";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-2, 8.5);
    ctx.lineTo(2, 8.5);
    ctx.lineTo(0, 12 + Math.sin(t * 20));
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
  if (broken)
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      const ph = (t * 0.6 + i * 0.25) % 1;
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(190,196,214," + 0.6 * (1 - ph) + ")";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x + 3 * s + ph * 6, y - 6 * s - ph * 16, 2 + ph * 4.5, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
    }
}
function drawMap() {
  if (!mapTex || mapTex.scene !== scene) buildMapTex();
  const t = performance.now() / 1000,
    B = CFG.worldHalf,
    N = mapTex.N;
  const MW = mapW(),
    MH = MW,
    mx = W - 16 - MW,
    my = 14,
    RANGE = 1700,
    sc = MW / RANGE;
  const toMap = (o) => ({ x: mx + MW / 2 + (o.x - p.x) * sc, y: my + MH / 2 + (o.y - p.y) * sc });
  ctx.save();
  // panel
  ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(0,0,0,.45)";
  ctx.shadowBlur = 18;
  ctx.shadowOffsetY = 6;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1024";
  rrp(mx - 5, my - 5, MW + 10, MH + 30, 14);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.shadowColor = "transparent";
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(90,209,255,.28)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  rrp(mx - 5, my - 5, MW + 10, MH + 30, 14);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.save();
  rrp(mx, my, MW, MH, 10);
  ctx.clip();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#120806";
  ctx.fillRect(mx, my, MW, MH);
  const px = ((p.x + B) / (2 * B)) * N,
    py = ((p.y + B) / (2 * B)) * N,
    sw = (RANGE / (2 * B)) * N;
  ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
  ctx.drawImage(mapTex.c, px - sw / 2, py - sw / 2, sw, sw, mx, my, MW, MH);
  // ızgara (250 birim)
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.07)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  const G = 250,
    gx0 = Math.ceil((p.x - RANGE / 2) / G) * G,
    gy0 = Math.ceil((p.y - RANGE / 2) / G) * G;
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let gx = gx0; gx < p.x + RANGE / 2; gx += G) {
    const X = toMap({ x: gx, y: 0 }).x;
    ctx.moveTo(X, my);
    ctx.lineTo(X, my + MH);
  }
  for (let gy = gy0; gy < p.y + RANGE / 2; gy += G) {
    const Y = toMap({ x: 0, y: gy }).y;
    ctx.moveTo(mx, Y);
    ctx.lineTo(mx + MW, Y);
  }
  ctx.stroke();
  // dünya sınırı
  const b0 = toMap({ x: -B, y: -B }),
    b1 = toMap({ x: B, y: B });
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,90,90,.6)";
  ctx.setLineDash([4, 3]);
  ctx.strokeRect(b0.x, b0.y, b1.x - b0.x, b1.y - b0.y);
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  // tarlalar
  for (const pl of farmArr()) {
    const q = toMap(pl);
    const ready = pl.g >= CFG.farmGrow,
      grow = pl.g > 0;
    ctx.fillStyle = ready ? "#ffd34d" : grow ? "#4ade80" : "#7a4a2a";
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.55)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    if (ready) {
      ctx.shadowColor = "#ffd34d";
      ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
    }
    rrp(q.x - 3.5, q.y - 3.5, 7, 7, 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    if (grow && !ready) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#bbf7d0";
      ctx.fillRect(q.x - 0.6, q.y - 2.6, 1.2, 4);
    }
  }
  // numuneler (metal elmas) + yıldız düşüşleri
  for (const st of stones) {
    if (st.taken) continue;
    const q = toMap(st);
    if (q.x < mx - 4 || q.x > mx + MW + 4 || q.y < my - 4 || q.y > my + MH + 4) continue;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#d7deee";
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(20,24,40,.8)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(q.x, q.y - 3.2);
    ctx.lineTo(q.x + 2.6, q.y);
    ctx.lineTo(q.x, q.y + 3.2);
    ctx.lineTo(q.x - 2.6, q.y);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (const n of rareNodes) {
    if (n.taken) continue;
    const dd = Math.hypot(n.x - p.x, n.y - p.y);
    if (dd > 1100 && !game.rareKnown[n.kind]) continue;
    if (dd > 1700) continue;
    const q = toMap(n),
      kn = game.rareKnown[n.kind],
      D = RARE_DEF[n.kind];
    const pu = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * 4 + n.seed);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(q.x, q.y);
    if (kn) {
      ctx.fillStyle = D.glow;
      ctx.shadowColor = D.glow;
      ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, -4);
      ctx.lineTo(3.4, 0);
      ctx.lineTo(0, 4);
      ctx.lineTo(-3.4, 0);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    } else {
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(185,168,255," + (0.4 + 0.6 * pu) + ")";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, 4 + pu * 3, 0, 7);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#d8ccff";
      ctx.font = "800 8px monospace";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.fillText("?", 0, 3);
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
  for (const d of drops) {
    if (d.taken) continue;
    const q = toMap(d);
    if (d.type === "star") {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd34d";
      ctx.shadowColor = "#ffd34d";
      ctx.shadowBlur = 6 + 3 * Math.sin(t * 5);
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
        const a = (k * Math.PI) / 4 - Math.PI / 2,
          rr = k % 2 ? 1.6 : 4.6;
        ctx.lineTo(q.x + Math.cos(a) * rr, q.y + Math.sin(a) * rr);
      }
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    } else if (d.type === "gold") {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffc93c";
      ctx.shadowColor = "#ffc93c";
      ctx.shadowBlur = 5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(q.x, q.y, 2.6, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#d7deee";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(q.x, q.y, 2.4, 0, 7);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  // meteorlar
  for (const m of ev.meteors) {
    const q = toMap(m),
      k = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * 12);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,120,60," + (0.6 + 0.4 * k) + ")";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(q.x, q.y, 4 + k * 3, 0, 7);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffcc66";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(q.x, q.y, 2, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  // roket (harita içinde ya da kenarda ok)
  const broken = game.repair.state !== "ok",
    rq = toMap(ROCKET);
  const inside = rq.x > mx + 8 && rq.x < mx + MW - 8 && rq.y > my + 8 && rq.y < my + MH - 8;
  if (inside) mapRocketIcon(rq.x, rq.y, 1, broken, t);
  // oyuncu: görüş konisi + ok
  const hd = p.hd != null ? p.hd : p.dir > 0 ? 0 : Math.PI,
    cx0 = mx + MW / 2,
    cy0 = my + MH / 2;
  const cg = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx0, cy0, 2, cx0, cy0, 34);
  cg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(90,209,255,.35)");
  cg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(90,209,255,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = cg;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx0, cy0);
  ctx.arc(cx0, cy0, 34, hd - 0.55, hd + 0.55);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(cx0, cy0);
  ctx.rotate(hd + Math.PI / 2);
  ctx.shadowColor = "#5ad1ff";
  ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#5ad1ff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, -7.5);
  ctx.lineTo(5.5, 6);
  ctx.lineTo(0, 3);
  ctx.lineTo(-5.5, 6);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#fff";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
  // fırtına: sinyal paraziti
  const SI = Math.min(1, stormFx.I);
  if (SI > 0.02) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(170,96,50," + 0.55 * SI + ")";
    ctx.fillRect(mx, my, MW, MH);
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.round(160 * SI); i++) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,226,190," + Math.random() * 0.5 * SI + ")";
      ctx.fillRect(mx + Math.random() * MW, my + Math.random() * MH, 2, 1);
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const yy = my + ((t * 90 + i * 61) % MH);
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,226,190," + 0.12 * SI + ")";
      ctx.fillRect(mx, yy, MW, 2);
    }
    if (SI > 0.5 && Math.sin(t * 6) > -0.3) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,236,210,.9)";
      ctx.font = "800 10px ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.fillText(T("SİNYAL ZAYIF"), mx + MW / 2, my + MH / 2 + 30);
    }
  }
  // kenar vinyeti
  const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(
    mx + MW / 2,
    my + MH / 2,
    MW * 0.35,
    mx + MW / 2,
    my + MH / 2,
    MW * 0.75,
  );
  vg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
  vg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,.45)");
  ctx.fillStyle = vg;
  ctx.fillRect(mx, my, MW, MH);
  ctx.restore(); // klip
  // roket ekran dışındaysa kenar oku
  if (!inside) {
    const ang = Math.atan2(rq.y - (my + MH / 2), rq.x - (mx + MW / 2)),
      R = MW / 2 - 11;
    const ex = mx + MW / 2 + Math.cos(ang) * R,
      ey = my + MH / 2 + Math.sin(ang) * R,
      dist = Math.round(Math.hypot(ROCKET.x - p.x, ROCKET.y - p.y) / 10);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(11,16,36,.85)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ex, ey, 10, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#ff8c42";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.stroke();
    mapRocketIcon(ex, ey, 0.55, broken, t);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(ex, ey);
    ctx.rotate(ang);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ff8c42";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(15, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(10, -4);
    ctx.lineTo(10, 4);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd2a8";
    ctx.font = "700 9px ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText(dist + "m", ex, ey + (Math.sin(ang) > 0 ? -14 : 20));
  }
  // çerçeve + başlık + pusula + ölçek
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(90,209,255,.45)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
  rrp(mx, my, MW, MH, 10);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(11,16,36,.85)";
  rrp(mx + MW / 2 - 11, my - 2, 22, 15, 6);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff8c42";
  ctx.font = "800 10px 'Segoe UI',sans-serif";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillText("K", mx + MW / 2, my + 9);
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#8d9cc0";
  ctx.font = "800 9.5px ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace";
  ctx.fillText(T("HARİTA · ") + PLANETS[scene].name.toLocaleUpperCase("tr-TR"), mx + 2, my + MH + 16);
  const sb = Math.round(250 * sc);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#cdd6f0";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(mx + MW - sb - 2, my + MH + 12);
  ctx.lineTo(mx + MW - 2, my + MH + 12);
  ctx.moveTo(mx + MW - sb - 2, my + MH + 9);
  ctx.lineTo(mx + MW - sb - 2, my + MH + 15);
  ctx.moveTo(mx + MW - 2, my + MH + 9);
  ctx.lineTo(mx + MW - 2, my + MH + 15);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.textAlign = "right";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#cdd6f0";
  ctx.fillText("25 m", mx + MW - sb - 6, my + MH + 16);
  ctx.restore();
}

/* ============== TOPRAK RADYASYONU · ÇÜRÜYEN HASAT · RADYASYON ÖLÇER ==============
   Mars toprağında radyoaktif mineral damarları var. Radyasyonu yüksek toprağa
   ekilen patatesler hasatta çürük çıkar. Oyuncu çürüyen hasadı Dünya'ya bildirir,
   numuneyi kapsülle yörüngedeki laboratuvara gönderir, analiz sonucunda
   radyasyon ölçeri (DZ-7) alır ve güvenli toprağı ölçerek bulur. */
const SOIL_SAFE = 1.0; // µSv/h altı güvenli
function _sh(ix, iy) {
  let h = (Math.imul(ix, 374761393) + Math.imul(iy, 668265263)) | 0;
  h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 13), 1274126177);
  h ^= h >>> 16;
  return (h >>> 0) / 4294967296;
}
function _vn(x, y, c) {
  const gx = x / c,
    gy = y / c,
    ix = Math.floor(gx),
    iy = Math.floor(gy),
    fx = gx - ix,
    fy = gy - iy,
    sx = fx * fx * (3 - 2 * fx),
    sy = fy * fy * (3 - 2 * fy);
  const a = _sh(ix, iy),
    b = _sh(ix + 1, iy),
    d = _sh(ix, iy + 1),
    e = _sh(ix + 1, iy + 1),
    t = a + (b - a) * sx;
  return t + (d + (e - d) * sx - t) * sy;
}
function soilRad01(x, y) {
  // her yere serpiştirilmiş: yeşil, sarı ve kırmızı noktalar iç içe (~%40 normal)
  let v = 0.62 * _vn(x, y, 90) + 0.38 * _vn(x + 5000, y - 3000, 38);
  v = (v - 0.5) * 2.2 + 0.43;
  return Math.max(0.02, Math.min(1, v));
}
const radUSv = (r) => 0.15 + r * 2.85;
function plotRadUSv(pl) {
  if (pl.rad == null) pl.rad = soilRad01(pl.x, pl.y);
  return radUSv(pl.rad);
}
function soilUSvAt(x, y) {
  const pl = farmArr().find((q) => Math.hypot(q.x - x, q.y - y) < 60);
  return pl ? plotRadUSv(pl) : radUSv(soilRad01(x, y));
}
const radLevel = (u) => (u < SOIL_SAFE ? 0 : u < 2 ? 1 : 2);
const RAD_LV = [
  ["NORMAL", "#4ade80", T("Ekim için uygun")],
  [T("DİKKAT"), "#fbbf24", T("Patates çürür")],
  [T("YÜKSEK"), "#ff5d5d", T("Patates çürür")],
];
const plotRots = (pl) => plotRadUSv(pl) >= SOIL_SAFE;

/* ---------- çürük hasat ---------- */
function harvestRot(pl) {
  game.inventory.rotten = (game.inventory.rotten || 0) + 1; // çürük yumrudan tohum çıkmaz
  burst(pl.x, pl.y, 26, "#4a3a22", { sp: 120, life: 0.9, size: 5, up: 50 });
  burst(pl.x, pl.y - 10, 14, "#7d8a3a", { sp: 50, life: 1.6, size: 3, up: 26 });
  addFloat(pl.x, pl.y - 38, T("Patatesler çürümüş!"), "#d6c08a");
  sfx("error");
  noiseBurst(0.3, 0.1, 520);
  tone(196, 0.35, "sawtooth", 0.05, 140, 0.05);
  shake = Math.max(shake, 2);
  const first = !(game.qstats.rotSeen > 0);
  storyTrigger("rot");
  bumpQuest("rotSeen");
  bumpQuest("harvested");
  commsObs("rot", { n: 1 });
  updateInv();
  if (first)
    setTimeout(
      () =>
        toast(
          T(
            "Patatesler çürük çıktı, bir tanesi çantanda. Roketteki <b>kargo terminalinden</b> Dünya'ya gönder, incelesinler.",
          ),
        ),
      900,
    );
  else
    toast(
      game.radLearned
        ? T("Bu toprak radyasyonlu, patatesler yine çürüdü. Ekmeden önce radyasyon ölçerle ölç")
        : T("Patatesler yine çürüdü"),
    );
  setTimeout(() => toast(T("🥀 Çürük yumrudan tohum çıkmaz — tohumu kaybettin")), first ? 4200 : 2600);
}

/* ---------- ölçüm ---------- */
let radM = null;
const cam = { z: 1, ox: 0, oy: 0 };
function startMeasure(wx, wy) {
  if (radM || !game) return;
  if (Math.hypot(wx - p.x, wy - p.y) > CFG.digRange) {
    sfx("error");
    toast(T("Çok uzak — ölçmek istediğin yere biraz yaklaş"));
    return;
  }
  if (Math.hypot(wx - ROCKET.x, wy - ROCKET.y) < 170) {
    sfx("error");
    toast(T("İniş platformu metal — ölçümü toprak üzerinde yap"));
    return;
  }
  const u = soilUSvAt(wx, wy);
  radM = { x: wx, y: wy, t: 0, T: 5.2, u, lv: radLevel(u), clk: 0.3, disp: 0, hist: [], done: false, cpm: 0 };
  p.dir = wx < p.x ? -1 : 1;
  tone(1200, 0.05, "square", 0.05);
  tone(1600, 0.07, "square", 0.04, 0, 0.08);
  tone(2100, 0.05, "sine", 0.04, 0, 0.16);
  radUIOpen();
}
function geigerClick() {
  noiseBurst(0.012, 0.26, 3600);
}
function updateMeasure(dt) {
  const m = radM;
  const want = m ? { z: 1.8, ox: (m.x - p.x) * 0.55, oy: (m.y - p.y) * 0.55 - 14 } : { z: 1, ox: 0, oy: 0 };
  const k = 1 - Math.exp(-dt * (m ? 3.6 : 4.5));
  if (!m) return;
  cam.z += (want.z - cam.z) * k;
  cam.ox += (want.ox - cam.ox) * k;
  cam.oy += (want.oy - cam.oy) * k;
  m.t += dt;
  const scan = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (m.t - 0.8) / 2.7));
  m.scan = scan;
  if (m.t > 0.7 && m.t < m.T - 0.5) {
    const rate = 1.2 + m.u * 8.5 * (scan < 1 ? 0.35 + 0.65 * scan : 1);
    m.clk -= dt;
    while (m.clk <= 0) {
      m.clk += -Math.log(Math.random() + 1e-6) / rate;
      geigerClick();
      m.hist.push(m.t);
      const a = Math.random() * 6.283,
        r = Math.random() * 38;
      burst(
        m.x + Math.cos(a) * r,
        m.y + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.5,
        1,
        m.lv === 0 ? "#b8ffcf" : m.lv === 1 ? "#ffe08a" : "#ff9a8a",
        { sp: 14, life: 0.55, size: 2.6, up: 90 },
      );
    }
  }
  m.hist = m.hist.filter((h) => m.t - h < 3.2);
  const tgt = m.u * (scan < 1 ? 0.25 + 0.75 * scan : 1);
  m.disp += (tgt * (1 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5 * (1 - scan)) - m.disp) * Math.min(1, dt * 7);
  if (scan >= 1) m.disp += (m.u - m.disp) * Math.min(1, dt * 10);
  m.cpm = Math.round(m.disp * 148 + (scan < 1 ? (Math.random() - 0.5) * 12 : 0));
  if (scan >= 1 && !m.done) {
    m.done = true;
    m.disp = m.u;
    finishMeasure(m);
  }
  radUIUpdate(m);
  if (m.t >= m.T) {
    radM = null;
    radUIClose();
  }
}
function finishMeasure(m) {
  const L = RAD_LV[m.lv];
  if (!Array.isArray(game.radMarks)) game.radMarks = [];
  const near = game.radMarks.find((q) => Math.hypot(q.x - m.x, q.y - m.y) < 90);
  if (near) Object.assign(near, { x: m.x, y: m.y, u: m.u, t: game.worldTime });
  else {
    game.radMarks.push({ x: m.x, y: m.y, u: m.u, t: game.worldTime });
    if (game.radMarks.length > 24) game.radMarks.shift();
    bumpQuest("measured");
  }
  m.born = performance.now() / 1000;
  burst(m.x, m.y, 22, L[1], { sp: 130, life: 0.8, size: 4, up: 60 });
  if (m.lv === 0) {
    tone(880, 0.12, "sine", 0.08);
    tone(1320, 0.2, "sine", 0.07, 0, 0.12);
    tone(1760, 0.25, "triangle", 0.05, 0, 0.26);
  } else if (m.lv === 1) {
    tone(520, 0.14, "triangle", 0.07);
    tone(520, 0.14, "triangle", 0.07, 0, 0.22);
  } else [0, 0.16, 0.32].forEach((d) => tone(330, 0.12, "square", 0.06, 0, d));
  setTimeout(() => {
    if (!game) return;
    toast(
      m.lv === 0
        ? T("<b>Güvenli toprak</b> (") +
            fmtN(m.u, 2) +
            T(" µSv/h) — buraya kazıp patates ekebilirsin. Yeşil bayrak yeri işaretliyor.")
        : T("Bu toprakta patates çürür (") +
            fmtN(m.u, 2) +
            T(" µSv/h). <b>1,0 µSv/h altını</b> ara — biraz uzaklaşıp yeniden ölç."),
    );
  }, 700);
}
function unlockMeter() {
  if (!game || game.radLearned) return;
  game.radLearned = true;
  game.meterOwned = true;
  updateInv();
  bumpQuest("rotAnalysis");
  storyTrigger("rotLearn");
  sfx("star");
  setTimeout(
    () =>
      toast(T("Toprağı ölçmek için <b>radyasyon ölçeri</b> makine dairesindeki <b>alet sandığından</b> al.")),
    600,
  );
}

/* ---------- dünya çizimi: tarama efekti + ölçüm bayrakları ---------- */
function drawRadMarks(vis) {
  {
    const n = performance.now() / 1000;
    drawMarkFx(Math.min(0.05, n - (drawRadMarks._t || n)));
    drawRadMarks._t = n;
  }
  const M = game.radMarks;
  if (!Array.isArray(M) || !M.length) return;
  const t = performance.now() / 1000;
  for (const mk of M) {
    if (!vis(mk)) continue;
    const L = RAD_LV[radLevel(mk.u)],
      x = mk.x,
      y = mk.y;
    ctx.fillStyle = L[1] + "33";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, 26, 12, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = L[1] + "99";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
    ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, 26, 12, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.3)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x + 2, y + 1, 4, 2, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#d7dce8";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, y);
    ctx.lineTo(x, y - 42);
    ctx.stroke();
    const w = Math.sin(t * 3 + x * 0.01) * 2.5;
    ctx.fillStyle = L[1];
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + 1, y - 42);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + 10, y - 40 + w, x + 19, y - 36 + w * 0.6);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + 10, y - 32 + w, x + 1, y - 30);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y - 43, 2, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    if (Math.hypot(p.x - x, p.y - y) < 300) {
      const s = fmtN(mk.u, 2) + " µSv/h";
      ctx.font = "700 11px ui-monospace,monospace";
      const tw = ctx.measureText(s).width;
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(8,10,18,.75)";
      rr(x - tw / 2 - 6, y - 64, tw + 12, 16, 5, "rgba(8,10,18,.75)");
      ctx.fillStyle = L[1];
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.fillText(s, x, y - 52);
      ctx.textAlign = "left";
    }
  }
}
function drawRadScan() {
  const m = radM;
  if (!m) return;
  const t = performance.now() / 1000,
    x = m.x,
    y = m.y,
    sc = m.scan || 0;
  const col = m.done ? RAD_LV[m.lv][1] : "#7fe7ff";
  const intro = Math.min(1, m.t / 0.6),
    out = m.t > m.T - 0.6 ? Math.max(0, (m.T - m.t) / 0.6) : 1,
    A = intro * out;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = A;
  // zemin ızgarası
  ctx.strokeStyle = col + "55";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let i = -3; i <= 3; i++) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x - 60, y + i * 8);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 60, y + i * 8);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + i * 18, y - 26);
    ctx.lineTo(x + i * 18, y + 26);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  // genişleyen halkalar
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const ph = (t * 0.9 + i / 3) % 1;
    ctx.strokeStyle = col;
    ctx.globalAlpha = A * (1 - ph) * 0.8;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, 14 + ph * 70, (14 + ph * 70) * 0.48, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = A;
  // radar süpürmesi
  if (!m.done) {
    const a0 = t * 4.2;
    ctx.fillStyle = col + "40";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, y);
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, 64, 31, 0, a0, a0 + 0.7);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }
  // nişangah
  ctx.strokeStyle = col;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(x, y, 64, 31, 0, 0, 7);
  ctx.stroke();
  for (const [dx, dy] of [
    [-1, 0],
    [1, 0],
    [0, -1],
    [0, 1],
  ]) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + dx * 56, y + dy * 27);
    ctx.lineTo(x + dx * 72, y + dy * 35);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  // ilerleme yayı
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.strokeStyle = col;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(x, y, 76, 37, 0, -Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2 + sc * 6.283);
  ctx.stroke();
  // sonuç ışıması
  if (m.done) {
    const pu = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * 6);
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 4, x, y, 70);
    g.addColorStop(0, col + "aa");
    g.addColorStop(1, col + "00");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.globalAlpha = A * (0.6 + 0.4 * pu);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, 70, 34, 0, 0, 7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = A;
  }
  // cihazdan toprağa ışın
  const hx = p.x + p.dir * 24,
    hy = p.y - 16;
  const g2 = ctx.createLinearGradient(hx, hy, x, y);
  g2.addColorStop(0, col + "ee");
  g2.addColorStop(1, col + "22");
  ctx.strokeStyle = g2;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.4;
  ctx.setLineDash([7, 6]);
  ctx.lineDashOffset = -t * 60;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(hx, hy);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo((hx + x) / 2, Math.min(hy, y) - 30, x, y);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  ctx.fillStyle = col;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(hx, hy, 3 + Math.sin(t * 12), 0, 7);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

/* ---------- cihaz arayüzü (HTML) ---------- */
function radUIOpen() {
  const el = $("radUI");
  el.querySelector(".rd-scr").style.color = "";
  el.classList.remove("hidden", "rd-close", "lv0", "lv1", "lv2");
  void el.offsetWidth;
  el.classList.add("rd-open");
  $("rdSt").innerHTML = T("Prob toprağa hizalanıyor…");
  $("rdVal").textContent = fmtN(0, 2);
  $("rdCpm").textContent = "0 CPM";
  $("rdLoc").textContent = "X " + Math.round(radM.x / 8) + " · Y " + Math.round(-radM.y / 8);
  $("rdHist").innerHTML = Array.from({ length: 28 }, () => "<i></i>").join("");
}
function radUIUpdate(m) {
  const el = $("radUI");
  if (!el) return;
  const fr = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, m.disp) / 3);
  $("rdNeedle").setAttribute("transform", "rotate(" + (-135 + fr * 270).toFixed(1) + " 60 60)");
  $("rdArc").setAttribute("stroke-dasharray", (fr * 179.1).toFixed(1) + " 238.8");
  if (!m.done)
    $("radUI").querySelector(".rd-scr").style.color = ["#4ade80", "#fbbf24", "#ff5d5d"][radLevel(m.disp)];
  $("rdVal").textContent = fmtN(Math.max(0, m.disp), 2);
  $("rdMark").style.left = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, m.disp) / 3) * 100 + "%";
  {
    const lv = radLevel(m.disp);
    ["rdZ0", "rdZ1", "rdZ2"].forEach((id, i) => $(id).classList.toggle("on", i === lv));
  }
  $("rdCpm").textContent = Math.max(0, m.cpm) + " CPM";
  const bars = $("rdHist").children,
    N = bars.length;
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    const t0 = m.t - (N - i) * 0.11,
      c = m.hist.filter((h) => h >= t0 && h < t0 + 0.11).length;
    bars[i].style.height = Math.min(100, 8 + c * 30) + "%";
  }
  $("rdLed").classList.toggle("on", m.hist.length && m.t - m.hist[m.hist.length - 1] < 0.06);
  if (!m.done) {
    const s = m.scan || 0;
    $("rdSt").innerHTML =
      s <= 0 ? T("Prob toprağa hizalanıyor…") : Tf(`Ölçülüyor… <b>%{0}</b>`, [Math.round(s * 100)]);
    $("rdBar").style.width = s * 100 + "%";
  } else if (!el.classList.contains("lv" + m.lv)) {
    const L = RAD_LV[m.lv];
    el.classList.add("lv" + m.lv);
    el.querySelector(".rd-scr").style.color = "";
    $("rdBar").style.width = "100%";
    $("rdSt").innerHTML = Tf(
      `<span class="rd-vd"><b>RADYASYON {0}</b><small>{1} µSv/h · {2}</small></span>`,
      [L[0], fmtN(m.u, 2), L[2]],
    );
  }
}
function radUIClose() {
  const el = $("radUI");
  el.classList.remove("rd-open");
  el.classList.add("rd-close");
  setTimeout(() => {
    if (!radM) el.classList.add("hidden");
  }, 420);
}

/* ---------- Dünya ile yazışma: numune talebi + laboratuvar raporu ---------- */
function rotAnalysisMsg(wt) {
  const C = commState(),
    no = "GK-" + pad3(C.seq.msg++);
  const body = Tf(
    `<p>Komutan,</p>
  <p>Gönderdiğin çürük patatesi inceledik. Mikrop ya da aşırı sulama izi yok. Neden <b>toprağın radyasyonu</b>: patatesin ekildiği yer yüksek radyasyonlu.</p>
  <div class="ltr-dir"><b>NE YAPMALI?</b><ol>
    <li>Roketteki alet sandığından <b>radyasyon ölçeri</b> al.</li>
    <li>Ekmeden önce toprağı ölç: ölçeri eline al ve toprağa <b>sol tıkla</b>.</li>
    <li>Ekranda <b>RADYASYON NORMAL</b> yazan yere ek. Yüksek çıkan yerde patates çürür.</li></ol></div>
  <div class="ltr-scale"><span style="flex:1;background:#4ade80">0 – 1,0 NORMAL</span><span style="flex:1;background:#fbbf24">1,0 – 2,0 DİKKAT</span><span style="flex:1;background:#ff5d5d">2,0+ YÜKSEK</span></div>`,
    [],
  );
  return {
    id: no,
    t: wt,
    kind: "lab",
    subject: T("Çürük patates analizi"),
    from: SIG.bio[0],
    read: false,
    html: letter({ no, wt, subject: T("Çürük patates analizi"), body, signers: ["bio"], cc: ["fd"] }),
  };
}
function sendRotCargo() {
  const C = commState();
  if (C.flags.capsAt && !C.flags.ana) {
    sfx("error");
    toast(T("Önceki kargo hâlâ inceleniyor — Dünya'nın cevabını bekle"));
    return;
  }
  if ((game.inventory.rotten || 0) < 1) {
    sfx("error");
    toast(T("Çantanda çürük patates yok"));
    return;
  }
  game.inventory.rotten--;
  updateInv();
  C.flags.capsAt = game.worldTime;
  C.flags.ana = false;
  C.flags.anaAt = game.worldTime + DAY_SECONDS * 0.05;
  bumpQuest("rotSample");
  tone(523, 0.1, "triangle", 0.07);
  tone(784, 0.14, "triangle", 0.07, 0, 0.1);
  noiseBurst(0.4, 0.08, 1400, 0.15);
  toast(T("Çürük patates kargoyla Dünya'ya gönderildi. Cevap birazdan gelen kutunda."));
  if (marketOpen) openMarket();
}
/* ============== ÇİZİM ============== */
function draw() {
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  if (mode !== "play") {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    return;
  }
  if (insideRocket) {
    ctx.save();
    if (shake > 0)
      ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shake * SHK(), (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake * SHK());
    drawInterior();
    ctx.restore();
    drawSleepOverlay();
    drawWakeOverlay();
    if (fly) drawFlyOverlay();
    return;
  }
  const S = PLANETS[scene],
    z = ((CFG.zoom * Math.min(W, H)) / 700) * cam.z;
  const vr = Math.hypot(W, H) / 2 / z + 140;
  const vis = (o) => Math.abs(o.x - p.x - cam.ox) < vr && Math.abs(o.y - p.y - cam.oy) < vr;

  ctx.save();
  if (shake > 0) ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shake * SHK(), (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake * SHK());

  // zemin + ışıklandırma her zaman ekranı doldurur (kamera oyuncuyu izler)
  ctx.fillStyle = S.ground;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  const lg = ctx.createRadialGradient(
    W / 2,
    H / 2,
    Math.min(W, H) * 0.08,
    W / 2,
    H / 2,
    Math.max(W, H) * 0.72,
  );
  lg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,.12)");
  lg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,.36)");
  ctx.fillStyle = lg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(W / 2, H / 2);
  ctx.scale(z, z);
  ctx.translate(-p.x - cam.ox, -p.y - cam.oy);

  // hafif yıldız (havasız gövdeler)
  if (S.air) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.28)";
    for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
      const sx = p.x + ((i * 97) % 2000) - 1000,
        sy = p.y + ((i * 173) % 1600) - 800;
      ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, 1.6, 1.6);
    }
  }
  ctx.strokeStyle = S.dot;
  ctx.fillStyle = S.dot;
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  drawLandmarks(vis);
  for (const c of decor[scene]) {
    if (vis(c)) drawDecor(c);
  }
  drawGroundDrift();
  drawCraters(vis);

  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.5)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 10;
  const B = CFG.worldHalf + 50;
  ctx.strokeRect(-B, -B, B * 2, B * 2);

  const fa = farmArr();
  fa.forEach((pl, i) => {
    if (vis(pl)) drawPlot(pl, fa[i]);
  });
  drawRadMarks(vis);
  drawRadScan();
  for (const st of stones) if (!st.taken && vis(st)) drawStone(st);
  for (const d of drops) if (!d.taken && vis(d)) drawDrop(d);
  {
    const tt = performance.now() / 1000;
    for (const n of rareNodes) if ((!n.taken || (n.fadeEnd && n.fadeEnd > tt)) && vis(n)) drawRare(n, tt);
    for (const n of rareNodes) if (n.split && vis(n)) drawRareCore(n, tt);
    drawDevils(tt);
  }
  for (const m of ev.meteors) if (vis(m)) drawMeteor(m);

  drawRocket(ROCKET.x, ROCKET.y);
  drawParticles();
  drawAstroGrav(p.x, p.y, p.z || 0, p._running, heldItemKey(), p.actionT);
  drawMeteorSky();
  ctx.restore();

  // atmosfer tonlaması
  ctx.fillStyle = S.atmo;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  drawAtmosphere();
  drawWeather();
  if (mflash > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,240,215," + Math.min(0.8, mflash) * (settings.noflash ? 0.25 : 1) + ")";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }
  if (game.o2 < 25 && scene !== "earth") {
    // düşük oksijen: kararan, nefes gibi atan kenarlar
    const q = 1 - game.o2 / 25,
      pu = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(performance.now() / (game.o2 <= 0 ? 160 : 380));
    const og = ctx.createRadialGradient(
      W / 2,
      H / 2,
      Math.min(W, H) * (0.38 - 0.18 * q),
      W / 2,
      H / 2,
      Math.max(W, H) * 0.75,
    );
    og.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,20,40,0)");
    og.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,18,40," + Math.min(0.85, (0.35 + 0.35 * pu) * q) + ")");
    ctx.fillStyle = og;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }
  if (game.radiationActive && !insideRocket) {
    // radyasyon: yeşil ekran + kenarlarda yoğun ışıma + parazit
    const tt = performance.now() / 1000,
      pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(tt * 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(70,210,70," + (0.13 + 0.05 * pulse) + ")";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(
      W / 2,
      H / 2,
      Math.min(W, H) * 0.3,
      W / 2,
      H / 2,
      Math.max(W, H) * 0.75,
    );
    rg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(120,255,90,0)");
    rg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(60,200,40," + (0.38 + 0.14 * pulse) + ")");
    ctx.fillStyle = rg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(190,255,160,.35)";
    for (let i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
      ctx.fillRect(Math.random() * W, Math.random() * H, 1.6, 1.6);
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(170,255,140,.06)";
    const sy = (tt * 120) % H;
    ctx.fillRect(0, sy, W, 3);
  }

  // vinyet
  const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(
    W / 2,
    H / 2,
    Math.min(W, H) * 0.34,
    W / 2,
    H / 2,
    Math.max(W, H) * 0.78,
  );
  vg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
  vg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,.46)");
  ctx.fillStyle = vg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  drawStoryArrow(z);
  drawQuestRocketMark(z);
  if (cam.z > 1.02) {
    const q = Math.min(1, (cam.z - 1) / 0.8);
    const sg = ctx.createRadialGradient(
      W / 2,
      H / 2,
      Math.min(W, H) * 0.22,
      W / 2,
      H / 2,
      Math.max(W, H) * 0.7,
    );
    sg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    sg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,8,14," + 0.55 * q + ")");
    ctx.fillStyle = sg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }

  // düşük can uyarısı
  if (game.hp < 35) {
    const a = (0.16 + 0.12 * Math.sin(performance.now() / 300)) * (1 - game.hp / 35);
    const rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(
      W / 2,
      H / 2,
      Math.min(W, H) * 0.25,
      W / 2,
      H / 2,
      Math.max(W, H) * 0.7,
    );
    rg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,0,0,0)");
    rg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,40,40," + Math.min(0.6, a) + ")");
    ctx.fillStyle = rg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }
  // hasar flaşı
  if (flash > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,60,60," + flash * 0.4 * (settings.noflash ? 0.35 : 1) + ")";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }

  ctx.restore(); // shake

  drawMap();

  // gezegen geçiş efekti
  if (warp > 0) {
    const a = Math.min(1, warp * 1.5);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + a * 0.9 + ")";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    for (let i = 0; i < 54; i++) {
      const ang = (i / 54) * 6.283 + (1 - warp) * 2;
      const r1 = Math.hypot(W, H) * 0.55 * (1.05 - warp * 0.85),
        r0 = r1 * 0.45;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(W / 2 + Math.cos(ang) * r0, H / 2 + Math.sin(ang) * r0);
      ctx.lineTo(W / 2 + Math.cos(ang) * r1, H / 2 + Math.sin(ang) * r1);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(215,240,255," + a * 0.55 + ")";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // roket yolculuk animasyonu (her şeyin üstünde)
  if (fly) drawFlyOverlay();
}

/* ============== DÖNGÜ ============== */
let last = performance.now(),
  lastDraw = 0,
  acc = 0;
function loop(now) {
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  const interval = 1000 / Math.max(20, settings.fps || 60);
  let dt = (now - last) / 1000;
  last = now;
  if (dt > 0.25) dt = 0.25;
  acc += dt;
  if (now - lastDraw < interval - 1) return;
  lastDraw = now;
  const step = Math.min(acc, 0.05);
  acc = 0;
  if (mode === "menu") {
    drawMenuBg();
    return;
  }
  if (mode === "intro") {
    updateIntro(step);
    drawIntro();
    return;
  }
  syncLooks();
  if (mode === "play") {
    if (fly) updateFly(step);
    else if (!paused && !bookOpen) {
      updateStory(step);
      update(step * storySlow());
    } // kitap açıkken zaman durur
    draw();
  }
}
resize();
refreshContinueButton();
applySettingsToUI();
requestAnimationFrame(loop);

</script>
</body>
</html>
